project.name: opencode
project.description: The open source AI coding agent — AI-powered development tool. Bun workspace monorepo: Effect-based CLI/TUI agent (packages/opencode), SolidJS web app (packages/app), Astro docs + share site (packages/web), shared UI library (packages/ui), generated TS SDK (packages/sdk/js), shared core utilities (packages/core).

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Foundation CI container image based on Ubuntu 24.04 that installs common build tools and utilities (build-essential, curl, git, jq, openssh-client, pkg-config, python3, unzip, zip). It is the root of the layered ghcr.io/anomalyco/build/* image chain that every other container in packages/containers builds on.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses apt-get with --no-install-recommends plus immediate /var/lib/apt/lists cleanup to keep the shared base image small, since every downstream CI image inherits these layers.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: CI container image that layers Node.js 24 and Bun on top of the build/base image, detecting the CPU architecture at build time to fetch the matching linux-x64/arm64 Node tarball and enabling corepack. Published as ghcr.io/anomalyco/build/bun-node:24.04, the standard image for GitHub Actions jobs in this monorepo.
nodes.languageNotes: The BUN_VERSION build-arg is fed from the root package.json packageManager field by packages/containers/script/build.ts, keeping the image's Bun version in lockstep with the monorepo. A uname -m based arch mapping keeps a single Dockerfile valid for multi-platform buildx builds.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Release CI container image that adds the Docker CLI (docker.io) and pacman-package-manager (AUR tooling) on top of build/bun-node. Backs release jobs that push multi-arch container images to GHCR and maintain Arch Linux AUR packages, mirroring the steps of the publish workflow.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: CI container image that installs the stable Rust toolchain via rustup (minimal profile, CARGO_HOME=/opt/cargo, RUSTUP_HOME=/opt/rustup) on top of build/bun-node. Provides rustc and cargo for jobs that need native or WASM compilation alongside the Bun/Node toolchain.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Top layer of the CI container chain, adding Tauri's Linux build dependencies (libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev, librsvg2-dev, libappindicator3-dev, patchelf) on top of the rust image. Used for building Tauri desktop applications on Linux inside CI.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Alpine image for the opencode CLI: copies the prebuilt musl binaries (x64-baseline and arm64, selected by TARGETARCH) into a minimal runtime with libgcc, libstdc++, and ripgrep, disables the Bun transpiler cache for ephemeral containers, smoke-tests the binary, and sets opencode as the entrypoint. Built and pushed as ghcr.io/anomalyco/opencode by the release publish script.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses buildx's TARGETARCH ARG to select between per-architecture stages (build-amd64/build-arm64) so a single multi-platform build ships both musl binaries. BUN_RUNTIME_TRANSPILER_CACHE_PATH=0 avoids useless cache writes on ephemeral containers.

nodes.name: base
nodes.summary: Alpine base stage shared by both architecture stages: installs the libgcc, libstdc++, and ripgrep runtime dependencies and disables the Bun runtime transpiler cache.

nodes.name: build-amd64
nodes.summary: Architecture stage for linux/amd64 that copies the prebuilt x64-baseline musl opencode binary from dist into /usr/local/bin.

nodes.name: build-arm64
nodes.summary: Architecture stage for linux/arm64 that copies the prebuilt arm64 musl opencode binary from dist into /usr/local/bin.

nodes.name: build-${TARGETARCH}
nodes.summary: Final stage selected by buildx's TARGETARCH: resolves to build-amd64 or build-arm64, verifies the binary with opencode --version, and sets opencode as the container entrypoint.

nodes.name: beta.yml
nodes.summary: Hourly scheduled (and manually dispatchable) workflow that syncs the beta branch by installing the published opencode-ai CLI and running script/beta.ts under an app-identity git committer.

nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: Minimal CI gate for pushes and pull requests to main/dev that installs Bun dependencies and runs the root typecheck script.

nodes.name: close-issues.yml
nodes.summary: Daily cron (plus manual dispatch) that closes stale GitHub issues by delegating to script/github/close-issues.ts with the workflow token.

nodes.name: close-stale-prs.yml
nodes.summary: Scheduled (daily, with dry-run dispatch input) workflow that closes pull requests inactive for 60 days via an embedded actions/github-script program using GraphQL pagination, adaptive throttling, and exponential-backoff retries.
nodes.languageNotes: The inline github-script job computes last activity as the max of created/commit/comment/review dates and adapts request delay (1s vs 2s) plus retry-after exponential backoff to stay under GitHub's 80 content-generating requests/minute limit.

nodes.name: compliance-close.yml
nodes.summary: Runs every 30 minutes to auto-close issues and PRs labeled needs:compliance that were not fixed within 2 hours of the compliance comment, consuming the '<!-- issue-compliance -->' markers posted by duplicate-issues and pr-standards.

nodes.name: containers.yml
nodes.summary: Builds and pushes the multi-arch dev container images (base, bun-node, rust, tauri-linux, publish) to GHCR via packages/containers/script/build.ts whenever packages/containers changes on dev.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses QEMU + Docker Buildx on a 4-vCPU Blacksmith runner to cross-build the container set tagged 24.04.

nodes.name: deploy.yml
nodes.summary: Deploys the SST-defined cloud infrastructure (web app on Cloudflare, Planetscale, Stripe, Sentry, Honeycomb) on pushes to dev and production using 'bun sst deploy' with stage-per-branch secrets.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains a pinned workaround that removes the runner's pre-installed pulumi-language-nodejs because SST 3.17.x's Pulumi SDK conflicts with Pulumi 3.212+ over the removed -root flag.

nodes.name: docs-locale-sync.yml
nodes.summary: Currently disabled (if: false) workflow intended to keep localized docs in packages/web in sync with changed English mdx pages by running opencode with a docs agent that fans translation work out to translator subagents.
nodes.languageNotes: Job is gated off with 'if: false'; the opencode run is locked down via OPENCODE_PERMISSION_CONFIG allowing only read/edit/glob/task tools.

nodes.name: docs-update.yml
nodes.summary: Twice-daily workflow (restricted to sst/opencode) that reviews the last 4 hours of commits with the opencode docs agent and updates packages/web documentation for undocumented user-facing features.

nodes.name: duplicate-issues.yml
nodes.summary: On issue open (and re-check on edit of flagged issues) runs opencode with Claude Sonnet to check contributing-guideline compliance and duplicates, posting '<!-- issue-compliance -->' comments and the needs:compliance label that compliance-close acts on.
nodes.languageNotes: Two jobs key off github.event.action: 'opened' triggers the duplicate/compliance check, 'edited' triggers recheck-compliance which clears the label and deletes the old marker comment via gh api.

nodes.name: generate.yml
nodes.summary: On every push to dev, runs script/generate.ts to regenerate derived code and commits any changes back to the branch under an app-identity committer.

nodes.name: nix-eval.yml
nodes.summary: CI check that evaluates the Nix flake for all four supported systems (x86_64/aarch64 linux/darwin), asserting the opencode package and default devShell derivations evaluate successfully.

nodes.name: nix-hashes.yml
nodes.summary: When dependency inputs change (bun.lock, package.json files, flake.lock, nix/, patches/), computes per-system node_modules SRI hashes on native runners and commits them to nix/hashes.json.
nodes.languageNotes: Derives correct hashes via the fakeHash trick: build with a placeholder hash, capture the 'got: sha256-...' mismatch from the build log, then fan artifacts into an update-hashes job that rewrites nix/hashes.json with jq.

nodes.name: notify-discord.yml
nodes.summary: On release published, sends a formatted release embed to Discord through the github-releases-to-discord action and a webhook secret.

nodes.name: opencode.yml
nodes.summary: Lets users invoke opencode on GitHub by commenting /oc or /opencode on issues and PR review comments; runs the opencode GitHub action with Claude Opus and bash denied.

nodes.name: pr-management.yml
nodes.summary: On newly opened PRs from non-team members, runs opencode via script/duplicate-pr.ts to flag potential duplicate PRs, and separately labels first-time contributors with the 'contributor' label.

nodes.name: pr-standards.yml
nodes.summary: Enforces community PR standards on pull_request_target events with two github-script jobs: check-standards validates conventional-commit titles and linked issues (via GraphQL), while check-compliance validates PR template sections and manages the needs:compliance workflow handled by compliance-close.
nodes.languageNotes: Both jobs skip team members (fetched from .github/TEAM_MEMBERS at the PR sha) and PRs created before a 2026-02-19 cutoff; idempotent comments are keyed by hidden markers like '<!-- pr-standards:title -->'.

nodes.name: publish-github-action.yml
nodes.summary: Publishes the standalone GitHub Action in the github/ directory by running github/script/publish when a github-v*.*.* tag is pushed.

nodes.name: publish.yml
nodes.summary: Full release pipeline for the opencode CLI: computes the version (script/version.ts), cross-builds binaries (packages/opencode/script/build.ts), code-signs Windows executables via Azure Trusted Signing, then publishes npm packages, GHCR containers, and AUR packages via script/publish.ts.
nodes.languageNotes: Four-stage job DAG (version -> build-cli -> sign-cli-windows -> publish) passes artifacts via upload/download-artifact; Windows signing excludes every Azure credential type except Azure CLI and verifies Authenticode signatures in pwsh before repacking zips.

nodes.name: release-github-action.yml
nodes.summary: Rolls a new version of the standalone GitHub Action by running github/script/release whenever files under github/ change on dev.

nodes.name: review.yml
nodes.summary: On /review comments from owners/members, runs opencode (GPT-5.5) to critique PR changes against the repo style guide and post inline file comments through the GitHub API, or a single 'lgtm'.
nodes.languageNotes: The opencode permission config denies all bash except 'gh*' (and denies 'gh pr review*') so the agent can only annotate through the REST API it is told to call.

nodes.name: stats.yml
nodes.summary: Daily workflow for anomalyco/opencode that runs script/stats.ts (powered by PostHog) to refresh download statistics and commits the updated STATS.md.

nodes.name: storybook.yml
nodes.summary: Builds the Storybook site ('bun --cwd packages/storybook build') when the storybook or shared UI packages change on dev or in PRs.

nodes.name: sync-zed-extension.yml
nodes.summary: On release published (or manual dispatch) syncs the Zed editor extension registry by invoking script/sync-zed.ts with the release tag, using dedicated ZED_EXTENSIONS_PAT/ZED_PR_PAT tokens.
nodes.languageNotes: The referenced script/sync-zed.ts is absent in this fork (the extensions/zed package was deleted), so the workflow would fail if triggered.

nodes.name: test.yml
nodes.summary: Main test pipeline: runs 'bun turbo test:ci' unit tests and HttpApi exerciser gates across linux/windows matrices, plus Playwright e2e tests for packages/app, publishing JUnit reports and artifacts.
nodes.languageNotes: Concurrency group uses the newer GitHub Expressions 'case()' function so dev-branch runs are never cancelled while PR runs collapse stale checks; Playwright browsers are cached by the catalog version pinned in package.json workspaces.

nodes.name: triage.yml
nodes.summary: On newly opened issues, runs the opencode triage agent against the issue title and body to categorize and label incoming reports.

nodes.name: typecheck.yml
nodes.summary: Runs the root 'bun typecheck' (turbo-driven tsgo across workspace packages) on pushes and pull requests targeting dev.

nodes.name: bug-report.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub issue form template for bug reports, collecting a required description plus plugins in use, OpenCode version, reproduction steps, a /share link or screenshot, OS, and terminal emulator.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses GitHub's structured issue forms schema (textarea/input types with validations) rather than legacy markdown templates, producing labeled, machine-parseable issue fields.

nodes.name: config.yml
nodes.summary: Issue template chooser configuration that disables blank issues and adds a Discord community contact link for quick questions.

nodes.name: feature-request.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub issue form template for feature requests, requiring a duplicate-check confirmation checkbox and a detailed description of the desired enhancement.

nodes.name: question.yml
nodes.summary: Minimal GitHub issue form template for questions, with a single required free-text question field.

nodes.name: bolt.md
nodes.summary: Canonical Bolt performance log with 30 dated Learning/Action entries covering SolidJS reactivity GC pressure, consolidating array traversals in createMemo hot paths, concurrent I/O patterns, and bun.lock hygiene; AGENTS.md mandates reading it before any performance refactor.
nodes.languageNotes: Each entry pairs a Learning with an Action; REVERTED entries (e.g. the useFilteredList createResource-to-createMemo swap) record why an optimization was rolled back, and the 2024-03-24 entry establishes the guardrail against micro-optimizing typical UI components.

nodes.name: palette.md
nodes.summary: Single-entry accessibility learning log documenting why buttons nested inside input elements must not use tabIndex={-1}, which makes them unreachable for keyboard-only users.

nodes.name: sentinel.md
nodes.summary: Security learning log with three vulnerability post-mortems: an overly permissive CORS origin regex allowing arbitrary subdomains, a TUI plugin error leak caused by Bun's console.error bypassing stderr interception, and an unsafe DOMPurify fallback that enabled XSS.

nodes.name: .oxlintrc.json
nodes.summary: Oxlint linter configuration for the monorepo: enables type-aware linting, warns on the suspicious category, and disables rules that clash with Effect generator closures, SolidJS reactive patterns, and namespace-heavy code.
nodes.languageNotes: Oxlint tolerates JSONC: this file contains inline comments and three duplicate top-level `options` keys without erroring.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Canonical workspace instruction file for AI coding agents, covering the fork's monorepo layout, setup, style guide, testing and typecheck rules, plus an extensive catalog of known issues and architectural notes. Re-read from disk and injected as a user message on every LLM API call.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the AGENTS.md convention (Instruction Hierarchy pattern) rather than a CLAUDE.md; documentation-integrity rules require file:line anchors to be re-verified before edits propagate into agent behavior.

nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: Keep-a-changelog style log of unreleased changes in this fork, grouping Added, Changed, Fixed, and Security entries with links to individual commits.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Contributor guide covering local development workflows (dev server, API server, web and desktop apps, debugger setup), pull request expectations and style preferences, feature request policy, and the trust and vouch system for external contributors.

nodes.name: GEMINI.md
nodes.summary: Empty zero-byte placeholder that marks the repo root for the Gemini CLI instruction-file convention; carries no instructions itself (AGENTS.md remains the canonical agent instructions).

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project front page for the open source AI coding agent: installation across package managers, desktop app beta notes, agent and keybinding overview, and FAQ, with links to 20+ translated README variants.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: Security policy defining the project's threat model (no sandbox, server mode exposure caveats, out-of-scope items) and the process for reporting vulnerabilities with escalation contacts.

nodes.name: STATS.md
nodes.summary: Single large markdown table tracking daily GitHub and npm download counts with per-day deltas and running totals since mid-2025; pure data record with no narrative sections.

nodes.name: ai-sdk-updates.md
nodes.summary: Dependency upgrade report for the Vercel AI SDK family (ai, @ai-sdk/anthropic, gateway, groq, xai, perplexity, bedrock, google-vertex), summarizing available minor/patch bumps, transitive-only changes, and a suggested upgrade order.

nodes.name: bunfig.toml
nodes.summary: Bun runtime configuration pinning exact versions on install and pointing the test runner root at a guard path, enforcing the 'do not run tests from root' rule so tests must run from package directories.

nodes.name: other-package-updates.md
nodes.summary: Minor/patch upgrade report for non-AI-SDK dependencies, bucketing candidates into safe upgrades, high-impact fixes, items needing review, already-latest, and out-of-scope major bumps, ending with a recommended upgrade order.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Root manifest of the Bun workspace monorepo: defines workspace globs (packages/*, packages/sdk/js), the centralized dependency version catalog, monorepo-wide scripts (dev, lint, typecheck), patched dependencies, trusted dependencies, and prettier settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Bun's `catalog:` protocol so workspace packages share pinned versions via bun.lock, plus `patchedDependencies` mapping four upstream packages to patch files under patches/.

nodes.name: plan-opencode-memory-reduction-2026-08-02.md
nodes.summary: Turkish-language optimization plan for reducing the opencode main process memory footprint, analyzing the eagerly loaded models-snapshot (~50-100 MB), ONNX embeddings (~15-20 MB), and growing LSP diagnostic maps, with lazy-loading and cleanup proposals, measurement methodology, and rollback notes.

nodes.name: subagent-effect-trypromise-report.md
nodes.summary: Turkish-language root-cause analysis of Effect.tryPromise failures in the write/edit tools, tracing the error through createTwoFilesPatch, diff-wasm WASM initialization races, and error masking by Effect.orDie, with five proposed fixes and step-by-step verification instructions.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript configuration extending @tsconfig/bun defaults and excluding the plugins directory; compiler options are deliberately empty because each workspace package owns its own tsconfig.

nodes.name: turbo.json
nodes.summary: Turborepo task pipeline for the monorepo defining typecheck, build, and test/test:ci tasks with per-package overrides for opencode, @opencode-ai/app, and @opencode-ai/ui, including JUnit artifact outputs and environment passthrough.
nodes.languageNotes: Package-scoped task overrides use the `<package>#<task>` key syntax (e.g. `opencode#test`, `@opencode-ai/app#test:ci`).

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: User and developer documentation for the opencode GitHub Action: issue/PR workflows triggered by /opencode or /oc mentions, installation via `opencode github install`, manual workflow setup, and local development with MOCK_EVENT payload templates.

nodes.name: action.yml
nodes.summary: Composite GitHub Action definition exposing inputs (model, agent, share, prompt, use_github_token, mentions, variant, oidc_base_url) and steps that resolve the latest opencode release, cache ~/.opencode/bin, install the binary, and run `opencode github run`.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses runs.using: composite — inputs flow to the CLI as environment variables (MODEL, AGENT, SHARE, etc.) rather than through a Node.js action main entry; the action executes the released opencode binary instead of building from the repo.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for the standalone GitHub Action entry (github/index.ts), declaring @actions/core, @actions/github, Octokit clients, and the workspace-pinned @opencode-ai/sdk dependency.
nodes.languageNotes: References @opencode-ai/sdk as workspace:* and @octokit/rest as catalog: even though github/ is excluded from the workspace config, so resolution depends on the monorepo's Bun install.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the standalone github action: ESNext target, bundler module resolution, react-jsx, noEmit, and strict mode with noUncheckedIndexedAccess and noImplicitOverride.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Workspace instructions for the packages/app web frontend covering local dev workflow (separate backend and Vite dev servers), SolidJS reactivity guardrails (prefer createStore, never fake createResource shapes), Bolt performance conventions with the ⚡ marker, i18n namespace rules, and browser automation commands.
nodes.languageNotes: Agent instruction file injected as a user message on every LLM call; documents the historical use-filtered-list.tsx createResource regression (commit 016a457) as a hard rule.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Package readme derived from the SolidJS Vite template, documenting available dev/build scripts, Playwright E2E setup with PLAYWRIGHT_* environment variables for pointing at a local opencode backend, and static hosting deployment of the dist folder.

nodes.name: bunfig.toml
nodes.summary: Bun runtime configuration for the package's unit tests: sets the test root to ./src and preloads happydom.ts so bun test runs against a happy-dom DOM shim.

nodes.name: create-effect-simplification-spec.md
nodes.summary: Implementation spec for reducing reactive misuse across packages/app/src (101 createEffect calls in 37 files). Defines an effect taxonomy with replacement rules (createMemo, keyed remounts, event handlers/actions, onMount/onCleanup, kept external bridges), a six-phase implementation plan, nine detailed work items by area, and verification/regression checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Anchors every replacement rule to concrete file:line targets (session.tsx, layout.tsx, file-tabs.tsx, context providers), making it a executable refactor checklist rather than prose guidance.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite entry HTML shell for the SolidJS web app: declares favicon/manifest/OG metadata, light and dark theme-color meta tags, a synchronous theme preload script, and mounts the app by loading /src/entry.tsx into the #root div.
nodes.languageNotes: Loads oc-theme-preload.js before the module bundle to apply the CSS theme variable before first paint, avoiding a flash of unstyled background.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @opencode-ai/app, the SolidJS web frontend. Defines Vite dev/build/serve scripts, tsgo -b typechecking, bun unit tests with happydom preload, Playwright E2E scripts, and dependencies on the workspace sdk/ui/core packages plus the SolidJS, TanStack Query, and Shiki ecosystems.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Bun workspace conventions throughout: catalog: references for shared versions, workspace:* for internal packages, and source .ts entry points via the exports map.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the app package: strict mode, composite project emitting declarations only into node_modules/.ts-dist, solid-js JSX preserve mode, bundler module resolution, and the @/* path alias mapped to ./src/*.
nodes.languageNotes: composite + emitDeclarationOnly feeds the monorepo's tsgo -b project graph; its incremental .tsbuildinfo cache under node_modules/.ts-dist is a known source of stale typecheck results.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent instructions for the diff-wasm package, codifying the WASM fallback retry pattern (a permanent `wasmFailed` flag so failed imports skip straight to the JS fallback instead of resetting `wasmReady`) and the `as unknown as` type-cast convention used at the `formatPatch`/`applyPatch` boundaries with the `diff` library.
nodes.languageNotes: Illustrates the memoized-promise-with-permanent-failure-flag idiom: caching the rejected `wasmReady` promise prevents re-attempting a failed dynamic WASM import on every call.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Rust crate manifest for `opencode-diff-rs` (the WASM diff engine behind the package), declaring dual `cdylib`/`rlib` crate types and the `similar`, `wasm-bindgen`, `serde`, and `serde-wasm-bindgen` dependencies used by the wasm-pack web build of `src/lib.rs`.
nodes.languageNotes: crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"] lets the same crate compile to a loadable WASM module for wasm-pack and a plain Rust library for native builds and tests.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for `@opencode-ai/diff-wasm`, exposing `src/index.ts` directly as main/module/types entry, and providing the `build:wasm` wasm-pack script that generates the gitignored `pkg/` artifacts the bridge imports at runtime.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports raw `.ts` source (no build step) so workspace consumers resolve the live file, while the compiled output lives entirely in the gitignored `pkg/` directory.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Mintlify starter-kit README for the docs package, covering local preview via the `mint` CLI, GitHub-app-driven publishing to production, and troubleshooting; still largely carries upstream Mintlify template content rather than opencode-specific material.

nodes.name: development.mdx
nodes.summary: Mintlify development guide for the opencode SDK docs site: installing the `mint` CLI, running local previews with custom ports, validating broken links, deployment verification, MDX code formatting, and troubleshooting accordion items.

nodes.name: docs.json
nodes.summary: Mintlify site configuration for `@opencode-ai/docs`, defining the green brand colors, logo/favicon, navbar, contextual AI options, and the SDK tab navigation that registers the index, quickstart, and development pages plus an OpenAPI-powered API reference (backed by the local `openapi.json` published at opencode.ai).
nodes.languageNotes: The navigation group's `openapi` key makes Mintlify auto-generate the API reference section from the published spec, separate from hand-written MDX pages.

nodes.name: index.mdx
nodes.summary: Landing page of the Mintlify docs site, presenting card layouts that route readers to the quickstart, local development, site customization, and OpenAPI-generated API reference sections.

nodes.name: quickstart.mdx
nodes.summary: Three-step Mintlify quickstart for the docs site: clone the docs repo and start `mint dev`, deploy through the Mintlify GitHub app while making a first branding edit to `docs.json`, then publish by pushing to the default branch.

nodes.name: claude-code.mdx
nodes.summary: Setup guide for using Anthropic's Claude Code CLI on the Mintlify docs project, including a ready-to-use `CLAUDE.md` template that encodes the working relationship, project context (MDX + docs.json), writing standards, frontmatter requirements, and git workflow rules.

nodes.name: cursor.mdx
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Cursor setup guide built around a ~400-line `.cursor/rules.md` project template covering technical writing principles, a full Mintlify component reference (callouts, code groups, steps, tabs, param/response fields, expandables, frames, tooltips, updates), required page structure, and content quality and accessibility standards.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a four-backtick fence to embed a markdown template that itself contains triple-backtick code blocks, a common MDX nesting technique for prompt/rule documents.

nodes.name: windsurf.mdx
nodes.summary: Windsurf setup guide providing a `.windsurf/rules.md` workspace template that teaches the Cascade assistant the docs project context (Mintlify, MDX, docs.json), writing standards, Mintlify component conventions, and API documentation requirements.

nodes.name: code.mdx
nodes.summary: Mintlify documentation page demonstrating inline code and fenced code blocks, including language-tagged syntax highlighting and optional file names after the language identifier.

nodes.name: images.mdx
nodes.summary: Mintlify documentation page covering images and embeds: markdown image syntax with size limits, HTML img embeds for customizability, general HTML element support, and iFrame embedding for videos.

nodes.name: markdown.mdx
nodes.summary: Mintlify documentation page serving as a markdown syntax reference: titles and subtitles with anchors, text formatting (bold, italic, strikethrough, super/subscript), root-relative page links, blockquotes, and LaTeX components.

nodes.name: navigation.mdx
nodes.summary: Mintlify documentation page explaining the navigation field of docs.json: recursive tab/group/page structure, folder-based routing for nested URLs, the reserved top-level api folder name, and hidden pages excluded from the sidebar.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the Mintlify CodeGroup MDX component to present paired JSON examples (regular vs nested navigation) of the recursive navigation schema.

nodes.name: reusable-snippets.mdx
nodes.summary: Mintlify documentation page on authoring reusable MDX snippets: default-export content snippets with prop-driven variables, exported reusable variables, and arrow-function components imported from the snippets directory, which is excluded from standalone page rendering.

nodes.name: settings.mdx
nodes.summary: Mintlify documentation page providing the full reference for global docs.json settings: name, navigation, logo/favicon, colors, topbar links and CTA button, versions, anchors, tabs, API auth/playground configuration, OpenAPI file paths, footer socials, feedback buttons, and the dark-mode toggle.
nodes.languageNotes: Renders the entire settings schema through Mintlify MDX components (ResponseField, Expandable, CodeGroup) instead of tables, nesting expandable field definitions up to four levels deep for the api and colors objects.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Package-level engineering guide for the opencode core package, covering prompt architecture (shared core + provider delta), Drizzle database conventions, CLI event-loop design (LoopContext / FooterOutput contract), Effect v4 rules, module-shape conventions, and the V2 session delegation bridge. Injected into the agent's context as a user message on every LLM API call, so its file:line references directly shape agent behavior.
nodes.languageNotes: This file is re-read from disk on every LLM API call and injected as a user message per the Instruction Hierarchy pattern, so stale file:line anchors propagate directly into agent behavior.

nodes.name: BUN_SHELL_MIGRATION_PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Phased migration plan to replace 143 runtime Bun `$` shell template calls across 17 source files with a unified Process API in util/process.ts. Prioritizes git-heavy hotspots (github.ts, worktree, LSP server, installation, snapshot) in Phase 1, with explicit shell-only exceptions and a validation strategy per phase.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Minimal bun init boilerplate README with install (bun install) and run (bun run index.ts) instructions; contains no project-specific documentation.

nodes.name: bunfig.toml
nodes.summary: Bun runtime configuration for the opencode package: preloads @opentui/solid globally for TUI rendering and adds the shared test preload (test/preload.ts) to the bun test runner.
nodes.languageNotes: bunfig.toml's [test] timeout key is not actually parsed by Bun (oven-sh/bun#7789), so the test timeout is passed via --timeout in package.json scripts instead.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Manifest for the opencode core package: defines the opencode CLI binary, dev/build/test/typecheck scripts (tsgo, bun test with junit CI reporting, compile-mode builds), wildcard src exports, and the full Effect / AI-sdk / OpenTUI / drizzle dependency set managed via workspace catalog versions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Node subpath imports (#db, #pty, #httpapi-server) with bun/node runtime conditions for platform-specific module resolution, plus catalog: version references resolved by the Bun workspace root.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the opencode package, extending @tsconfig/bun with OpenTUI SolidJS JSX settings (jsxImportSource @opentui/solid), browser custom conditions, and @/*, @tui/*, @test/* path aliases.
nodes.languageNotes: The @/* path aliases often produce false-positive 'Cannot find module' LSP diagnostics; bun typecheck (tsgo) is the source of truth for alias resolution.

nodes.name: errors.md
nodes.summary: Design spec for migrating packages/opencode from NamedError/defect compatibility bridges to typed Effect service errors and explicit HTTP error contracts. Defines the Schema.TaggedErrorClass authoring rules, the HttpApi boundary error module, a six-phase migration plan, and per-domain conversion priorities for storage, worktree, provider, MCP, skill, LSP, and IDE services.
nodes.languageNotes: Central pattern: Schema.TaggedErrorClass with an httpApiStatus annotation so Effect HttpApiBuilder and OpenAPI generation derive the HTTP status directly from the error schema instead of a parallel name-to-status map.

nodes.name: facades.md
nodes.summary: Working checklist for removing makeRuntime-backed async service facades in packages/opencode, replacing Namespace.method() calls with AppRuntime.runPromise(Effect.gen(...)) bodies and yield*-style service access. Tracks the two merged cleanup waves (Pty, Skill, Vcs, ToolRegistry, Auth, Config, Provider, File, LSP, MCP), caller/test conversion templates, and the remaining hotspots in the TUI config and instance plumbing.

nodes.name: instance-context.md
nodes.summary: Phased plan for retiring the promise-backed/ALS-backed Instance helper in src/project/instance.ts and moving instance selection into Effect-provided scope via InstanceRef/WorkspaceRef and a scoped per-directory runtime. Includes a 56-file inventory of direct Instance.* usage across HTTP, CLI, TUI, tool, and service boundaries, ranked by churn.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents the AsyncLocalStorage-to-Effect-context transition: ALS survives only as a bridge for native callbacks firing outside the Effect fiber tree, with per-directory boot handled by ScopedCache keyed layers instead of a module-level promise Map.

nodes.name: loose-ends.md
nodes.summary: Short follow-up list for Effect migration items that do not fit the main facade, route, tool, or schema checklists: finishing the internal Effect migration of the TUI config service, splitting pure from effectful helpers in config/paths.ts behind a ConfigPaths.Service, and continued shrinking of the legacy instance helper.

nodes.name: migration.md
nodes.summary: Practical reference for Effect patterns in packages/opencode: the canonical service module shape (Context.Service tag, Effect.fn-traced methods, InstanceState for per-directory state), Schema-to-Zod interop via the zod() helper, Effect.cached deduplication, preferred platform services, and a ~40-module service-shape migration checklist with a facade-destruction playbook and pitfalls.
nodes.languageNotes: Codifies the repo's Effect conventions: InstanceState.make closures receive a Scope so acquireRelease/forkScoped resources are cleaned up by ScopedCache on disposal, and Effect.cached replaces hand-rolled Promise/fiber memoization for concurrent deduplication.

nodes.name: routes.md
nodes.summary: Reference for converting server route handlers to a single AppRuntime.runPromise(Effect.gen(...)) body that yields services from context instead of calling async facades one-by-one. The Hono-era instance route files it tracks (src/server/routes/instance/*.ts) have since been superseded by the Effect HttpApi handlers layout under src/server/routes/instance/httpapi/.

nodes.name: schema.md
nodes.summary: Reference for migrating domain types in packages/opencode from Zod-first definitions to Effect Schema with .zod compatibility shims derived through @opencode-ai/core/effect-zod. Includes preferred shapes (Schema.Class, TaggedErrorClass, branded IDs, named refinements), escape hatches (ZodOverride, DeepMutable), migration ordering rules, and a per-domain progress tracker covering config, leaf schema modules, session, provider, tools, and HTTP route boundaries.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents the effect-zod walker that derives z.ZodType from Effect Schema while preserving JSON Schema output (type: integer, exclusiveMinimum, pattern, format: uuid), plus the ZodOverride annotation for schemas that cannot be expressed purely in Effect Schema yet.

nodes.name: server-package.md
nodes.summary: Execution-oriented plan for extracting a future packages/server from the packages/opencode monolith as the home for HttpApi contracts, handler implementations, and OpenAPI generation. Specifies the opentunnel-style definition/api split, the phase-1 dependency rule that keeps packages/server free of packages/opencode imports, merged OpenAPI transition rules, and a nine-step incremental PR sequence starting from the experimental question slice.
nodes.languageNotes: Key architectural rule: pure HttpApi/HttpApiGroup/HttpApiEndpoint contracts live separately from HttpApiBuilder.group implementations so OpenAPI can be generated from contract alone and the package stays cycle-free while packages/opencode remains the temporary host.

nodes.name: tools.md
nodes.summary: Status reference for tool migration in packages/opencode: Tool.define init/execute paths already return Effect, so the remaining work is removing Promise and raw platform bridges inside tool bodies and swapping internals to AppFileSystem, HttpClient, and ChildProcessSpawner. Tracks the exported tool checklist and spot cleanups in read.ts, ripgrep, and patch application.

nodes.name: compaction.txt
nodes.summary: System prompt for the compaction persona, an anchored context summarization assistant that condenses older coding-session history while preserving exact file paths and identifiers, merging updates into a <previous-summary> block when one is provided. Instructs the model to follow the caller's exact output structure and respond in the conversation's language.

nodes.name: explore.txt
nodes.summary: System prompt defining the explore persona, a read-only file search specialist subagent that uses Glob, Grep, Read, and Bash to navigate codebases and reports findings as absolute file paths. Explicitly forbids creating files or running commands that modify the user's system state.

nodes.name: general.txt
nodes.summary: System prompt for the general-purpose subagent persona, constraining the agent to work autonomously on multi-step tasks delegated by a parent agent and return a concise, complete summary of findings or code changes instead of addressing the user directly or asking questions.

nodes.name: scout.txt
nodes.summary: System prompt for the scout persona, a read-only research agent that clones and inspects external repositories, dependency source, and documentation, returning evidence-backed findings with absolute path and line citations. Defines a numbered working style (repo_clone first, then Glob/Grep/Read, WebFetch for docs), research standards separating verified from inferred facts, and structured output expectations.

nodes.name: summary.txt
nodes.summary: Prompt template that generates a 2-3 sentence pull-request-style summary of what was done in a conversation, written in first person, describing changes rather than process, and preserving any final unanswered question or imperative request to the user verbatim.

nodes.name: title.txt
nodes.summary: System prompt for the title generator persona, which outputs only a single grammatical thread title of at most 50 characters that helps the user retrieve the conversation later. Structured with XML-style <task>, <rules>, and <examples> sections, including ten few-shot examples and rules for matching the user's language, avoiding tool names, and handling minimal or conversational input.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses XML-style section markers (<task>, <rules>, <examples>) to delimit prompt regions, consistent with the project's convention of structured XML tags inside system prompts.

nodes.name: build-switch.txt
nodes.summary: Transient system-reminder template injected when the session switches from plan mode to build mode, telling the agent it is no longer read-only and may edit files and run tools again. Loaded and injected by session/loop/reminders.ts.
nodes.languageNotes: Wrapped in a <system-reminder> tag, the project's convention for transient authoritative directives that override ordinary user-message content.

nodes.name: core.txt
nodes.summary: The shared system prompt core appended before any provider delta, defining the agent's identity, tone, task workflow, autonomous hunk-based patch retry behavior, code conventions, system-tag semantics, and the four-level instruction priority hierarchy. Its content is the cacheable prefix base assembled by SystemPrompt.provider() in session/system.ts and streamed by session/llm.ts.
nodes.languageNotes: Establishes the project's XML tag semantics: <system-reminder> for authoritative transient directives and <instructions source="..."> for AGENTS.md provenance, with an explicit priority ladder (system prompt > system-reminder > project instructions > user).

nodes.name: delta-anthropic.txt
nodes.summary: Claude-specific system prompt delta enforcing professional objectivity over user validation, frequent TodoWrite usage for task tracking, and preferring the Task tool with parallel tool calls for codebase exploration. Selected by matchDelta() in session/system.ts for Anthropic models.

nodes.name: delta-beast.txt
nodes.summary: Autonomous-mode provider delta instructing the agent to persist until the query is fully resolved, following a nine-step workflow of URL fetching, codebase investigation, TodoWrite planning, incremental implementation, debugging, and testing. Matched by matchDelta() in session/system.ts for the beast provider profile.

nodes.name: delta-codex.txt
nodes.summary: Codex provider delta covering editing constraints (ASCII default, apply_patch for single-file edits), git workspace hygiene rules forbidding destructive commands, frontend design guidance against generic layouts, and concise presentation conventions. Selected by matchDelta() in session/system.ts.

nodes.name: delta-deepseek.txt
nodes.summary: DeepSeek provider delta that branches behavior between reasoning models (deepseek-reasoner, deepseek-r1, any `:thinking` suffix) that should reason step by step in a separate trace, and direct chat models (deepseek-chat, v3, v4-flash). Encourages unexplained parallel tool calls and clean summary output. Matched by matchDelta() in session/system.ts.

nodes.name: delta-default.txt
nodes.summary: Fallback provider delta used by matchDelta() in session/system.ts when no provider-specific adjustments apply, explicitly stating that the core prompt provides all necessary guidance.

nodes.name: delta-gemini.txt
nodes.summary: Gemini provider delta requiring verification of established library usage before employment, construction of absolute paths from the project root before filesystem tools, project-specific build/lint verification after changes, and brief explanations before state-modifying bash commands. Matched by matchDelta() in session/system.ts.

nodes.name: delta-glm.txt
nodes.summary: GLM provider delta directing built-in thinking mode for complex tasks, direct unexplained parallel tool calls with sequential chaining when steps depend on each other, and structured concise output. Matched by matchDelta() in session/system.ts for GLM models.

nodes.name: delta-gpt.txt
nodes.summary: GPT provider delta promoting minimal correct changes and end-to-end autonomy, git hygiene with a preference for non-interactive commands, and strict markdown formatting rules (flat single-level lists, short bold Title Case headers, inline code for identifiers). Matched by matchDelta() in session/system.ts.

nodes.name: delta-kimi.txt
nodes.summary: Kimi provider delta instructing the agent to interpret ambiguous requests as tasks, issue unexplained parallel tool calls, follow bug-fix/feature/refactor coding guidelines, and keep AGENTS.md updated when modified files are documented there. Matched by matchDelta() in session/system.ts.

nodes.name: delta-qwen.txt
nodes.summary: Qwen provider delta explaining the DashScope `enable_thinking` parameter for reasoning traces on complex multi-step tasks, self-explanatory parallel tool calls, and concise step-by-step output style. Matched by matchDelta() in session/system.ts for Qwen models.

nodes.name: delta-trinity.txt
nodes.summary: Token-efficiency provider delta demanding extreme conciseness (fewer than four lines, one-word answers when possible), exactly one tool call per assistant message, the question tool for vague requests, and no code comments unless requested. Matched by matchDelta() in session/system.ts for the trinity provider profile.

nodes.name: max-steps.txt
nodes.summary: Critical reminder injected by session/loop/run-loop.ts when the agent exhausts its maximum step budget: all tools are disabled and the model must respond with text only, summarizing completed work, remaining tasks, and recommended next steps.

nodes.name: plan.txt
nodes.summary: Plan-mode system-reminder template injected by session/loop/reminders.ts that enforces strict read-only operation (no edits, no non-readonly tools, overriding even direct user edit requests) and defines the agent's responsibility to research and present a well-formed plan with clarifying questions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the <system-reminder> wrapper plus explicit override language, mirroring the instruction-priority ladder defined in core.txt where system-reminders outrank project instructions and user messages.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Architecture notes for the built-in tool layer: documents the typed ToolContextExtra boundary contract, permission-gate semantics (bypassAgentCheck vs deny evaluation, assertExternalDirectoryEffect as the real gate), the todo-autoclose pattern for file-mutating tools, framework-level output truncation in Tool.define, ripgrep exit-code-2 error surfacing, symlink path-traversal risks, and the SSRF DNS-rebinding fix in webfetch.
nodes.languageNotes: Each of the 13 sections is a self-contained invariant or gotcha anchored to concrete file:line references, written to be re-read by agents before modifying the tool layer.

nodes.name: apply_patch.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template teaching the apply_patch diff language: the Begin/End Patch envelope, Add/Delete/Update File operation headers, rename via 'Move to', and self-healing hunk semantics where failed hunks are skipped and reported while clean hunks still apply.

nodes.name: codesearch.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the codesearch tool backed by the Exa Code API, positioning it as the default tool for any programming research question with an adjustable 1000-50000 token budget (default 5000) for focused or comprehensive results.

nodes.name: edit.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the edit tool's exact string-replacement rules: mandatory prior Read, preserving indentation after the line-number prefix, oldString uniqueness failure modes, replaceAll for renames, and routing multi-file edits to apply_patch.

nodes.name: glob.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the glob file-pattern matcher: results sorted by modification time, batching multiple speculative searches in one response, and preferring the Task tool for open-ended multi-round exploration.

nodes.name: grep.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the regex content-search tool: include-pattern file filtering, path-and-line-number results sorted by modification time, delegating match counting to Bash rg, and routing open-ended searches to the Task tool.

nodes.name: index-workspace.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for index_workspace, which chunks workspace source files and generates vector embeddings (local model by default, OpenAI when configured) as the prerequisite step before semantic search; takes 10-60 seconds depending on workspace size.

nodes.name: lsp.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the LSP tool enumerating nine code-intelligence operations (goToDefinition, findReferences, hover, documentSymbol, workspaceSymbol, goToImplementation, and the call-hierarchy trio) with their 1-based line/character parameter requirements.

nodes.name: plan-enter.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the plan_enter tool, which suggests switching to the plan agent when a complex request would benefit from planning first, with explicit guidance on when to call and when not to call it.

nodes.name: plan-exit.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the plan_exit tool, which asks the user to switch from the plan agent to the build agent once a complete plan has been written to the plan file and all clarifying questions are resolved.

nodes.name: question.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the question tool's structured user Q&A: an automatic 'type your own answer' option when custom is enabled, multiple-select answers returned as label arrays, and the recommended-option-first labeling convention.

nodes.name: read.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the read tool's file and directory semantics: 2000-line default window, 1-indexed offset paging, the 'line: content' prefix contract, parallel reads for multiple files, image/PDF attachment support, and onlyHunks for reading only git-modified ranges with 3 context lines.

nodes.name: repo_clone.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for repo_clone, which clones or refreshes external repositories into OpenCode's managed cache from git URLs, forge host/path references, or GitHub owner/repo shorthand, returning the cached local path for dependency and documentation research.

nodes.name: repo_overview.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for repo_overview, which summarizes a cloned repository's detected ecosystems, dependency files, package manager, likely entrypoints, and a compact structure tree so the agent can orient quickly after repo_clone.

nodes.name: semantic-search.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for semantic_search: vector-embedding search that finds conceptually similar code and returns ranked snippets with relevance scores, requires a prior index_workspace run, and includes routing guidance versus grep for exact patterns.

nodes.name: skill.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the skill tool, which loads a specialized skill matching one listed in the system prompt and injects its instructions and directory resources (scripts, files) into the current conversation.

nodes.name: task.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for the Task subagent launcher: subagent_type selection, launching multiple agents concurrently in a single message, task_id session resume, fresh-context briefing requirements, slash-command delegation, and when to prefer Read/Glob instead.

nodes.name: todowrite.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for TodoWrite, the largest template in the tool layer: when-to-use and when-not-to-use guidance illustrated with four positive and four negative worked examples (each with a reasoning block), task states (pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled), and single-in-progress management rules.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses few-shot <example>/<reasoning> block structure mirroring Anthropic's TodoWrite prompt conventions to teach proactive task tracking behavior.

nodes.name: webfetch.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for webfetch: URL content fetching with markdown/text/html format conversion, automatic HTTP-to-HTTPS upgrade, read-only semantics, summarization of large content, and deferring to better-suited fetching tools when available.

nodes.name: websearch.txt
nodes.summary: LLM prompt template for websearch: real-time web search via the session's configured provider with live-crawling modes (fallback/preferred), search types (auto/fast/deep), domain filtering, and a {{year}} placeholder that must be filled with the current year for recency-sensitive queries.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains a {{year}} placeholder substituted at prompt-render time so generated search queries include the current year.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Contributor guide for the @opencode-ai/sdk package: documents the parallel v1/v2 generated client structure, the responseStyle/throwOnError error-handling contract, generator limitations that force post-generation patching in script/build.ts, the downstream typecheck gate to run after regeneration, and test conventions in packages/opencode/test/server/.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @opencode-ai/sdk defining the export map (root, client, server, v2, v2/client, v2/gen/client), the @hey-api/openapi-ts dev dependency for client generation, a cross-spawn runtime dependency, and build/typecheck scripts that run script/build.ts and tsgo.
nodes.languageNotes: The exports map points at raw TypeScript sources (src/index.ts, src/v2/index.ts) rather than dist output — the workspace symlink makes src edits live for in-repo consumers without a build step, while the files field publishes only dist to npm.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the SDK package extending @tsconfig/node22 with nodenext module resolution, composite project references, declaration emit to dist, and DOM libs required by the generated fetch-based client types.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Conventions guide for the @opencode-ai/ui SolidJS component package: SSR/HMR-safe module initialization (no module-level Math.random), tests co-located in src/components/, the theme system's context/loader separation with the triple-cache Vite glob pattern, and Storybook patterns (DataProvider wrappers, mock data factories, FileStub for the diff viewer, deterministic IDs for snapshots).

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @opencode-ai/ui, the shared SolidJS component library: subpath exports for components, hooks, context, theme, i18n, pierre, icons, styles, fonts, and audio assets; Vite dev server and tsgo typecheck scripts; and dependencies on solid-js, kobalte, marked, shiki, katex, motion, virtua, plus the workspace SDK, core, and diff-wasm packages.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses wildcard subpath exports (./* mapped to ./src/components/*.tsx) so every component is importable by filename without a barrel file; workspace:* entries link sibling packages through the Bun workspace symlink layout.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the UI package: SolidJS JSX setup (jsx preserve with solid-js import source), bundler module resolution, strict type checking, vite/client and bun ambient types, and exclusion of Storybook stories and MDX files from compilation.
nodes.languageNotes: jsx: "preserve" with jsxImportSource: "solid-js" is the SolidJS compile model — the compiler emits JSX untouched for vite-plugin-solid to transform, unlike React's classic/automatic runtime imports.

nodes.name: accordion.css
nodes.summary: Styles the accordion component's items, headers, triggers, and collapsible content, with slideDown/slideUp keyframe animations for open and close transitions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the [data-component]/[data-slot] attribute-selector convention and native CSS nesting.

nodes.name: animated-number.css
nodes.summary: Styles the rolling-digit animated number display using per-digit strips and cells, with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback that disables the roll animation.

nodes.name: app-icon.css
nodes.summary: Minimal styles for the app icon image element, enforcing block display, border-box sizing, and contain object-fit.

nodes.name: avatar.css
nodes.summary: Styles user avatars with an info-tinted monogram fallback (mono font, uppercase) exposed via --avatar-bg/--avatar-fg tokens, small/normal/large size variants, and a borderless full-bleed image mode.

nodes.name: basic-tool.css
nodes.summary: Styles the generic tool-call card rendered for assistant tool invocations, covering the trigger row, spinner, title/subtitle, structured argument sections, and nested task-tool sub-cards.

nodes.name: button.css

nodes.name: dropdown-menu.css

nodes.name: file.css

nodes.name: hover-card.css

nodes.name: icon-button.css

nodes.name: icon.css

nodes.name: image-preview.css

nodes.name: inline-input.css

nodes.name: keybind.css

nodes.name: list.css
nodes.summary: Styles the selectable/filterable list component: filter input, groups, items with selected/active/extra icons, dividers, empty state, and a scroll fade animation.

nodes.name: logo.css

nodes.name: markdown.css

nodes.name: message-nav.css
nodes.summary: Styles the message timeline navigator with nav items, message/tick buttons, a tick line, title previews, and a hover tooltip.

nodes.name: message-part.css
nodes.summary: The largest component stylesheet: styles every chat message part renderer (assistant/user messages, tool outputs, diffs, bash output, diagnostics, compaction parts, apply-patch diffs, edit content, dock prompt, code) with prefers-color-scheme dark adjustments.
nodes.languageNotes: 1,275 lines of per-part overrides that effectively catalog every message part variant; relies on native CSS nesting and dark-scheme media queries.

nodes.name: popover.css
nodes.summary: Styles the anchored popover with open/close animations, arrow, header/title/description/body slots, and a close button.

nodes.name: progress-circle.css
nodes.summary: Styles the circular progress indicator as a -90deg-rotated SVG with weak background stroke and an active stroke whose dash-offset animates via cubic-bezier transition.
nodes.languageNotes: Circular progress via stroke-dashoffset transition instead of keyframes.

nodes.name: progress.css
nodes.summary: Styles the linear progress bar with track, fill, header, label, and value-label slots plus an indeterminate animation.

nodes.name: provider-icon.css

nodes.name: radio-group.css
nodes.summary: Styles the radio group form control with wrapper, items, hidden native input, custom control with animated indicator, and labels.

nodes.name: resize-handle.css
nodes.summary: Styles edge and corner resize handles with direction and edge variants, hover/active visibility transitions, and matching resize cursors.

nodes.name: scroll-view.css
nodes.summary: Styles the custom-scrollable view: hidden native scrollbars, a styled thumb with hover and dragging states, and dark-mode adjustments.

nodes.name: select.css
nodes.summary: Styles the select dropdown with a trigger showing value and chevron icon, an open-animated content list, and items with check indicators.

nodes.name: session-review.css
nodes.summary: Styles the session review UI with container, change groups, per-change rows, accordion items and content, actions, and embedded radio-group overrides for change dispositions.

nodes.name: session-turn.css
nodes.summary: Styles the session turn grouping with assistant content, compaction sections, and collapsible diffs groups featuring chevron, directory, filename, and path meta rows.

nodes.name: shell-submessage.css
nodes.summary: Styles the inline shell/tool sub-message layout used inside message parts, keeping values on the text baseline with clipped width slots.
nodes.languageNotes: Has no sibling shell-submessage.tsx; its data-component selectors are consumed by message-part.tsx.

nodes.name: spinner.css
nodes.summary: Minimal sizing for the loading spinner: inherits color, renders as an 18px square that never shrinks.

nodes.name: sticky-accordion-header.css
nodes.summary: Makes the accordion header sticky with a CSS-variable-driven top offset stack and an opaque background to hide scrolling content behind it.
nodes.languageNotes: Top offset composes two custom properties (--sticky-accordion-top + --sticky-accordion-offset) so parents can stack sticky headers.

nodes.name: switch.css
nodes.summary: Styles the Switch toggle component via nested [data-component="switch"] attribute selectors covering the hidden input, thumb, and label slots.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the project convention of styling SolidJS components through [data-component]/[data-slot] attribute selectors with native CSS nesting instead of class names.

nodes.name: tabs.css
nodes.summary: Comprehensive stylesheet for the Tabs component defining bar-height custom properties, compact pill variants, mono/color file-icon states, and a 640px responsive breakpoint.
nodes.languageNotes: Drives layout metrics from --tabs-* custom properties so variants (compact pills) can be tuned without new selectors; a min-width 640px media query switches the desktop layout.

nodes.name: tag.css
nodes.summary: Minimal styling for the Tag badge component: an inline-flex pill with a weak border, raised surface background, and radius tokens.

nodes.name: text-field.css
nodes.summary: Styles the text input component ([data-component="input"]) with typography and color tokens applied to the nested input slot.

nodes.name: text-reveal.css
nodes.summary: Implements the TextReveal mask-position wipe animation, sweeping the mask itself across each span (top-to-bottom) so new text drops in and old text exits downward, with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
nodes.languageNotes: Animates mask-position rather than transforming the text, an odometer alternative documented in the file's header comment.

nodes.name: text-shimmer.css
nodes.summary: Custom-property-driven shimmer animation for the TextShimmer component with a text-shimmer-sweep keyframe, honoring prefers-reduced-motion.
nodes.languageNotes: All timing (step/duration/swap) and geometry (angle/spread/size) live in --text-shimmer-* custom properties, letting the TSX component stagger items per index without extra keyframes.

nodes.name: text-strikethrough.css
nodes.summary: Spring-animated strikethrough that draws a line left-to-right via clip-path on a transparent-text overlay layered with grid stacking, with a reduced-motion fallback.
nodes.languageNotes: Hides glyph paint with -webkit-text-fill-color on a grid-area: 1/1 overlay so the decoration animates independently of the base text.

nodes.name: toast.css
nodes.summary: Styles the fixed-position toast notification region with toastPopIn, toastPopOut, and toastSwipeOut keyframe animations.
nodes.languageNotes: Separate enter/exit/swipe keyframes let the TSX toast component choreograph dismissal gestures (swipe-out) distinctly from timed auto-dismiss.

nodes.name: tool-count-label.css
nodes.summary: Styles the tool count label as a nowrap inline-flex with before/count/after slots baseline-aligned, plus a reduced-motion fallback.

nodes.name: tool-count-summary.css
nodes.summary: Styles the tool count summary row with an empty-state grid slot that cross-fades rows on a shared baseline, honoring prefers-reduced-motion.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a single-column inline-grid so the empty state and content can transition through the same grid cell.

nodes.name: tool-error-card.css
nodes.summary: Theme override sheet that retunes the generic Card and Collapsible components for tool error display via [data-kind="tool-error-card"], adjusting padding and open-state gaps.
nodes.languageNotes: Composes with the shared Card by overriding --card-* custom properties and child selectors rather than duplicating card styles.

nodes.name: tool-status-title.css
nodes.summary: Styles the tool status title with baseline-aligned suffix and duration slots, honoring prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.name: tooltip.css
nodes.summary: Simple flex layout styling for the tooltip trigger and the tooltip keybind hint slot.

nodes.name: typewriter.css
nodes.summary: 14-line sheet defining the blinking-cursor blink keyframe (opacity stepped at 50%) for the Typewriter component.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Entry point of the shared UI style system: declares the cascade layer order (theme, base, components, utilities) and aggregates the entire stylesheet via layered @imports — color ramps and semantic theme tokens into theme, the preflight reset into base, ~54 per-component stylesheets from ../components/ into components, and utilities plus animations into utilities.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses native CSS cascade layers (@layer + @import ... layer(...)) so component styles always win over tokens and lose to utilities, independent of import order.

nodes.name: animations.css
nodes.summary: Defines the shared keyframe library (pulse-opacity, pulse-scale, pulse-opacity-dim, fadeUp) and exposes --animate-pulse tokens on :root, plus the .fade-up-text class whose nth-child(1..30) selectors stagger the fade-up animation in 0.1s steps for cascading list entrances.
nodes.languageNotes: The --animate-* custom properties are later re-registered as Tailwind animate tokens via the @theme block in tailwind/index.css; the 30-rule nth-child ladder is pure repetition to delay up to 30 siblings.

nodes.name: base.css
nodes.summary: Global preflight/reset for the UI package: border-box sizing, margin/padding/border resets, font inheritance for form controls and mono elements, replaced-element display fixes, and hidden-attribute enforcement, extended with Tauri drag-region rules and a touch-device media query that forces 16px inputs to prevent iOS focus zoom.
nodes.languageNotes: Closely mirrors Tailwind Preflight (down to issue-linked comments) but adds project-specific rules: app-region drag/no-drag for Tauri windows and an iOS anti-zoom font-size guard for coarse pointers.

nodes.name: colors.css
nodes.summary: The raw color-token registry: 12-step scales with solid and alpha variants for ~14 palette families (gray, smoke, yuzu, cobalt, apple, ember, solaris, lilac, coral, mint, blue, ink, amber), closed by a legacy-alias section that keeps older themes working (smoke→gray, amber-lightalpha→amber-light-alpha, purple-9→lilac-9, cyan-9→blue-9).
nodes.languageNotes: Radix-style 12-step ramps where each step has a fixed semantic role (1-2 backgrounds, 3-5 components, 6-8 borders, 9-10 solid fills, 11-12 text); alpha is encoded as 8-digit hex. The gray ramp is declared twice — the later warm-tinted block silently overrides the initial neutral one — and the trailing alias block intentionally re-points legacy names at the new values.

nodes.name: theme.css
nodes.summary: The semantic design-token layer: typography, spacing, breakpoints, container widths, radii, and layered box shadows, followed by the complete 'OC-2 fallback' semantic palette (background, surface, text, input, button, border, icon, syntax-highlighting, markdown, diff, avatar colors) declared in light mode with a nested prefers-color-scheme: dark override that redefines every variable.
nodes.languageNotes: Dual-scheme theming via a @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) block nested inside :root, so dark mode needs no class toggling; shadows use light-dark() with var() fallbacks, and specialized tokens like --icon-agent-plan/ask/build-base color per-agent-type icons.

nodes.name: utilities.css
nodes.summary: Global helper classes: .no-scrollbar, .sr-only, .truncate-start (RTL direction trick to ellipsize the start of overflowing text), a pointer-events fix for floating-ui popper positioners, and the .text-12-regular through .text-20-medium typography scale composed entirely from theme.css font variables.
nodes.languageNotes: Only consumes tokens (var(--font-*), var(--line-height-*)) defined in theme.css, keeping this file theme-agnostic; truncate-start uses direction: rtl so the ellipsis lands at the logical start of the text.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Tailwind v4 integration entry for the UI package: imports the tailwindcss package theme/utilities (with the scanning root widened to the package root), the shared styles/index.css design system, and the local tailwind utilities/colors, then declares an @theme block that wipes Tailwind's defaults (--*: initial) and re-registers spacing, breakpoints, containers, fonts, text sizes, radii, shadows, and the pulse animation as aliases of the project's design-token variables.
nodes.languageNotes: Tailwind v4 CSS-first configuration: --*: initial disables the default theme so only project tokens generate utilities, and @import "tailwindcss/utilities.css" ... source("../../../../") expands Tailwind's content scanning beyond the stylesheet's own directory.

nodes.name: colors.css
nodes.summary: Generated bridge (by script/tailwind.ts, do-not-edit) that registers ~230 --color-* theme tokens — background, surface, text, input, border, button, icon, syntax, and markdown families — each aliasing the matching semantic CSS variable from styles/theme.css, after removing Tailwind's default color palette with --color-*: initial.
nodes.languageNotes: Purely mechanical var(--x) to --color-x aliasing: it makes utilities like bg-surface-base or text-interactive-base consume themed variables that automatically flip with prefers-color-scheme, so regeneration (not hand-editing) is the only supported change path.

nodes.name: utilities.css
nodes.summary: Custom Tailwind v4 @utility definitions: no-scrollbar, badge-mask and badge-mask-tight (radial-gradient corner-notched masks), truncate-start, and fade-up-text with the 30-step staggered animation-delay ladder — the Tailwind-native counterparts of the plain classes in styles/utilities.css and styles/animations.css.
nodes.languageNotes: Tailwind v4's @utility at-rule makes these first-class utilities that compose with variants (hover:, md:, group-...) unlike plain classes; fade-up-text resolves its fadeUp keyframes from styles/animations.css at runtime.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Package-level agent guide for the web package, deferring general rules to the root AGENTS.md. Documents two share-page invariants: the WebSocket message conversion gate in Share.tsx (V1 messages detected via 'metadata' in content, V2 shell messages bypassing fromV1) and the exact BashTool state shape (state.input.command, state.metadata.output, state.metadata.description) expected by part.tsx.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Boilerplate Starlight starter-kit README retained from the 'npm create astro' template, describing the Astro/Starlight project structure (src/content/docs routing, public assets) and the npm dev/build/preview commands. Contains no project-specific guidance beyond the template.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Manifest for @opencode-ai/web, the Astro/Starlight docs and session-share site. Defines astro dev/build scripts (including a dev:remote variant pointing at api.opencode.ai) and dependencies on @astrojs/starlight, solid-js, shiki, marked, and workspace packages @opencode-ai/diff-wasm and opencode, with catalog: version pinning managed by the Bun workspace.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Bun workspace conventions: catalog: for shared version pinning and workspace:* for monorepo-internal dependencies.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the web package, extending Astro's strict preset over all sources except dist. Preserves JSX and sets jsxImportSource to solid-js so .tsx files compile as SolidJS components rather than React.
nodes.languageNotes: jsx: preserve with jsxImportSource: solid-js is the standard Astro + SolidJS integration setup; 'preserve' lets the Astro/Vite pipeline handle the JSX transform.

nodes.name: content-bash.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for the bash tool view in session-share rendering: a terminal-style card with a centered header (macOS-style terminal icon drawn via mask-image), Shiki-highlighted command and output panes, and a 10-line line-clamp on output that lifts when data-expanded is set.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses display: contents on the root so slot children participate directly in the parent flex layout; the terminal icon is a CSS mask over a custom property (--term-icon) rather than an inline SVG.

nodes.name: content-code.module.css
nodes.summary: Minimal CSS module for the generic code block view: a bordered, padded surface with Shiki background overrides and a data-flush variant that strips border, background, and padding for embedding inside larger blocks.

nodes.name: content-diff.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for diff rendering with a responsive dual layout: a side-by-side desktop grid (before/after columns, +/- gutters, red/green row tinting that also overrides the Shiki pre background) and a stacked mobile variant that swaps in below 40rem.
nodes.languageNotes: Maintains two parallel rule sets (desktop grid vs mobile stack) toggled by a single max-width 40rem media query; added/removed markers are ::before pseudo-elements positioned in a ch-based gutter.

nodes.name: content-error.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for error output rendering: monospace pre blocks with semantically colored spans (data-color red/dimmed, uppercase label markers, separators) and a 7-line line-clamp on the content section toggled by data-expanded, plus a subtle expand button.

nodes.name: content-markdown.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for markdown message bodies in the share view: a full typography stack (headings, nested lists, bordered tables, blockquotes, Shiki code blocks) inside a 3-line line-clamped container that expands via data-expanded, with copy-button positioning.
nodes.languageNotes: Inline code is decorated with literal backtick characters via ::before/::after pseudo-elements, visually marking code spans without extra markup; table outer borders are stripped for a clean card look.

nodes.name: content-text.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for plain text message bubbles: compact and data-theme variants (invert renders a solid blue bubble with inverted text, blue a tinted surface), a 3-line clamped text slot with expand button, and absolute positioning for the copy button.

nodes.name: copy-button.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for the copy-to-clipboard icon button: absolutely positioned and hidden by default, revealed with a fade whenever any ancestor is hovered, and switching to green on data-copied for confirmation feedback.
nodes.languageNotes: The *:hover > .root universal selector reveals the button on ancestor hover without coupling to any specific parent class — a deliberate CSS-modules pattern for reusable overlay affordances.

nodes.name: part.module.css
nodes.summary: The largest share-view stylesheet, styling every part type in the session transcript: a left decoration column with copy anchor link and copied tooltip, reasoning and assistant text bubbles, per-tool layouts (bash, edit, task, read, grep, webfetch) sized via sm/md/lg width tiers, a todos checklist with priority colors and status checkbox states, and a key-value grid for tool arguments.
nodes.languageNotes: The completed-todo checkmark is drawn purely in CSS with a clip-path polygon plus inset box-shadow fill; per-tool result widths are tiered through --sm/--md/--lg-tool-width custom properties.

nodes.name: acp.mdx

nodes.name: agents.mdx
