nodes.name: cli.mdx
nodes.summary: Full command-line reference for the opencode binary, documenting every subcommand (tui, agent, auth, github, mcp, models, run, serve, session, stats, export, import, web, acp, plugin, pr, db, debug, uninstall, upgrade) with flags, global flags, environment variables, and experimental options.

nodes.name: commands.mdx
nodes.summary: Explains how to create custom slash commands in Markdown or JSON, covering command file locations, template variables, arguments, shell output embedding, file references, and per-command agent, subtask, and model overrides.

nodes.name: config.mdx
nodes.summary: Reference for OpenCode's JSON/JSONC configuration, covering config file locations and precedence order (remote, global, per-project, managed), the full schema (TUI, server, shell, models, agents, keybinds, formatters, LSP, permissions, MCP, skills, plugins, providers), and env/file variable interpolation.

nodes.name: custom-tools.mdx
nodes.summary: Guide to writing custom tools the LLM can call as TypeScript or JavaScript files, covering tool file locations, the definition structure, multiple tools per file, name collisions with built-in tools, arguments, context, and a Python-backed tool example.

nodes.name: ecosystem.mdx
nodes.summary: Curated list of community plugins, projects, and agents built on OpenCode, linking out to awesome-opencode and the opencode.cafe community hub.

nodes.name: enterprise.mdx
nodes.summary: Overview of OpenCode Enterprise covering data handling guarantees, code ownership, pricing, and deployment options including central config, SSO integration, internal AI gateways, and self-hosting.

nodes.name: formatters.mdx
nodes.summary: Documents OpenCode's post-edit code formatting, listing built-in language formatters and how to enable, configure, disable, or define custom formatters.

nodes.name: github.mdx
nodes.summary: Guide to the OpenCode GitHub Action, which responds to /opencode mentions in issues and pull requests, with installation, configuration, supported events, and worked workflow examples for triage, scheduled tasks, and PR review.

nodes.name: gitlab.mdx
nodes.summary: Documents OpenCode's GitLab integration via GitLab CI/CD pipelines and GitLab Duo, including runner setup, configuration, and usage examples for issues and merge requests.

nodes.name: go.mdx
nodes.summary: Product page for the OpenCode Go subscription ($5 first month, then $10/month), covering usage limits, behavior beyond limits, endpoints, available models, and privacy policy.

nodes.name: ide.mdx
nodes.summary: Short guide to the OpenCode IDE integration for VS Code, Cursor, and other terminal-capable IDEs, covering the Cmd/Ctrl+Esc quick launch, installation, and troubleshooting.

nodes.name: index.mdx
nodes.summary: Getting-started tutorial for OpenCode covering installation across platforms (including Windows prerequisites), initial configuration and model setup, and core workflows like asking questions, adding features, making changes, undoing, and sharing sessions.

nodes.name: keybinds.mdx
nodes.summary: Reference for customizing TUI keybinds via tui.json, documenting the default binding table, leader key with timeout, binding values, disabling keys, and desktop prompt shortcuts.
nodes.languageNotes: Keybinds are configured in a separate tui.json file with its own JSON schema (opencode.ai/tui.json), not in the main opencode.json config.

nodes.name: lsp.mdx
nodes.summary: Documents OpenCode's Language Server Protocol integration, which feeds diagnostics back to the LLM, listing built-in LSP servers and covering configuration, environment variables, initialization options, and disabling or adding custom servers.

nodes.name: mcp-servers.mdx
nodes.summary: Comprehensive guide to adding Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to OpenCode, covering remote and local server enable/config options, automatic and pre-registered OAuth flows, global and per-agent enablement with glob patterns, and worked examples for Sentry, Context7, and Grep.

nodes.name: models.mdx
nodes.summary: Guide to configuring LLM providers and models in OpenCode, covering provider credentials via /connect, recommended models, setting defaults, custom model configuration, built-in and custom variants, variant cycling, and how models are loaded.

nodes.name: network.mdx
nodes.summary: Brief guide to network configuration covering standard proxy environment variables, proxy authentication, and custom certificates for enterprise network environments.

nodes.name: permissions.mdx
nodes.summary: Reference for OpenCode's permission system, covering permission actions (allow/ask/deny), string and granular object rule syntax, wildcards, home directory expansion, external directories, default policies, what ask mode does, and per-agent permissions.

nodes.name: plugins.mdx
nodes.summary: User guide for the opencode plugin system: installing plugins from local files or npm, load order, and authoring plugins with event handlers, custom tools, and hooks. Includes worked examples for notifications, .env protection, environment injection, and compaction hooks.

nodes.name: providers.mdx
nodes.summary: The exhaustive model-provider catalog covering credentials, config, and base-URL setup for roughly forty backends (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, Azure, GitHub Copilot, GitLab Duo, Ollama, OpenRouter, xAI, Z.AI, ZenMux, and more). Also documents OpenCode Zen and Go hosted gateways, custom OpenAI-compatible provider definitions, and provider troubleshooting.

nodes.name: rules.mdx
nodes.summary: Explains AGENTS.md rules files: initializing with `opencode rules`, project vs. global rule types, precedence, and Claude Code compatibility. Shows how to reference external files from opencode.json or AGENTS.md custom instructions.

nodes.name: sdk.mdx
nodes.summary: Reference for the @opencode-ai/sdk TypeScript client: installing, creating browser and client-only instances, structured output with JSON schemas, and per-namespace API usage (Global, App, Project, Path, Config, Sessions, Files, TUI, Auth, Events) with examples.

nodes.name: server.mdx
nodes.summary: Documents opencode's headless server mode: `opencode serve` usage and options, API-key authentication, and the full REST API surface (global, project, config, providers, sessions, messages, commands, files, tools, agents, LSP/MCP, and events).

nodes.name: share.mdx
nodes.summary: Covers sharing sessions as public web links: manual (default), auto-share, and disabled modes, un-sharing, privacy and data-retention details, and enterprise recommendations.

nodes.name: skills.mdx
nodes.summary: Guide to the AgentSkills system: where to place SKILL.md files, how discovery works, frontmatter requirements, name and length validation, tool-description recognition, automatic skill matching, permission configuration, per-agent overrides, and disabling the skill tool.

nodes.name: themes.mdx
nodes.summary: Documents TUI theming: terminal true-color requirements, built-in themes, the system theme, and authoring custom themes covering hierarchy, JSON format, color definitions, and terminal defaults.

nodes.name: tools.mdx
nodes.summary: Reference for built-in agent tools (bash, edit, write, read, grep, glob, lsp, apply_patch, skill, todowrite, webfetch, websearch, question) with per-tool configuration and permission settings. Also covers custom tools, MCP servers, and internals such as ignore patterns.

nodes.name: troubleshooting.mdx
nodes.summary: Troubleshooting guide covering log locations, storage, desktop-app quick checks (disabling plugins, clearing cache, fixing server connections), platform-specific issues (Wayland/X11, WebView2, Linux clipboard), and common errors like ProviderInitError and AI_APICallError.

nodes.name: tui.mdx
nodes.summary: Terminal UI reference: file references and bash-command features, every slash command (connect, compact, details, editor, export, init, models, new, redo, sessions, share, themes, thinking, undo, unshare), editor setup, and TUI configuration options.

nodes.name: web.mdx
nodes.summary: Documents the `opencode web` command and web interface: port, hostname, mDNS discovery, CORS, and authentication settings, plus using sessions, server status, and attaching a terminal from the browser.

nodes.name: windows-wsl.mdx
nodes.summary: Windows/WSL setup guide: installing opencode inside WSL, pairing the desktop app with a WSL server, using the web client with WSL, accessing Windows files from WSL sessions, and platform tips.

nodes.name: zen.mdx
nodes.summary: Documents OpenCode Zen, the hosted model proxy: architecture and endpoints (including GitHub and Google OAuth container models), the model lineup, pricing and auto-reload, monthly limits, deprecated models, privacy policy, and team features like roles, model access, and bring-your-own-key.

nodes.name: CODEOWNERS
nodes.summary: Assigns default code owners for the web, Tauri, and desktop packages to specific maintainers so GitHub automatically requests their review on pull requests touching those paths.

nodes.name: TEAM_MEMBERS
nodes.summary: Plain roster of core team GitHub usernames used as a reference by repository automation such as code ownership and review routing.

nodes.name: action.yml
nodes.summary: Reusable composite GitHub Action that installs Bun pinned to the packageManager version in package.json, restores the Bun package cache keyed on bun.lock, and runs bun install (with a hoisted-linker workaround for patched dependencies on Windows).
nodes.languageNotes: Falls back to an x64-baseline Bun download URL on X64 runners and uses actions/cache@v4 keyed by hashFiles('**/bun.lock') with a per-OS restore key.

nodes.name: action.yml
nodes.summary: Composite GitHub Action that mints a GitHub App installation token via actions/create-github-app-token, configures the <slug>[bot] git committer identity, clears the checkout auth header, and re-points the origin remote to an authenticated x-access-token URL.

nodes.name: publish-python-sdk.yml
nodes.summary: Fully commented-out GitHub Actions workflow for generating the Python SDK from the OpenAPI spec and publishing it to PyPI on release; kept only as a placeholder pending a move to its final location.

nodes.name: pull_request_template.md
nodes.summary: Pull request template enforcing a structured checklist: linked issue, change type, a description section that warns against pasted AI-generated boilerplate, verification steps, and screenshots for UI changes.

nodes.name: .gitleaksignore
nodes.summary: Allowlist of fake secret-looking fixture strings for gitleaks, pinned to exact commit:file:rule:line locations in the http-recorder record/replay tests so redaction-test data does not trip secret scanning.

nodes.name: pre-push
nodes.summary: Git pre-push hook that verifies the local Bun version satisfies the packageManager semver range from package.json before running the repo-wide typecheck, blocking the push on any failure.

nodes.name: .prettierignore
nodes.summary: Excludes SST's generated sst-env.d.ts and the desktop bindings file from Prettier formatting.

nodes.name: settings.json
nodes.summary: Zed editor workspace settings enabling format-on-save by piping buffers through Prettier via bunx.

nodes.name: flake.nix
nodes.summary: Nix flake providing a devShell with Bun, Node.js 20, and build tooling across four platforms, plus overlays and packages that build the opencode CLI and desktop app from the ./nix derivations (including a fakeHash updater derivation to discover correct hashes).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses nixpkgs.lib.genAttrs over four systems for per-platform outputs and callPackage wiring for the node_modules -> opencode -> desktop derivation chain.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Entry point of the standalone opencode GitHub Action: on /opencode or /oc issue/PR comments it spawns an `opencode serve` instance, exchanges an OIDC token for a GitHub App token, builds a prompt from issue/PR context with image attachments, runs an agent chat session, and pushes the resulting commits, branches, or PRs back to GitHub.
nodes.languageNotes: Script-style top-level orchestration with module-level mutable state and hoisted function declarations; talks to the opencode server through the generated @opencode-ai/sdk v2 client while manually parsing the /event SSE stream.

nodes.name: publish
nodes.summary: Release helper that finds the latest github-v* semver tag and re-points the movable `latest` tag at it, deleting and re-pushing the tag on origin.

nodes.name: release
nodes.summary: Release helper that bumps the github-v* patch version (or minor with --minor), tags it, and pushes the tag to trigger a new GitHub Action release build.

nodes.name: sst-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: SST-generated ambient type shim for the github/ directory that references the root sst-env.d.ts and imports the `sst` module for infrastructure type context.

nodes.name: app.ts
nodes.summary: SST infrastructure for the public API surface: a Cloudflare Worker (the packages/function API with a SyncServer durable object) on api.<domain>, plus the Astro docs site on docs.<domain> and the static web app on app.<domain>.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses SST/Pulumi ambient globals ($app, $resolve) with no imports; the SyncServer durable object binding is appended via a transform hook with migration tags that vary by stage.

nodes.name: console.ts
nodes.summary: SST infrastructure for the console: a PlanetScale database with per-stage branches and passwords, a Cloudflare Worker auth API linked to GitHub/Google OAuth secrets, Stripe billing resources (products, prices, coupons, webhook endpoint), and a SolidStart console app wired to dozens of linked secrets and a log-processor tail consumer.
nodes.languageNotes: Composed entirely from SST/Pulumi ambient globals (sst, planetscale, stripe, $app, $dev); the ZEN_MODELS config is sharded across 30 separate sst.Secret values.

nodes.name: enterprise.ts
nodes.summary: SST infrastructure for the enterprise Teams app: a SolidStart site on the short opncd.ai domain backed by an R2 bucket, using the r2 storage adapter with linked access-key secrets.

nodes.name: monitoring.ts
nodes.summary: SST infrastructure for Honeycomb alerting: a Discord webhook recipient plus five triggers watching model and provider HTTP error rates for the Go and Zen tiers and free-tier request spikes.
nodes.languageNotes: Query specs are built with honeycomb.getQuerySpecificationOutput and embedded as JSON in trigger definitions; error-rate formulas gate on a minimum sample count to suppress noisy alerts.

nodes.name: secret.ts
nodes.summary: Declares shared SST secrets (R2 access keys) and a random 24-character Honeycomb webhook secret, and teaches sst.Linkable how to wrap random.RandomPassword resources.

nodes.name: stage.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves per-stage domains (opencode.ai and opncd.ai plus their dev and stage-prefixed variants), exports the Cloudflare zone ID, and registers a regional hostname for the stage domain.

nodes.name: install
nodes.summary: curl|bash installer for the opencode binary: detects OS/arch (including Rosetta translation, AVX2 baseline fallback, and musl variants), downloads the matching release archive with a custom ASCII progress bar, installs to ~/.opencode/bin, and updates the shell config PATH.
nodes.languageNotes: Progress rendering pipes curl --trace-ascii through a named FIFO and parses received-byte lines with an unbuffered sed variant; falls back to plain curl -# on Windows or non-TTY environments.

nodes.name: createOpencode
nodes.summary: Spawns `opencode serve` bound to 127.0.0.1:4096 and returns an SDK client pointed at it, with a close() helper that kills the child process.

nodes.name: getReviewCommentContext
nodes.summary: Extracts file, line, diff hunk, and commit anchors from a pull_request_review_comment payload, returning null for any other event type.

nodes.name: assertOpencodeConnected
nodes.summary: Polls the spawned opencode server up to 30 times at 300ms intervals and throws if it never becomes reachable.

nodes.name: useEnvModel
nodes.summary: Parses the MODEL env var into providerID and modelID components, throwing when it is unset or not in provider/model format.

nodes.name: getAccessToken
nodes.summary: Resolves the GitHub token: the TOKEN env var when set, otherwise exchanges an OIDC ID token (or a mock PAT in dev) for a GitHub App installation token via api.opencode.ai.

nodes.name: createComment
nodes.summary: Posts a '[Working...]' placeholder comment linked to the action run URL on the triggering issue.

nodes.name: getUserPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the user prompt from the comment body (bare /opencode summarizes the thread; review comments inject diff context) and downloads github.com/user-attachments assets, rewriting them to @file references with base64-encoded prompt files.

nodes.name: subscribeSessionEvents
nodes.summary: Opens the /event SSE stream and pretty-prints the session's completed tool executions (color-coded per tool) and finished text parts to the action log while tracking session metadata updates.

nodes.name: summarize
nodes.summary: Asks the model to compress its full response into under 40 characters for a commit or PR title, falling back to the issue title (or a fixed string for scheduled runs) on failure.

nodes.name: resolveAgent
nodes.summary: Validates the AGENT env var against the server's registered agents and falls back to the default agent when the name is unknown or refers to a subagent.

nodes.name: chat
nodes.summary: Sends the prompt (plus inline base64 file parts) to the opencode session with the configured model and agent, returning the last text part of the response.

nodes.name: configureGit
nodes.summary: Backs up the local git http extraheader, replaces it with a basic-auth app token credential, and sets the global committer identity to opencode-agent[bot]; skipped in mock runs.

nodes.name: checkoutForkBranch
nodes.summary: Adds the PR head repository as the `fork` remote, shallow-fetches the head branch, and checks it out under a generated local branch name.

nodes.name: pushToNewBranch
nodes.summary: Commits all changes with the model-generated summary and a Co-authored-by trailer for the triggering actor, then pushes the new issue branch to origin.

nodes.name: pushToLocalBranch
nodes.summary: Commits all changes with a co-authored trailer and pushes directly to the currently checked-out local PR branch.

nodes.name: pushToForkBranch
nodes.summary: Commits all changes and pushes HEAD back to the fork's remote branch so the contribution lands in the contributor's own repository.

nodes.name: assertPermissions
nodes.summary: Verifies the triggering actor has admin or write collaborator permission before the agent acts, skipping the check entirely when a personal TOKEN env var is supplied.

nodes.name: updateComment
nodes.summary: Overwrites the placeholder comment with the final response body and footer links.

nodes.name: createPR
nodes.summary: Opens a pull request from the issue branch to the default branch with the title truncated to 256 characters, returning the new PR number.

nodes.name: footer
nodes.summary: Renders the markdown footer appended to every comment: an optional social-card share image, the session share link, and the GitHub run link.

nodes.name: fetchIssue
nodes.summary: Queries the GitHub GraphQL API for the issue's title, body, author, state, and up to 100 comments.

nodes.name: buildPromptDataForIssue
nodes.summary: Serializes an issue and its prior comments into an XML-tagged context block, excluding the action's own placeholder and trigger comments.

nodes.name: fetchPR
nodes.summary: Queries the GitHub GraphQL API for a pull request including commits, changed files, issue comments, and nested review threads with inline comments.

nodes.name: buildPromptDataForPR
nodes.summary: Serializes a pull request — metadata, prior comments, changed files with diff stats, and review threads — into XML-tagged context sections for the prompt.

nodes.name: revokeAppToken
nodes.summary: Deletes the GitHub installation token on exit so the minted credential does not outlive the action run.

nodes.name: modelHttpErrorsQuery
nodes.summary: Builds a Honeycomb query spec computing the per-model HTTP error rate for a product tier (the Go tier excludes 401 and 429), gated on at least 100 requests over a 15-minute window.

nodes.name: providerHttpErrorsQuery
nodes.summary: Builds a Honeycomb query spec computing the per-provider error rate by comparing completions successes against llm.error failures, gated on at least 50 samples over 15 minutes.

nodes.name: usage
nodes.summary: Prints the installer's help text with curl|bash usage examples and the available options.

nodes.name: print_message
nodes.summary: Echoes a color-coded message to the terminal based on the info/warning/error level.

nodes.name: check_version
nodes.summary: Skips the install early when an existing opencode binary on PATH already reports the requested version.

nodes.name: unbuffered_sed
nodes.summary: Returns a sed invocation using the best available unbuffered mode (-u, -l, or a 512-byte line-padding fallback) so the progress parser sees curl trace lines in real time.

nodes.name: print_progress
nodes.summary: Renders a 50-cell ASCII progress bar (filled with ■ and ･) with a percentage derived from bytes downloaded versus content length.

nodes.name: download_with_progress
nodes.summary: Downloads the release archive with curl --trace-ascii through a named FIFO, feeding parsed received-byte lines to the progress bar, with cursor restoration and temp-file cleanup handled by a RETURN trap.

nodes.name: download_and_install
nodes.summary: Downloads the platform archive (progress bar with a plain-curl fallback on Windows or non-TTY), extracts the tar.gz or zip, and moves the binary into ~/.opencode/bin with mode 0755.

nodes.name: add_to_path
nodes.summary: Appends the PATH export (or fish_add_path) line to a shell config file once, skipping when the command is already present or the file is not writable.

nodes.name: desktop.nix
nodes.summary: Nix derivation packaging the Tauri-based OpenCode desktop app. It inherits version, src, and node_modules from the opencode CLI derivation, builds the Rust/Tauri bundle against GTK4 and WebKitGTK on Linux, stages the CLI binary as a sidecar, and renames the output binary to opencode-desktop.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses rustPlatform.buildRustPackage with cargoRoot pointing at packages/desktop/src-tauri; the Linux postFixup renames OpenCode to opencode-desktop to dodge case-insensitive filesystem conflicts.

nodes.name: hashes.json
nodes.summary: Stores the per-platform sha256 fixed-output hashes for the opencode node_modules derivation across the four supported Linux and macOS platforms.

nodes.name: node_modules.nix
nodes.summary: Fixed-output Nix derivation that runs bun install with a frozen lockfile for the opencode, desktop, and app workspace packages, then canonicalizes symlinks and normalizes bin entries via the bundled scripts, yielding a reproducible node_modules tree keyed by the hashes in hashes.json.
nodes.languageNotes: Achieves reproducibility through outputHashMode = "recursive" content addressing; cross-platform builds are steered with bun's --cpu/--os flags instead of native interpreters.

nodes.name: opencode.nix
nodes.summary: Main Nix derivation for the opencode CLI: stages the prebuilt node_modules tree, patches shebangs, compiles the self-contained binary via script/build.ts --single under bun, installs schema.json, and wraps the binary with ripgrep and shell completions.

nodes.name: canonicalize-node-modules.ts
nodes.summary: Post-install build script that rebuilds node_modules/.bun/node_modules symlinks so every package slug resolves to its highest installed version, making bun's content-addressed store look like a canonical node_modules layout for Nix packaging.
nodes.languageNotes: Top-level-await ESM script driven by Bun APIs (Bun.semver.order/satisfies); parseEntry decodes bun's "@scope+name@version" directory labels.

nodes.name: normalize-bun-binaries.ts
nodes.summary: Post-install build script that scans bun's package store, reads each manifest's bin entries, and symlinks them into a normalized bin directory with deduplicated names so the Nix build exposes package executables uniformly.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration scoped to the Playwright e2e test directory, extending the app package's base tsconfig with test-specific compiler options.

nodes.name: happydom.ts
nodes.summary: Test DOM shim that registers happy-dom globally and replaces HTMLCanvasElement.getContext with a stubbed CanvasRenderingContext2D so canvas-dependent UI code can run in Node-based unit tests.
nodes.languageNotes: Overrides the canvas prototype at test-setup time and falls through to the original implementation for non-2d contexts.

nodes.name: playwright.config.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright e2e configuration for the web app: a chromium project, the Vite dev server booted via `bun run dev` as a reusable webServer, and HTML/line reporters with retries and traces configured for CI.

nodes.name: _headers
nodes.summary: Cloudflare Pages header rules that force correct Content-Type headers for JavaScript, ES-module, and CSS assets served from the app's public directory.

nodes.name: oc-theme-preload.js
nodes.summary: Blocking theme bootstrap script that reads the persisted theme id and color scheme from localStorage, migrates legacy oc-1 themes to oc-2, sets data-theme/data-color-scheme on the document element, and injects cached theme CSS to prevent a flash of unstyled content.

nodes.name: serialize.ts
nodes.summary: Port of the xterm.js serialize addon for ghostty-web: walks terminal buffer cells, diffs SGR styles between cells, and reconstructs ANSI escape sequences that can restore terminal state, plus a plain-text serialization mode.
nodes.languageNotes: Class hierarchy mirrors xterm.js (BaseSerializeHandler to StringSerializeHandler) with per-cell SGR diffing to minimize emitted escape codes.

nodes.name: app.tsx
nodes.summary: SolidJS application root: composes the full provider stack (query client, i18n, dialogs, SDK, sync, theming, routing), lazy-loads route pages, and gates rendering on a server health check with a connection-error fallback screen.
nodes.languageNotes: ConnectionGate runs the health-check retry loop inside Effect.gen with timeoutOrElse/ensuring, bridging Effect fibers into Solid's createResource lifecycle.

nodes.name: parseEntry
nodes.summary: Parses a bun store directory label ("@scope+name@version") into name and version parts, treating "+" as the scope-path separator and rejecting malformed labels.

nodes.name: collectPackages
nodes.summary: Walks the bun modules store including @scoped subdirectories and returns the sorted list of package directory paths that expose a manifest.

nodes.name: linkBinary
nodes.summary: Creates a relative symlink for a package's bin entry inside the normalized bin root, skipping duplicates via a seen-set and removing stale links first.

nodes.name: isBuffer
nodes.summary: Duck-types a value as a terminal buffer by checking its type field, cursor coordinates, and getLine/getNullCell members.

nodes.name: getTerminalBuffers
nodes.summary: Extracts the normal and alternate buffers from a terminal-like object using structural checks so the addon works without importing ghostty-web internals.

nodes.name: equalFlags
nodes.summary: Compares the attribute flags (bold, italic, underline, blink, inverse, invisible, dim, strikethrough) of two buffer cells to decide whether SGR state changed.

nodes.name: BaseSerializeHandler
nodes.summary: Abstract buffer serializer that iterates rows and cells within a buffer range, delegating to overridable _nextCell/_rowEnd/_serializeString hooks.

nodes.name: StringSerializeHandler
nodes.summary: Concrete serializer that emits ANSI escape sequences with per-cell SGR diffing, cursor-style tracking, wide-character handling, and row separators so output can restore terminal state.

nodes.name: SerializeAddon
nodes.summary: Addon entry point that activates on a terminal and exposes serialize() (escape-sequence output over scrollback or an explicit range) and serializeAsText() for plain-text extraction.

nodes.name: QueryProvider
nodes.summary: Wraps children in a TanStack Query QueryClientProvider bound to a shared client for the subtree.

nodes.name: AppShellProviders
nodes.summary: Nests the app-level context providers (global SDK, sync, layout, permission, notification) around the application shell.

nodes.name: SessionProviders
nodes.summary: Installs per-session providers such as prompt, comments, and highlights around session-scoped routes.

nodes.name: RouterRoot
nodes.summary: Declares the root Solid router with a lazy-loaded home route and parameterized session routes.

nodes.name: AppBaseProviders
nodes.summary: Base provider composition (theme, i18n, dialogs, marked renderer, fonts) plus desktop titlebar wiring and Sentry error capturing; exported for reuse outside the default tree.

nodes.name: ConnectionGate
nodes.summary: Polls server health with an Effect retry loop (repeat until healthy, timeout with background-mode fallback), exposes retry and switch-server actions, and only renders children once a connection is established.

nodes.name: ConnectionError
nodes.summary: Full-screen connection failure view that names the unreachable server, offers other known servers to switch to, and auto-retries on an interval until cleanup.

nodes.name: AppInterface
nodes.summary: Top-level app interface composing the connection gate, layout shell, dialog stack, and debug bar; exported as the embeddable app surface.

nodes.name: debug-bar.tsx

nodes.name: titlebar-history.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helpers maintaining the titlebar navigation history stack (apply/push/trim/back/forward) with a maximum depth cap.

nodes.name: applyPath
nodes.summary: Applies a navigation to the history stack, dropping forward entries after the current position and enforcing the maximum depth.

nodes.name: titlebar.tsx
nodes.summary: Custom window titlebar with platform-specific window controls (macOS/Windows/Linux), navigation history back/forward, and menu shortcuts, adapting between Tauri desktop and browser.

nodes.name: Titlebar
nodes.summary: Renders the custom titlebar: drag region, navigation back/forward driven by titlebar-history, window minimize/maximize/close controls, and command shortcuts.

nodes.name: file-picker.ts
nodes.summary: Constants defining accepted image and general file MIME types and extensions for the file picker, plus a helper building picker filter lists.

nodes.name: command.tsx
nodes.summary: Command registry context providing command palette state, keybind parsing/matching/formatting, persisted custom keybinds, and global keyboard shortcut dispatch.
nodes.languageNotes: Keybinds are normalized cross-platform ('mod' maps to Meta on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere) and custom bindings persist through a Persist utility rather than raw localStorage.

nodes.name: parseKeybind
nodes.summary: Parses a keybind string such as 'mod+shift+p' into a normalized structure of modifiers and key, with platform-aware modifier expansion.

nodes.name: matchKeybind
nodes.summary: Checks whether a keyboard event matches a parsed keybind, accounting for modifier state.

nodes.name: formatKeybind
nodes.summary: Formats a parsed keybind into localized display segments with platform-specific modifier symbols for UI rendering.

nodes.name: comments.tsx
nodes.summary: Comments context managing per-session code comment state — create, reply, resolve, and selection cloning — with scoped caches and persistence.

nodes.name: createCommentSessionState
nodes.summary: Builds the per-session comment store with create/reply/resolve/update operations over a SolidJS reactive store, keyed by session and file path.

nodes.name: createCommentSession
nodes.summary: Creates the comment session API bound to route params and persistence, sharing state across subscribers via createRoot.

nodes.name: file.tsx
nodes.summary: File viewer context provider coordinating file content fetching with an LRU byte-budget cache, path helpers, view state, file tree store, and watcher-driven invalidation.

nodes.name: content-cache.ts
nodes.summary: Module-level LRU cache for file contents enforcing a global approximate byte budget, with touch/evict/reset and byte-accounting helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-scope mutable Map with recency tracking; exported getters expose byte totals and entry counts so eviction can be tested and monitored.

nodes.name: evictContentLru
nodes.summary: Evicts least-recently-used file contents until the total cached bytes fall under the configured budget.

nodes.name: path.ts
nodes.summary: Pure path helpers handling file:// stripping, query/hash removal, git-quoted path unquoting (octal escapes), and percent encode/decode of file paths.
nodes.languageNotes: unquoteGitPath decodes git's C-style quoted paths (octal escapes for non-ASCII bytes), which standard URL decoding does not handle.

nodes.name: unquoteGitPath
nodes.summary: Unquotes C-quoted git paths, decoding octal escape sequences and producing UTF-8 text for non-ASCII components.

nodes.name: encodeFilePath
nodes.summary: Percent-encodes a file path for safe use in URLs and cache identifiers.

nodes.name: createPathHelpers
nodes.summary: Creates bound encode/decode/strip path helpers used by the file context for content keys and display paths.

nodes.name: tree-store.ts
nodes.summary: Factory module for the reactive file-tree store: lazy directory listing, in-flight request deduplication, and expand/collapse state, reconciling fetched nodes into solid-js stores via immer produce.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses SolidJS createStore with immer-style produce() drafts for structural updates of nested tree state; a scope() guard discards responses that arrive after the user switched directories.

nodes.name: createFileTreeStore
nodes.summary: Builds the file-tree store: tracks per-directory loading/error state, deduplicates concurrent listings in an inflight map, and reconciles removed nodes including whole removed subtrees on refresh.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared types for the file-explorer context, including the directory-listing node shape and selected-line range, plus a helper that normalizes a line range into an ordered selection.

nodes.name: selectionFromLines
nodes.summary: Normalizes a possibly reversed line range into an ordered selection clamped so both endpoints are at least 1.

nodes.name: view-cache.ts
nodes.summary: Per-session cache of file-view state (scroll position and selected lines), persisted via Persist.scoped and pruned to a bounded number of files per view.

nodes.name: normalizeSelectedLines
nodes.summary: Orders and clamps a line range so start <= end and both values are positive.

nodes.name: createViewSession
nodes.summary: Creates a persisted per-session view store tracking scroll offsets and selected lines per file, with automatic pruning of stale file entries.

nodes.name: createFileViewCache
nodes.summary: Builds a scoped cache of per-session view stores keyed by directory/session, creating each SolidJS root lazily and disposing entries on eviction or clear.

nodes.name: watcher.ts
nodes.summary: Maps SDK file-change events into file-tree store invalidation: reloads open changed files and refreshes the nearest loaded ancestor directory.

nodes.name: invalidateFromWatcher
nodes.summary: Applies a file-change event through store ops: reloads the file if open, refreshes its directory if loaded, and otherwise walks up parent directories to the nearest loaded one.

nodes.name: global-sdk.tsx
nodes.summary: Provides the global SDK context: creates the opencode client per server and runs a resilient global SSE event stream with heartbeat stall detection, event coalescing, and batched emission to subscribers.
nodes.languageNotes: The SSE loop combines a heartbeat timeout (aborts stalled connections), identity-keyed coalescing of repeated events, and a periodic macrotask yield so high-volume streams do not starve the UI thread.

nodes.name: global-sync.tsx
nodes.summary: Root of the client-side session synchronization engine: wires the global SDK event stream into per-directory child stores, bootstraps projects/providers/agents, loads and trims session lists, and exposes the GlobalSyncProvider context.

nodes.name: loadMcpQuery
nodes.summary: TanStack Query options for fetching a directory's MCP server status.

nodes.name: loadLspQuery
nodes.summary: TanStack Query options for fetching a directory's LSP server status.

nodes.name: createGlobalSync
nodes.summary: Assembles the global sync engine: global config/provider/path queries, a per-directory SDK cache, the child-store manager, the refresh queue, event listeners dispatching into the reducer, and bounded session loading — the central orchestrator of the sync subsystem.

nodes.name: GlobalSyncProvider
nodes.summary: SolidJS context provider component that instantiates the global sync engine once per app.

nodes.name: useGlobalSync
nodes.summary: Hook returning the global sync context value (projects, sessions, providers, and child-store accessors).

nodes.name: bootstrap.ts
nodes.summary: Bootstrap queries and sequencing for the sync engine: loads global config, projects, providers, agents, and path info, then performs staged per-directory bootstrap and session warming.
nodes.languageNotes: Bootstrap runs in stages gated by requestAnimationFrame (waitForPaint) so heavy initial fetches never block first render; an allSettled-based runAll aggregates failures into a single toast.

nodes.name: waitForPaint
nodes.summary: Returns a promise that resolves after the next animation frame (with a setTimeout fallback), used to yield between bootstrap stages.

nodes.name: showErrors
nodes.summary: Surfaces aggregated bootstrap failures as a single error toast with a formatted server error and an overflow count.

nodes.name: clearProviderRev
nodes.summary: Drops the cached provider revision for a directory, forcing provider data to reload on the next bootstrap.

nodes.name: loadGlobalConfigQuery
nodes.summary: TanStack Query options for fetching the global opencode config with retry.

nodes.name: loadProjectsQuery
nodes.summary: TanStack Query options for the project list, filtering out test worktrees and sorting deterministically.

nodes.name: bootstrapGlobal
nodes.summary: Runs global bootstrap: fetches config and projects in parallel, seeds the store, shows aggregated errors, and warms recent sessions.

nodes.name: mergeSession
nodes.summary: Merges a single session into the store, inserting or updating it in id order.

nodes.name: warmSessions
nodes.summary: Pre-warms recently updated sessions during bootstrap so their message lists are ready before the user opens them.

nodes.name: loadProvidersQuery
nodes.summary: TanStack Query options for a directory's provider list.

nodes.name: loadAgentsQuery
nodes.summary: TanStack Query options for a directory's agent list, normalizing the SDK's flexible agent response shape.

nodes.name: loadPathQuery
nodes.summary: TanStack Query options for a directory's path info.

nodes.name: bootstrapDirectory
nodes.summary: Staged per-directory bootstrap: providers, agents, path, MCP/LSP status, and VCS info are fetched across paint-yielding stages into the directory's child store, with aggregated error reporting.

nodes.name: child-store.ts
nodes.summary: Manages the lifecycle of per-directory child stores: creation under the owner's reactive root, pin/unpin reference tracking, idle-TTL eviction, and per-directory caches for VCS info, project metadata, and icons.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements manual LRU with pin counts plus a WeakMap of owner-scoped pins; eviction disposes SolidJS roots created via createRoot/runWithOwner so reactive graphs are torn down correctly.

nodes.name: createChildStoreManager
nodes.summary: Factory returning the child-store manager API (child, ensureChild, pin/unpin, mark, projectMeta/projectIcon, disposeDirectory) with idle-TTL and max-store eviction driven by pickDirectoriesToEvict.

nodes.name: event-reducer.ts
nodes.summary: Event reducer for the sync engine: folds global SSE events (session/message/part lifecycle, todos, permissions, questions, VCS) into solid-js stores with fine-grained reconcile, plus directory-level event application.

nodes.name: applyGlobalEvent
nodes.summary: Entry point that routes a global event payload to the matching session/message handler and reports whether the store changed.

nodes.name: cleanupSessionCaches
nodes.summary: Drops cached message, part, and todo state for a removed session.

nodes.name: cleanupDroppedSessionCaches
nodes.summary: After a session list reconcile, removes caches and todo state for sessions that disappeared from the trimmed list.

nodes.name: handleSessionCreated
nodes.summary: Inserts a newly created session in id order and re-trims the session list to the configured limit.

nodes.name: handleSessionUpdated
nodes.summary: Applies session.updated events (title, timestamps, parent, revoke) and re-trims the list, keeping child sessions even when over the limit.

nodes.name: handleSessionDeleted
nodes.summary: Removes a deleted session from the store and cascades cache cleanup for it and its child sessions.

nodes.name: handleMessageUpdated
nodes.summary: Upserts a session message summary in the store's message index.

nodes.name: handleMessageRemoved
nodes.summary: Deletes a message and its parts from the session's message cache.

nodes.name: handleMessagePartUpdated
nodes.summary: Reconciles an updated message part (decoding binary payloads) into the part cache.

nodes.name: handleMessagePartRemoved
nodes.summary: Removes a message part and drops the parent message when its last part disappears.

nodes.name: handleMessagePartDelta
nodes.summary: Appends a streaming text delta to a message part, skipping when a stale-delta marker says a full part update already superseded it.

nodes.name: handleVcsBranchUpdated
nodes.summary: Updates the cached VCS branch for a directory on vcs.branch.updated events.

nodes.name: handlePermissionAsked
nodes.summary: Records a pending permission request on its session, initializing the permission queue if needed.

nodes.name: handlePermissionReplied
nodes.summary: Removes a replied permission request from the session's pending list.

nodes.name: handleQuestionAsked
nodes.summary: Records a pending question on its session along with its metadata.

nodes.name: handleQuestionRepliedRejected
nodes.summary: Removes an answered or rejected question from the session's pending list.

nodes.name: applyDirectoryEvent
nodes.summary: Applies directory-scoped events to a child store: config, path, VCS, and permission updates plus session-list refresh triggers, deciding when a refetch or re-bootstrap is needed.

nodes.name: eviction.ts
nodes.summary: Pure eviction policy for directory stores: picks idle or over-limit directories to evict (respecting pins) and decides whether a specific directory can be safely disposed.

nodes.name: pickDirectoriesToEvict
nodes.summary: Sorts unpinned stores by last access and returns those idle beyond the TTL plus enough least-recently-used stores to get back under the configured maximum.

nodes.name: canDisposeDirectory
nodes.summary: Returns true only when a directory has an existing store, is unpinned, not booting, and not loading sessions — the safe-to-dispose guard.

nodes.name: queue.ts
nodes.summary: Deduplicating refresh queue for the sync engine: drains bootstrap work in small batches on the macrotask queue and pauses when the engine is paused.

nodes.name: createRefreshQueue
nodes.summary: Creates the refresh queue: per-directory dedup via a keyed map, a root/global refresh flag, and a drain loop that processes two directories per tick between setTimeout(0) yields.

nodes.name: session-cache.ts
nodes.summary: Bounded in-memory cache of per-session message and part state, dropping the least recently useful sessions beyond SESSION_CACHE_LIMIT.

nodes.name: dropSessionCaches
nodes.summary: Deletes cached message, part, and todo state for the given session ids, updating cache bookkeeping.

nodes.name: pickSessionCacheEvictions
nodes.summary: Selects sessions to evict from the cache: unpinned, without pending permissions, least recently updated first, beyond the cache limit.

nodes.name: session-load.ts
nodes.summary: Session list loading helpers: paginated fetch with fallback to an unfiltered listing when filtered queries are unsupported, plus total-count estimation for limited responses.

nodes.name: loadRootSessionsWithFallback
nodes.summary: Fetches root sessions for a directory with a limit, retrying without the filter when the server rejects filtered queries.

nodes.name: estimateRootSessionTotal
nodes.summary: Estimates the true total session count from a limited response's count, limit, and limited flags.

nodes.name: session-prefetch.ts
nodes.summary: Module-level prefetch registry for session message lists: TTL-guarded cache of pagination metadata, inflight deduplication, and version counters that invalidate stale prefetches.
nodes.languageNotes: Invalidation uses monotonic version counters (rev map) so prefetches started before an invalidation are detected and discarded via isSessionPrefetchCurrent.

nodes.name: shouldSkipSessionPrefetch
nodes.summary: Decides whether a prefetch can be skipped: message-bearing navigation with complete or oversized cached metadata, or a fetch fresher than the TTL.

nodes.name: runSessionPrefetch
nodes.summary: Runs (or joins) the in-flight prefetch task for a session and returns the shared promise.

nodes.name: setSessionPrefetch
nodes.summary: Stores prefetch metadata (limit, cursor, completeness, timestamp) for a session.

nodes.name: clearSessionPrefetch
nodes.summary: Invalidates and clears prefetch state for specific sessions, bumping their version counters.

nodes.name: clearSessionPrefetchDirectory
nodes.summary: Invalidates and clears all prefetch state for every session under a directory.

nodes.name: session-trim.ts
nodes.summary: Keeps the visible session list bounded: orders sessions by recency and permission-pending status and trims to a limit while preserving a recent-activity window.

nodes.name: takeRecentSessions
nodes.summary: Slices the recency-sorted session list to the limit while ensuring sessions inside the recent window are retained.

nodes.name: trimSessions
nodes.summary: Sorts root and child sessions by recency with permission-pending sessions first, applies the recent window, and returns the bounded list to store.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions and tuning constants for the sync engine: store shapes for sessions, messages, parts, todos, and permissions, child-store options, and eviction limits (MAX_DIR_STORES, DIR_IDLE_TTL_MS, SESSION_RECENT_WINDOW).

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Normalization helpers for the sync engine: re-exports pathKey as directoryKey, normalizes the SDK's flexible agent-list shape, filters deprecated provider models, and strips project icon overrides.

nodes.name: normalizeAgentList
nodes.summary: Normalizes an SDK agents response that may be an array, a single agent, or an object map into a validated Agent array.

nodes.name: normalizeProviderList
nodes.summary: Copies a provider list response with deprecated models filtered out of every provider.

nodes.name: sanitizeProject
nodes.summary: Returns a project with custom icon url/override removed so untrusted project metadata cannot inject arbitrary images.

nodes.name: highlights.tsx
nodes.summary: Release-highlights context: fetches and defensively parses the opencode changelog feed, slices releases between the previous and current app versions, and shows the release-notes dialog once per version.
nodes.languageNotes: Every field of the remote changelog JSON is parsed through isRecord/getText guards so a malformed feed can never crash the app.

nodes.name: parseHighlight
nodes.summary: Parses one changelog item into a typed Highlight, requiring title and description and optionally attaching media.

nodes.name: parseRelease
nodes.summary: Parses a changelog release entry, keeping only highlight groups sourced from the desktop.

nodes.name: parseChangelog
nodes.summary: Parses the changelog document, accepting either a top-level release array or a { releases } wrapper.

nodes.name: sliceHighlights
nodes.summary: Selects the releases strictly between the previous and current app versions to decide which highlights to show.

nodes.name: language.tsx
nodes.summary: i18n context: detects the user locale from stored preference, cookie, and navigator languages, lazy-loads the matching dictionary merged over base English strings, and persists the choice.
nodes.languageNotes: Locale matching explicitly distinguishes Traditional Chinese (zht) from Simplified Chinese (zh) by inspecting the `hant` subtag before the generic zh matcher runs.

nodes.name: detectLocale
nodes.summary: Maps navigator.languages to a supported locale using an ordered matcher table, defaulting to English.

nodes.name: readStoredLocale
nodes.summary: Reads and validates the persisted locale from localStorage, falling back silently on parse errors.

nodes.name: layout-scroll.ts
nodes.summary: Scroll persistence for layout panes: debounced capture of scroll positions into a solid-js store with per-key clamping and restore of the last remembered offset.

nodes.name: createScrollPersistence
nodes.summary: Creates the scroll persistence controller: registers elements by key, clamps and debounces position updates, and restores last offsets on re-registration.

nodes.name: layout.tsx
nodes.summary: The app's layout brain: LayoutProvider tracks session tabs per project, pane widths (sidebar, file tree, session, terminal), review diff style, project expansion, and avatar colors — persisted per session key.
nodes.languageNotes: Session keys encode the project directory as base64 so one persisted record can hold per-project tab and scroll state; pruneSessionKeys bounds that map by a recency score.

nodes.name: getAvatarColors
nodes.summary: Maps an avatar color key to a CSS variable pair with an info-surface fallback for unknown keys.

nodes.name: ensureSessionKey
nodes.summary: Touches and seeds LRU tracking for a session key and returns it, used to keep per-session state alive.

nodes.name: createSessionKeyReader
nodes.summary: Wraps a session key (plain value or accessor) into an accessor that ensures LRU tracking on every read.

nodes.name: pruneSessionKeys
nodes.summary: Evicts the lowest-scored session keys (union of view and tab keys) beyond the maximum, always keeping the active key.

nodes.name: local.tsx
nodes.summary: Per-session local selection context: resolves the current agent/model/variant for the routed session, validates against connected providers, persists selections per workspace, and supports cross-session handoff.

nodes.name: migrate
nodes.summary: Migrates the persisted model-selection store from the legacy `pick` shape to `session`, dropping the old workspace-wide default.

nodes.name: model-variant.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helpers for model variant selection: reads the agent-configured variant, resolves the effective variant from selected/configured state, and cycles through available variants.

nodes.name: getConfiguredAgentVariant
nodes.summary: Returns the agent's configured variant only when the agent's model matches the current provider/model and the variant still exists on it.

nodes.name: resolveModelVariant
nodes.summary: Picks the effective variant: an explicit selection if valid, else the configured one; a null selection disables variants entirely.

nodes.name: cycleModelVariant
nodes.summary: Cycles to the next variant with wraparound, treating a null selection as variants-off and restarting from the first variant.

nodes.name: models.tsx
nodes.summary: Models context: derives the available model list from connected providers, overlays per-user visibility/favorite flags and recent picks, and persists preferences globally.

nodes.name: notification.tsx
nodes.summary: Notification context: persists turn-complete and error notifications (30-day TTL, 500-item cap), indexes them by session and project with unseen counts, plays sounds, and marks them viewed on navigation.

nodes.name: createNotificationIndex
nodes.summary: Creates the empty two-level (session/project) notification index with all, unseen, unseenCount, and unseenHasError buckets.

nodes.name: buildNotificationIndex
nodes.summary: Builds the full notification index from a flat list, bucketing by session and project and tracking unseen counts and error flags.

nodes.name: permission-auto-respond.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helper module deciding whether an incoming permission request should be auto-answered, based on persisted auto-accept state, the requesting session's parent lineage, and directory-scoped acceptance. Used by the permission context to implement auto-accept for parent/subagent sessions.

nodes.name: acceptKey
nodes.summary: Builds the persisted-storage key (base64-encoded sessionID/directory pair) under which a session's auto-accept flag is stored.

nodes.name: directoryAcceptKey
nodes.summary: Builds the storage key for directory-wide auto-accept flags, scoping acceptance to an entire working directory.

nodes.name: isDirectoryAutoAccepting
nodes.summary: Returns whether auto-accept is currently enabled for every session in the given directory.

nodes.name: sessionLineage
nodes.summary: Walks the parent chain of a session (following parentID links with cycle protection) and returns the list of ancestor session IDs ending at the requested session, so permission decisions can honor acceptance granted to any ancestor.

nodes.name: autoRespondsPermission
nodes.summary: Decides whether a specific permission request qualifies for auto-response by checking acceptance for the session or any of its ancestors, plus directory-wide acceptance.

nodes.name: permission.tsx
nodes.summary: SolidJS context serving as the app's permission-request hub: subscribes to server permission events, tracks pending prompts, dedupes responses, auto-accepts requests when enabled per session or directory (draining the backlog on enable), and exposes respond/once/always/deny actions plus auto-accept toggles. Delegates lineage-aware auto-respond decisions to permission-auto-respond helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the createSimpleContext use/provider pair convention; responded-request dedup is a Map keyed by permission id with time-based pruning, and enable-version counters guard against racing a disable while the backlog drain is in flight.

nodes.name: isNonAllowRule
nodes.summary: Type guard detecting permission config rules that are not plain allow rules (arrays, deny/ask objects), used to decide when the UI must keep prompting despite configured permissions.

nodes.name: platform.tsx
nodes.summary: Defines the Platform capability interface abstracting web vs desktop (Tauri) differences — link opening, notifications, history navigation, file/directory pickers, storage, update checks, WSL/display-backend settings, clipboard — and a simple context provider that injects the active implementation.
nodes.languageNotes: Classic capability object pattern: optional methods (openFilePickerDialog, getWslEnabled, parseMarkdown, etc.) mark desktop-only features, letting web code feature-detect instead of branching on platform checks.

nodes.name: prompt.tsx
nodes.summary: Per-session prompt composer state: draft text, file selections, and context items with attached comments, backed by a persisted SolidJS store with structural equality checks (to avoid spurious saves), deep clone helpers, stable content-hash keys for context items, and an LRU cache of per-session stores with dispose/prune lifecycle.

nodes.name: isPartEqual
nodes.summary: Structurally compares two prompt parts (text plus file selections) so persistence only fires when draft content actually changed.

nodes.name: isPromptEqual
nodes.summary: Compares full prompt drafts part-by-part for deep equality; exported for reuse by persistence and UI logic.

nodes.name: contextItemKey
nodes.summary: Derives a stable identity key for a context item from its comment text and a truncated checksum of its content, enabling dedup and keyed updates of attached-file items.

nodes.name: createPromptActions
nodes.summary: Builds the set/batch/reset action closures that mutate a prompt store, always cloning prompts before writes to keep the store immutable from the caller's perspective.

nodes.name: createPromptSession
nodes.summary: Creates the per-session prompt store backed by scoped persistence, wiring context-item add/remove/comment-update/replace actions and memoized draft state; instantiated under createRoot by the session cache.

nodes.name: sdk.tsx
nodes.summary: Directory-scoped SDK context: wraps the global SDK to produce a per-directory API client (throwOnError) and re-emits server events for that directory through a strongly-typed global emitter, so components can subscribe to individual event types.
nodes.languageNotes: The SDKEventMap mapped type ({ [key in Event["type"]]: Extract<Event, {type: key}> }) turns the SDK's discriminated event union into a typed emitter — a useful pattern for re-broadcasting tagged unions.

nodes.name: server.tsx
nodes.summary: Multi-server connection manager: resolves and dedupes the persisted server list, tracks per-server health via polling, holds active/expanded server UI state (open/close, expand/collapse, reorder, touch), and exports URL normalization/naming helpers used across the app.

nodes.name: normalizeServerUrl
nodes.summary: Normalizes user-entered server URLs: trims whitespace, defaults a missing scheme to http, and strips trailing slashes.

nodes.name: serverName
nodes.summary: Derives a display name for a server connection from its URL (scheme stripped, host+port kept), unless a display name override is set.

nodes.name: resolveServerList
nodes.summary: Merges stored server connections with runtime inputs into a deduplicated connection list keyed by ServerConnection.key, tolerating partially-invalid stored entries.

nodes.name: settings.tsx
nodes.summary: Persisted application settings store: font configuration for mono/sans/terminal faces (input accessors plus CSS font-family stacks with escaping and defaults), UI visibility toggles (file tree, navigation, search, status, terminal, reasoning summaries, progress bar), autosave/followup behavior, per-agent and permission/error filter rules with enable flags, and reset actions.

nodes.name: sync.tsx
nodes.summary: The app's per-directory data synchronization engine: loads and paginates session messages with cursor/limit metadata, merges optimistic message/part additions and removals into server pages, reconciles diffs and todos, dedupes in-flight fetches with retry, tracks seen sessions, and evicts least-recently-used session caches under a global limit. Exports the pure optimistic-merge helpers for testing.
nodes.languageNotes: Sorted message/part lists are maintained with Binary.search insertions instead of re-sorts, and solid-js store reconcile() keyed by id applies server pages with minimal reactivity churn — a good example of merging server data into fine-grained stores.

nodes.name: mergeParts
nodes.summary: Merges an incoming set of message parts into a sorted existing list, replacing same-id parts and inserting new ones at their binary-searched position.

nodes.name: mergeOptimisticPage
nodes.summary: Folds optimistic (locally-added) messages into a freshly fetched server page: matches by id/time, keeps optimistic parts that the server page doesn't yet cover, and reports which optimistic messages were confirmed so their markers can be cleared.

nodes.name: applyOptimisticAdd
nodes.summary: Pure draft mutation inserting an optimistic message into a session's sorted message list; exported for unit testing.

nodes.name: applyOptimisticRemove
nodes.summary: Pure draft mutation removing a message (by id or timestamp match) from a session's optimistic message list; exported for unit testing.

nodes.name: setOptimisticAdd
nodes.summary: Applies applyOptimisticAdd through the sync store's produce() so SolidJS reactivity records the insertion.

nodes.name: setOptimisticRemove
nodes.summary: Applies applyOptimisticRemove through the sync store's produce(), matching messages by id then falling back to timestamp comparison.

nodes.name: terminal-title.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny helpers for default terminal tab titles: renders the numbered title template, detects whether a title is still the unmodified default, and finds the lowest unused terminal number.

nodes.name: terminal.tsx
nodes.summary: Workspace terminal (PTY) manager: persists terminal tab state with legacy-state migration, creates/clones/closes/renames terminals through the SDK pty API, auto-removes exited terminals on server events, trims the tab list to a cap, and caches per-workspace sessions in a createRoot-based LRU cache with dispose/prune lifecycle.
nodes.languageNotes: The 226-line createWorkspaceTerminalSession factory assembles the whole terminal store/actions under an owner scope so the cache can dispose reactions via createRoot disposal — the same LRU-owner pattern used by prompt.tsx.

nodes.name: pty
nodes.summary: Coerces an unknown persisted value into a well-formed terminal record, defaulting ids/titles/dimensions and deriving the title number.

nodes.name: migrateTerminalState
nodes.summary: Migrates legacy persisted terminal state to the current shape: normalizes records, dedupes by id, and reconciles the active terminal id with the surviving list.

nodes.name: getTerminalServerScope
nodes.summary: Resolves which server connection a workspace's terminals are scoped to, preferring the current connection and falling back to platform/local defaults.

nodes.name: clearWorkspaceTerminals
nodes.summary: Clears a workspace's terminal sessions: disposes the cached session, removes persisted state, and sweeps legacy storage keys left by older formats.

nodes.name: createWorkspaceTerminalSession
nodes.summary: Builds the full per-workspace terminal store and action set: persisted state with migration, exited-terminal removal on server events, pty create/clone/update/remove SDK calls, title/number assignment, tab trimming, next/previous navigation, and reorder/move operations.

nodes.name: entry.tsx
nodes.summary: Web app entry point: constructs the web Platform implementation (localStorage-backed default server URL, browser notifications, history navigation, reload), optionally initializes Sentry, extracts and strips the auth_token URL parameter, and renders PlatformProvider + AppBaseProviders + AppInterface with the resolved server connection.

nodes.name: setStorage
nodes.summary: Writes (or removes, when given null) a value under a localStorage key with defensive try/catch around quota and serialization failures.

nodes.name: notify
nodes.summary: Sends a browser notification when the page is unfocused: requests permission, skips when the document has focus, and routes notification clicks through the shared handleNotificationClick deep-link handler.

nodes.name: env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Ambient type declarations for Vite import.meta.env (opencode server host/port/channel, Sentry DSN/environment/release) plus a solid-js JSX module augmentation registering the sortable directive.

nodes.name: use-providers.ts
