nodes.summary: Returns an agent's tint color: custom override first, then built-in defaults, then a deterministic palette tone hashed from the lowercased name.

nodes.name: messageAgentColor
nodes.summary: Scans messages backwards for the last user message carrying an agent and resolves that agent's color against the configured agent list.

nodes.name: aim.ts
nodes.summary: Headless 'aim' interaction controller that activates hover targets from pointer trajectory — detects deliberate movement toward a region's right edge or converging corner slopes and activates after a dwell delay.
nodes.languageNotes: Slope-comparison gesture recognition: delayed activation requires a decreasing slope toward the top-right corner AND an increasing slope toward the bottom-right corner between consecutive pointer samples.

nodes.name: createAim
nodes.summary: Builds the aim controller tracking recent pointer locations; activates hover targets immediately when idle or after a configurable dwell delay when the pointer converges toward the region's right edge, with enter/leave/cancel/reset lifecycle methods.

nodes.name: base64.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny base64 helper exposing decode64, which decodes credential tokens (e.g. Basic auth) using the runtime's base64Decode routine.

nodes.name: decode64
nodes.summary: Decodes a base64 string into plain text via the environment's base64Decode helper.

nodes.name: comment-note.ts
nodes.summary: Serializes and parses user code-review comments attached to files or line selections, both as structured opencodeComment metadata and as LLM-readable prompt notes. Round-trips between the structured form and a natural-language format so comments sent to the model can be parsed back into FileSelection objects.
nodes.languageNotes: Maintains two parallel representations: a typed metadata object for the client and a regex-parseable sentence format for the LLM prompt.

nodes.name: selection
nodes.summary: Validates an unknown selection object into a FileSelection with finite startLine/startChar/endLine/endChar, returning undefined when malformed.

nodes.name: createCommentMetadata
nodes.summary: Wraps a PromptComment into an opencodeComment metadata object for attaching structured comment context to a message part.

nodes.name: readCommentMetadata
nodes.summary: Safely extracts and validates an opencodeComment payload from unknown message metadata, returning a PromptComment or undefined.

nodes.name: formatCommentNote
nodes.summary: Renders a comment as an LLM-readable note naming the file and line range, e.g. 'The user made the following comment regarding lines 3 through 7 of path...'.

nodes.name: parseCommentNote
nodes.summary: Parses a formatted comment note back into path, selection, and comment using a regex that mirrors formatCommentNote's output.

nodes.name: diffs.ts
nodes.summary: Type guards for diff-shaped message data returned by the SDK: validates individual diff entries, collections of diffs, and whole diff message payloads.

nodes.name: diffs
nodes.summary: Type guard validating that a value is a collection of well-formed diffs, delegating to the per-entry diff and object guards.

nodes.name: message
nodes.summary: Type guard validating a diff message payload, composing the object shape check with the diffs collection guard.

nodes.name: id.ts
nodes.summary: Generates prefixed, lexicographically sortable identifiers (ses_, msg_, per_, usr_, prt_, pty_) through the exported Identifier namespace, offering ascending and descending timestamp ordering plus a zod prefix schema for validation.
nodes.languageNotes: Packs Date.now() into 6 big-endian bytes as (timestamp << 12) + monotonic counter, then bit-inverts the value (~) for descending IDs so string sort order follows creation order or its reverse.

nodes.name: generateID
nodes.summary: Entry point behind Identifier.ascending/descending: mints a new prefixed ID or validates a caller-supplied ID against the expected prefix, throwing on mismatch.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Mints a sortable ID: packs (timestamp << 12) + per-millisecond counter into 6 hex bytes, bit-inverts the value for descending order, and appends crypto-random base62 characters.

nodes.name: getRandomBytes
nodes.summary: Fills a Uint8Array with random bytes using crypto.getRandomValues, falling back to per-byte Math.random in non-crypto environments.

nodes.name: notification-click.ts
nodes.summary: Routes web notification clicks back into the SPA: the app registers its navigate function via setNavigate, and the click handler focuses the window and navigates, falling back to location.assign when no navigator is registered.

nodes.name: handleNotificationClick
nodes.summary: Handles a notification click by focusing the window and invoking the registered navigate function, falling back to a full page navigation via location.assign.

nodes.name: path-key.ts
nodes.summary: Normalizes file paths into stable storage keys by canonicalizing Windows backslashes to forward slashes, trimming trailing slashes, and preserving drive-letter roots like C:/.

nodes.name: pathKey
nodes.summary: Canonicalizes a path into a stable key: rewrites Windows backslash paths to forward slashes, trims trailing slashes, and keeps drive-letter roots intact.

nodes.name: persist.ts
nodes.summary: Client-side state persistence layer for SolidJS stores: wraps @solid-primitives/storage makePersisted with an in-memory LRU cache, quota-aware eviction, defaults merging, migration from legacy storage layouts, and dual web (localStorage) / desktop (async platform storage) backends. Exposes the Persist target builder (global/workspace/session scopes), persisted() binding, removePersisted() cleanup, and a PersistTesting surface.
nodes.languageNotes: Handles browser storage quota exhaustion defensively (retry after removeItem, then evict largest 'opencode.'-prefixed keys) and permanently degrades to an in-memory cache per scope once localStorage access throws, e.g. blocked cookies.

nodes.name: quota
nodes.summary: Detects storage quota errors across browsers by checking DOMException names and codes as well as quota-like message text on unknown error objects.

nodes.name: evict
nodes.summary: Frees localStorage space when quota is exceeded by removing other 'opencode.'-prefixed keys largest-first until the pending write succeeds.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Quota-resilient storage write: tries setItem, retries after removing the stale key, and finally falls back to evict() to make room.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Recursively merges a persisted value over defaults, preserving arrays as-is and keeping unknown keys so newly added default fields appear for existing users.

nodes.name: readCurrent
nodes.summary: Reads the current key from synchronous storage, normalizing the raw JSON (migrate + merge) and writing the normalized form back or removing corrupt entries.

nodes.name: migrateLegacy
nodes.summary: Migrates a persisted value from legacy locations on the sync path — legacy prefixed stores first, then legacy keys — moving the normalized value into current storage and deleting the old entry.

nodes.name: readCurrentAsync
nodes.summary: Async twin of readCurrent for the desktop AsyncStorage backend, normalizing raw JSON and removing corrupt entries.

nodes.name: migrateLegacyAsync
nodes.summary: Async twin of migrateLegacy for the desktop AsyncStorage backend, migrating legacy stores and keys into current storage.

nodes.name: legacyWorkspaceStorage
nodes.summary: Computes legacy workspace storage names for a directory, accounting for pre-pathKey raw paths and Windows drive-letter backslash variants.

nodes.name: localStorageWithPrefix
nodes.summary: Wraps localStorage in a SyncStorage scoped by key prefix, layering an in-memory LRU cache and a permanent in-memory fallback once localStorage access fails for that scope.

nodes.name: localStorageDirect
nodes.summary: SyncStorage adapter over unprefixed localStorage keys with the same caching and failure-fallback semantics as localStorageWithPrefix.

nodes.name: removePersisted
nodes.summary: Deletes a persisted key from its current and legacy storages on both desktop (platform storage) and web (localStorage) backends.

nodes.name: persisted
nodes.summary: The core persistence primitive: binds a Solid store to a PersistTarget (global, workspace-, or session-scoped) through makePersisted, assembling a sync or async storage API with legacy migration layered on top, and returns [state, setState, init, ready] where ready tracks hydration of async desktop storage.
nodes.languageNotes: Augments makePersisted's result with a createResource-backed ready accessor so components can await async desktop storage hydration before reading persisted state.

nodes.name: prompt.ts
nodes.summary: Reconstructs a composer Prompt from SDK message parts, used by undo to restore the original user input: rebuilds @-mention syntax for files and agents, resolves paths relative to the session directory, extracts line selections from file URLs, and separates image attachments from inline text.

nodes.name: selectionFromFileUrl
nodes.summary: Extracts a line selection (startLine/endLine) from the query string of a file part's URL.

nodes.name: textPartValue
nodes.summary: Picks the longest non-synthetic, non-ignored text part from a message — the one representing the user's actual prompt.

nodes.name: extractPromptFromParts
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a Prompt from message parts for undo/restore: re-emits @-mention syntax for inline file and agent mentions sorted by position, resolves file paths relative to the session directory, and splits out image/file attachments from the restored text.

nodes.name: runtime-adapters.ts
nodes.summary: Duck-typing adapters that probe untyped runtime objects for optional capabilities — dispose, setOption, hovered-link text, and SpeechRecognition — without importing platform-specific types.

nodes.name: getHoveredLinkText
nodes.summary: Duck-types a runtime object to read hovered link text from an xterm-like terminal API.

nodes.name: getSpeechRecognitionCtor
nodes.summary: Duck-types a runtime bridge object to retrieve the SpeechRecognition constructor used for voice input.

nodes.name: same.ts
nodes.summary: Shallow array equality helper comparing element references, used to skip redundant updates.

nodes.name: same
nodes.summary: Shallow equality for arrays: true when both arrays have the same length and identical element references.

nodes.name: scoped-cache.ts
nodes.summary: Factory for keyed caches with TTL expiry, LRU touch-on-access, max-entry pruning, and dispose hooks — the client-side twin of the ScopedCache pattern used by the opencode server for per-directory instances.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports a factory (createScopedCache) rather than a class; expiry and capacity pruning happen inside get()/peek() so callers never observe stale entries.

nodes.name: createScopedCache
nodes.summary: Creates a scoped cache around a createValue factory, exposing get/peek/remove/clear with TTL sweep, LRU touch-on-access, max-entry pruning, and dispose callbacks for evicted values.

nodes.name: server-errors.ts
nodes.summary: Converts server error payloads into human-readable, translated messages, with dedicated parsers for config-validation issues (listing zod issue paths) and provider model-not-found errors (suggesting similar model IDs).

nodes.name: formatServerError
nodes.summary: Formats an unknown server error into a readable message, dispatching to dedicated parsers for config-invalid and provider-model-not-found shapes with a translated fallback.

nodes.name: parseReadableConfigInvalidError
nodes.summary: Renders a config validation error into a readable, translated message listing each validation issue's path and message.

nodes.name: parseReadableProviderModelNotFoundError
nodes.summary: Renders a model-not-found error with up to five suggested similar model IDs as a translated 'Did you mean' hint.

nodes.name: server-health.ts
nodes.summary: Probes server health through the SDK global.health endpoint with retries, linear backoff, and an overall timeout, plus a SolidJS hook (useCheckServerHealth) that memoizes results per server URL in a 30-second module cache.

nodes.name: timeoutSignal
nodes.summary: Creates an AbortSignal that aborts after a timeout, using the platform's timeout support when available and a manual setTimeout fallback otherwise.

nodes.name: wait
nodes.summary: Promise-based delay that resolves after the given milliseconds and rejects immediately if the caller's signal aborts.

nodes.name: checkServerHealth
nodes.summary: Polls the server's global.health endpoint with linear backoff, retrying network-class errors and respecting an overall timeout signal, returning health status and server version.

nodes.name: useCheckServerHealth
nodes.summary: SolidJS hook wrapper around checkServerHealth that serves cached results per server URL for 30 seconds to avoid duplicate probes across components.

nodes.name: server.ts
nodes.summary: Builds @opencode-ai/sdk clients bound to a specific server connection, generating Basic auth headers from username/password credentials and encoding/decoding credential tokens.

nodes.name: authFromToken
nodes.summary: Decodes a Basic auth token back into its username and password components.

nodes.name: createSdkForServer
nodes.summary: Instantiates an SDK client pointed at a specific server URL, injecting a Basic Authorization header when credentials are present and merging any custom fetch config headers.

nodes.name: session-title.ts
nodes.summary: Strips the auto-generated timestamp suffix from default session titles ('New session - 2026-01-01T...Z' becomes 'New session') for display.

nodes.name: sessionTitle
nodes.summary: Matches an auto-generated title pattern and returns just the label part, passing through custom titles unchanged.

nodes.name: solid-dnd.tsx
nodes.summary: Drag-and-drop helpers for solid-dnd: extracts draggable IDs from custom drag events and exports axis-constraint transformers (ConstrainDragXAxis / ConstrainDragYAxis) that lock dragging to a single axis.

nodes.name: getDraggableId
nodes.summary: Extracts the draggable node id from a solid-dnd drag event object.

nodes.name: createAxisConstraint
nodes.summary: Builds a drag transformer that zeroes movement along one axis, registering it with the drag-drop context when the constrained node starts dragging and removing it on drag end or cleanup.

nodes.name: sound.ts
nodes.summary: Plays notification sounds by lazily loading audio assets discovered via Vite's import.meta.glob, caching resolved URLs and exposing SOUND_OPTIONS plus playSoundById for the settings UI.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses import.meta.glob so sound assets are code-split and only fetched on first play, with a Promise cache to avoid repeated dynamic imports.

nodes.name: getLoads
nodes.summary: Maps sound file paths discovered by import.meta.glob to lazy loader functions keyed by sound id.

nodes.name: soundSrc
nodes.summary: Resolves and caches the URL for a sound id by invoking its lazy loader, falling back to the default sound when the id is unknown.

nodes.name: playSound
nodes.summary: Plays an audio element for a source URL, pausing any currently playing sound first and swallowing autoplay-policy rejections.

nodes.name: terminal-websocket-url.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the WebSocket URL for a terminal session from an HTTP base URL, converting the scheme, carrying query parameters, and appending Basic auth credentials when the server requires them.

nodes.name: terminalWebSocketURL
nodes.summary: Converts an HTTP(S) server URL plus session parameters into an authenticated ws(s):// WebSocket URL for the terminal connection.

nodes.name: terminal-writer.ts
nodes.summary: Batching writer for terminal output: coalesces queued chunks and flushes them through a schedulable callback with error settling, preventing interleaved partial writes to the xterm display.

nodes.name: terminalWriter
nodes.summary: Creates a coalescing writer around a terminal write callback: batches pushed chunks, flushes joined output through the provided scheduler, settles write errors, and lets callers await completion via flush().

nodes.name: time.ts
nodes.summary: Formats timestamps as localized relative-time strings (seconds, minutes, hours, or days ago) through a translation callback.

nodes.name: getRelativeTime
nodes.summary: Formats a date as a localized relative-time string ('5m ago') by bucketing the elapsed duration and delegating each unit label to a translation callback.

nodes.name: uuid.ts
nodes.summary: Generates RFC 4122 UUIDs via crypto.randomUUID with a Math.random-based fallback for environments lacking the Web Crypto API.

nodes.name: uuid
nodes.summary: Returns crypto.randomUUID() when available, otherwise concatenates random hex slices into a UUID-shaped fallback string.

nodes.name: worktree.ts
nodes.summary: Module-level registry tracking worktree setup state (pending/ready/failed) per directory, with promise-based wait() so components can await worktree readiness exactly once.
nodes.languageNotes: A const-object singleton (Worktree) built from Map-based state plus deferred-promise waiters rather than a class; waiter promises are shared per directory until resolved.

nodes.name: sst-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated SST ambient type declaration that pulls in the sst environment types for the app package.
nodes.languageNotes: Generated by SST (marked do-not-edit); references the repo-root sst-env.d.ts via a triple-slash path.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite configuration for the app package: dev server on 0.0.0.0:3000, esnext build target with sourcemaps, optional Sentry release/source-map upload when env tokens are set, and the desktop plugin pipeline from vite.js.

nodes.name: vite.js
nodes.summary: Vite plugin pipeline for the SolidJS app: configures the '@' path alias and ES worker format, inlines the theme preload script into index.html at build time, and registers Tailwind CSS v4 and the solid plugin.
nodes.languageNotes: Plain JS (not TS) so Vite can load it without transformation; the theme-preload plugin inlines oc-theme-preload.js into the HTML to avoid a flash of wrong theme.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documents the CI container images (base, bun-node, rust, tauri-linux, publish) used by the monorepo build, explaining their purpose and how the build script produces them.

nodes.name: build.ts
nodes.summary: Bun shell script that builds the five CI container images (base, bun-node, rust, tauri-linux, publish) via docker buildx for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, optionally pushing to a registry; derives the pinned Bun version from the root packageManager field.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Bun's `$` tagged-template shell API; the bun-node image version is sourced from the root package.json packageManager field to keep the container Bun in sync with the repo.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the containers package, extending the shared root config with package-specific compiler options for the container build scripts.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @opencode-ai/core, the shared core package used by both opencode and app; declares the opencode bin, wildcard `./*` subpath exports, and dependencies on effect, zod, and platform libraries.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent guidance notes for the core package: explains that Effect Schema ASTs are immutable so the effect-zod walkCache stays valid, and that Effect.runSyncExit on async transforms surfaces as defects rather than silent errors.

nodes.name: cross-spawn-spawner.ts
nodes.summary: Implements Effect's CommandExecutor contract on top of cross-spawn, providing Effect-native child process spawning with stream/sink stdio bridging, process-group kill on timeout, and PlatformError mapping. Exports the make factory plus layer/defaultLayer for wiring into a runtime.
nodes.languageNotes: Bridges Effect Platform's Command/CommandInput abstractions onto node child_process: streams become 'pipe' stdio, timeouts kill the detached process group, and spawn errors are normalized to PlatformError via a tag-mapping helper.

nodes.name: effect-zod.ts
nodes.summary: Converts Effect Schemas to zod schemas by walking the Effect Schema AST, translating types, refinements, defaults, optionality, unions, and objects. The derived zod forms feed the zod-openapi JSON Schema pipeline used by the LLM/SDK layer.
nodes.languageNotes: Memoizes walks in a WeakMap keyed by AST node identity — safe because Effect Schema ASTs are immutable and shared. A ZodOverride symbol annotation lets authors hand-craft a zod schema that overrides AST-derived output.

nodes.name: logger.ts
nodes.summary: Custom Effect Logger implementation that normalizes structured log fields (renaming sessionID to session.id), renders log spans as durations, and attaches causes, providing a Handle facade with debug/info/warn/error methods.

nodes.name: memo-map.ts
nodes.summary: Creates and exports a process-wide Layer memo map so independently built runtimes share memoized service instances instead of re-constructing layers.
nodes.languageNotes: Layer.makeMemoMapUnsafe is called once at module load; passing this shared MemoMap to ManagedRuntime.make is how services stay singletons across multiple runtimes.

nodes.name: observability.ts
nodes.summary: Wires OpenTelemetry observability when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set: builds the OTLP resource attributes, layers the OTLP log exporter alongside the custom Effect logger, and lazily initializes NodeSdk tracing via dynamic imports.
nodes.languageNotes: Trace SDK packages (@opentelemetry/sdk-node etc.) are loaded via dynamic import inside the layer so the tracing stack never loads unless OTel is enabled.

nodes.name: runtime.ts
nodes.summary: Helper that builds a ManagedRuntime for a service layer (sharing the global memo map and observability layer) and returns a convenience facade exposing runSync, runPromise, runPromiseExit, runFork, and runCallback.

nodes.name: filesystem.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the AppFileSystem service: an Effect FileSystem extension with safe exists/read helpers, JSON read/write, directory-creating writes, typed directory entries, glob support, and findUp/up/globUp ancestor searches. Also exports Windows-aware pure path helpers (normalizePath, windowsPath, resolve, overlaps, contains).
nodes.languageNotes: windowsPath rewrites POSIX-style drive prefixes (/c/, /cygdrive/c/, /mnt/c/) into Windows drive letters so paths coming from Git Bash, Cygwin, or WSL resolve correctly on win32.

nodes.name: flag.ts
nodes.summary: Centralizes all environment-variable feature flags (OPENCODE_DISABLE_*, OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_*, OTEL endpoints) into a single Flag object, with channel-aware defaults so experimental features are on for dev/beta/local and opt-in for stable.
nodes.languageNotes: unstableDefault() flips defaults by InstallationChannel: flags like OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_MARKDOWN and OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CUSTOMIZE_SKILL default on unless the channel is stable.

nodes.name: global.ts
nodes.summary: Global paths service that resolves the opencode state/config/cache directories (honoring XDG conventions and the global lock system) and exposes them as a Context service with layer/defaultLayer/layerWith constructors.

nodes.name: version.ts
nodes.summary: Exports the installation version, channel, and an is-local boolean from compile-time defines, falling back to "local" when not built.
nodes.languageNotes: Reads global OPENCODE_VERSION/OPENCODE_CHANNEL constants that Bun's compile step injects as defines; typeof guards keep unbuilt dev runs from throwing on undefined globals.

nodes.name: npm-config.ts
nodes.summary: Loads resolved npm configuration for a directory via @npmcli/config (project, user, and global .npmrc) as an Effect, and derives the normalized registry URL used for package operations.

nodes.name: npm.ts
nodes.summary: Npm service that installs and manages packages programmatically through @npmcli/arborist (reify-based install/add), guarded by the EffectFlock cross-process lock, with bin resolution (which) and entry-point resolution for installed packages. Also exposes standalone install/add/which helpers backed by a default runtime.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Arborist.reify instead of shelling out to npm so installs respect the user's .npmrc without spawning a child process; concurrent installs on the same directory serialize through a file lock.

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: Reusable Effect Schema building blocks: PositiveInt/NonNegativeInt branded ints, optionalOmitUndefined for optional keys that skip undefined values, withStatics for attaching static methods to schemas, and a Newtype helper for zero-cost branded types.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent guidance for the core util directory covering the error.ts isInstance null guard, identifier.ts module-level mutable state caveat, and the fact that binary.ts insert mutates the array in place.

nodes.name: array.ts
nodes.summary: Provides a findLast helper that scans an array backwards for the last element matching a predicate.

nodes.name: binary.ts
nodes.summary: Binary search primitives over arrays sorted by a string key: search locates an id (returning found + insertion index) and insert splices a new item into sorted position, mutating the array in place.
nodes.languageNotes: insert mutates the caller's array via splice — a deliberate performance choice documented in util/AGENTS.md; callers wanting immutability must copy first.

nodes.name: effect-flock.ts
nodes.summary: Effect-native cross-process file locking service built on atomic mkdir: acquires advisory locks under the global state directory with heartbeat files, stale-lock takeover via a breaker directory, jittered retry with timeout, and scope-based automatic release. Exposes acquire and withLock through a Context service.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses mkdir EEXIST as the atomic contention primitive (works on POSIX and Windows without O_EXCL races); a .breaker directory arbitrates which waiter may reclaim a stale lock, and Effect.ensuring guarantees breaker cleanup.

nodes.name: encode.ts
nodes.summary: Encoding and hashing helpers: URL-safe base64 encode/decode, async SHA hashing via WebCrypto, a fast FNV-style string checksum, and sampledChecksum which fingerprints large content by checksumming evenly spaced windows.

nodes.name: error.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the NamedError base class: a Schema.TaggedErrorClass factory that gives every error a tagged zod schema (name + data), a toObject serializer, an isInstance null-safe type guard, and a create constructor for subclassing.
nodes.languageNotes: isInstance deliberately accepts null/undefined (returning false) because deserialized errors may be missing; Object.defineProperty pins the class name so tagged schemas survive minification.

nodes.name: flock.ts
nodes.summary: Promise-based cross-process file locking (the non-Effect twin of effect-flock): atomic-mkdir lock directories with heartbeat mtime updates, stale detection and breaker-coordinated takeover, jittered retry with timeout and abort support, plus acquire/withLock/async-dispose lease APIs.
nodes.languageNotes: Heartbeats touch the lock directory's mtime via utimes on an unref'd interval, so a crashed holder's lock goes stale after staleMs and a surviving waiter reclaims it through the .breaker race.

nodes.name: make
nodes.summary: Builds the CommandExecutor service: resolves cwd/env, maps Effect streams and sinks onto 'pipe' stdio, spawns via cross-spawn with detached process groups, wires stdin/stdout/stderr streams, implements signal sending with group-kill fallback, and applies timeouts.

nodes.name: zod
nodes.summary: Converts any Effect Schema into the equivalent zod type by walking the schema's AST, returning the memoized cached subtree when available.

nodes.name: zodObject
nodes.summary: Like zod() but narrows the result to z.ZodObject so .shape/.omit/.extend are usable; honors a schema's pre-attached .zod static or the ZodOverride annotation instead of re-deriving from the AST.

nodes.name: toJsonSchema
nodes.summary: Emits a JSON Schema from an Effect Schema by deriving the zod form first, so Effect Schema tool/route parameters flow through the same zod-openapi pipeline as native zod schemas (io: "input").

nodes.name: translateFilter
nodes.summary: Translates a single Effect Schema AST filter annotation into the corresponding zod constraint (min/max/length/startsWith/regex/integers/etc.), returning unhandled filters so the caller can fall back to superRefine.

nodes.name: logger
nodes.summary: The core Logger.make implementation: reads fiber log annotations and spans, converts span durations to milliseconds, pretty-prints causes, and forwards each entry to the shared Log sink with normalized field keys.

nodes.name: resource
nodes.summary: Builds the OTLP resource descriptor (service name/version plus attributes) by merging process metadata with OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES parsed from the W3C comma-separated key=value format.

nodes.name: logs
nodes.summary: Constructs the logging layer that replaces existing loggers with the custom Effect logger plus an OTLP HTTP log exporter pointed at the configured collector endpoint.

nodes.name: traces
nodes.summary: Lazily imports the OpenTelemetry Node SDK and builds a tracing layer that installs a global context manager, enables instrumentation, and exports spans to the OTLP endpoint.

nodes.name: makeRuntime
nodes.summary: Creates a ManagedRuntime for a service tag and layer (memoized via the shared memo map and observability layer) and returns a facade with runSync/runPromise/runPromiseExit/runFork/runCallback helpers.

nodes.name: layer
nodes.summary: Constructs the AppFileSystem service over Effect's FileSystem: safe exists/read variants that swallow NotFound, JSON read/write, ensureDir, writeWithDirs that creates parent directories on demand, typed directory entries, glob delegation, and findUp/up/globUp ancestor walkers.

nodes.name: findUp
nodes.summary: Walks ancestor directories from a start path collecting every occurrence of a named target file, stopping at an optional boundary or the filesystem root.

nodes.name: normalizePath
nodes.summary: Normalizes a path for Windows by converting POSIX drive prefixes, resolving, and following the native realpath (falling back to the resolved path when the target does not exist).

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves a path to its real absolute form on Windows (handling WSL/cygdrive prefixes and symlinks), returning the normalized resolved path for missing targets instead of throwing on ENOENT.

nodes.name: windowsPath
nodes.summary: Rewrites Git Bash (/c/), Cygwin (/cygdrive/c/), and WSL (/mnt/c/) drive prefixes into uppercase Windows drive-letter paths; a no-op on non-win32 platforms.

nodes.name: make
nodes.summary: Computes the global paths object (config, state, cache directories) from the home directory and XDG-style environment overrides, seeding the Flock global so locks land under the state directory.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads the fully resolved npm configuration for a directory using @npmcli/config (merging project/user/global .npmrc and defaults) as an Effect, falling back to an empty config on failure.

nodes.name: layer
nodes.summary: Builds the Npm service: directory-scoped installs guarded by an EffectFlock lock, Arborist-based reify for install/add with parsed npm config, bin discovery via which-like resolution, and entry-point lookup through import.meta.resolve.

nodes.name: resolveEntryPoint
nodes.summary: Resolves a package's main entry point file using import.meta.resolve against the consuming module, returning an Option of the resolved path.

nodes.name: Newtype
nodes.summary: Creates a zero-cost branded newtype over a Schema: values are branded via prototype at decode time, giving nominal typing (SessionID vs plain string) without runtime overhead.

nodes.name: optionalOmitUndefined
nodes.summary: Wraps a Schema as an optional key whose encoding skips undefined values entirely, and whose derived zod form is optional — avoiding explicit undefined leaking into serialized output.

nodes.name: findLast
nodes.summary: Scans an array from the end and returns the last element satisfying the predicate, or undefined.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Binary-searches a string-sorted array for an id, returning whether it was found along with the insertion index for the miss case.

nodes.name: insert
nodes.summary: Inserts an item into a string-sorted array at its binary-searched position, splicing in place and returning the same (mutated) array.

nodes.name: layer
nodes.summary: Builds the EffectFlock service over Global and AppFileSystem: implements acquire via atomic-mkdir lock directories with stale-breaker takeover and a jittered exponential retry schedule, and withLock as a scoped acquire/release wrapper.

nodes.name: tryAcquireLockDir
nodes.summary: Single attempt at acquiring a lock directory: claims it atomically via exclusive mkdir; on contention checks staleness, races a .breaker directory to decide which waiter may remove and recreate the stale lock, then writes heartbeat and meta.json exclusively.

nodes.name: checksum
nodes.summary: Computes a fast synchronous FNV-style 32-bit rolling hash of a string as a compact decimal checksum.

nodes.name: sampledChecksum
nodes.summary: Fingerprints arbitrarily large content by checksumming evenly spaced sample windows of bounded size, joining the per-window checksums into one stable content signature.

nodes.name: NamedError
nodes.summary: Base class for all typed errors in the codebase: create() derives a Schema.TaggedErrorClass with a name-literal + data schema, plus toObject serialization, a null-safe isInstance guard, and message formatting from the data payload.

nodes.name: acquire
nodes.summary: Acquires a cross-process lock for a key: hashes the key into a lock directory under the global state root, retries with jitter until timeout, starts the heartbeat, and returns a Lease with release and Symbol.asyncDispose.

nodes.name: tryAcquireLockDir
nodes.summary: One lock-acquisition attempt: atomically mkdir's the lock dir; if contended, detects staleness from heartbeat age, uses a .breaker directory to elect a single waiter to reclaim the stale lock, then writes heartbeat and meta.json with exclusive-create flags.

nodes.name: fn.ts
nodes.summary: Factory that wraps a callback in a Zod-validated function, exposing .force() to bypass validation and .schema for introspection.

nodes.name: fn
nodes.summary: Creates a validated function wrapper that parses input against a Zod schema before invoking the callback, attaching .force() and .schema properties to the returned function.

nodes.name: glob.ts
nodes.summary: Glob namespace providing unified wrappers around the glob and minimatch packages for async/sync filesystem scanning and pattern matching.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a TypeScript namespace (export namespace Glob) rather than a class to group static helpers — the same pattern used by Hash, Identifier, Module, and Slug in packages/core/src/util.

nodes.name: scan
nodes.summary: Scans the filesystem asynchronously for paths matching a glob pattern, normalizing the namespace Options shape to the underlying glob library's options.

nodes.name: hash.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal Hash namespace offering a fast SHA-1 hex digest helper used for cache keys and content fingerprinting.

nodes.name: identifier.ts
nodes.summary: Generates 26-character sortable unique IDs: a 48-bit timestamp plus counter encoded in the first 12 hex chars with base62 randomness filling the rest, supporting both ascending and bit-inverted descending orderings.
nodes.languageNotes: MongoDB-ObjectId-like scheme with a module-level monotonic counter (lastTimestamp/counter) so IDs minted within the same millisecond still sort in creation order.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Builds a 26-char identifier from a 48-bit timestamp+counter prefix (bit-inverted when descending) plus a random base62 suffix, using module state to keep same-millisecond IDs monotonic.

nodes.name: iife.ts
nodes.summary: Three-line helper that immediately invokes a function and returns its result, typically used to compute inline constants in expressions.

nodes.name: lazy.ts
nodes.summary: Memoizing wrapper that defers computing a value until first access and caches the result for all subsequent calls.

nodes.name: lazy
nodes.summary: Returns a wrapper that invokes the producer function only on the first call and caches its result for every later invocation.

nodes.name: log.ts
nodes.summary: Core logging subsystem: initializes a timestamped log file under the opencode data directory, prunes stale logs, and creates cached tagged logger instances with debug/info/warn/error levels, elapsed-time prefixes, and stopwatch helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Loggers are cached in a module-level _internal.loggers Map so repeated create(tags) calls return the same instance; messages written before init() are queued in a buffer and drained once the file stream opens.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Prepares the logging subsystem: runs cleanup of stale logs, resolves the log file path, truncates it, opens an append stream, and flushes messages queued before initialization.

nodes.name: cleanup
nodes.summary: Prunes old timestamped log files in a directory (matched via Glob.scan), keeping only the newest files and unlinking the rest in parallel.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Creates (or returns a cached) tagged logger exposing debug/info/warn/error methods, key=value tag formatting, ISO timestamp plus elapsed-ms prefixes, and a time() stopwatch helper with child logger cloning.

nodes.name: module.ts
nodes.summary: Module namespace helper that resolves a module id as if required from a target directory using Node's createRequire, returning undefined on failure.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves a module specifier anchored at the given directory by creating a require rooted at its package.json; swallows resolution errors and returns undefined instead of throwing.

nodes.name: opencode-process.ts
nodes.summary: Process identity helpers that lazily assign an OPENCODE_RUN_ID UUID and process role onto globalThis, and build a sanitized env copy with metadata overrides for spawning opencode child processes.

nodes.name: ensureProcessMetadata
nodes.summary: Lazily initializes the run id and process role globals, returning both as a metadata object describing the current process.

nodes.name: sanitizedProcessEnv
nodes.summary: Builds a filtered copy of process.env (dropping empty values) merged with override entries, used to hand a clean environment to spawned opencode processes.

nodes.name: path.ts
nodes.summary: String-based path helpers for extracting filenames, directories, and extensions from URL-ish paths, plus middle-truncation utilities for rendering long filenames in constrained UI space.

nodes.name: getFilename
nodes.summary: Extracts the basename from a path, stripping any query-string suffix (e.g. file.ts?raw=true) before splitting on slashes.

nodes.name: getDirectory
nodes.summary: Returns the parent directory portion of a path by dropping the last segment after splitting on forward slashes.

nodes.name: getFileExtension
nodes.summary: Returns the lowercase file extension (without the dot) taken from the last dot-separated segment of the path.

nodes.name: getFilenameTruncated
nodes.summary: Shortens a filename to a maximum display length by middle-truncating the stem while preserving the file extension.

nodes.name: truncateMiddle
nodes.summary: Truncates text from the middle, keeping balanced head and tail halves joined by an ellipsis.

nodes.name: retry.ts
nodes.summary: Generic async retry helper with exponential backoff that retries only transient network errors by default (ECONNRESET, failed to fetch, socket hang up, etc.), with a customizable retryIf predicate.
nodes.languageNotes: isTransientError matches lowercased substrings of the error message rather than error codes, so it also catches Bun/Fetch runtime message variants across libraries.

nodes.name: retry
nodes.summary: Executes an async function with up to `attempts` tries, sleeping delay*factor^attempt (capped at maxDelay) between failures and rethrowing immediately when retryIf rejects the error.

nodes.name: slug.ts
nodes.summary: Generates human-friendly random slugs by pairing a random adjective with a random noun (e.g. 'curious-falcon') from curated word lists, used for readable session naming.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Returns a random adjective-noun pair joined by a hyphen, sampled uniformly from the module's word lists.

nodes.name: sst-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated SST ambient type declaration that references the repo-root sst-env.d.ts and imports the sst module to type infrastructure environment variables.
nodes.languageNotes: Marked auto-generated by SST with lint/format disable pragmas — regenerated by the toolchain, never hand-edited.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for packages/core extending @tsconfig/bun, relaxing noUncheckedIndexedAccess for the package.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript facade for the Rust/WASM diff engine: lazily loads wasm-bindgen exports with a pure-JS `diff` package fallback on failure, re-exposing diffLines, createTwoFilesPatch, and structuredPatch with byte-compatible jsdiff Change/Hunk formats.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level wasmReady promise plus wasmFailed latch: once WASM init fails, every call permanently falls back to the JS implementation; the glue-module path is overridable via globalThis.OPENCODE_DIFF_WASM_JS_PATH so Bun compile builds can inject the bundled artifact.

nodes.name: ensureWasm
nodes.summary: Lazily dynamic-imports the wasm-bindgen glue module, caches the three Rust diff entry points, runs mod.init(), and latches failure so subsequent calls go straight to the JS fallback.

nodes.name: diffLines
nodes.summary: Computes line-level changes between two strings via the WASM engine (or jsdiff fallback), with adjacent same-tag changes merged to match the jsdiff package's output semantics.

nodes.name: createTwoFilesPatch
nodes.summary: Produces a unified diff string for two named files with configurable context radius, delegating to the Rust implementation and falling back to jsdiff when WASM is unavailable.

nodes.name: structuredPatch
nodes.summary: Returns a structured ParsedDiff (hunks with line arrays and offsets) for two files, computed in Rust when WASM is available and via jsdiff otherwise.

nodes.name: applyPatch
nodes.summary: Applies a unified diff patch to source text, delegating to the jsdiff applyPatch implementation.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Rust WASM diff engine (wasm-bindgen) implementing jsdiff-compatible diffLines, createTwoFilesPatch, and structuredPatch on top of the similar crate's Myers line diff, with serde-serialized Change/Hunk/ParsedDiff outputs.
nodes.languageNotes: Builds unified hunks from similar's TextDiff op ranges (old_range/new_range) and serializes via serde_wasm_bindgen to plain JS objects with camelCase renames; the manual change-merging loops in diff_lines_rs exist solely to replicate jsdiff's merge behavior exactly.

nodes.name: Change
nodes.summary: Serde-serializable struct mirroring jsdiff's Change object: line value, optional added/removed flags, and a line count.

nodes.name: Hunk
nodes.summary: Serde-serializable hunk descriptor with old/new start positions and line counts plus the hunk's content lines, camelCase-renamed for JS consumers.

nodes.name: ParsedDiff
nodes.summary: Top-level structured diff result holding old/new file names, headers, and hunks, matching the jsdiff ParsedDiff shape.

nodes.name: diff_lines_rs
nodes.summary: Computes line diffs with the Myers algorithm and manually merges adjacent insert/delete runs so the serialized Change[] output replicates jsdiff's semantics exactly.

nodes.name: create_two_files_patch_rs
nodes.summary: Renders a unified diff string for two files with a configurable context radius using similar's unified_diff formatter.

nodes.name: structured_patch_rs
nodes.summary: Builds a ParsedDiff whose hunks are derived from similar op ranges (old/new starts and lengths) with per-change lines tagged as context, insert, or delete.

nodes.name: snippet-intro.mdx
nodes.summary: Short MDX snippet used by the documentation to introduce custom snippets as the DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) solution for repeated doc content.

nodes.name: opencode

nodes.languageNotes: The platform matrix mirrors Bun's native-package naming: baseline variants for pre-AVX2 x64 CPUs, musl variants detected via /etc/alpine-release or `ldd --version`; Windows AVX2 detection shells out to PowerShell with an Add-Type P/Invoke of IsProcessorFeaturePresent.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Spawns the resolved binary with inherited stdio, forwards SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP while it runs, and mirrors the child's exit code or re-raises its terminating signal on the launcher process.

nodes.name: supportsAvx2
nodes.summary: Detects AVX2 CPU support per platform: /proc/cpuinfo parsing on Linux, sysctl hw.optional.avx2_0 on macOS, and a PowerShell P/Invoke of IsProcessorFeaturePresent on Windows.

nodes.name: findBinary

nodes.languageNotes: A 900-line Agent class acting as a thin orchestrator over sibling modules (session manager, tool dispatch, model resolution, session config); per-session permission queues serialize concurrent requestPermission calls and forward edit approvals via writeTextFile.

nodes.name: rethrowAuthAware
nodes.summary: Rethrows provider errors as ACP RequestError.authRequired when the failure is a LoadAPIKeyError for the given provider, surfacing authentication problems to the ACP client.

nodes.name: unwrapSyncEvent
nodes.summary: Unwraps the payload from a bus sync event and strips the type prefix from its identifier so downstream consumers see a plain event id.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Entry point that constructs the Agent over an ACP connection and SDK client, wiring the protocol handler for the external editor.

nodes.name: Agent
nodes.summary: Implements the ACP Agent interface: subscribes to the SDK global event stream and translates opencode events into sessionUpdate, plan, and usage notifications; manages per-session permission queues and shell/tool state; and implements initialize, authenticate, the session lifecycle, mode/model config, prompt (including slash-command dispatch), and cancel.

nodes.name: message-replay.ts
nodes.summary: Replays persisted opencode messages to the ACP client, translating each message part (text, tool, resource links, images, thoughts) into the corresponding sessionUpdate chunks so a resumed session renders identically.

nodes.name: processMessage
nodes.summary: Walks a stored message's parts and emits the appropriate ACP sessionUpdate for each: user/agent text chunks, agent thought chunks, resource links, file and data URIs (as images or embedded resources), and tool parts via handleToolPartUpdate.

nodes.name: parseUri
nodes.summary: Extracts filename, mime type, and a file:// URL from file:, http(s):, and data: URIs, falling back to URL-derived guesses when headers are missing.

nodes.name: getNewContent
nodes.summary: Applies a unified diff to the original file content to compute post-edit content, returning undefined when the patch fails to apply.

nodes.name: model-resolution.ts
nodes.summary: Model selection fallback chain and usage reporting for ACP: resolves the default model from config, the last-used session, or provider sort order, and emits usage_update notifications with token and cost totals.

nodes.name: getContextLimit
nodes.summary: Looks up a model's context window limit from the provider config for the given directory, returning undefined on lookup failure.

nodes.name: sendUsageUpdate
nodes.summary: Aggregates token usage and cost from a session's assistant messages and emits an ACP usage_update with used tokens, context size, and USD cost.

nodes.name: defaultModel
nodes.summary: Resolves the model for new ACP sessions through a fallback chain: explicit config model, the last-used model from the most recent session, or the first model of the sorted provider list.

nodes.name: lastUsedModel
nodes.summary: Finds the model recorded on the most recent user message of the latest session, returning it only if the provider still lists that model.

nodes.name: session-config.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helper functions for building ACP session config options: provider sorting and model listing, variant expansion and formatting, model-selection parsing, and assembly of the mode/model/variant option sets surfaced to the ACP client.

nodes.name: sortProvidersByName
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of the provider list sorted case-insensitively by display name.

nodes.name: modelVariantsFromProviders
nodes.summary: Collects the available variant keys for a given provider/model pair from the provider list.

nodes.name: buildAvailableModels
nodes.summary: Flattens providers into a sorted ACP model list, expanding each model's variants into distinct selectable entries.

nodes.name: formatModelIdWithVariant
nodes.summary: Formats a provider/model/variant triple into the canonical model id string, including the variant suffix only when the model has multiple variants to disambiguate.

nodes.name: buildVariantMeta
nodes.summary: Builds display metadata (pretty name and id) for a variant within the set of available variants.

nodes.name: parseModelSelection
nodes.summary: Parses a selected model id back into provider, model, and variant components, tolerating variant suffixes embedded in the model id segment.

nodes.name: buildConfigOptions
nodes.summary: Assembles the ACP session config options — model selector, variant selector, and mode selector — from the available models, variants, and agent modes.

nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.summary: In-memory ACP session manager that caches ACPSessionState (model, variant, mode) per session id, deduplicates concurrent server loads through a pendingLoads map, and syncs create/load/remove operations with the SDK.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately in-memory only — ACP protocol methods don't send cwd with every request, so the manager re-loads from the server on demand; get() throws RequestError.invalidParams while tryGet() silently drops unknown sessions.

nodes.name: ACPSessionManager
nodes.summary: Caches ACPSessionState per session with tryGet/getOrLoad/tryGetOrLoad accessors and setters for model, variant, and mode; concurrent loads of the same id share one in-flight promise via pendingLoads, and remove() evicts the cached entry.

nodes.name: tool-dispatch.ts
nodes.summary: Translates opencode tool-call parts into ACP tool_call updates: a pending/in-progress/completed/failed state machine with shell output dedup, edit/read location derivation, todo-plan decoding, and image content extraction.
nodes.languageNotes: handleToolPartUpdate centralizes all tool state transitions and deduplicates shell output by hashing so ACP clients don't receive repeated identical output blocks.

nodes.name: shellOutput
nodes.summary: Extracts the combined stdout/stderr output text from a running shell tool part.

nodes.name: toolStart
nodes.summary: Emits the initial pending tool_call update for a call id, deduplicated through the shared toolStarts set so each call is announced to the ACP client exactly once.

nodes.name: handleToolPartUpdate
nodes.summary: State machine for tool parts across running, pending, and completed-error states: emits in-progress updates (with shell output deduped by hash), completed updates carrying content blocks or decoded todo plans, and failed updates with error content and raw output.

nodes.name: toToolKind
nodes.summary: Maps opencode tool names (edit, write, bash, read, fetch, move, search...) to ACP ToolKind values, defaulting to other.

nodes.name: toLocations
nodes.summary: Derives ACP Locations (file path plus optional line range) from tool input metadata for edit, read, and move tools.

nodes.name: completedToolContent
nodes.summary: Builds the ACP content blocks for a completed tool call from its title, metadata, and image attachments.

nodes.name: completedToolRawOutput
nodes.summary: Serializes a completed tool part's state (output, metadata, error) into the rawOutput payload for ACP clients.

nodes.name: imageContents
nodes.summary: Converts image attachments carrying data URIs into ACP image content blocks, ignoring non-image mime types.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared ACP types: ACPSessionState (per-session id, cwd, MCP servers, model/variant/mode) and ACPConfig (SDK client plus optional default model) used by the agent adapter and session manager.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent-system notes documenting subagent permission invariants: allow-only has() semantics for tool restrictions, deny-only forwarding with first-wins dedupe in deriveSubagentSessionPermission, prompt permission merging rules, and the shared V1/V2 helpers in subagent-permissions.ts.

nodes.name: agent.ts
nodes.summary: Central agent registry as an Effect service: defines the built-in agents (build, plan, general, explore, scout, compaction, title, summary) with layered permission rulesets, merges user config overrides and scout reference agents per instance, and exposes get/list/defaultAgent plus an LLM-backed generate() that turns a description into a new agent config.
nodes.languageNotes: Agent state is built per-instance via InstanceState (config, skills, and scout references resolved lazily); Permission.merge composes defaults + per-agent + user rulesets; generate() uses the AI SDK's generateObject/streamObject with provider-specific system prompt delivery and avoids colliding identifiers.

nodes.name: generate.txt
nodes.summary: System prompt for the LLM-driven agent generator, instructing the model to turn a natural-language description into a JSON agent config (identifier, whenToUse with Task-tool examples, systemPrompt); imported by agent.ts as PROMPT_GENERATE.

nodes.name: subagent-permissions.ts
nodes.summary: Shared V1/V2 subagent permission helpers: derives the subagent session permission with deny-only parent forwarding and first-wins dedupe, and computes tool enable/disable restrictions from primary_tools.

nodes.name: dedupe
nodes.summary: Deduplicates permission rules by pattern+permission key, keeping the first occurrence encountered (earlier entries win).

nodes.name: deriveSubagentSessionPermission
nodes.summary: Merges the subagent's permission with deny rules forwarded from the parent agent, deduped first-wins; only deny rules propagate from the parent so subagents never gain extra rights.

nodes.name: subagentSessionPermission
nodes.summary: Wraps deriveSubagentSessionPermission and additionally grants an allow rule for each of the subagent's primary tools.

nodes.name: subagentToolRestrictions
nodes.summary: Builds a tools enable/disable record from primary_tools — a tool is enabled only when the subagent's permission rules contain an explicit allow for it.

nodes.name: audio.d.ts
nodes.summary: Ambient module declarations enabling default imports of .wav and .wasm asset files as URL strings for the bundler.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Auth credential store as an Effect service: reads and writes auth.json (mode 0600) with OAuth, API-key, and well-known variants discriminated by type, honoring OPENCODE_AUTH_CONTENT for injected credentials and normalizing trailing-slash provider keys.
nodes.languageNotes: A Schema.Class union with a type discriminator gives typed decoding of the stored file; the OPENCODE_AUTH_CONTENT env var overrides the file entirely; writes strip duplicate trailing-slash keys.

nodes.name: bus-event.ts
nodes.summary: Typed bus event definition factory: registers event types with their Effect Schema properties and regenerates the effectPayloads schema set (id/type/properties) used for the SDK event union.

nodes.name: define
nodes.summary: Registers a bus event type with its properties schema in the module registry and returns a definition object carrying the type string and schema.

nodes.name: effectPayloads
nodes.summary: Maps every registered event definition to an Effect Schema struct (id, literal type, properties) annotated as Event.<type> for the generated SDK event union.

nodes.name: global.ts
nodes.summary: Process-wide GlobalBus EventEmitter that stamps emitted event payloads with an ascending evt id (reusing the sync event's id when present), fanning bus events out to non-Effect listeners.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: The core event bus as an Effect service: per-instance typed and wildcard PubSubs created via InstanceState, publish/subscribe/subscribeAll streams, callback subscriptions bridged into fibers via EffectBridge, GlobalBus fan-out, and an InstanceDisposed event published on shutdown; module-level publish/subscribe wrappers run the service outside Effect contexts.
nodes.languageNotes: Each event type gets its own unbounded PubSub alongside a wildcard PubSub; a scope finalizer publishes server.instance.disposed before shutdown; EffectBridge plus an explicit Scope converts Effect streams into plain callback subscriptions with proper cleanup.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: CLI-local agent instructions documenting the effectCmd error-handling contract: handlers must return Effect<void, CliError, ...> and surface user-visible errors via fail() from effect-cmd, since Effect.fail(new Error(...)) fails typecheck.

nodes.name: bootstrap.ts
nodes.summary: Wraps a callback in the per-directory project instance lifecycle, providing the WithInstance context and disposing the instance in a finally block when the callback settles.

nodes.name: bootstrap
nodes.summary: Runs a callback inside a WithInstance.provide scope bound to the given directory and always disposes the InstanceRuntime for the current instance afterward.

nodes.name: account.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the console account commands: device-code OAuth login with polling, logout (direct or interactive), org switching and listing, and opening the console in a browser, all grouped under the parent console command.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an Effect.fn generator with a recursive poll() helper that grows its backoff interval, and exhaustively handles every PollResult variant via Match.valueTags.

nodes.name: LoginCommand
nodes.summary: Starts the console device-code login flow: opens the authorization URL in a browser, polls with growing intervals until success/expiry/denial, and reports the outcome through the spinner.

nodes.name: LogoutCommand
nodes.summary: Logs out from a console account either directly by email or through an interactive picker over all stored accounts.

nodes.name: SwitchCommand
nodes.summary: Interactively switches the active console organization across all logged-in accounts, marking the currently active choice.

nodes.name: OrgsCommand
nodes.summary: Prints every organization across all logged-in accounts, highlighting the active one with a status dot and styling.

nodes.name: OpenCommand
nodes.summary: Opens the active console account URL in the system browser.

nodes.name: ConsoleCommand
nodes.summary: Parent console command that re-registers the login, logout, switch, orgs, and open subcommands with user-facing descriptions.

nodes.name: acp.ts
nodes.summary: Starts the ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server: boots the opencode HTTP server, points an internal SDK client at it, and bridges stdin/stdout NDJSON streams into an AgentSideConnection for editor integrations.
nodes.languageNotes: Adapts Node process.stdin/stdout into web ReadableStream/WritableStream to feed the @agentclientprotocol/sdk ndJsonStream transport.

nodes.name: AcpCommand
nodes.summary: Boots the opencode server with resolved network options, connects an authenticated SDK client to it, and serves ACP over stdin/stdout until stdin ends.

nodes.name: agent.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the agent management command: interactive or fully non-interactive agent creation that LLM-generates the system prompt and writes a markdown file with permission frontmatter, plus a listing subcommand.
nodes.languageNotes: Permissions are configured at the permission-key level (e.g. edit, bash) rather than raw tool names, matching how the runtime actually enforces tool gating; unselected permissions become explicit deny rules.

nodes.name: AgentCreateCommand
nodes.summary: Creates a new agent markdown file: collects scope, description, permissions, and mode via prompts (or CLI flags for fully non-interactive runs), generates the system prompt with the Agent service, and writes gray-matter frontmatter with deny rules for unselected permissions.

nodes.name: AgentCommand
nodes.summary: Parent agent command grouping the create and list subcommands.

nodes.name: cmd.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny identity helper that types yargs CommandModules so their argument type includes the double-dash passthrough ("--" followed by free strings) used to forward args to spawned processes.

nodes.name: cmd
nodes.summary: Identity function that widens a yargs CommandModule's inferred arguments to the WithDoubleDash shape.

nodes.name: db.ts
nodes.summary: Database debugging commands: opens a read-only-guarded sqlite3 shell or runs a single query, prints the database path, and migrates legacy JSON storage into SQLite with a terminal progress bar.

nodes.name: QueryCommand
nodes.summary: Default db command: executes a single SQL query against the readonly database (rejecting any mutating statement with an error) and prints JSON or TSV output, or drops into an interactive sqlite3 shell when no query is given.

nodes.name: MigrateCommand
nodes.summary: Migrates legacy JSON session storage into SQLite via JsonMigration.run, rendering an animated TTY progress bar or machine-readable percentage lines on non-TTY output.

nodes.name: DbCommand
nodes.summary: Parent db command grouping the query, path, and migrate subcommands.

nodes.name: agent.ts
nodes.summary: Debug command that prints an agent's fully resolved configuration including per-tool enablement, or directly executes one of the agent's tools with JSON params against a synthetic session and message context.

nodes.name: AgentCommand
nodes.summary: debug agent <name> entry point: shows the agent configuration with resolved tools, or runs a specific tool with --tool/--params and prints the input plus result as JSON.

nodes.name: resolveTools
nodes.summary: Computes a tool-id to enabled boolean map by applying the agent's permission ruleset through Permission.disabled().

nodes.name: parseToolParams
nodes.summary: Parses a --params string as a JSON object, throwing when the input parses to a non-object or array.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Debug command that prints the fully resolved configuration as pretty-printed JSON.

nodes.name: ConfigCommand
nodes.summary: Fetches the merged configuration from Config.Service and writes it to stdout as JSON.

nodes.name: file.ts
nodes.summary: Filesystem debugging utilities exposed as debug file subcommands: read a file as JSON, status, directory listing, fuzzy search, and a ripgrep-backed directory tree.

nodes.name: FileCommand
nodes.summary: Parent debug file command registering the read, status, list, search, and tree subcommands.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Root debug command that registers every debugging subcommand (config, lsp, rg, file, scrap, skill, snapshot, startup, agent, info, paths, wait) and defines the info, paths, and wait helpers inline.

nodes.name: DebugCommand
nodes.summary: Parent debug command that composes all troubleshooting subcommands from their sibling modules and demands one is invoked.

nodes.name: lsp.ts
nodes.summary: LSP debugging commands: diagnostics for a file, workspace symbol search, and document symbol lookup, each timed via Log.Default.time.

nodes.name: LSPCommand
nodes.summary: Parent debug lsp command grouping diagnostics, symbols, and document-symbols subcommands.

nodes.name: SymbolsCommand
nodes.summary: Searches workspace symbols by query through the LSP service and prints the results as JSON.

nodes.name: DocumentSymbolsCommand
nodes.summary: Fetches symbols for a single document URI through the LSP service and prints them as JSON.

nodes.name: ripgrep.ts
nodes.summary: Ripgrep debugging commands exposing the Ripgrep service: file tree with limit, file listing filtered by glob and query, and content search over the current instance directory.

nodes.name: RipgrepCommand
nodes.summary: Parent debug rg command grouping the tree, files, and search subcommands.

nodes.name: scrap.ts
nodes.summary: Debug command that dumps all known projects as pretty-printed JSON, wrapped in a Log timing span.

nodes.name: ScrapCommand
nodes.summary: Prints the full Project.list() result as JSON to stdout and stops the Log.Default.time span measuring the scrape.

nodes.name: skill.ts
nodes.summary: Skill debugging commands: list registered skills as JSON, and validate every skill (including invalid ones) against the agentskills.io frontmatter spec with folder-name consistency checks.

nodes.name: SkillCommand
nodes.summary: Parent debug skill command grouping the list and validate subcommands.

nodes.name: ValidateCommand
nodes.summary: Re-validates all skills (via Skill.allIncludingInvalid) against a strict zod frontmatter schema plus name/folder matching, reports every issue to stderr, and fails the command when any skill is invalid.

nodes.name: snapshot.ts
nodes.summary: Snapshot debugging commands: track the current snapshot state, and print the patch or diff for a given snapshot hash.

nodes.name: SnapshotCommand
nodes.summary: Parent debug snapshot command grouping the track, patch, and diff subcommands.

nodes.name: startup.ts
nodes.summary: Prints the process startup timing (performance.now) so callers can measure CLI boot cost.

nodes.name: StartupCommand
nodes.summary: Writes the current performance.now() value to stdout as the measured startup time.

nodes.name: export.ts
nodes.summary: Exports a session (by ID or via an interactive autocomplete picker) as JSON, with an optional --sanitize mode that replaces all sensitive transcript, path, diff, and tool I/O content with structured [redacted:kind:id] placeholders for safe sharing.
nodes.languageNotes: Sanitization preserves the full message structure while substituting typed placeholders keyed by kind and part ID, so exported transcripts stay useful for debugging without leaking file contents or prompts.

nodes.name: ExportCommand
nodes.summary: export [sessionID] command shell: dumps session info plus messages as JSON and delegates to the run generator, which prompts with an autocomplete picker when no ID is supplied.

nodes.name: part
nodes.summary: Redacts a single message part by discriminated type — text, reasoning, file sources and spans, subtask prompts, all four tool states (pending/running/completed/other), patch files, snapshot hashes, and agent sources.

nodes.name: sanitize
nodes.summary: Top-level sanitizer that redacts session info (title, directory, summary diffs, revert data) and maps every message's user system prompt, summary, paths, and parts through the part redactor.

nodes.name: generate.ts
nodes.summary: Generates the OpenAPI specification with x-codeSamples JS snippets injected for every operation and prints it prettier-formatted to stdout; consumed by the SDK build pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: Formats through a dynamically imported prettier (babel + estree plugins) so the emitted JSON is byte-identical to the committed openapi.json regardless of later format runs.

nodes.name: GenerateCommand
nodes.summary: Fetches the server's OpenAPI spec, attaches a JS code sample to each operation, formats the result with prettier, and waits for stdout to flush before exit.

nodes.name: github.ts
nodes.summary: The opencode github CLI: install sets up the GitHub agent interactively (app installation polling, provider/model selection, workflow file generation), while run is the GitHub Actions entrypoint that handles issue, PR, comment, and schedule events — exchanging OIDC tokens for app tokens, building prompts from issue/PR context, running the agent, and pushing branches, creating PRs and comments.
nodes.languageNotes: The ~1200-line run handler routes USER_EVENTS (with actor/issueId, supporting reactions and comments) separately from REPO_EVENTS (schedule/workflow_dispatch, log-only output), and branches its git strategy between local and fork PRs.

nodes.name: GithubCommand
nodes.summary: Parent github command grouping the install and run subcommands.

nodes.name: GithubInstallCommand
nodes.summary: Interactive installer: resolves the repo from the git origin remote, polls the opencode API until the opencode-agent GitHub app is installed, prompts for provider and model, writes .github/workflows/opencode.yml, and prints next steps including required secrets or AWS OIDC setup.

nodes.name: GithubRunCommand
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions runner: authenticates via OIDC or GITHUB_TOKEN, routes supported events, builds prompts from issue/PR GraphQL data and comment mentions, runs the agent session, then commits, pushes to new/local/fork branches, creates PRs and comments with share links, and revokes the app token on exit.

nodes.name: extractResponseText
nodes.summary: Extracts the last text part from an assistant response, returning null when only non-text parts exist (signaling a summary is needed) and throwing for truly empty responses.

nodes.name: formatPromptTooLargeError
nodes.summary: Formats a PROMPT_TOO_LARGE error listing each file with its estimated decoded size (base64 length times 0.75).

nodes.name: import.ts
nodes.summary: Imports a session from a local JSON file or a share URL into the SQLite database: fetches ShareNext data (attaching auth headers when origins match), regroups the flat API array into nested messages/parts, and upserts session, message, and part rows.
nodes.languageNotes: The ShareNext API returns a flat [session, message, part, ...] array that must be regrouped by messageID to rebuild the hierarchy local storage expects; inserts use onConflictDoUpdate/onConflictDoNothing so re-imports are idempotent.

nodes.name: ImportCommand
nodes.summary: import <file|url> command shell that resolves the instance context and delegates to runImport with the current project ID.

nodes.name: parseShareUrl
nodes.summary: Extracts the share slug from an https://host/share/<slug> URL, returning null for non-matching URLs.

nodes.name: shouldAttachShareAuthHeaders
nodes.summary: Returns true only when the share URL origin matches the account base URL origin, making it safe to attach account auth headers to the fetch.

nodes.name: transformShareData
nodes.summary: Regroups the ShareNext flat [session, message, part, ...] array into the nested { info, messages: [{ info, parts }] } structure expected by local storage, indexing messages and parts by ID.

nodes.name: mcp.ts
nodes.summary: Full MCP server management CLI: list servers with connection status, run OAuth authentication and logout for remote servers, interactively add servers to opencode.json (comment-preserving via jsonc-parser edits), and debug OAuth connectivity down to WWW-Authenticate headers and token expiry.

nodes.name: McpCommand
nodes.summary: Parent mcp command grouping the add, list, auth, logout, and debug subcommands.

nodes.name: McpListCommand
nodes.summary: Lists configured MCP servers with a status icon per connection state (connected, disabled, needs auth, needs client registration, failed) plus OAuth token hints and the command or URL backing each server.

nodes.name: McpAuthCommand
nodes.summary: Runs the OAuth flow for a remote MCP server (interactive picker when unnamed), surfacing browser-open failures via Bus events and guiding users to add a clientId when the server rejects dynamic client registration.

nodes.name: McpAuthListCommand
nodes.summary: Lists OAuth-capable remote MCP servers with their authentication status (authenticated, expired, not authenticated) and URLs.

nodes.name: McpLogoutCommand
nodes.summary: Removes stored OAuth credentials for an MCP server, chosen directly by name or via an interactive picker showing what is stored (tokens, client registration).

nodes.name: McpAddCommand
nodes.summary: Interactive wizard that collects server name, type, command or URL, and OAuth client details, then writes the server entry into the chosen project or global opencode.json(c) while preserving comments via jsonc-parser edits.

nodes.name: McpDebugCommand
nodes.summary: Deep OAuth and connection debugger: prints stored token/client expiry details, sends a raw JSON-RPC initialize request, inspects WWW-Authenticate on 401s, and probes whether dynamic client registration would be attempted.

nodes.name: models.ts
nodes.summary: Lists available models per provider (opencode providers sorted first), with optional verbose metadata output and a models.dev cache refresh flag.

nodes.name: ModelsCommand
nodes.summary: Optionally refreshes the models.dev cache, then prints provider/model IDs sorted alphabetically (opencode providers prioritized), failing cleanly when a requested provider does not exist.

nodes.name: plug.ts
nodes.summary: The plugin installer command: installs an npm plugin package, reads its manifest to detect tui/server targets, and patches the appropriate opencode config, built around an injectable PlugDeps seam so the flow is testable without process mocks.
nodes.languageNotes: createPlugTask receives a PlugDeps object (spinner, log, filesystem helpers) defaulting to real implementations, letting tests substitute fakes rather than mocking child processes.

nodes.name: createPlugTask
nodes.summary: Builds the install pipeline (install package, read manifest, patch config) as an async task over injectable deps, translating npm registry failures and manifest problems into actionable user-facing messages.

nodes.name: PluginCommand
nodes.summary: plugin <module> command shell that validates the module name, runs createPlugTask with the instance's vcs/worktree context, and sets a non-zero exit code on failure.

nodes.name: pr.ts
nodes.summary: Fetches and checks out a GitHub PR via the gh CLI onto a pr/<n> branch, wires cross-repository fork remotes and upstreams, imports any opencode share session linked in the PR body, and relaunches opencode with that session.

nodes.name: PrCommand
nodes.summary: pr <number> handler: runs gh pr checkout under a local branch name, configures fork remotes for cross-repo PRs, imports a linked share session via the opencode import CLI, and spawns opencode with -s <session> (dying on non-zero exit).

nodes.name: providers.ts
nodes.summary: CLI command group for `opencode providers` — lists configured models and providers, runs OAuth and API-key login flows (including plugin-provided auth), and logs out stored credentials.
nodes.languageNotes: Effect-based effectCmd handlers; plugin auth providers are collected via Hooks and merged with built-in ModelsDev entries.

nodes.name: resolvePluginProviders
nodes.summary: Collects auth providers registered by plugins and merges them with the built-in provider set for the login command list.

nodes.name: run.ts
nodes.summary: CLI entry point for `opencode run` with three modes: non-interactive single-prompt streaming to stdout, interactive local mode booting the split-footer direct UI with an in-process server, and interactive attach against a running server. Also handles slash-command execution, JSON event output, and session continue/fork.

nodes.name: resolveRunInput
nodes.summary: Resolves the run input text from CLI arguments or piped stdin, rejecting interactive TTY input in non-interactive mode.

nodes.name: tool
nodes.summary: Formats a streaming tool part into stdout display blocks for non-interactive mode.

nodes.name: toolError
nodes.summary: Formats a failed tool part together with its error output for non-interactive stdout display.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Architecture guide for the cli/cmd/run directory documenting the layered module organization, the .shared.ts pure-state-machine dependency rules, the handler signature constraints (no footer APIs, no IO), and session.error discriminated-union handling pitfalls.

nodes.name: demo.ts
nodes.summary: Demo mode for direct interactive mode (`--demo`) that intercepts prompt submissions and generates synthetic SDK events through the real reducer and footer pipeline, letting permission, question, and tool UIs be exercised without model calls via slash commands like /permission, /question, and /fmt.
nodes.languageNotes: Synthetic events reuse the production reduceSessionData pipeline, so demo output formatting stays in lockstep with real transcripts.

nodes.name: showSubagent
nodes.summary: Displays the subagent footer panel with synthetic status tabs for demo mode.

nodes.name: open
nodes.summary: Initializes the demo session state and emits the synthetic session started/opened events.

nodes.name: emitText
nodes.summary: Streams synthetic text parts word-by-word into the reducer to simulate model output with realistic pacing.

nodes.name: emitReasoning
nodes.summary: Streams synthetic reasoning/thinking parts with interleaved delays to simulate model reasoning output.

nodes.name: startTool
nodes.summary: Emits a tool part in running state with metadata to begin a synthetic tool call.

nodes.name: askPermission
nodes.summary: Emits a synthetic permission request and resolves it locally with the selected reply.

nodes.name: doneTool
nodes.summary: Completes a synthetic tool part with generated output state such as success metadata or diffs.

nodes.name: failTool
nodes.summary: Fails a synthetic tool part with error output state.

nodes.name: emitError
nodes.summary: Emits a synthetic session error event with a message.

nodes.name: emitPatch
nodes.summary: Emits a synthetic patch tool part with unified diff output.

nodes.name: emitTask
nodes.summary: Runs a synthetic subagent task lifecycle — spawning a child session with streamed progress and completion states.

nodes.name: emitTodo
nodes.summary: Emits synthetic todo-list snapshots showing progressive task completion.

nodes.name: emitQuestionTool
nodes.summary: Emits a synthetic in-tool question request and resolves it from local demo answers.

nodes.name: emitPermission
nodes.summary: Drives every permission UI variant through the footer — request, always-confirm, and reject-text stages — with local reply handling.

nodes.name: emitQuestion
nodes.summary: Drives single and multi-question UI variants through the footer with option picking and custom answers.

nodes.name: emitFmt
nodes.summary: Dispatches /fmt demo slash commands, producing the requested tool/text output type (bash, write, edit, table, error, mix, and others).

nodes.name: intro
nodes.summary: Emits the synthetic assistant header entry shown when a demo response starts.

nodes.name: createRunDemo
