nodes.name: dialog-workspace-unavailable.tsx
nodes.summary: Dialog shown when the active workspace is missing or disconnected, offering restore/retry and cancel actions through a keyboard-driven option store.

nodes.name: DialogWorkspaceUnavailable
nodes.summary: Renders the unavailable-workspace notice with restore/cancel options wired through useBindings, dispatching props.onRestore when the user confirms.

nodes.name: diff-block.tsx
nodes.summary: Theme-aware wrapper around the native <diff> element that centralizes diff coloring (added/removed/context backgrounds, sign colors, line-number styles) and syntax style for the v1/v2 session views and the permission diff route.
nodes.languageNotes: Single source of truth pattern: callers keep view/filetype/wrapMode computation while this component owns all diff theme props.

nodes.name: ThemedDiff
nodes.summary: Maps theme and syntax tokens onto the native <diff> element's props (fg, addedBg, removedBg, contextBg, line-number colors) for consistent diff rendering everywhere.

nodes.name: error-component.tsx
nodes.summary: Full-screen crash handler that renders a fatal error with a pre-filled GitHub issue URL, copy-to-clipboard action, and a scrollable stack trace before tearing down the renderer and exiting.

nodes.name: ErrorComponent
nodes.summary: Builds a prefilled GitHub issue URL from the error message and truncated stack, copies it via Clipboard.copy on demand, renders the scrollable stack with scroll acceleration, and performs terminal cleanup (title reset, renderer destroy, win32 input buffer flush) on exit.

nodes.name: logo.tsx
nodes.summary: Animated ASCII-art opencode logo engine: parses the logo glyph rows into a cell grid with stroke routes and part centroids, then renders per-frame effects — shimmer sweeps, typing waves, interaction rings and holds, glow/bloom releases, traces, and an idle ambient field — driven entirely by procedural math.
nodes.languageNotes: A miniature shader pipeline in TypeScript: per-cell effect functions (shimmer/wave/field/trace/bloom) blend RGBA tints using lerp/ease/noise primitives over a 60fps frame loop instead of CSS or canvas.

nodes.name: route
nodes.summary: Traces an ordered path through the remaining glyph cells using nearest-neighbor search with directional preference, producing stroke routes for the trace animation.

nodes.name: mapGlyphs
nodes.summary: Converts the ASCII logo rows into cell coordinates, labels connected parts via flood fill, computes stroke traces with route() and part centroids — the shared geometry every effect renders against.

nodes.name: shimmer
nodes.summary: Computes per-cell brightness for the periodic shimmer sweep: distance falloff from interaction rings plus a traveling sinusoidal wave modulated by the shimmer config.

nodes.name: remain
nodes.summary: Holds cells at rest brightness with distance-based decay from the shimmer origin when no active effect applies.

nodes.name: wave
nodes.summary: Typing-wave effect: exponentially decaying ripples with noise-modulated jitter that propagate across the glyph grid.

nodes.name: field
nodes.summary: Idle ambient field combining a breathing base glow, an ambient brightness band, and noise across the whole logo for subtle background life.

nodes.name: pick
nodes.summary: Chooses which effect (shimmer, wave, trace, hold/release, bloom, idle) applies to a given cell for the current frame based on the animation timeline phases.

nodes.name: trace
nodes.summary: Animates a bright trace traveling along precomputed stroke routes with a glowing head and fading tail.

nodes.name: idle
nodes.summary: Idle-state renderer mixing the ambient field, hold/release interactions, and subtle per-part motion for cells with no active effect.

nodes.name: bloom
nodes.summary: Expanding glow bloom radiating from a glyph after an interaction release, brightening then decaying over the GLOW_OUT window.

nodes.name: buildIdleState
nodes.summary: Precomputes the per-frame idle animation state (interaction rings, holds, releases, glow, spark) shared by all cell renderers to avoid recomputing per cell.

nodes.name: Logo
nodes.summary: The animated logo component: builds the glyph geometry once, runs the frame loop with requestAnimationFrame-style scheduling, tracks mouse interactions into rings/holds, dispatches the per-cell effect pipeline, and layers shadow glyphs beneath the letter glyphs with sound feedback.

nodes.name: GoLogo
nodes.summary: Compact wrapper rendering the go variant of the logo used by the Go upsell treatment.

nodes.name: plugin-route-missing.tsx
nodes.summary: Fallback view shown when a plugin route id cannot be resolved, displaying a warning and a clickable go-home action.

nodes.name: PluginRouteMissing
nodes.summary: Renders the unknown-plugin-route warning with a mouse-clickable box that navigates home via props.onHome.

nodes.name: autocomplete.tsx
nodes.summary: Prompt autocomplete engine for @file and /command mentions: fuzzy file search ranked by frecency, command palette integration via the SDK, line-range suffix parsing (#12-20), and a floating list anchored to the prompt with keyboard-driven paging.

nodes.name: extractLineRange
nodes.summary: Parses a trailing #line or #start-end suffix from the typed query into a base file name plus an optional validated line range for file mentions.

nodes.name: Autocomplete
nodes.summary: Full autocomplete controller: detects @file and /command triggers from the caret position, runs fuzzysort over sync-known files with frecency ranking and directory grouping, queries commands from the palette context, manages selection/paging/scroll through useBindings, and writes selections back into prompt parts with extmark anchors.

nodes.name: cwd.ts
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder module reserved for prompt current-working-directory helpers; contains no executable code.

nodes.name: frecency.tsx
nodes.summary: Frecency context provider tracking per-file open frequency and recency, scored as frequency / (1 + days since last open), persisted as compacted JSONL in global state with a 1000-entry cap.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the createSimpleContext factory which exports a matched use/provider pair (useFrecency / FrecencyProvider) — the standard TUI context idiom.

nodes.name: history.tsx
nodes.summary: Prompt history context provider persisting the last 50 prompts (input plus file/agent/text parts) as a self-healing JSONL file, with negative-index cursor navigation via move() and append() on submit.
nodes.languageNotes: Self-healing pattern: on mount the JSONL is re-parsed, invalid lines dropped, and the file rewritten with only valid entries.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: The main TUI prompt: an OpenTUI textarea with mention autocomplete, file/agent part assembly, editor-selection context injection as a system-reminder, prompt history and stash integration, shell mode, draft retention, command palette, and the submission pipeline into the session (including workspace warp flows).
nodes.languageNotes: A single ~1776-line SolidJS component function wiring 20+ context hooks; on submit it clones parts, assigns fresh PartIDs, and appends synthetic system-reminder context from the user's editor selection.

nodes.name: formatEditorContext
nodes.summary: Formats the user's current editor file and selected ranges into a <system-reminder> note that is appended to the submitted prompt so the model knows what the user has open or highlighted.

nodes.name: Prompt
nodes.summary: The prompt component itself: owns the textarea, cursor and IME/paste handling, integrates the Autocomplete controller, history navigation, stash push/pop and the stash dialog, shell-mode and cost display, draft persistence and restore, and on submit assembles the PromptInfo (text, file parts with line ranges, agent parts, editor context) and sends it to the session while handling workspace-unavailable and workspace-create flows.

nodes.name: part.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny helpers for message-part lifecycle in the prompt: strip removes server-assigned ids from a part before local reuse, and assign attaches a fresh ascending PartID before submission.

nodes.name: strip
nodes.summary: Removes the server-assigned id, messageID and sessionID fields from a part so it can be safely reused in a new prompt.

nodes.name: assign
nodes.summary: Assigns a fresh ascending PartID to a part when submitting a prompt.

nodes.name: stash.tsx
nodes.summary: Prompt stash context provider persisting up to 50 stashed prompts (input, parts, timestamp) as a self-healing JSONL file, exposing list/push/pop/remove operations used by the stash dialog and the prompt's stash keybinding.
nodes.languageNotes: Same createSimpleContext use/provider idiom as the history and frecency contexts; pop() rewrites the whole file rather than appending.

nodes.name: traits.ts
nodes.summary: Computes OpenTUI textarea traits for the TUI prompt, deciding which keys the prompt captures (escape/navigate/submit/tab) based on mode and autocomplete visibility while leaving suspend ownership to the keymap-managed editor.

nodes.name: computePromptTraits
nodes.summary: Pure function mapping prompt mode (normal/shell) and autocomplete visibility to OpenTUI editor capture traits and the SHELL status indicator.

nodes.name: spinner.tsx
nodes.summary: SolidJS component wrapping the native spinner element with theme-aware colors, variant configs (dots, knight-rider, blocks), and an animations_enabled KV fallback that renders a static ellipsis when animations are disabled.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately gates rendering on a KV flag so all TUI views share one animation kill-switch instead of using the native element directly.

nodes.name: Spinner
nodes.summary: Renders an animated spinner with variant-driven frames and interval from spinner-config, falling back to a static ellipsis when the animations_enabled KV flag is off.

nodes.name: startup-loading.tsx
nodes.summary: Startup loading indicator that delays appearing by 500ms and holds briefly after readiness so fast startups never flash a transient loading state at the user.

nodes.name: StartupLoading
nodes.summary: Implements the delayed-show and minimum-hold timing logic around the ready signal, tracking timestamps and cleaning up timers on unmount.

nodes.name: todo-item.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a single agent todo item with a status icon, priority badge, and theme-driven priority coloring.

nodes.name: todoIcon
nodes.summary: Maps a todo status (pending, in_progress, completed) to its display icon glyph.

nodes.name: priorityBadge
nodes.summary: Maps a todo priority (high, medium, low) to a short badge label.

nodes.name: priorityColor
nodes.summary: Resolves a todo priority to a theme RGBA color with a muted fallback.

nodes.name: TodoItem
nodes.summary: SolidJS component composing the status icon, priority badge, and text for one todo entry.

nodes.name: use-connected.tsx
nodes.summary: Hook reporting whether any provider in the sync store currently has at least one connected model.

nodes.name: useConnected
nodes.summary: Memoized check over sync provider data for any model with an active connection.

nodes.name: workspace-label.tsx
nodes.summary: Small display component rendering the workspace directory label in muted theme text.

nodes.name: WorkspaceLabel
nodes.summary: Displays the workspace directory name using muted theme styling.

nodes.name: cwd.ts
nodes.summary: Effect Context.Reference carrying the current working directory through the TUI config layer, defaulting to process.cwd().
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Effect 4 Context.Reference (a service tag with a default) rather than Context.Tag, so the layer composes even when no explicit value is provided.

nodes.name: keybind.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the complete TUI keybind catalog: zod binding-value schema, per-command defaults with descriptions (leader ctrl+x, session/editor/theme commands), platform-specific undo bindings, and helpers converting overrides into OpenTUI keymap BindingConfig.
nodes.languageNotes: Binding values accept a string, structured keystroke object, binding object, or array of any of these, plus literal false and "none" to unbind.

nodes.name: toBindingConfig
nodes.summary: Converts user keybind overrides into an OpenTUI keymap BindingConfig object via Object.entries mapping.

nodes.name: bindingDefaults
nodes.summary: Builds the default BindingConfig view from the built-in command definitions.

nodes.name: tui-migrate.ts
nodes.summary: One-time migration extracting tui-specific keys (theme, keybinds, tui options) from opencode.json files into dedicated tui.json files, backing up and stripping the legacy keys via comment-preserving JSONC edits.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses jsonc-parser modify/applyEdits to strip keys while preserving user comments and formatting instead of re-serializing the whole file.

nodes.name: migrateTuiConfig
nodes.summary: Coordinates per-directory migration: reads each opencode.json, validates legacy keys, writes a tui.json when absent, then strips migrated keys from the source with a backup.

nodes.name: normalizeTui
nodes.summary: Parses and strips legacy tui options with per-field .catch tolerance so one invalid option does not abort migration.

nodes.name: backupAndStripLegacy
nodes.summary: Backs up the original opencode.json and surgically removes migrated tui keys using JSONC modify/applyEdits, skipping gracefully when nothing needs stripping.

nodes.name: opencodeFiles
nodes.summary: Discovers global and per-directory opencode.json config file paths using ConfigPaths and findUp, returning only files that exist.

nodes.name: tui-schema.ts
nodes.summary: Zod schema for tui.json covering leader timeout, scroll speed and acceleration, diff style, mouse capture, theme, keybind overrides, and plugin specs; also reused to derive the published JSON schema.

nodes.name: tui.ts
nodes.summary: TuiConfig Effect service that discovers and merges tui.json files (global plus per-directory), migrates legacy config, resolves plugin specs with origins, and exposes a resolved config with a compiled keybind lookup.
nodes.languageNotes: Composes Effect.fn generators with Layer/Effect.gen to load, validate, and deep-merge config across directories, plus makeRuntime for a module-level global runtime.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Effect Context.Service tag (@opencode/TuiConfig) for the TUI config interface exposing get() and waitForDependencies().

nodes.name: normalize
nodes.summary: Flattens a nested tui key so users who wrote { tui: { ... } } inside tui.json get their settings applied like top-level keys.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Runs the service get Effect through the global runtime and returns the resolved TUI config promise.

nodes.name: waitForDependencies
nodes.summary: Waits for the TuiConfig layer dependencies (plugin installs) to settle via the global runtime.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Engineering notes for the TUI event context: documents that useEvent() only filters the versioned sync envelope copy (not raw Bus-published SyncEvents), and warns that message.part.updated.batch needs its own handler in sync.tsx alongside the single-part handler.

nodes.name: aggregate-failures.ts
nodes.summary: Aggregates Promise.allSettled results into a single labeled Error naming every failed request, used at TUI bootstrap so parallel endpoint failures surface together instead of as separate unhandled rejections.

nodes.name: aggregateFailures
nodes.summary: Combines rejected settle results into one Error with a per-endpoint reason summary and a structured cause listing each failure.

nodes.name: reasonMessage
nodes.summary: Extracts a human-readable message from unknown rejection reasons (Error, string, or object with message/name).

nodes.name: args.tsx
nodes.summary: Context carrying CLI invocation arguments (model, agent, prompt, continue, sessionID, fork) into the TUI component tree.

nodes.name: command-palette.tsx
nodes.summary: Command palette context and dialog: exposes run/show/slashes APIs over OpenTUI keymap commands, renders a fuzzy-selectable DialogSelect with keybinding hints, and supports suggested commands and suspension while other dialogs are open.

nodes.name: CommandPaletteProvider
nodes.summary: Builds the palette context from dialog and keymap services, exposing command execution, slash entries, show/hide, and a suspension counter with a reactive matcher.

nodes.name: useCommandPalette
nodes.summary: Consumes the CommandPalette context, throwing when used outside its provider.

nodes.name: CommandPaletteDialog
nodes.summary: Renders the palette DialogSelect with filtered reachable command entries, formatted key bindings, and suggested-first ordering.

nodes.name: useCommandSlashes
nodes.summary: Returns the reactive list of slash-command entries from the palette context.

nodes.name: directory.ts
nodes.summary: Hook deriving the active TUI working directory from the project instance path expressed relative to process.cwd().

nodes.name: useDirectory
nodes.summary: Memoizes the project directory path relative to the process working directory.

nodes.name: editor-selection.ts
nodes.summary: Zod schema normalizing editor selection payloads (websocket or Zed source) from single-selection or multi-range shapes into a canonical ranges-based EditorSelection.

nodes.name: editor-zed.ts
nodes.summary: Reads Zed's local SQLite database to recover the active editor's selection and buffer contents, mapping UTF-8 byte offsets to line/character positions and scoring workspaces against the current directory.
nodes.languageNotes: Opens Zed's db.sqlite read-only via bun:sqlite and validates every raw row with zod safeParse before use, closing the handle per query.

nodes.name: resolveZedSelection
nodes.summary: Resolves the current Zed selection end-to-end: active editor row, byte-offset selection ranges, buffer text from disk, and a converted EditorSelection payload.

nodes.name: queryZedActiveEditor
nodes.summary: Queries Zed's items/panes/workspaces/editors tables for active editor rows, scoring and sorting workspaces that contain the cwd.

nodes.name: queryZedEditorSelections
nodes.summary: Fetches byte-offset selection ranges for a given Zed editor/workspace pair from the editor_selections table.

nodes.name: queryZedEditorContents
nodes.summary: Fetches the cached buffer contents for a Zed editor row from the editors table.

nodes.name: resolveZedDbPath
nodes.summary: Locates the Zed SQLite database via OPENCODE_ZED_DB or the default macOS/Linux application-support paths.

nodes.name: offsetToPosition
nodes.summary: Converts a UTF-8 byte offset into a selection position using string-index mapping.

nodes.name: utf8ByteOffsetToStringIndex
nodes.summary: Translates a UTF-8 byte offset to a JavaScript string index, handling multi-byte code points via TextEncoder re-encoding of the prefix.

nodes.name: offsetsToSelection
nodes.summary: Builds a text plus start/end line-character selection range from byte offsets into the buffer text.

nodes.name: editor.ts
nodes.summary: Editor integration context: discovers editor lock files, maintains a JSON-RPC WebSocket connection (VS Code extension protocol) with exponential-backoff reconnects, tracks selection state, forwards mention events, and falls back to polling Zed's database.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses injected WebSocketImpl for testability and dedupes selection updates via a computed editorSelectionKey instead of deep equality.

nodes.name: resolveEditorConnection
nodes.summary: Builds the editor connection (URL plus auth token) from environment overrides or the best-matching lock file.

nodes.name: resolveEditorLockFile
nodes.summary: Scans editor lock directories and picks the lock whose workspace folders best contain the active directory, preferring longer matches then newer files.

nodes.name: readEditorLockFile
nodes.summary: Parses a single lock file into port, auth token, and workspace folders, keeping only folders that still exist on disk.

nodes.name: editorSelectionKey
nodes.summary: Builds a stable comparison key (file path plus all range coordinates and text) to detect selection changes cheaply.

nodes.name: event.ts
nodes.summary: useEvent hook subscribing to SDK server events, filtering the sync envelope copy and routing only events for the global scope, the current workspace, or the instance directory.

nodes.name: useEvent
nodes.summary: Returns subscribe/on helpers with workspace- and directory-scoped filtering over the SDK event stream.

nodes.name: exit.tsx
nodes.summary: Exit context managing graceful TUI shutdown: single-flight exit promise, terminal title reset, renderer destruction, win32 input buffer flush, optional exit message, and SIGHUP handling.

nodes.name: helper.tsx
nodes.summary: Factory for lightweight SolidJS contexts: a provider that gates children on init readiness and a use() hook that throws when used outside the provider.

nodes.name: createSimpleContext
nodes.summary: Creates a provider/use pair where the provider defers rendering children until init reports ready, enabling async contexts to avoid undefined-value consumers.

nodes.name: kv.tsx
nodes.summary: Persistent TUI key-value store context backed by state/kv.json with flock-serialized cross-process access, queued in-order writes, and atomic temp-file-plus-rename persistence.
nodes.languageNotes: Writes queue on a promise chain and swap kv.json via rename of a pid+timestamp temp file, so a mid-write shutdown can never leave partial JSON behind.

nodes.name: local.tsx
nodes.summary: Local UI state context: agent selection with theme-driven colors and cycling, model selection with recents/favorites/variants persisted to model.json, and MCP server connect/disconnect toggling.

nodes.name: parseModel
nodes.summary: Splits a provider/modelID string on the first slash into its provider and model components.

nodes.name: path-format.tsx
nodes.summary: Path formatting context that renders paths relative to the workspace root, abbreviating home paths with ~ and falling back to absolute paths outside it.

nodes.name: PathFormatterProvider
nodes.summary: Provides the format function bound to the workspace base path.

nodes.name: usePathFormatter
nodes.summary: Consumes the PathFormatter context, throwing when used outside its provider.

nodes.name: formatPath
nodes.summary: Normalizes a path to relative form against the base, with home-directory tilde abbreviation and absolute fallback.

nodes.name: project.tsx
nodes.summary: SolidJS context providing project and workspace state for the TUI — syncs the current project, the workspace list, and per-workspace statuses from the SDK into a reactive store.

nodes.name: prompt.tsx
nodes.summary: Minimal context holding a mutable reference to the prompt component instance, letting any TUI layer read or replace the current prompt ref.

nodes.name: route.tsx
nodes.summary: Route context for TUI view navigation — maintains a reactive route store with a navigate() helper and exposes typed route data through the useRouteData hook.

nodes.name: sdk.tsx
nodes.summary: SDK context that creates the opencode client and maintains the server-sent events connection — queues incoming events, flushes them in batches to avoid per-event churn, and reconnects with exponential backoff.
nodes.languageNotes: The SSE loop wraps sdk.global.event with retryDelay * 2^(attempt-1) backoff capped at maxRetryDelay; queued events flush on a debounce timer so bursts coalesce into single store updates.

nodes.name: sync-schema.ts
nodes.summary: Type-only module defining SyncStore, the shape of the TUI's global client-side state — providers, agents, config, sessions, messages, parts, todos, permissions, and LSP/MCP/formatter/VCS statuses.

nodes.name: sync-v2.tsx
nodes.summary: SolidJS context syncing v2 session messages into a reactive store — subscribes to the event stream, keeps per-session SessionMessage arrays current, and provides selectors like activeAssistant, latestTool, and latestReasoning for the v2 session view.

nodes.name: sync.tsx
nodes.summary: The TUI's main state bootstrap — orchestrates blocking requests (providers, agents, config, sessions) and non-blocking status fetches (commands, LSP, MCP, resources, formatter, session status, auth, VCS) into the SyncStore, with aggregated failure reporting and on-demand full sync of individual sessions.
nodes.languageNotes: Bootstrap distinguishes blocking vs non-blocking requests via Promise.allSettled plus an aggregateFailures helper so one rejected endpoint surfaces a labeled message instead of drowning siblings as unhandled rejections; store status progresses loading → partial → complete.

nodes.name: theme.tsx
nodes.summary: The TUI theme engine — merges built-in, custom (JSON files on disk), and terminal-derived system themes; resolves color references (hex, ANSI-16/256, alias chains) to concrete RGBA values and generates complete themes including grayscale ramps, muted text colors, and tree-sitter syntax highlighting rules.
nodes.languageNotes: The system theme is synthesized from the terminal's 16-color palette via renderer.getPalette; a 500-line table in getSyntaxRules maps theme roles to tree-sitter scopes, and custom themes are discovered by globbing global and project theme directories.

nodes.name: tui-config.tsx
nodes.summary: Simple context exposing the resolved TuiConfig object to the rest of the TUI tree.

nodes.name: event.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the TUI's bus events — prompt append, command execute (session/prompt/agent commands), toast show, and session select — with Effect Schema payloads, plus the TuiPublishPayload union for publishing any of them over the bus.

nodes.name: footer.tsx
nodes.summary: Internal plugin rendering the home screen footer — working directory with git branch, MCP server connection status with error indicator, and version display.

nodes.name: tips-view.tsx
nodes.summary: Presentational tips renderer — parses {highlight} markup in tip strings into styled parts and renders the tips list shown on the home screen, including a dynamically generated theme-count tip.

nodes.name: tips.tsx
nodes.summary: Internal plugin registering the tips view in the home screen's bottom slot, with a tips.toggle command whose visibility preference persists via KV storage.

nodes.name: useRouteData
nodes.summary: Hook returning the current route's typed data payload from the Route context.

nodes.name: selectedForeground
nodes.summary: Chooses a readable foreground color for selected list items by scoring candidate theme colors against the item background.

nodes.name: listThemes
nodes.summary: Builds the sorted list of available theme names from defaults, custom themes, and the system theme.

nodes.name: allThemes
nodes.summary: Returns the merged map of default, custom, and system themes.

nodes.name: hasTheme
nodes.summary: Checks whether a theme with the given name is registered.

nodes.name: addTheme
nodes.summary: Registers a validated theme under a name, rejecting duplicates, and syncs the theme list into the store.

nodes.name: upsertTheme
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a theme by name after validating its structure, then syncs the store.

nodes.name: resolveTheme
nodes.summary: Resolves every color entry of a theme to concrete RGBA values, following color-reference chains, hex strings, and ANSI codes through a recursive resolveColor helper.

nodes.name: ansiToRgba
nodes.summary: Converts ANSI terminal color codes — base 0-15 colors, the 6x6x6 color cube, and the grayscale ramp — to RGBA values.

nodes.name: getCustomThemes
nodes.summary: Scans global and project theme directories for JSON theme files and loads validated custom themes.

nodes.name: tint
nodes.summary: Alpha-blends an overlay color over a base color, rounding each channel.

nodes.name: generateSystem
nodes.summary: Synthesizes a complete theme from the terminal's palette colors — deriving backgrounds, borders, accent colors, grays, and muted text with tinting heuristics that differ for light and dark modes.

nodes.name: generateGrayScale
nodes.summary: Derives an 8-step grayscale ramp from the background color, clamped differently for dark and light modes.

nodes.name: generateMutedTextColor
nodes.summary: Computes a muted text color by blending the text color toward the background by a mode-dependent ratio.

nodes.name: generateSyntax
nodes.summary: Builds a SyntaxStyle from the theme's syntax rules for tree-sitter highlighting.

nodes.name: generateSubtleSyntax
nodes.summary: Builds a dimmed syntax highlighting variant by desaturating each rule color toward its average channel value.

nodes.name: getSyntaxRules
nodes.summary: 500-line mapping table converting theme color roles (keywords, strings, comments, diff states, and more) into tree-sitter token highlighting rules.

nodes.name: Directory
nodes.summary: Renders the working directory (home-abbreviated to ~) with an optional git branch suffix.

nodes.name: Mcp
nodes.summary: Renders MCP server status — connected count computed in a single pass plus an error indicator when any server has failed.

nodes.name: View
nodes.summary: Composes the home footer row from the Directory, Mcp, and Version segments.

nodes.name: tui
nodes.summary: Plugin entry registering the home footer view into its home footer slot.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Splits a tip string into styled parts by matching {highlight}...{/highlight} markup spans with a regex scan.

nodes.name: Tips
nodes.summary: Renders the tips list, picking a tip appropriate to connection state and highlighting its marked spans with the current theme.

nodes.name: View
nodes.summary: Renders the home tips panel and registers a tips.toggle command that persists visibility via KV storage.

nodes.name: tui
nodes.summary: Plugin entry computing tip visibility from KV state and connection status, then registering the tips view in the home bottom slot.

nodes.name: context.tsx
nodes.summary: Sidebar plugin showing session context usage — total token count from the last assistant response, context-window percentage, and accumulated cost across the session.

nodes.name: files.tsx
nodes.summary: Sidebar plugin listing files modified in the session with per-file diff counters, collapsible when there are more than two entries.

nodes.name: footer.tsx
nodes.summary: Sidebar footer plugin showing the project path with git branch, plus a dismissible getting-started hint shown only when no paid providers are configured.

nodes.name: lsp.tsx
nodes.summary: Sidebar plugin listing LSP server statuses, with empty-state hints when LSPs are disabled or will activate once files are read.

nodes.name: mcp.tsx
nodes.summary: Sidebar plugin summarizing MCP server health — connected/failed counts computed in a single pass, per-server status rows with colored dots, and expand/collapse behavior.

nodes.name: todo.tsx
nodes.summary: Sidebar plugin rendering the session's todo list with normalized statuses and priorities, hidden when everything is completed or the list is empty.

nodes.name: plugins.tsx
nodes.summary: Plugin manager dialog — lists installed plugins with source metadata and enabled/active state, and supports browsing plus installing new plugins.

nodes.name: session-v2.tsx
nodes.summary: The v2 session view (experimental) — renders the SessionMessage stream end to end: user/shell/compaction/agent-switch/model-switch messages, assistant text, reasoning, and a family of dedicated per-tool renderers (Bash, Read, Edit, ApplyPatch, TodoWrite, Question, Task, and more).
nodes.languageNotes: AssistantTool dispatches each tool part to a per-tool SolidJS component selected by tool name with a GenericTool fallback; small helpers (input, filetype, normalizePath, toolOutput) shape tool input/output for display.

nodes.name: which-key.tsx
nodes.summary: Emacs-style which-key panel — surfaces available keybindings and pending key sequences in a layout-persisted overlay, with grouping, scrolling, and group navigation commands.

nodes.name: keymap.tsx
nodes.summary: Keymap infrastructure for the TUI — wraps @opentui/keymap with provider re-exports, key alias expansion (enter→return, esc→escape), leader-key support, binding formatting helpers, and registration of opencode-specific bindings from resolved config.

nodes.name: layer.ts
nodes.summary: Six-line Effect layer composition merging observability, TUI config, and the NPM layers into CliLayer for the CLI TUI runtime.

nodes.name: api.tsx
nodes.summary: Factory building the TuiPluginApi object handed to every TUI plugin — wires route registration and navigation, slot composition, dialogs (alert/confirm/prompt/select), toast, KV, keymap formatting, renderer access, and a memoized state API over the sync store.

nodes.name: View

nodes.name: tui

nodes.name: grouped

nodes.name: HomeHint
nodes.summary: Renders a small home-screen hint showing the which-key toggle shortcut.

nodes.name: WhichKeyPanel
nodes.summary: The which-key overlay itself — renders grouped keybinding entries with scrolling, group navigation, layout toggling, and pending-key preview, with preferences persisted via KV.

nodes.name: tui
nodes.summary: Plugin entry registering the which-key panel as a high-priority layer along with its toggle, layout, and scroll/navigation commands.

nodes.name: formatOptions
nodes.summary: Formats the keymap options block — leader-key display and recognized key aliases — for display.

nodes.name: formatKeySequence
nodes.summary: Formats a parsed key sequence into a display string using the leader-aware config.

nodes.name: formatKeyBindings
nodes.summary: Formats a command's key bindings for display using the current TUI config.

nodes.name: registerOpencodeKeymap
nodes.summary: Registers opencode-specific key aliases and bindings onto the renderer's keymap, driven by resolved TUI config keybinds.

nodes.name: useCommandShortcut
nodes.summary: Hook registering a command with optional keybindings via useBindings.

nodes.name: useLeaderActive
nodes.summary: Hook returning whether a leader-key sequence is currently active in the keymap.

nodes.name: routeRegister
nodes.summary: Registers a list of route renderers under their route names, returning a cleanup that removes only this registration's entries.

nodes.name: routeNavigate
nodes.summary: Navigates to a named route with parameters, with fallback behavior for unknown routes.

nodes.name: routeCurrent
nodes.summary: Returns the current route name and parameters from the route store.

nodes.name: pickOption
nodes.summary: Maps a dialog item to the select-option shape used by plugin-facing dialogs.

nodes.name: stateApi
nodes.summary: Builds the plugin-facing state API over the sync store — memoized accessors for messages, parts, todos, diffs, providers, MCP/LSP status, and more.

nodes.name: createTuiApi
nodes.summary: Composes the full TuiPluginApi handed to plugins — slots, routes, dialogs, toast, KV, theme, renderer, keymap formatting, and the state API — from the TUI's internal contexts.

nodes.name: command-shim.ts
nodes.summary: Legacy bridge exposing the deprecated v1 `api.command` plugin API on top of the new keymap layer API, emitting a one-time deprecation warning per method and translating commands, dialogs, and keybinds.
nodes.languageNotes: Classic adapter/shim pattern: wraps TuiCommand objects into palette-namespaced keymap commands and derives binding entries from a legacy keybind map, deduplicating warnings with a module-level Set.

nodes.name: createCommandShimDialog
nodes.summary: Adapts the current DialogContext into the legacy v1 dialog shape expected by old plugins, mapping depth/open getters onto the dialog stack length.

nodes.name: toCommand
nodes.summary: Converts a legacy TuiCommand into a palette-namespaced keymap command, wiring its onSelect handler to the shimmed dialog.

nodes.name: toBindings
nodes.summary: Derives keymap binding entries from legacy command keybinds, falling back to a raw key binding when the keybind map has no match.

nodes.name: createCommandShim
nodes.summary: Builds the deprecated `api.command` facade (register/trigger/show) over the keymap API, warning once per method and mapping register callbacks onto keymap layers.

nodes.name: internal-types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines InternalTuiPlugin, the module-shape type for built-in TUI feature plugins: a TuiPluginModule with a required id, its tui entrypoint, and an optional enabled flag.

nodes.name: internal.ts
nodes.summary: Registry of built-in TUI feature plugins (home footer/tips, sidebar context/MCP/LSP/todo/files/footer, plugin manager, which-key, and the flag-gated SessionV2 debug view) that the plugin runtime loads at startup.

nodes.name: runtime.ts
nodes.summary: The TUI plugin runtime: discovers and loads internal plus external plugins, manages activation/deactivation with scoped keymaps and lifecycle tracking, installs plugins from specs, syncs plugin themes, persists enabled state in KV, and re-exports the Slot component used by every TUI route.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level singleton (RuntimeState plus a memoized `loaded` promise) guarded by working-directory checks; plugins activate sequentially so command registration order and keybind precedence stay deterministic.

nodes.name: createScopedKeymap
nodes.summary: Wraps a keymap instance so a plugin only sees scoped methods (layers, transformers, tokens, analyzers), proxying allowed calls through and tagging acquired resources for cleanup.

nodes.name: runCleanup
nodes.summary: Runs a queue of tracked cleanup callbacks under a timeout guard, logging any that throw so one misbehaving plugin's teardown cannot hang disposal.

nodes.name: createThemeInstaller
nodes.summary: Builds a plugin-scoped theme installer that upserts themes into the theme context, keeps a rollback record, syncs theme files to disk, and reverses everything when the plugin scope is disposed.

nodes.name: createMeta
nodes.summary: Assembles the TuiPluginMeta record (spec, target, source, timestamps) describing where a plugin came from and how it was loaded.

nodes.name: loadInternalPlugin
nodes.summary: Normalizes a built-in InternalTuiPlugin entry into the same PluginLoad shape used for external plugins so both share one activation path.

nodes.name: readThemeFiles
nodes.summary: Reads the JSON theme files under a plugin's theme root and parses them into theme records for registration.

nodes.name: syncPluginThemes
nodes.summary: Merges a plugin entry's theme file records into the runtime's per-plugin theme registry.

nodes.name: createPluginScope
nodes.summary: Creates a per-plugin lifecycle scope that tracks disposers (timers, listeners, keymap resources) and tears them down with a bounded timeout when the plugin deactivates.

nodes.name: listPluginStatus
nodes.summary: Projects the runtime's plugin entries into TuiPluginStatus records backing the public list() API.

nodes.name: activatePluginEntry
nodes.summary: Activates a plugin entry by building its scoped API, invoking its tui() hook, and recording the scope, guarding errors so one failing plugin does not break the rest.

nodes.name: pluginApi
nodes.summary: Constructs the per-plugin TuiPluginApi facade (ui dialog, scoped keymap, theme installer, lifecycle hooks, and the legacy command shim) handed to each plugin's tui() entrypoint.

nodes.name: addPluginEntry
nodes.summary: Registers a loaded plugin entry in the runtime's ordered list and id map.

nodes.name: resolveExternalPlugins
nodes.summary: Resolves configured external plugin origins (local paths and package specs) into PluginLoad records by reading manifests, waiting for dependency availability, and collecting per-origin failures.

nodes.name: addExternalPluginEntries
nodes.summary: Imports resolved external plugin modules, validates their exported shape, and adds them (with their themes) to the runtime, reporting load failures per origin.

nodes.name: installDetail
nodes.summary: Formats a structured install-failure detail message from an error cause and its context for user-facing feedback.

nodes.name: addPluginBySpec
nodes.summary: Adds a plugin by spec at runtime: resolves it, loads and activates the entry, and persists the new origin to tui.json config.

nodes.name: installPluginBySpec
nodes.summary: Installs a plugin from a package spec into the global or project plugin directory (writing manifest and TUI marker files and patching config), returning a structured success or failure result.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Initializes the TUI plugin runtime for the current working directory, memoizing the load promise and rejecting re-initialization from a different directory.

nodes.name: dispose
nodes.summary: Tears down the runtime: awaits any in-flight load, then deactivates every plugin in reverse registration order.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Core loader: sets up the slot registry, registers internal plugins, resolves external origins (skipped in pure mode), applies persisted enabled state, and activates enabled plugins sequentially inside a WithInstance context.

nodes.name: slots.tsx
nodes.summary: Host-side slot system for TUI plugins: exposes the Slot render component and setupSlots, which builds an OpenTUI Solid slot registry so plugins can replace or augment named UI regions with per-plugin error logging.

nodes.name: Slot
nodes.summary: Render component for named plugin slots; delegates to the registry view installed by setupSlots and renders nothing before the runtime initializes.

nodes.name: setupSlots
nodes.summary: Creates the Solid slot registry over the TUI renderer and theme, installs it as the active Slot view, and returns a guarded register() that validates host slot plugins and logs slot render errors.

nodes.name: home.tsx
nodes.summary: Home route view: renders the logo and prompt input (both replaceable through plugin slots) with rotating placeholder suggestions, and auto-submits the --prompt CLI argument once sync and the model store are ready.

nodes.name: Home
nodes.summary: Home screen component composing the home_logo, home_prompt, home_prompt_right, home_bottom, and home_footer plugin slots around the Prompt input and Toast layer.

nodes.name: dialog-fork-from-timeline.tsx
nodes.summary: Fork dialog listing every past user message so the user can fork a session from a chosen point, rebuilding the original prompt text and file parts in the forked session.

nodes.name: DialogForkFromTimeline
nodes.summary: Builds the fork-point picker from user messages plus a full-session option, calls sdk session.fork with the chosen messageID, and navigates to the new session with the reconstructed prompt.

nodes.name: dialog-message.tsx
nodes.summary: Per-message actions dialog (revert, retry/edit, copy, and related operations) that operates on a single message through the SDK client and the shared sync store.

nodes.name: DialogMessage
nodes.summary: Message action menu whose options mutate session state (revert undoes messages and file changes while restoring the prompt) and copy message content to the clipboard.

nodes.name: dialog-subagent.tsx
nodes.summary: Minimal subagent actions dialog with a single Open action that navigates to the subagent's own session view.

nodes.name: DialogSubagent
nodes.summary: Renders a one-option select dialog that navigates to the given subagent session and clears the dialog stack.

nodes.name: dialog-timeline.tsx
nodes.summary: Timeline dialog listing user messages in reverse chronological order; picking one opens the per-message actions dialog for revert/retry operations.

nodes.name: DialogTimeline
nodes.summary: Builds the timeline picker from user messages' text parts with formatted timestamps and hands selection off to DialogMessage via dialog replacement.

nodes.name: footer.tsx
nodes.summary: Bottom status bar showing the working directory plus live MCP/LSP connection counts, pending permission count, and a rotating connect hint while the server is unreachable.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a single for-in loop memo instead of Object.values().filter().length to reduce GC pressure (Bolt optimization), and tracks all setTimeout ids for cleanup on unmount.

nodes.name: Footer
nodes.summary: Renders directory and service status indicators (MCP connected/failed, LSP count, pending permissions) with a timeout-driven welcome message that only appears while disconnected.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: The v1 TUI session view: the complete conversation screen with user/assistant message renderers, per-tool part views, permission and question prompts, sidebar, keymap commands (share, rename, fork, compact, undo/redo, export), and upsell gating.
nodes.languageNotes: One ~1100-line SolidJS Session component plus roughly twenty part-renderer components dispatched per tool type; heavy createMemo-derived state over the shared sync store, with KV-persisted visibility toggles.

nodes.name: Session
nodes.summary: Main session component: wires route and session sync, aggregates permission/question prompts across the session subtree, manages sidebar visibility and KV-backed display toggles, registers ~35 keymap commands, and renders the scrollable message list with prompt input.

nodes.name: UserMessage
nodes.summary: Renders a user message with its text/file parts, timestamps, and conceal handling, plus message-level actions.

nodes.name: AssistantMessage
nodes.summary: Renders an assistant message including provider/model metadata, token and cost info, and its reasoning, text, and tool parts.

nodes.name: ReasoningPart
nodes.summary: Collapsible reasoning part renderer that respects the thinking-visibility toggle.

nodes.name: TextPart
nodes.summary: Renders message text parts as markdown (via the markdown element or markdown-highlighted code view depending on the experimental flag).

nodes.name: ToolPart
nodes.summary: Dispatches a tool part to its specialized renderer (Shell, Edit, Read, Task, and so on), falling back to InlineTool, BlockTool, or GenericTool for tools without a dedicated view.

nodes.name: GenericTool
nodes.summary: Fallback renderer showing raw serialized tool input/output for tools that have no dedicated view.

nodes.name: InlineTool
nodes.summary: Compact single-line tool renderer for tools whose result fits inline in the transcript.

nodes.name: BlockTool
nodes.summary: Expandable block renderer for verbose tool output that can be toggled open and closed.

nodes.name: Shell
nodes.summary: Shell tool renderer showing the command, exit code, and collapsible stdout/stderr output.

nodes.name: Write
nodes.summary: Write tool renderer with the target file path and a preview of the created content.

nodes.name: Glob
nodes.summary: Glob tool renderer summarizing matched files in one compact line.

nodes.name: Read
nodes.summary: Read tool renderer with a syntax-highlighted preview of the file content that was read.

nodes.name: Grep
nodes.summary: Grep tool renderer summarizing search matches in one compact line.

nodes.name: Task
nodes.summary: Subagent task tool renderer showing the agent label, description, and live status of the delegated subtask.

nodes.name: Edit
nodes.summary: Edit tool renderer showing a themed diff of the applied file change.

nodes.name: ApplyPatch
nodes.summary: apply_patch tool renderer with a multi-file diff preview of the patch that was applied.

nodes.name: TodoWrite
nodes.summary: TodoWrite tool renderer listing the updated todo items with their status icons.

nodes.name: Question
nodes.summary: Question tool renderer showing the questions the agent asked and the answers that were chosen.

nodes.name: Diagnostics
nodes.summary: LSP diagnostics tool renderer listing diagnostics with severity-colored output.

nodes.name: permission.tsx
nodes.summary: Permission prompt UI for tool approval: per-tool request bodies (diffs for edits, commands for bash, paths, and text descriptions), allow / always-allow with scope and wildcard-pattern options, and a reject flow with optional reason.

nodes.name: EditBody
nodes.summary: Renders the diff preview (split or unified depending on terminal width and diff_style config) for edit-type permission requests.

nodes.name: TextBody
nodes.summary: Renders a simple icon/title/description body for permission requests that have no diff to show.

nodes.name: PermissionPrompt
nodes.summary: Main permission prompt: describes the pending tool call with a per-tool body, drives the ask/always/reject stages, offers always-allow scopes (session versus wildcard patterns), and submits the decision through the SDK.

nodes.name: RejectPrompt
nodes.summary: Reject stage UI collecting an optional reason message in a textarea and submitting the rejection via the SDK.

nodes.name: Prompt
nodes.summary: Outer prompt wrapper rendering request metadata (session, provider/model, path) above the permission or reject body inside a bordered, scrollable layout with keybinds.

nodes.name: question.tsx
nodes.summary: Question prompt UI rendering the agent's structured questions as single- or multi-select tabs with a custom free-text option, submitting or rejecting answers through the SDK.

nodes.name: QuestionPrompt
nodes.summary: Tabbed question renderer handling single and multi-select options, custom answers typed into a textarea, a confirm tab for multi-question sets, and reply/reject submission.

nodes.name: sidebar.tsx
nodes.summary: Session sidebar panel showing the session title, workspace label, share URL, and installed version, with plugin slots for title, content, and footer regions.

nodes.name: Sidebar
nodes.summary: Renders the fixed-width scrollable sidebar with workspace status label fallbacks, share URL, version footer, and slot-augmentable title/content/footer regions; can render as an overlay.

nodes.name: subagent-footer.tsx
nodes.summary: Footer shown when viewing a subagent session, displaying the agent label, sibling position (n of m), context-window usage percent, and accumulated cost.

nodes.name: SubagentFooter
nodes.summary: Computes the subagent label and sibling index from the session tree, then renders context usage percentage against the model limit and total session cost.

nodes.name: upsell.ts
nodes.summary: KV key constants and gating helpers for suppressing opencode/opencode-go upsell prompts (free-tier limit and account rate limit) within a 24-hour window.

nodes.name: goUpsellKeys
nodes.summary: Maps an upsell action (provider plus reason) to its last-seen/dont-show KV key pair, returning undefined for providers outside the gated set.

nodes.name: stderr-capture.ts
nodes.summary: Redirects process.stderr.write and all console.* methods into the log file during TUI rendering so stray output cannot corrupt the alternate screen; stdout is deliberately left untouched for OSC 52 clipboard escape sequences.
nodes.languageNotes: Bun's optimized console writes directly to file descriptors, bypassing process.stderr.write, so both layers must be patched; capture/restore are idempotent via a saved original reference.

nodes.name: formatValue
nodes.summary: Serializes an arbitrary console argument (errors with chained causes, arrays, objects) into a log-safe JSON string with String() fallbacks for non-serializable values.

nodes.name: capture
nodes.summary: Installs the stderr.write override and console.* redirections that append level-prefixed formatted lines to the current log file; no-op when already captured.

nodes.name: restore
nodes.summary: Restores the original process.stderr.write and console methods saved by capture().

nodes.name: thread.ts
nodes.summary: The `opencode` TUI entrypoint command: spawns the TUI worker thread, bridges fetch and the global event stream over RPC to the worker, applies win32 console guards, and handles --prompt stdin piping, heap snapshots, network options, and session validation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a compile-time OPENCODE_WORKER_PATH define to locate the bundled worker, falling back to a dist or source URL; the RPC client re-implements fetch and SSE-style event subscription across the thread boundary.

nodes.name: createWorkerFetch
nodes.summary: Wraps the worker RPC client in a fetch-compatible function that forwards URL, method, headers, and body and rebuilds a Response from the RPC result.

nodes.name: resolveThreadDirectory
nodes.summary: Resolves the TUI working directory from an optional --project path (absolute, or joined onto PWD/cwd) for the worker thread.

nodes.name: dialog-alert.tsx
nodes.summary: Minimal alert dialog showing a bold title and message with enter-to-confirm and esc/click-to-dismiss.

nodes.name: DialogAlert
nodes.summary: Renders the alert box with a bold title, muted message, and a return-key binding that invokes onConfirm and clears the dialog.

nodes.name: dialog-confirm.tsx
nodes.summary: Confirmation dialog with confirm/cancel focus switching via arrow keys and enter to activate the focused action.

nodes.name: DialogConfirm
nodes.summary: Two-button confirm/cancel dialog tracking the active button in a store, switching focus with left/right keys, and invoking the matching callback on enter.

nodes.name: dialog-export-options.tsx
nodes.summary: Transcript export options dialog: a filename input plus tab-cycled toggles for including thinking, tool details, assistant metadata, and open-without-saving.

nodes.name: DialogExportOptions
nodes.summary: Renders the export form with a textarea filename field, toggle rows that flip boolean options, tab navigation across fields, and confirm/cancel callbacks carrying the chosen options.

nodes.name: dialog-help.tsx
nodes.summary: Small help dialog pointing users at the command palette shortcut for discovering all available actions.

nodes.name: DialogHelp
nodes.summary: Renders the help text with the resolved command-palette shortcut and ok/esc dismissal bindings.

nodes.name: dialog-prompt.tsx
nodes.summary: Text-input dialog with a busy state that suspends the textarea and shows a spinner status line while an async operation runs.

nodes.name: DialogPrompt
nodes.summary: Renders the titled textarea dialog, focusing and moving the cursor to the end on mount and toggling suspend/BUSY traits plus a spinner while props.busy is set.

nodes.name: dialog-select.tsx
nodes.summary: The generic fuzzy-filterable selection dialog used by virtually every TUI picker: grouped options, custom keymap actions with resolved shortcut labels, keyboard and mouse selection, and a filter input.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines fuzzysort for filtering, remeda pipe/groupBy for option grouping, and a keymap selector to render live action-button shortcut labels.

nodes.name: DialogSelect
nodes.summary: Full-featured generic select dialog managing filter and selection state, fuzzy filtering with grouping, custom action bindings, current-value syncing, and onSelect/onMove dispatch for every TUI picker.

nodes.name: Option
nodes.summary: Renders a single option row with selection highlight, description/footer, gutter decorations, and disabled/mouse-hover states.

nodes.name: dialog.tsx
nodes.summary: SolidJS modal dialog system for the TUI: renders a centered, focus-managed overlay stack with keyboard bindings for close/refocus and selection-aware copy handling, exposed to the tree via DialogProvider and the useDialog hook.

nodes.name: Dialog
nodes.summary: Renders the top-most dialog of the stack as a bordered overlay positioned by terminal dimensions and theme colors, swallowing mouse events and invoking onClose when the stack is empty.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Builds the dialog store and stack-management API (open, replace, clear, setSize) wiring renderer bindings, focus restoration for nested dialogs, and selection-aware escape/backspace close behavior.

nodes.name: DialogProvider
nodes.summary: Context provider that instantiates the dialog API, forwards ctrl+c selection copies to the toast, and clears the dialog stack through the provided context value.

nodes.name: useDialog
nodes.summary: Hook that returns the dialog context (open/replace/clear stack API) to consuming components.

nodes.name: link.tsx
nodes.summary: Clickable hyperlink component for the TUI that opens its URL in the system default browser when the link text is clicked.

nodes.name: Link
nodes.summary: Renders themed text that opens props.href in the default browser on mouse-up, falling back to the URL itself as display text.

nodes.name: spinner-config.ts
nodes.summary: Variant-to-config factory layer for the TUI spinner: maps the dots, knight-rider, and blocks variants onto frame/color/interval configs built from the knight-rider frame generator in spinner.ts.

nodes.name: createDotsSpinner
nodes.summary: Returns the classic braille dots spinner config with an 80ms interval and optional color.

nodes.name: createKnightRiderSpinner
nodes.summary: Builds a knight-rider scanner spinner config from generated frames and color generators, defaulting to the diamonds style at a 40ms interval.

nodes.name: createBlocksSpinner
nodes.summary: Builds the blocks-style spinner as a knight-rider variant with explicit inactive-factor and min-alpha defaults.

nodes.name: getSpinnerConfig
nodes.summary: Dispatches a spinner variant name to its matching config factory, defaulting to dots.

nodes.name: spinner.ts
nodes.summary: Frame and color generation engine for animated TUI spinners: implements the knight-rider scanner trail algorithm, gamma-derived trail color ramps, and per-character active/inactive color indexing used by the spinner variants.

nodes.name: getScannerState
nodes.summary: Computes the scanner position and wrap state for a frame — a ping-ponging head with trail length derived from width and options — forming the core of the knight-rider animation.

nodes.name: calculateColorIndex
nodes.summary: Maps a character position to its trail color index for a frame, returning -1 for inactive characters outside the scanner trail.

nodes.name: createKnightRiderTrail
nodes.summary: Renders a single knight-rider trail frame as styled glyph runs, clamping positions to terminal width for smooth edge behavior.

nodes.name: deriveTrailColors
nodes.summary: Derives a fading trail color ramp from a bright head color using power-curve interpolation toward black.

nodes.name: deriveInactiveColor
nodes.summary: Scales a hex color toward black by a factor to produce the inactive-track color.

nodes.name: createFrames
nodes.summary: Generates the full frame array for the scanner animation, choosing diamond or block glyphs per character based on its trail color index.

nodes.name: createColors
nodes.summary: Builds the per-frame color generator combining a default palette, the derived trail ramp, inactive color, and knight-rider trail overlays.

nodes.name: toast.tsx
nodes.summary: Transient notification system for the TUI: renders a themed single-toast banner with auto-dismiss timers, with options decoded through the TuiEvent Effect Schema and exposed via ToastProvider/useToast.

nodes.name: Toast
nodes.summary: Renders the current toast as a styled banner anchored to the terminal width using theme colors and variant styling.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Creates the toast store with show/error methods, decoding options via the TuiEvent ToastShow schema and scheduling auto-dismiss through an unref'd setTimeout.

nodes.name: ToastProvider
nodes.summary: Context provider component that instantiates the toast store and wraps the component tree.

nodes.name: useToast
nodes.summary: Hook returning the toast context (show/error API) to consuming components.

nodes.name: clipboard.ts
nodes.summary: Cross-platform clipboard access for the TUI: OSC52 escape-sequence writes plus platform-specific native tools (osascript/pbpaste on macOS, wl-paste/xclip/xsel on Linux, PowerShell on Windows) with a clipboardy fallback.
nodes.languageNotes: copy() always emits an OSC52 escape sequence first so terminals with remote-clipboard support receive the text even when no native tool exists; the PowerShell path pipes text via stdin to avoid shell string interpolation.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Reads the system clipboard using the platform's native tool — temp-file osascript on macOS, wl-paste/xclip with base64 image decoding on Linux, PowerShell Get-Clipboard on Windows — falling back to clipboardy.

nodes.name: copy
nodes.summary: Copies text to the clipboard by writing an OSC52 escape sequence and then delegating to the lazily detected native copy method.

nodes.name: denied-error.shared.ts
nodes.summary: Pure predicate recognizing 'user denied this tool call' error messages so both v1 and v2 session views can render them with strikethrough; behavior pinned by characterization tests.

nodes.name: isDeniedErrorMessage
nodes.summary: Returns true when a message contains one of four denial signatures: QuestionRejectedError, rejected permission, specified a rule, or user dismissed.

nodes.name: editor.ts
nodes.summary: Opens the user's editor on a temporary file for TUI text editing, suspending the renderer around the spawned process and reading the edited text back.

nodes.name: open
nodes.summary: Writes initial text to a temp file (registered for deferred removal), suspends the TUI renderer, spawns the configured editor, and returns the edited contents after resuming rendering.

nodes.name: model.ts
nodes.summary: Model lookup helpers for the TUI: indexes provider model lists into Maps for providerID/modelID lookup and resolves human-readable display names.

nodes.name: index
nodes.summary: Indexes a provider list into a providerID-to-provider Map.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Resolves a model by provider and model ID from either a Map or raw provider array.

nodes.name: name
nodes.summary: Returns the display name for a provider/model pair, falling back to the raw model ID.

nodes.name: provider-origin.ts
nodes.summary: Single-purpose helper checking whether a provider belongs to the console-managed provider collection, accepting either an array or a Set.

nodes.name: isConsoleManagedProvider
nodes.summary: Returns true when providerID is contained in the console-managed providers array or Set.

nodes.name: revert-diff.ts
nodes.summary: Parses a unified diff patch to extract the list of file paths affected by a revert operation.

nodes.name: getRevertDiffFiles
nodes.summary: Parses patch hunks with parsePatch and deduplicates the new/old file names, normalizing a/ b/ prefixes and skipping deleted-file markers.

nodes.name: scroll.ts
nodes.summary: Scroll acceleration support for the TUI: a speed-ramping scroll implementation and a config-driven acceleration factor getter.

nodes.name: CustomSpeedScroll
nodes.summary: Scroll helper implementing tick-based speed ramping with reset, used for accelerated TUI scrolling.

nodes.name: getScrollAcceleration
nodes.summary: Reads the scroll acceleration factor from the TUI config, falling back to a default when unset.

nodes.name: selection.ts
nodes.summary: Terminal selection helpers for the TUI: copies selected text to the clipboard with toast feedback and dispatches selection-aware key handling (copy on ctrl+c, clear on other keys).

nodes.name: copy
nodes.summary: Copies the renderer's currently selected text to the clipboard, shows a confirmation toast on success, and clears the selection.

nodes.name: handleSelectionKey
nodes.summary: Handles key events while a selection is active: ctrl+c copies and consumes the event, other keys clear the selection and optionally stop propagation.

nodes.name: session-tree.ts
nodes.summary: Collects all descendant session IDs of a root session by breadth-first traversal of a parent-to-children map, guarding against cycles.

nodes.name: collectSessionDescendants
nodes.summary: Builds a children-by-parent map from the session list, then walks it breadth-first from the root collecting descendant IDs while skipping already-seen nodes.

nodes.name: signal.ts
nodes.summary: SolidJS signal utilities for the TUI: debounced signal writes and an alpha fade-in animation signal for smooth element transitions.

nodes.name: createDebouncedSignal
nodes.summary: Creates a SolidJS signal whose setter is debounced by the given delay.

nodes.name: createFadeIn
nodes.summary: Creates a reactive fade-in that drives a target's alpha from 0 to 1 over time via an interval loop, jumping straight to full opacity when animation is disabled.

nodes.name: sound.ts
nodes.summary: Audio feedback for the TUI: materializes embedded WAV assets into a temp dir and plays them through cli-sound or whichever system player binary is available (ffplay, mpv, afplay, PowerShell, and others).
nodes.languageNotes: WAV assets are imported with `with { type: "file" }` import attributes and copied to tmpdir on demand, because player binaries need real filesystem paths.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Stops any previous playback and starts the looping charge 'hum' sound through the resolved player.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Stops the looping hum sound, terminating the player process immediately or after a fade-out delay.

nodes.name: pulse
nodes.summary: Plays one of the pulse sound assets at a volume scaled by the given factor.

nodes.name: dispose
nodes.summary: Stops playback and releases the audio subsystem.

nodes.name: transcript.ts
nodes.summary: Formats a session and its messages into a Markdown transcript — title, metadata, assistant headers with model and duration, and per-part bodies — for export or display.

nodes.name: formatTranscript
nodes.summary: Renders the full session transcript as Markdown: title, session ID, created/updated timestamps, and every message separated by horizontal rules.

nodes.name: formatMessage
nodes.summary: Formats a single user or assistant message, prefixing assistant messages with a metadata header and joining the formatted parts.

nodes.name: formatAssistantHeader
nodes.summary: Builds the assistant message header with completion duration, model display name, and titlecased provider.

nodes.name: formatPart
nodes.summary: Renders an individual message part — text verbatim, tool calls/results and other structured parts as JSON — honoring thinking and tool-details options.

nodes.name: validate-session.ts
nodes.summary: Pre-flight validation of an optional --session argument before the TUI starts: decodes the SessionID schema and probes the server through the SDK client.

nodes.name: validateSession
nodes.summary: Decodes and validates the session ID format via Effect Schema, then verifies the session exists on the server with a throwOnError SDK client call.

nodes.name: win32.ts
nodes.summary: Windows console-mode management for the TUI via bun:ffi kernel32 calls: disables ENABLE_PROCESSED_INPUT so Ctrl+C arrives as stdin, flushes the input buffer, and keeps the mode enforced against external toggles.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bun:ffi dlopen to invoke kernel32.dll console APIs (GetStdHandle/GetConsoleMode/SetConsoleMode/FlushConsoleInputBuffer) directly from TypeScript; all functions are no-ops off Windows or non-TTY stdin.

nodes.name: win32DisableProcessedInput
nodes.summary: Clears the ENABLE_PROCESSED_INPUT flag on the console stdin handle so Ctrl+C is delivered as console input.

nodes.name: win32FlushInputBuffer
nodes.summary: Discards queued console input events (key presses, mouse events) via FlushConsoleInputBuffer.

nodes.name: win32InstallCtrlCGuard
nodes.summary: Keeps processed input disabled by hooking setRawMode to re-clear the flag after known toggles, plus a low-frequency polling backstop for mode changes by native or external code.

nodes.name: worker.ts
nodes.summary: Host module for the TUI's worker process: bootstraps logging, heap monitoring, and global event forwarding over RPC, then exposes fetch, snapshot, server, checkUpgrade, reload, and shutdown RPC endpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: Module runs side effects at import via top-level await (Log.init, Heap.start, Rpc.listen registration) — importing it effectively starts the worker.

nodes.name: uninstall.ts
nodes.summary: The `opencode uninstall` CLI command: detects the installation method, collects removal targets (data/cache/config/state directories, shell config, curl binary), previews them with sizes, and removes them with confirmation, dry-run, and keep-config/keep-data flags.

nodes.name: collectRemovalTargets
nodes.summary: Builds the removal target list from global data/cache/config/state paths plus curl-install shell config and binary location, honoring the keep flags.

nodes.name: showRemovalSummary
nodes.summary: Prints a preview of everything slated for removal, computing directory sizes by recursively walking each tree.

nodes.name: executeUninstall
nodes.summary: Performs the destructive removal — deleting target directories, stripping opencode lines from the shell config, and removing the curl-installed binary — collecting per-target errors and printing a final summary.

nodes.name: getShellConfigFile
nodes.summary: Locates the user's shell config (bash, zsh, fish variants) by probing home-dir candidates and checking for opencode references.

nodes.name: cleanShellConfig
nodes.summary: Rewrites the shell config with opencode PATH exports and alias lines removed, trimming trailing blank lines left behind.

nodes.name: getDirectorySize
nodes.summary: Recursively walks a directory tree summing file sizes with error-tolerant stat calls.

nodes.name: upgrade.ts
nodes.summary: The `opencode upgrade` CLI command: detects the installation method, resolves the target version (latest or explicit), skips no-op upgrades, and runs the installer with spinner feedback and choco elevation-error handling.

nodes.name: web.ts
nodes.summary: The `opencode web` CLI command: starts the HTTP server and opens the web interface in a browser, printing local and filtered network access URLs; built with effectCmd and no ambient project instance.

nodes.name: getNetworkIPs
nodes.summary: Enumerates non-virtual IPv4 network interface addresses, filtering VPN/virtual adapters by interface-name patterns and preferring 192.168 ranges first.

nodes.name: effect-cmd.ts
nodes.summary: Effect-native CLI command builder bridging yargs to Effect handlers: loads and provides the project InstanceContext (or skips it per command), restores it across await boundaries via AsyncLocalStorage, and guarantees store disposal on every exit; also defines CliError and fail() for user-visible command failures.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-phase instance loading bridges Effect fiber context and Node's AsyncLocalStorage: InstanceRef is provided via fiber context, while Instance.current ALS survives re-entrant AppRuntime.runPromise calls inside async callbacks.

nodes.name: CliError
nodes.summary: Schema-tagged error class for user-visible CLI failures, carrying a message and optional exit code, recognized by the global error formatter.

nodes.name: fail
nodes.summary: Fails the command Effect with a CliError carrying the message and exit code (default 1).

nodes.name: effectCmd
nodes.summary: Wraps a yargs command whose handler is an Effect: optionally loads the project InstanceContext, runs the body under Instance.restore with InstanceRef provided, and disposes the store in a finally block on every exit path.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Package doc for the CLI Effect prompt wrapper: pins the @clack/prompts 1.7.0 spinner API (spinner.error exists, stop(msg) simplified) and documents the stale node_modules version gotcha that makes SpinnerResult.error appear missing.

nodes.name: prompt.ts
nodes.summary: Wraps @clack/prompts CLI primitives (intro, outro, log, select, autocomplete, text, password, spinner) as Effect values, converting user cancellations into Option.none so interactive prompts compose with Effect-based CLI commands.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Effect.promise + Effect.map to bridge callback-based @clack/prompts into Effect; isCancel results are mapped to Option.none instead of throwing.

nodes.name: error.ts
nodes.summary: Formats well-known domain errors (CliError, MCPFailed, ProviderModelNotFoundError, ProviderInitError, ConfigJsonError, ConfigDirectoryTypoError, ConfigInvalidError) into human-readable CLI messages, including exit-code handling and actionable fix suggestions.

nodes.name: heap.ts
nodes.summary: Opt-in RSS watchdog that samples process memory every minute and writes a V8 heap snapshot to the log directory when usage crosses a 2 GiB limit, gated by the OPENCODE_AUTO_HEAP_SNAPSHOT flag.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses node:v8 writeHeapSnapshot behind an armed/lock state machine so only one snapshot is taken per threshold crossing.

nodes.name: logo.ts
nodes.summary: Stores the block-character ASCII art glyphs for the opencode and go wordmarks plus the substitution marks consumed by the CLI logo renderer.

nodes.name: network.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the shared yargs --port/--hostname/--mdns/--mdns-domain/--cors options for server commands and resolves final network settings by layering config-file values under explicitly passed CLI flags.
nodes.languageNotes: Precedence is decided by inspecting process.argv directly, so an explicit flag always beats the config file.

nodes.name: ui.ts
nodes.summary: Terminal UI helpers for non-TUI CLI commands: stderr print helpers, ANSI style constants, the colored block-glyph logo renderer, readline-based input, and error output.
nodes.languageNotes: All output is written to process.stderr so stdout stays clean for piped data; the logo degrades to a plain wordmark when not attached to a TTY.

nodes.name: upgrade.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the auto-update flow: detects the installation method and latest version, publishes an UpdateAvailable bus event for notify-only or non-patch releases, and otherwise performs an in-place upgrade honoring autoupdate config and feature flags.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Command service aggregating built-in /init and /review templates, config-file commands, MCP prompts, and skills into a per-instance registry of slash commands with argument placeholder hints.
nodes.languageNotes: Effect Layer + Context.Service DI pattern; MCP-backed command templates are lazy promises bridged back into Effect via EffectBridge.

nodes.name: initialize.txt
nodes.summary: Prompt template for the built-in /init command: instructs the agent to create or improve AGENTS.md by investigating the repo's executable sources of truth and writing only high-signal, repo-specific guidance; supports $ARGUMENTS and ${path} substitution.

nodes.name: review.txt
nodes.summary: Prompt template for the built-in /review command: a complete code-reviewer playbook covering review-target selection (uncommitted changes, commit, branch, or PR), context gathering, bug-first review criteria, certainty standards, and output tone; supports $ARGUMENTS and ${path} substitution.

nodes.name: agent.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the agent config schema (model, temperature, prompt, permission, steps, color, mode) with normalization that promotes unknown keys into options and translates the deprecated tools map into permission rules, plus markdown loaders for agent and mode definitions.

nodes.name: attachment.ts
nodes.summary: Effect Schema for attachment processing configuration: image auto-resize toggle plus max width, height, and base64 byte limits, each exposed with a derived zod compatibility surface.

nodes.name: command.ts
nodes.summary: Schema and markdown loader for user-defined commands: scans {command,commands}/**/*.md, parses YAML frontmatter with the body as the template, derives entry names from paths, and throws InvalidError on schema mismatch.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: The central configuration hub: defines the full opencode.json Effect Schema (agents, providers, MCP, LSP, compaction, permissions, plugins, ...) and the Config.Service layer that loads and deep-merges global, project, remote well-known, account/org, and MDM-managed sources with variable substitution and plugin origin tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: Merge precedence chain: well-known remote auth configs, global config, custom/project files, OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT env, account org config, managed directory, then macOS MDM plist; instructions arrays concatenate (deduped) instead of replacing. Global caches use Effect.cachedInvalidateWithTTL with infinite TTL and explicit invalidation after writes.

nodes.name: console-state.ts
nodes.summary: Schema.Class describing console-derived config state (console-managed provider IDs, active org name, switchable org count) plus an emptyConsoleState factory.

nodes.name: entry-name.ts
nodes.summary: Derives configuration entry names (agents, commands, modes) from file paths by slicing after known directory roots and stripping the file extension.

nodes.name: error.ts
nodes.summary: Named error definitions for config loading: JsonError for invalid JSONC input and InvalidError for schema validation failures carrying structured issue lists.

nodes.name: formatter.ts
nodes.summary: Effect Schema for formatter configuration: a boolean toggle or per-formatter entries with disabled, command, environment, and extensions overrides.

nodes.name: layout.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny schema exporting the deprecated layout config literal ('auto' | 'stretch'); current builds always use the stretch layout.

nodes.name: lsp.ts
nodes.summary: Effect Schema for LSP server configuration (builtin boolean toggle or per-server command/extensions/env entries) with a custom filter requiring the extensions array for non-builtin custom servers.

nodes.name: managed.ts
nodes.summary: Reads enterprise managed configuration: resolves platform-specific managed config directories and reads macOS MDM mobileconfig plists for the ai.opencode.managed domain, converting them via plutil and stripping MDM metadata keys.
nodes.languageNotes: The macOS path shells out to plutil -convert json through Process.run with array arguments (no shell interpolation); MDM-injected Payload* keys are removed before the plist is treated as config.

nodes.name: markdown.ts
nodes.summary: Shared markdown frontmatter parsing for config entries: gray-matter parse with a permissive fallback sanitizer that repairs invalid YAML written by other coding agents, plus regexes for @file and !`shell` template references.

nodes.name: mcp.ts
nodes.summary: Effect Schema for MCP server configs: a type-discriminated union of local (command, environment, timeout) and remote (url, headers, oauth) server definitions with derived zod surfaces.

nodes.name: model-id.ts
nodes.summary: Exports the ConfigModelID string schema, preserving the original models.dev external $ref via ZodOverride so SDK schema generation stays faithful.

nodes.name: parse.ts
nodes.summary: Config parsing and validation helpers: JSONC parsing with caret-positioned error diagnostics, a zod safeParse wrapper, and Effect Schema decoding with strict unknown-top-level-key rejection, all throwing typed config errors.
nodes.languageNotes: jsonc() renders syntax errors with line/column and a caret pointer; effectSchema() manually checks top-level extra keys because Effect Schema structs are non-strict by default, unlike the historical zod .strict() config surface.

nodes.name: spinner
nodes.summary: Creates a @clack spinner wrapped in Effect, exposing start/stop Effect methods where a non-zero exit code renders the error style.

nodes.name: FormatError
nodes.summary: Maps tagged and named errors (CliError, MCPFailed, account and provider failures, config errors) to concise CLI-friendly strings, setting process.exitCode for CliError, suggesting similar models for ProviderModelNotFoundError, and returning an empty string for user cancellations.

nodes.name: start
