nodes.summary: Defines the zod schema for OpenAI-style error bodies plus the ProviderErrorStructure contract (errorSchema, errorToMessage, optional isRetryable) and its default implementation for the chat model.

nodes.name: convert-to-openai-responses-input.ts
nodes.summary: Converts AI SDK ModelMessages into OpenAI Responses API input items, handling file-ID detection versus base64 media, tool calls and results, reasoning items with summaries, local-shell calls/outputs, and approval deduplication.
nodes.languageNotes: A ~310-line single exported converter that walks every message/part kind; fileIdPrefixes (e.g. 'file-' for OpenAI, 'assistant-' for Azure) decide whether binary data is sent as a file reference or an inline base64 data URL.

nodes.name: convertToOpenAIResponsesInput
nodes.summary: Single-pass converter from ModelMessage arrays to Responses API input: emits system/user/assistant items, merges tool outputs and reasoning summaries, validates local-shell payloads against their zod schemas, and collects warnings for unsupported parts.

nodes.name: map-openai-responses-finish-reason.ts
nodes.summary: Maps OpenAI Responses API finish reasons (e.g. stop, length, content_filter) to unified AI SDK finish reasons, upgrading to tool-calls when function output is present.

nodes.name: mapOpenAIResponseFinishReason
nodes.summary: Translates a Responses API status/finish reason into the unified finish reason, returning "tool-calls" when the response contains function call output regardless of the raw reason string.

nodes.name: openai-config.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the OpenAIConfig type shared by the Responses language model: provider name, URL builder, header factory, fetch override, optional ID generator, and fileIdPrefixes for file-ID versus base64 detection.

nodes.name: openai-error.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the zod error-body schema for the Responses API and builds the openaiFailedResponseHandler used to surface API errors as retryable provider failures.

nodes.name: openai-responses-api-types.ts
nodes.summary: Type-only wire-format definitions for the OpenAI Responses API: input items (message, function_call, reasoning, local_shell), output items (text, reasoning, tool calls, code interpreter, image generation, web search), streaming events, and include options.

nodes.name: openai-responses-language-model.ts
nodes.summary: LanguageModelV3 implementation over the OpenAI Responses API: assembles requests via convertToOpenAIResponsesInput and prepareResponsesTools, applies per-model config from getResponsesModelConfig, and reduces response output items and SSE events (text deltas, reasoning summaries, function-call arguments, code-interpreter output, image partials, annotations) into AI SDK content parts.
nodes.languageNotes: Streaming is decoded by ~15 small isX type-guard predicates (isTextDeltaChunk, isResponseOutputItemDoneChunk, ...) that discriminate the typed SSE event union before the TransformStream reducer; vendor-specific reasoning summary parts are reassembled from added/delta events.

nodes.name: OpenAIResponsesLanguageModel
nodes.summary: The Responses API language model class: getArgs builds the request body (model config, input conversion, tool preparation, include flags), doGenerate validates and reduces a complete response, and doStream pipes SSE events through a stateful transform into AI SDK stream parts.

nodes.name: getResponsesModelConfig
nodes.summary: Infers model capabilities (reasoning display, verbosity control, storage) from model-ID prefixes so the request omits include flags and options the specific model does not support.

nodes.name: openai-responses-prepare-tools.ts
nodes.summary: Converts AI SDK tool definitions into Responses API tool objects, recognizing built-in OpenAI hosted tools (file search, web search, web search preview, code interpreter, image generation) by ID and validating their args against the per-tool zod schemas.

nodes.name: prepareResponsesTools
nodes.summary: Maps each tool to the Responses tool format, parsing hosted-tool configuration from tool metadata schemas and emitting warnings for unsupported tool types or invalid hosted-tool arguments.

nodes.name: openai-responses-settings.ts
nodes.summary: Single-line type alias declaring OpenAIResponsesModelId as a plain string model identifier for the Responses language model.

nodes.name: code-interpreter.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the OpenAI hosted code-interpreter tool for the Responses API: zod schemas for input (code, containerId), output (logs/images), and args (container or file IDs), plus the tool factory wrapper.

nodes.name: codeInterpreter
nodes.summary: Thin exported wrapper that instantiates the code-interpreter provider tool with its input/output schemas.

nodes.name: file-search.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the OpenAI hosted file-search tool: zod schemas for vector-store args (with recursive comparison/compound filters) and scored search results, plus the tool factory.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses z.lazy for a self-referential compound filter schema (and/or trees of comparison filters), one of the few recursive zod schemas in the subtree.

nodes.name: image-generation.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the OpenAI hosted image-generation tool: a strict zod args schema (background, fidelity, mask, format, quality, size, partial images), output schema, and the tool factory wrapper.

nodes.name: imageGeneration
nodes.summary: Thin exported wrapper that instantiates the image-generation provider tool with its input/output schemas.

nodes.name: local-shell.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the OpenAI local-shell tool (id openai.local_shell): zod schemas for exec actions (command array, timeout, env, working directory) and plain-text output, plus the tool factory.

nodes.name: web-search-preview.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the OpenAI hosted web-search-preview tool: args schema for search context size and approximate user location, and the prompt-driven tool factory (no direct input parameters).

nodes.name: web-search.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the OpenAI hosted web-search tool: args schema for domain filters, search context size, and user location, plus the tool factory and its wrapper.

nodes.name: webSearch
nodes.summary: Thin exported wrapper that instantiates the web-search provider tool with its args schema.

nodes.name: transform.ts
nodes.summary: The ProviderTransform orchestrator that adapts opencode's internal model contract to each AI SDK provider: normalizeMessages fans out to per-provider transform modules, then message/options/providerOptions/variants compute sanitized messages, sampling parameters, reasoning-effort variants, and provider-option keys per model.
nodes.languageNotes: Follows the documented orchestrator pattern: a 41-line normalizeMessages dispatcher (transform.ts:97-137) over 7 sibling modules under provider/transform/ (sanitize, anthropic, bedrock, claude-ids, mistral, deepseek, interleaved), with variants() being a ~340-line per-model capability table.

nodes.name: systemPromptDelivery
nodes.summary: Decides whether the system prompt is delivered as messages or via the instructions field; OpenAI OAuth lacks system-role support so it returns instructions for that auth type.

nodes.name: shouldUseInstructions
nodes.summary: Deprecated boolean wrapper over systemPromptDelivery kept for backward compatibility.

nodes.name: supportsMediaInToolResult
nodes.summary: Reports whether a provider accepts media attachments inside tool results or requires extracting them into a separate user message; per-SDK rules with a Gemini-3-only allowance for Google.

nodes.name: sdkKey
nodes.summary: Maps an AI SDK npm package name to the providerOptions key the SDK expects (e.g. @ai-sdk/github-copilot to "copilot", ai-gateway-provider to camelCase "openaiCompatible" to avoid a deprecation warning).

nodes.name: normalizeMessages
nodes.summary: Dispatches messages through the per-provider normalization pipeline: sanitize, Anthropic/Bedrock empty-content removal, Claude tool-call ID scrubbing, Anthropic tool_use reordering, Mistral normalization, DeepSeek reasoning injection, and interleaved reasoning extraction.

nodes.name: applyCaching
nodes.summary: Injects prompt-caching provider options for Anthropic-style providers by finding stable tool/system breakpoints in the last non-system message and merging cache-control metadata deep into the message tree.

nodes.name: unsupportedParts
nodes.summary: Flags message parts whose media modality (image/audio/video/pdf) the target model does not accept, so callers can strip or convert them before the API call.

nodes.name: message
nodes.summary: Entry point producing the final ModelMessage array: detects multi-part-capable models, applies normalization and caching, then remaps file/text parts when a model only supports single-part content.

nodes.name: temperature
nodes.summary: Suppresses temperature for reasoning/thinking model families (o-series, thinking variants, K2, etc.) that reject explicit temperature settings.

nodes.name: topP
nodes.summary: Suppresses top_p for model families (minimax-m2, gemini, kimi-k2.5) that reject the parameter.

nodes.name: topK
nodes.summary: Suppresses top_k for minimax m2-family models and only allows it for Anthropic and Gemini providers.

nodes.name: variants
nodes.summary: Builds the per-model capability/variant table: reasoning-effort ladders for OpenAI/GPT-5, Anthropic adaptive thinking, and Gemini thinking levels, expanded into named model variants with their supported effort values.

nodes.name: options
nodes.summary: Computes the reasoning/sampling option set for a request: maps the requested effort onto the model's variant ladder (GPT-5 versioned efforts, Claude adaptive/fixed thinking, Gemini thinking budgets) and returns provider-shaped settings.

nodes.name: smallOptions
nodes.summary: Returns reduced-cost option presets for small/fast model tiers, mapping the effort ladder onto cheaper reasoning budgets.

nodes.name: providerOptions
nodes.summary: Assembles the providerOptions payload keyed by the SDK package name (via sdkKey), merging reasoning, caching, and provider-specific settings into the shape each AI SDK package expects.

nodes.name: maxOutputTokens
nodes.summary: Returns the OUTPUT_TOKEN_MAX cap (experimental flag override or 32,000) applied to generation requests.

nodes.name: schema
nodes.summary: Converts and sanitizes a JSON schema for structured-output usage, normalizing it into the strict shape providers require and gating on the model's structured-output support.

nodes.name: anthropic.ts
nodes.summary: Anthropic-specific message transforms for ProviderTransform: removeEmptyContent delegates to the shared helper, and reorderToolUseBlocks fixes assistant turns where tool_use blocks precede text (which Anthropic rejects) by splitting them into text-then-tool_use messages.
nodes.languageNotes: reorderToolUseBlocks is a documented workaround for upstream stream ordering: [tool_use, text] is reshaped into two messages because consecutive assistant messages are later merged by the provider SDK, which would otherwise resurrect the invalid payload order.

nodes.name: removeEmptyContent
nodes.summary: Anthropic-flavored wrapper over the shared remove-empty-content helper, dropping messages whose content array became empty after sanitization.

nodes.name: reorderToolUseBlocks
nodes.summary: Splits assistant messages mixing tool calls with trailing non-tool content into a text message followed by a tool-call-only message, satisfying Anthropic's requirement that tool_use blocks be immediately followed by tool_result blocks.

nodes.name: bedrock.ts
nodes.summary: Bedrock provider transform adapter that re-exports the shared empty-content filter pinned to the bedrock provider key, so reasoning parts carrying Bedrock signatures or redacted data survive filtering.
nodes.languageNotes: Follows the transform sibling-module convention: a thin per-provider wrapper plus `export * as TransformBedrock` namespace re-export consumed by the normalizeMessages orchestrator.

nodes.name: claude-ids.ts
nodes.summary: Anthropic message transform that rewrites tool-call and tool-result IDs, replacing any character outside [a-zA-Z0-9_-] with underscores to satisfy Anthropic's tool ID format requirements.

nodes.name: deepseek.ts
nodes.summary: DeepSeek message transform that appends an empty reasoning part to every assistant message lacking one, since DeepSeek expects reasoning state to be echoed back on subsequent requests even when empty.

nodes.name: interleaved.ts
nodes.summary: Message transform for interleaved-thinking models that lifts reasoning parts out of assistant content into a model-configured top-level openaiCompatible field (e.g. reasoning_content), always setting the field even when empty.

nodes.name: mistral.ts
nodes.summary: Mistral message normalizer that scrubs tool-call IDs to exactly 9 alphanumeric characters and inserts a synthetic 'Done.' assistant message whenever a tool result would be followed directly by a user message, which Mistral's API rejects.

nodes.name: remove-empty-content.ts
nodes.summary: Shared empty-content filter for Anthropic and Bedrock that drops empty text parts and messages left with no content, while preserving empty-text reasoning parts that carry a provider signature or redacted data; behavior pinned by characterization tests.

nodes.name: sanitize.ts
nodes.summary: Message sanitization transform that replaces unpaired UTF-16 surrogate code units with U+FFFD across system, user, assistant, and tool-result content, preventing invalid-string errors in provider APIs.

nodes.name: claude.ts
nodes.summary: Anthropic OAuth usage provider that fetches the 5-hour and 7-day rate-limit buckets (including Opus and Sonnet tiers) from the Anthropic usage API and normalizes them into UsageLimit reports with percent-based amounts and account metadata.

nodes.name: registry.ts
nodes.summary: Usage module registry and barrel that reads auth.json credentials, maps opencode provider IDs to usage provider IDs, and fans out to every registered provider (Claude, ZAI) that supports the available credential.
nodes.languageNotes: Doubles as the module's public surface via re-exports (claudeUsageProvider, zaiUsageProvider, shared types) while also owning the credential-reading dispatch logic.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared usage and quota type definitions (UsageReport, UsageLimit, UsageAmount, UsageWindow, UsageCredential) plus pure helpers that derive used-fraction and warning status from any amount shape; ported from oh-my-pi.

nodes.name: zai.ts
nodes.summary: ZAI usage provider that queries the Z.AI monitor API for quota limits and model-usage windows, normalizing percentage and absolute counters into UsageLimit reports with reset times.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: PTY session service that spawns terminal processes behind a websocket fan-out, maintaining a 2 MB capped scrollback buffer for cursor-based replay, resize/write control, and pty.created/updated/exited/deleted bus events with automatic cleanup on exit.
nodes.languageNotes: Effect Layer + InstanceState pattern; the backend is lazy-loaded via the `#pty` package.json imports alias so Bun uses bun-pty and Node uses @lydell/node-pty.

nodes.name: input.ts
nodes.summary: Decodes incoming PTY websocket input, passing strings through directly and strictly validating binary frames as UTF-8 before forwarding them to the session's onMessage handler.

nodes.name: scrubToolCallIds
nodes.summary: Rewrites tool-call and tool-result IDs in assistant and tool messages, replacing characters outside [a-zA-Z0-9_-] with underscores to meet Anthropic's ID constraints.

nodes.name: injectReasoningParts
nodes.summary: Appends an empty reasoning part to every assistant message that lacks one, converting string content to a text part first, so DeepSeek always receives reasoning state back.

nodes.name: extractReasoningField
nodes.summary: Moves reasoning parts out of assistant content into the model's configured openaiCompatible field (e.g. reasoning_content), setting the field even when empty because some providers require it echoed back.

nodes.name: normalizeForMistral
nodes.summary: Scrubs tool-call IDs to exactly 9 alphanumeric characters and inserts a 'Done.' assistant message whenever a tool message would be followed by a user message, a sequence Mistral's API rejects.

nodes.name: removeEmptyContent
nodes.summary: Filters empty text/reasoning parts and drops messages left with no content, keeping empty-text reasoning parts that still carry a provider signature or redacted data under the anthropic or bedrock providerOptions key.

nodes.name: sanitizeToolResultOutput
nodes.summary: Applies surrogate sanitization to a tool-result part's text, error-text, or nested content-array values.

nodes.name: sanitizeMessages
nodes.summary: Maps over all messages by role and applies surrogate sanitization to system/user strings, text and reasoning parts, and tool-result outputs.

nodes.name: buildAmount
nodes.summary: Clamps a utilization percentage to 0-100 and builds a percent-unit UsageAmount with derived remaining and fraction fields.

nodes.name: buildLimit
nodes.summary: Assembles a UsageLimit (id, label, window, scope, tier) from a parsed usage bucket, returning null for buckets without usable utilization.

nodes.name: fetchClaudeUsage
nodes.summary: Fetches the Anthropic OAuth usage and profile endpoints, parses the 5-hour, 7-day, Opus, and Sonnet buckets into UsageLimits, and attaches account email metadata to the report.

nodes.name: readAuthCredentials
nodes.summary: Reads auth.json and converts oauth, api, and wellknown entries into UsageCredential objects keyed by the mapped usage provider ID.

nodes.name: fetchUsageReports
nodes.summary: Fans out to every registered usage provider matching the available credentials and collects non-null reports, swallowing per-provider errors.

nodes.name: resolveUsedFraction
nodes.summary: Derives a 0-1 used fraction from a UsageLimit's amount, preferring explicit fractions, then used/limit, then percent units, then the inverse of remainingFraction.

nodes.name: buildUsageStatus
nodes.summary: Maps a used fraction to ok, warning (>= 0.9), or exhausted (>= 1), returning undefined when the fraction is unknown.

nodes.name: parseLimitItem
nodes.summary: Validates a raw Z.AI limit object and coerces its usage, currentValue, percentage, remaining, and nextResetTime fields to numbers.

nodes.name: buildAmount
nodes.summary: Builds a UsageAmount from used/limit/remaining counters or a percentage, clamping the derived used fraction to 0-1.

nodes.name: fetchZaiUsage
nodes.summary: Queries the Z.AI quota and model-usage endpoints with the API key, parses limit items into 7-day UsageLimits, and records the request window in report metadata.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Spawns a new PTY session: resolves the shell and login flag from config, merges plugin shell.env into the environment, lazy-loads the #pty backend, wires output fan-out to subscribers with a capped ring buffer, and publishes pty.created with auto-removal on exit.

nodes.name: connect
nodes.summary: Attaches a websocket subscriber to a session, replays scrollback from the requested cursor in 64 KB chunks, sends the 0x00-prefixed cursor control frame, and returns onMessage/onClose hooks bridging input to the process.

nodes.name: handlePtyInput
nodes.summary: Passes string websocket input straight through and strictly decodes binary frames as UTF-8, silently dropping undecodable input instead of failing the handler.

nodes.name: pty.bun.ts
nodes.summary: Bun-native PTY adapter that wraps bun-pty's spawn in the vendor-neutral Proc interface (onData/onExit/write/resize/kill) consumed by the PTY service; selected by the `#pty` alias's bun/default conditions.

nodes.name: pty.node.ts
nodes.summary: Node.js PTY adapter that wraps @lydell/node-pty's spawn in the vendor-neutral Proc interface (onData/onExit/write/resize/kill); selected by the `#pty` alias's node condition.

nodes.name: pty.ts
nodes.summary: Vendor-neutral PTY contract defining the Disp, Exit, Opts, and Proc types that both the bun-pty and node-pty adapters implement and the PTY service consumes.

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: Effect Schema definition of the branded PtyID identifier with an ascending factory built on the shared Identifier helper and a derived zod schema for SDK boundaries.

nodes.name: ticket.ts
nodes.summary: One-time PTY connect-ticket service backed by an Effect Cache with a 60-second TTL: issue() mints a UUID bound to a pty/directory/workspace scope and consume() atomically invalidates it only when the scopes match.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Cache.set/invalidateWhen as a TTL-scoped one-shot store; the cache lookup intentionally dies because get() is never a valid operation on tickets.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Question service implementing the ask/reply/reject protocol between agent and user: publishes question.asked bus events, parks each pending request on a Deferred, and resolves or fails it when the client replies or dismisses; also defines the full Effect/zod schema model for options, requests, and replies.

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: QuestionID branded-newtype Effect Schema with an ascending monotonic factory and a derived zod schema for SDK-facing validation.

nodes.name: reference.ts
nodes.summary: Reference service that resolves the config's reference map into local paths or cached git repositories, detects conflicting branch requests targeting the same clone, and (under the experimental scout flag) materializes git references through the RepositoryCache with cached, concurrency-limited refresh effects.

nodes.name: repository-cache.ts
nodes.summary: Git repository cache manager that clones (depth 100), refreshes, and hard-resets remote repositories into local cache paths under an exclusive per-path file lock, reusing existing clones only when the origin URL matches the requested repository.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Architecture guidance for the search subsystem: documents ZvecIndex's low-level contract and dimension-precedence rules, the manifest adjacency invariant, coded native errors, EmbeddingService's lazy config resolution, and the dynamic-import pattern that keeps the 13 MB ONNX/WASM runtime out of module load.

nodes.name: embedding.ts
nodes.summary: Embedding service with two lazily constructed backends: a local pure-WASM ONNX runtime running all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (hand-rolled BERT WordPiece tokenizer, mean pooling, HuggingFace download cache) and an OpenAI API provider, selected from config on first use.
nodes.languageNotes: onnxruntime-web and the 13 MB WASM binaries must be dynamically imported inside createLocalProvider; static imports would eagerly load the runtime at module parse time even when semantic search is never used.

nodes.name: indexer.ts
nodes.summary: Workspace indexing pipeline that globs source files, splits them into 100-line chunks, tracks mtimes in a JSON manifest for incremental re-indexing, deletes stale chunks, and embeds new content in batches of 64 through the EmbeddingService; also exposes the SemanticSearch query helper.

nodes.name: spawn
nodes.summary: Spawns a process through bun-pty and adapts it to the vendor-neutral Proc interface with dispose-returning listeners.

nodes.name: spawn
nodes.summary: Spawns a process through @lydell/node-pty and adapts it to the vendor-neutral Proc interface with dispose-returning listeners.

nodes.name: make
nodes.summary: Factory that builds the ticket service over an Effect Cache with the given TTL: issue mints UUID tickets via Cache.set, consume removes one atomically via invalidateWhen with scope matching; exposed for tests to shorten the TTL.

nodes.name: Info
nodes.summary: Effect Schema class for a single question: question text, short header, label/description options, optional multi-select, and optional custom-answer support, with a derived zod schema.

nodes.name: Request
nodes.summary: Effect Schema class for an ask request carrying the QuestionID, session ID, question list, and optional originating tool identifiers.

nodes.name: RejectedError
nodes.summary: Tagged error raised when a pending question is dismissed, failing the asker's Deferred with 'The user dismissed this question'.

nodes.name: ask
nodes.summary: Registers a pending question: creates a Deferred, decodes and stores the request, publishes question.asked on the bus, and awaits the reply with pending-entry cleanup guaranteed on interruption.

nodes.name: reply
nodes.summary: Resolves a pending request's Deferred with the user's answers and publishes question.replied; unknown request IDs only log a warning.

nodes.name: reject
nodes.summary: Fails a pending request's Deferred with RejectedError and publishes question.rejected on the bus.

nodes.name: QuestionID
nodes.summary: Branded string newtype for question identifiers with a monotonic ascending factory and a derived zod schema.

nodes.name: referencePath
nodes.summary: Resolves a reference value to an absolute path, expanding ~/ against the home directory and relative values against the worktree or project directory.

nodes.name: resolveGit
nodes.summary: Parses a repository string into a structured git reference plus its cache path, returning an invalid entry for file: protocols or unparseable URLs.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves one config reference entry to a local path or git clone target based on string prefixes (./, /, ~) and the path/repository/branch object shape.

nodes.name: resolveAll
nodes.summary: Resolves every config reference and marks git entries invalid when two names request different branches of the same clone path.

nodes.name: resetTarget
nodes.summary: Chooses the git reset target for a refresh: the requested branch, origin's HEAD symbolic ref, the current branch, or plain HEAD as a fallback.

nodes.name: ensure
nodes.summary: Ensures a repository exists in the cache under an exclusive flock: reuses valid clones whose origin matches, removes mismatched directories, clones with depth 100, or fetches all and hard-resets to the computed target ref, returning head and branch info.

nodes.name: WordPieceTokenizer
nodes.summary: Hand-rolled BERT WordPiece tokenizer for all-MiniLM-L6-v2: lowercases and strips accents, splits punctuation, applies greedy longest-match wordpiece with ## prefixes, and emits CLS/SEP-framed input ids and attention masks.

nodes.name: meanPool
nodes.summary: Mean-pools token logits under the attention mask and L2-normalizes the result into a single embedding vector.

nodes.name: createLocalProvider
nodes.summary: Creates the local ONNX embedding backend: memoized init dynamically imports onnxruntime-web and WASM assets, downloads the quantized model and vocab to ~/.cache/opencode, and runs per-text inference with mean pooling.

nodes.name: createOpenAIProvider
nodes.summary: Creates the OpenAI embedding backend delegating to the AI SDK's embedMany with the configured model and API key.

nodes.name: chunkFile
nodes.summary: Splits ANSI-stripped file content into 100-line chunks (or one whole-file chunk), dropping chunks under the 200-character minimum.

nodes.name: IndexWorkspace
nodes.summary: Incremental indexing workflow: opens the vector index before reading the manifest, diffs globbed file mtimes against the manifest, deletes stale chunks, embeds new/modified chunks in batches of 64, and writes the updated manifest.

nodes.name: SemanticSearch
nodes.summary: Query helper that embeds the query text and delegates top-K vector search to the SearchService.

nodes.name: manifest.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the cross-module invariant that a zvec index's companion manifest always lives at `{indexPath}_manifest.json`, exposing the suffix constant and a path-builder helper so consumers never hand-build manifest paths.

nodes.name: manifestPathFor
nodes.summary: Builds the companion manifest path for a zvec index by appending the `_manifest.json` suffix.

nodes.name: search.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the SearchService Effect service contract (open/index/search/reset/delete over an embedding-backed index) and the SearchResult shape for the workspace semantic-search subsystem.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the Effect Context.Service tag pattern: a class-based service identifier paired with a readonly interface of Effect-returning methods.

nodes.name: SearchService
nodes.summary: Context.Service tag for the semantic-search service, exposing open (idempotent, must run before manifest reads), index, search, reset, and delete operations.

nodes.name: zvec.ts
nodes.summary: Implements SearchService on the native zvec vector database: lazy-loads the platform binding, manages collection lifecycle (create/open/dimension migration), and wires an Effect layer with per-instance index state under the global cache directory.
nodes.languageNotes: A template `require(`@zvec/bindings-${process.platform}-${process.arch}`)` is statically analyzable by Bun --compile so the .node addon is embedded in the standalone binary; the @zvec/zvec JS wrapper is bypassed because its runtime require.resolve cannot resolve inside the compiled binary's virtual filesystem.

nodes.name: zvec
nodes.summary: Lazily loads the platform-specific zvec native binding, initializes it at ERROR log level, and normalizes its exports to the ZVecModule interface shape; returns undefined when the binding is unavailable.

nodes.name: ZvecError
nodes.summary: Typed error for all ZvecIndex operations, carrying a `code` that passes through native ZVEC_* codes or names the failed operation (OPEN_FAILED, INDEX_FAILED, BINDING_UNAVAILABLE, ...).

nodes.name: checkStatuses
nodes.summary: Inspects per-document ZVecStatus results from upsert/delete batches: throws when every document failed, logs partial failures, and ignores benign codes such as ZVEC_NOT_FOUND on idempotent deletes.

nodes.name: buildSchema
nodes.summary: Constructs the zvec collection schema for workspace search: an FP32 embedding vector with HNSW index and cosine metric (m=24, efConstruction=100) plus path/content/mtime payload fields.

nodes.name: openNative
nodes.summary: Synchronous native open path kept outside Effect.gen so raw throws convert to typed failures: tries ZVecCreateAndOpen, falls back to ZVecOpen when the path exists, and destructively recreates the collection when the persisted vector dimension mismatches.

nodes.name: ZvecIndex
nodes.summary: Manages a per-workspace zvec collection: lazy open with dimension validation and migration, batched upserts of SHA1-hashed document IDs (zvec rejects '/', ':', '.'), k-NN search hydrating path/content from stored fields, idempotent delete, destructive reset that also removes the companion manifest, and close.

nodes.name: layer
nodes.summary: Builds the SearchService Effect layer: per-instance lazy ZvecIndex state keyed by a fast hash of the working directory under the global cache, embedding-config resolution before first open (preventing bogus dimension migrations), and delegation of index/search/reset/delete to the active index.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Server implementation guide covering shutdown patterns (Effect.runPromiseExit + atomic stopPromise), embedded UI caching and ETag strategy, CSP hash caching, proxy header security blocklists, virtual network interface filtering, mDNS exponential-backoff retry, the bonjour-service type import quirk, and WebSocket tracker concurrency limits.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Basic-auth support for the HTTP server: reads OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME/OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD config, checks whether auth is required and credentials are authorized, and builds Basic Authorization headers for outbound SDK calls.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.summary: ConfigService definition reading OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD (optional) and OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME (defaulting to 'opencode') for server basic auth.

nodes.name: required
nodes.summary: Returns whether server basic auth is active, i.e. a non-empty OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD is configured.

nodes.name: authorized
nodes.summary: Checks decoded basic-auth credentials against the configured username and Redacted-wrapped password.

nodes.name: header
nodes.summary: Builds a Basic Authorization header from explicit credentials or the OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD flag fallbacks, returning undefined when no password is set.

nodes.name: headers
nodes.summary: Wraps the Basic Authorization header into a fetch-style headers object, or undefined when auth is not configured.

nodes.name: cors.ts
nodes.summary: Origin allowlist checks for CORS: permits localhost/127.0.0.1, opencode.ai origins, tauri hosts and the oc:// renderer scheme, same-host requests, and extra origins supplied through the CorsConfig context reference.

nodes.name: isAllowedCorsOrigin
nodes.summary: Allowlist check for an Origin header: localhost/127.0.0.1, tauri hosts, oc://renderer, exact opencode.ai domains, and user-configured extra origins.

nodes.name: isAllowedRequestOrigin
nodes.summary: Request-origin check that additionally accepts origins whose host matches the request Host header before falling back to the CORS allowlist.

nodes.name: event.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the two server-level bus events, `server.connected` and `global.disposed`, that bracket an OpenCode server's lifetime on the event streams.

nodes.name: global-lifecycle.ts
nodes.summary: Global server lifecycle helpers: emits the `global.disposed` event on the GlobalBus and uninterruptibly disposes all OpenCode instances via InstanceStore, with optional error swallowing for shutdown paths.

nodes.name: emitGlobalDisposed
nodes.summary: Emits the `global.disposed` event on the GlobalBus to notify cross-instance SSE consumers that the server is going away.

nodes.name: disposeAllInstancesAndEmitGlobalDisposed
nodes.summary: Uninterruptibly disposes every OpenCode instance through InstanceStore (optionally catching and logging per-instance causes) and then emits the global disposed event.

nodes.name: httpapi-server.node.ts
nodes.summary: Node.js HTTP server layer for the Effect HttpApi stack: wraps node:http in NodeHttpServer.layer with a 1-second graceful shutdown timeout and exposes a closeAll service that force-destroys active sockets when shutdown must not wait for keep-alive connections.
nodes.languageNotes: Monkey-patches server.close to record that shutdown started, so a later closeAll() (from listener.stop(true)) can call server.closeAllConnections() at the right moment instead of racing Node's graceful drain.

nodes.name: layer
nodes.summary: Constructs the Node HTTP server layer: creates the node:http server, wraps it with NodeHttpServer.layer, patches close() for force-stop tracking, and merges in a Service layer whose closeAll flips the force flag and destroys open connections.

nodes.name: httpapi-server.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the HttpApiServer Service context tag and its Interface (closeAll) that platform-specific layers such as httpapi-server.node.ts implement for forced connection shutdown.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Context.Service tag for the HttpApiServer, exposing closeAll as an Effect so callers can force-close all active HTTP connections.

nodes.name: mdns.ts
nodes.summary: Publishes the opencode HTTP server over mDNS/Bonjour as `opencode-{port}` (type http, host opencode.local or a custom domain) with exponential-backoff retry up to 3 attempts, and unpublishes/destroys the advertiser on shutdown.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `InstanceType<typeof Bonjour>` for type annotations because bonjour-service's CommonJS `export =` cannot be used as a type under esModuleInterop.

nodes.name: publish
nodes.summary: Publishes the opencode mDNS service (name `opencode-{port}`, txt path=/), no-op when the port is unchanged, with exponential backoff (500ms base, doubling) across at most 3 retry attempts before giving up permanently.

nodes.name: unpublish
nodes.summary: Unpublishes all mDNS services, destroys the Bonjour advertiser, and resets the module-level port/state tracking.

nodes.name: projectors.ts
nodes.summary: Initializes the SyncEvent projector pipeline: registers the session projectors and a convertEvent hook that rehydrates `session.updated` payloads with full Session info read from SessionTable via Drizzle.
nodes.languageNotes: Side-effectful module: initProjectors() runs at import time, so merely importing the file wires the projector pipeline.

nodes.name: initProjectors
nodes.summary: Configures SyncEvent with the session projectors and a converter that looks up the SessionTable row for `session.updated` events and substitutes a hydrated `{ sessionID, info }` payload.

nodes.name: proxy-util.ts
nodes.summary: Header-sanitization and WebSocket helpers for the reverse-proxy server: strips hop-by-hop and security-sensitive headers (set-cookie, x-forwarded-*, forwarded, x-real-ip) plus internal x-opencode-* routing headers, parses Sec-WebSocket-Protocol, and converts http(s) URLs to ws(s) targets.

nodes.name: headers
nodes.summary: Builds a sanitized Headers copy of the incoming request headers, removing hop-by-hop, spoofable, and internal routing headers, then merging any extra headers on top.

nodes.name: websocketProtocols
nodes.summary: Parses the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header (from a Request or a plain header record) into a trimmed list of requested subprotocols.

nodes.name: websocketTargetURL
nodes.summary: Converts an http/https URL to its ws/wss counterpart for WebSocket proxy targeting.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Route-authoring conventions for the Effect HttpApi layer: HttpApiBuilder.group patterns, SSE handling via handleRaw, the three-file endpoint wiring (groups/handlers/server.ts), request-scoped vs stable services, the OpenAPI self-referencing component workaround, and the differing envelopes of the /global/event and /event SSE endpoints.

nodes.name: api.ts
nodes.summary: Composition root of the HttpApi surface: assembles RootHttpApi (control + global groups with auth and schema-error middleware), InstanceHttpApi (15 instance-scoped route groups), and OpenCodeHttpApi, and registers the SSE event schemas derived from the BusEvent/SyncEvent registries as additional OpenAPI schemas.
nodes.languageNotes: Purely declarative assembly: HttpApi.make(...).addHttpApi(...) chains compose the route tree, and the OpenAPI Event union schema is generated at build time from the BusEvent registry rather than hand-written.

nodes.name: errors.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the SDK-visible 404 error contract (ApiNotFoundError Schema.ErrorClass with a message payload) and a notFound() constructor used by HttpApi handlers for expected not-found failures.

nodes.name: ApiNotFoundError
nodes.summary: Schema.ErrorClass mapping to HTTP 404, carrying a message in its data payload so SDK clients receive structured not-found errors.

nodes.name: notFound
nodes.summary: Constructor helper that instantiates ApiNotFoundError with a human-readable message.

nodes.name: event.ts
nodes.summary: Per-instance SSE endpoint (GET /event): declares the EventApi group and implements its handler, streaming raw Bus events (id/type/properties) plus synthetic server.connected and 10-second heartbeat events through the SSE encoder with no-cache/nosniff headers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses handlers.handleRaw because the SSE response bypasses the schema-typed success channel; the stream terminates when the Bus emits InstanceDisposed.

nodes.name: eventResponse
nodes.summary: Builds the SSE HttpServerResponse: merges the Bus event stream (halted on InstanceDisposed) with 10s heartbeats, prefixes a server.connected event, encodes through the Sse channel, and sets Cache-Control/no-buffering/nosniff headers.

nodes.name: eventHandlers
nodes.summary: HttpApiBuilder group wiring for EventApi: yields Bus.Service once at layer construction and registers the raw `subscribe` handler that returns the SSE stream response.

nodes.name: GET /event
nodes.summary: Subscribes to the per-instance event stream over SSE, delivering Bus events directly (unwrapped id/type/properties) for per-project consumers such as the TUI and web UI.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: HttpApi route group for configuration: GET/PATCH /config and GET /config/providers, workspace-routed through the instance-context and workspace-routing middleware with full OpenAPI annotations.

nodes.name: GET /config
nodes.summary: Retrieves the current OpenCode configuration settings and preferences for the routed workspace.

nodes.name: PATCH /config
nodes.summary: Updates workspace configuration settings and preferences, returning the resulting config; rejects invalid payloads with 400.

nodes.name: GET /config/providers
nodes.summary: Lists all configured AI providers and their default models.

nodes.name: control.ts
nodes.summary: Control-plane HttpApi route group: PUT/DELETE /auth/:providerID for provider credential management and POST /log for writing structured log entries (service, level, message, extra metadata) to the server logs.

nodes.name: PUT /auth/:providerID
nodes.summary: Sets authentication credentials for a provider, returning boolean success; 400 on invalid input.

nodes.name: DELETE /auth/:providerID
nodes.summary: Removes a provider's stored authentication credentials, returning boolean success.

nodes.name: POST /log
nodes.summary: Writes a log entry with service, level (debug/info/warn/error), message, and optional extra metadata to the server logs, optionally scoped to a directory or workspace via query.

nodes.name: experimental.ts
nodes.summary: Experimental HttpApi route group (11 endpoints): Console org state/listing/switching, tool and tool-ID listings per provider+model, worktree create/list/remove/reset, cross-project session listing with pagination and search, and MCP resource listing.

nodes.name: GET /experimental/console
nodes.summary: Returns the active Console org name and the provider IDs managed by that org.

nodes.name: GET /experimental/console/orgs
nodes.summary: Lists the switchable Console orgs across logged-in accounts, marking the currently active one.

nodes.name: POST /experimental/console/switch
nodes.summary: Persists a new active Console account/org selection (accountID + orgID) for the current local OpenCode state.

nodes.name: GET /experimental/tool
nodes.summary: Lists available tools with their JSON schema parameters for a specific provider and model combination.

nodes.name: GET /experimental/tool/ids
nodes.summary: Lists all available tool IDs, including both built-in and dynamically registered tools.

nodes.name: GET /experimental/worktree
nodes.summary: Lists all sandbox worktree directories for the current project.

nodes.name: POST /experimental/worktree
nodes.summary: Creates a new git worktree for the current project and runs any configured startup scripts.

nodes.name: DELETE /experimental/worktree
nodes.summary: Removes a git worktree and deletes its branch.

nodes.name: POST /experimental/worktree/reset
nodes.summary: Resets a worktree branch back to the primary default branch.

nodes.name: GET /experimental/session
nodes.summary: Lists sessions across all projects sorted by most recently updated, with optional pagination (start/cursor/limit), search text, roots-only, and archived filters.

nodes.name: GET /experimental/resource
nodes.summary: Lists all available MCP resources from connected servers as a name-to-resource record.

nodes.name: file.ts
nodes.summary: File-oriented HttpApi route group: ripgrep text search, file/directory name search with type and limit filters, LSP workspace symbol search, directory listing, file content read, and git file status.

nodes.name: GET /find
nodes.summary: Searches for a text pattern across files in the project using ripgrep, returning structured matches.

nodes.name: GET /find/file
nodes.summary: Searches for files or directories by name or pattern, with optional file/directory type filter and a 1-200 result limit.

nodes.name: GET /find/symbol
nodes.summary: Searches workspace symbols such as functions, classes, and variables using LSP.

nodes.name: GET /file
nodes.summary: Lists files and directories at a specified path in the routed workspace.

nodes.name: GET /file/content
nodes.summary: Reads the content of a specified file.

nodes.name: GET /file/status
nodes.summary: Returns the git status of all files in the project.

nodes.name: global.ts
nodes.summary: Global (cross-instance) HttpApi route group: health check with version, global SSE event stream over the combined BusEvent/SyncEvent payload union, global config get/patch, dispose-all-instances, and self-upgrade to a target version or latest.

nodes.name: GET /global/health
nodes.summary: Health check returning `{ healthy: true, version }` for the OpenCode server.

nodes.name: GET /global/event
nodes.summary: Subscribes to global events over SSE with payloads wrapped in a directory/project/workspace envelope, serving cross-instance consumers such as the ACP agent and CLI run command.

nodes.name: GET /global/config
nodes.summary: Retrieves the current global OpenCode configuration settings and preferences.

nodes.name: PATCH /global/config
nodes.summary: Updates global OpenCode configuration settings, returning the updated config; 400 on invalid input.

nodes.name: POST /global/dispose
nodes.summary: Cleans up and disposes all OpenCode instances, releasing all resources.

nodes.name: POST /global/upgrade
nodes.summary: Upgrades opencode to the specified target version or the latest when unspecified, returning success and version or an error message.

nodes.name: instance.ts
nodes.summary: Instance-scoped HttpApi route group (12 endpoints): dispose, path info, VCS info/status/diff/raw-diff/apply (with ApiVcsApplyError contract), and listings for commands, agents, skills, LSP servers, and formatters.

nodes.name: ApiVcsApplyError
nodes.summary: Schema.ErrorClass mapping to HTTP 400 for failed patch application, carrying a message and a `non-git` or `not-clean` reason.

nodes.name: POST /instance/dispose
nodes.summary: Cleans up and disposes the current OpenCode instance, releasing its resources.

nodes.name: GET /path
nodes.summary: Returns the current working directory plus home, state, config, and worktree path information for the instance.

nodes.name: GET /vcs
nodes.summary: Retrieves version control information for the current project, such as the current git branch.

nodes.name: GET /vcs/status
nodes.summary: Retrieves changed files in the current working tree without patch contents.

nodes.name: GET /vcs/diff
nodes.summary: Retrieves the current git diff for the working tree or against the default branch, controlled by the mode query parameter.

nodes.name: GET /vcs/diff/raw
nodes.summary: Retrieves a raw patch (text/x-diff) of current uncommitted changes.

nodes.name: POST /vcs/apply
nodes.summary: Applies a raw patch to the current working tree; fails with a 400 VcsApplyError carrying a non-git or not-clean reason.

nodes.name: GET /command
nodes.summary: Lists all available commands in the OpenCode system.

nodes.name: GET /agent
nodes.summary: Lists all available AI agents in the OpenCode system.

nodes.name: GET /skill
nodes.summary: Lists all available skills in the OpenCode system.

nodes.name: GET /lsp
nodes.summary: Returns the status of all LSP servers for the instance.

nodes.name: GET /formatter
nodes.summary: Returns the status of all configured formatters for the instance.

nodes.name: mcp.ts
nodes.summary: MCP (Model Context Protocol) HttpApi route group (8 endpoints): server status map and dynamic add, per-server OAuth start/callback/authenticate/remove with UnsupportedOAuthError contract, and connect/disconnect controls.

nodes.name: UnsupportedOAuthError
nodes.summary: Schema.ErrorClass mapping to HTTP 400, returned when an MCP server does not support the OAuth authentication flow.

nodes.name: GET /mcp
nodes.summary: Returns the status of all registered MCP servers as a name-to-status record.

nodes.name: POST /mcp
nodes.summary: Dynamically adds a new MCP server by name and config, returning the updated status map.

nodes.name: POST /mcp/:name/auth
nodes.summary: Starts the OAuth flow for an MCP server, returning the authorization URL and oauth state; 400 when OAuth is unsupported or 404 when unknown.

nodes.name: POST /mcp/:name/auth/callback
nodes.summary: Completes OAuth authentication for an MCP server by exchanging the authorization code, returning the server status.

nodes.name: POST /mcp/:name/auth/authenticate
nodes.summary: Starts the OAuth flow and waits for the callback (opening the browser), returning the final server status.

nodes.name: DELETE /mcp/:name/auth
nodes.summary: Removes stored OAuth credentials for an MCP server.

nodes.name: POST /mcp/:name/connect
nodes.summary: Connects a registered MCP server.

nodes.name: POST /mcp/:name/disconnect
nodes.summary: Disconnects an MCP server.

nodes.name: metadata.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny OpenAPI metadata helpers shared by all route groups: `described()` annotates an endpoint success schema with a response description and `responseDescription()` builds OpenApi annotations for response documentation.

nodes.name: described
nodes.summary: Annotates a schema with a description, used to document endpoint success responses in the generated OpenAPI spec.

nodes.name: responseDescription
nodes.summary: Builds an OpenApi.annotations object carrying a response description for endpoint documentation.

nodes.name: permission.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the permission HttpApi contract: GET /permission lists pending permission requests and POST /permission/:requestID/reply approves or denies them, wired through instance-context, workspace-routing, and authorization middleware.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Effect's declarative HttpApi DSL (HttpApi.make / HttpApiGroup / HttpApiEndpoint) with annotateMerge(OpenApi.annotations(...)) so the OpenAPI spec is generated from the same code that types the endpoints.

nodes.name: project.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the project HttpApi contract: list projects, get the current project, initialize a git repository, and PATCH project properties such as name, icon, and commands.

nodes.name: provider.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the provider HttpApi contract: list AI providers, retrieve available auth methods, and drive per-provider OAuth authorize and callback flows.

nodes.name: pty.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the PTY HttpApi contract: shell discovery, PTY session CRUD, and short-lived WebSocket connect tokens, plus a separate PtyConnectApi for the WebSocket connect endpoint. Also exports the shared Params, CursorQuery, ShellItem, and PtyPaths route constants consumed by the PTY handlers.

nodes.name: query.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the QueryBoolean schema, a 'true'/'false' string literal that decodes to a boolean for query strings, along with its anyOf OpenAPI representation. Shared by the v1 session list and v2 sessions list query schemas.

nodes.name: question.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the question HttpApi contract: list pending question requests, reply with ordered answer selections, and reject a question request from the AI assistant.

nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the session HttpApi contract, the largest route group with 28 endpoints: session CRUD, status maps, children, todos, per-message diffs, message/part retrieval and editing, fork, abort, share/unshare, init, summarize, next-prompt prediction, prompt (sync and async), command, shell, revert/unrevert, and permission responses. Also exports the SessionPaths route map plus query and payload schemas reused across handlers.
nodes.languageNotes: Payload schemas derive from service input types via Struct.omit(Input.fields, ["sessionID"]) so the route layer stays in sync with the session service contract; query booleans reuse the shared QueryBoolean literal-to-boolean transform.

nodes.name: sync.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the sync HttpApi contract for the workspace sync event system: start sync loops, validate and replay a full event history, steal a session into the current workspace, and list incremental sync events keyed by per-aggregate sequence cursors.

nodes.name: tui.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the TUI HttpApi contract: 13 endpoints for remote-controlling the terminal UI, including append/submit/clear prompt, opening help/session/theme/model dialogs, toasts, event publishing, session selection, and the control request/response queue.

nodes.name: v2.ts
nodes.summary: Composes the v2 HttpApi by adding the SessionGroup and MessageGroup under the 'v2' API title; a thin barrel over the experimental v2 route surface.

nodes.name: message.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the v2.message HttpApi group: a cursor-paginated GET /api/session/:sessionID/message endpoint returning projected v2 messages with limit/order controls and opaque previous/next cursors.

nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the v2.session HttpApi group: cursor-paginated session listing over the v2 session store, prompt queuing with optional delivery mode, compaction, wait-for-idle, and active-context retrieval (messages after the last compaction).

nodes.name: workspace.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the experimental workspace HttpApi contract: list/create/remove control-plane workspaces, list workspace adapters, register adapter-provided workspaces, check connection status, and warp a session's sync history into a target workspace. Declares the ApiWorkspaceWarpError schema error (HTTP 400).

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the config route group: get and update instance config (marking the instance for disposal after an update) and list configured providers with their default model IDs.

nodes.name: control.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the server-wide control route group registered on RootHttpApi rather than the instance API: set and remove provider auth credentials and forward client log messages into the server logger.

nodes.name: experimental.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the experimental route group: console/org state and switching, tool listing with JSON-schema parameters, worktree sandbox create/remove/reset, global session search with x-next-cursor pagination headers, and MCP resource listing.

nodes.name: file.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the file route group: ripgrep text search, fuzzy file search, directory listing, file content reading, and file subsystem status via the File and Ripgrep services.

nodes.name: global.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the server-wide global route group on RootHttpApi: health check, SSE event stream (server.connected plus GlobalBus events with 10-second heartbeats), global config get/update with instance disposal, and self-upgrade. Holds the SSE stream builder used by the event endpoint.
nodes.languageNotes: handleRaw endpoints (event, upgrade) bypass the typed HttpApi pipeline and return raw HttpServerResponse objects, e.g. the SSE stream with no-cache, no-transform, and nosniff headers.

nodes.name: instance.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the instance route group: dispose, path info, VCS branch/status/diff/apply (mapping apply failures to the ApiVcsApplyError schema error), and listing commands, agents, skills, LSP servers, and formatters for the current instance.

nodes.name: mcp.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the MCP route group: server status, adding servers with decoded status maps, OAuth start/callback/authenticate/remove guarded by UnsupportedOAuthError for non-OAuth servers, and connect/disconnect control.

nodes.name: permission.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the permission route group: list pending permission requests and approve or deny them through Permission.Service reply.

nodes.name: project.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the project route group: list projects, resolve the current project from instance context, init git (reloading the instance when the project identity changes), and update project properties.

nodes.name: provider.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the provider route group: merges the models.dev catalog with connected providers while applying enabled/disabled config filters, exposes auth methods, and drives OAuth authorize (including a raw variant preserving legacy JSON-null behavior) and callback flows.

nodes.name: pty.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the PTY route group (shell listing, session CRUD, origin-checked connect-token issuance) and ptyConnectRoute, a raw HttpRouter WebSocket endpoint that validates one-time tickets, registers with WebSocketTracker, and bridges the socket to a PTY session with cursor-based output replay.
nodes.languageNotes: The WebSocket handshake fires inside socket.runRaw AFTER pty.connect registers its message callback, so no early-frame buffer is needed — an invariant carried over from the legacy Hono handler and documented in-code.

nodes.name: question.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the question route group: list pending questions, submit ordered answer replies, and reject question requests through Question.Service.

nodes.name: eventResponse
nodes.summary: Builds the SSE event-stream response for the global event endpoint: a synthetic server.connected event, GlobalBus subscriptions via Stream.callback with acquireRelease cleanup, 10-second heartbeats, merged with halt-on-left strategy and SSE-encoded with no-cache headers.

nodes.name: ApiWorkspaceWarpError
nodes.summary: Schema-defined HttpApi error (HTTP 400) carrying a WarpError name and message payload, returned by the workspace warp endpoint when moving a session's sync history fails.

nodes.name: session-errors.ts
nodes.summary: Maps storage NotFoundError failures to a typed 404 ApiError, giving all HTTP session endpoints a consistent not-found error path.

nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.summary: Registers the session HTTP API group with 28 endpoints covering session CRUD, paginated messages, prompting (sync/async), sharing, compaction, revert, permission replies, and message/part editing, delegating to Session, SessionPrompt, SessionShare, and sibling services.
nodes.languageNotes: Handlers are Effect.fn closures yielded from services inside HttpApiBuilder.group, then bound with a .handle() chain; cursor pagination emits RFC-style Link and X-Next-Cursor headers.

nodes.name: sync.ts
nodes.summary: Sync HTTP API group exposing start, replay, steal, and history endpoints that drive workspace event synchronization through Workspace and SyncEvent services, with history queried directly from the Drizzle EventTable.

nodes.name: tui.ts
nodes.summary: TUI HTTP API group bridging web and desktop clients to the terminal UI by publishing TuiEvent bus commands (prompt append, toasts, session select, legacy command aliases) and exposing the TUI control request/response channel.

nodes.name: v2.ts
nodes.summary: Composition barrel that merges the v2 session and message handler layers and provides the SessionV2 default layer beneath them.

nodes.name: message.ts
nodes.summary: V2 message list endpoint with base64url cursor pagination: decodes cursor tokens through an Effect Schema struct and returns previous/next cursors computed from SessionV2.messages pages.

nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.summary: V2 session API group implementing cursor-paginated session listing (rejecting cursor/filter conflicts and workspace routing mismatches) plus prompt, compact, wait, and context endpoints over SessionV2.

nodes.name: workspace.ts
nodes.summary: Workspace HTTP API group exposing adapter discovery, workspace list/create/remove, sync listing and status, and session warp, mapping VCS patch-apply failures to typed API errors.

nodes.name: lifecycle.ts
nodes.summary: Instance lifecycle helpers that mark instances for disposal or reload after the HTTP response is sent, handing teardown from the endpoint handler to the outer disposeMiddleware via a WeakMap keyed by the original Request object.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a WeakMap keyed by the raw Request plus HttpEffect.appendPreResponseHandler so disposal runs only after the response has been written — a clean handoff between endpoint and server middleware.

nodes.name: authorization.ts
nodes.summary: Authorization middleware validating Basic credentials from the Authorization header or auth_token query parameter against ServerAuth, with bypasses for public UI paths and PTY connect tickets; exported as both an HttpApiMiddleware layer and a raw router middleware.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately avoids HttpApiSecurity alternatives: Effect security middleware wraps the whole handler, so a downstream failure could trigger the next auth alternative and remap an authorized 404 into a 401.

nodes.name: compression.ts
nodes.summary: Response compression middleware that gzip/deflate-encodes buffered bodies over a size threshold based on Accept-Encoding, skipping HEAD, already-encoded, streaming-path, and no-transform responses.

nodes.name: cors-vary.ts
nodes.summary: Global middleware patching effect-smol CORS preflight responses to append Vary: Origin, preventing shared caches from reusing a dynamic-origin preflight response across different origins.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents an upstream bug where HttpMiddleware.cors spreads allowOrigin() and allowHeaders() into one record, letting the second Vary header overwrite the first.

nodes.name: error.ts
nodes.summary: Top-level error boundary middleware that converts unhandled defects into NamedError JSON responses (404 for NotFoundError, 400 for model/auth/worktree errors, 500 otherwise) while preserving typed HttpApi failures on their declared error paths.

nodes.name: mapStorageNotFound
nodes.summary: Maps a storage NotFoundError to a typed HttpApi 404 via Effect.mapError, standardizing not-found handling across session endpoints.

nodes.name: sessionHandlers
nodes.summary: Builds the 28-endpoint session API group — list, messages with Link-header pagination, prompt/promptAsync/predict, create, share, summarize, revert, permission responses, and message/part mutations — over thirteen yielded services.

nodes.name: syncHandlers
nodes.summary: Builds the sync API group (start, replay, steal, history) that kicks off workspace syncing, replays serialized sync events, steals sessions between workspaces, and drains event history from the Drizzle EventTable.

nodes.name: tuiHandlers
nodes.summary: Builds the 13-endpoint TUI control group that publishes TuiEvent bus commands (prompt append/submit/clear, dialogs, toasts, session select, legacy aliases) and bridges the nextTuiRequest/submitTuiResponse control channel.

nodes.name: messageHandlers
nodes.summary: V2 messages endpoint handler that rejects cursor/order conflicts, decodes the base64url cursor through an Effect Schema struct, pages via SessionV2.messages, and emits previous/next cursors.

nodes.name: sessionHandlers
nodes.summary: V2 session API group with cursor-paginated session listing (including cursor/filter and directory/workspace routing mismatch validation) plus prompt, compact, wait, and context endpoints delegating to SessionV2.

nodes.name: workspaceHandlers
nodes.summary: Builds the workspace API group — adapters, list, create, syncList, status, remove, and warp — mapping Vcs.PatchApplyError and warp failures to typed API error responses.

nodes.name: markInstanceForDisposal
nodes.summary: Registers a pre-response handler that records the instance in the disposal WeakMap keyed by the request source, deferring teardown to disposeMiddleware after the response is sent.

nodes.name: markInstanceForReload
nodes.summary: Registers a pre-response handler that uninterruptibly reloads the instance store with the next load input while preserving the response value.

nodes.name: disposeMiddleware
nodes.summary: Outer server middleware that runs marked instance disposal after the response is produced, logging and swallowing disposal failures so shutdown errors never corrupt an in-flight response.

nodes.name: Authorization
nodes.summary: HttpApiMiddleware service tag declaring the authorization boundary with an UnauthorizedNoContent error path, kept as a custom middleware so downstream failures cannot fall through to alternate auth schemes.

nodes.name: validateCredential
nodes.summary: Validates a decoded username/password credential against ServerAuth.required and appends a pre-response handler stamping the WWW-Authenticate header on rejection.

nodes.name: decodeCredential
nodes.summary: Base64-decodes a Basic auth header into a redacted username/password credential, falling back to an empty credential on malformed or split-mismatched input.

nodes.name: validateRawCredential
nodes.summary: Validates an already-decoded credential against ServerAuth for router-level requests, failing with an empty 401 response when authorization is denied.

nodes.name: fence.ts
nodes.summary: Fence middleware that, for state-changing methods when workspace routing is enabled, diffs sync sequence state before and after the handler and stamps the delta into the x-opencode-sync response header.

nodes.name: instance-context.ts
nodes.summary: Instance context middleware that decodes the WorkspaceRouteContext produced by workspace routing and provides the InstanceStore directory plus WorkspaceRef to downstream handlers; exported as both an HttpApiMiddleware layer and a raw router middleware.

nodes.name: proxy.ts
nodes.summary: HTTP and WebSocket reverse-proxy primitives for forwarding requests to remote workspace instances, mirroring socket messages and close events bidirectionally and registering proxied sockets with WebSocketTracker for graceful shutdown.

nodes.name: schema-error.ts
nodes.summary: Schema validation error middleware that truncates Effect's issue-formatter output to 1KB and returns a NamedError-shaped 400 JSON body so SDK clients can extract data.message from rejected payloads.

nodes.name: workspace-routing.ts
nodes.summary: Workspace routing middleware that plans every request as local, remote, or missing-workspace from query params and session state, proxies remote workspaces through the sync fence, and provides WorkspaceRouteContext for local handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a Data.TaggedEnum RequestPlan plus RequestPlan.$match for exhaustive dispatch; query fields consumed by the middleware must be spread into every endpoint schema because effect-smol HttpApiMiddleware cannot declare its own query params yet.

nodes.name: public.ts
nodes.summary: Assembles the public API surface: annotates OpenCodeHttpApi with OpenAPI metadata and a legacy-compatibility transform that normalizes component names, collapses duplicate schemas, strips optional-null unions, injects legacy error schemas, and patches self-referencing $ref bugs from Effect's OpenAPI generator.
nodes.languageNotes: The transform exists to keep the generated @opencode-ai/sdk client byte-compatible with the legacy Hono-era spec; recursive normalizers carry depth caps (MAX_SCHEMA_DEPTH 100, warn at 80) to guard against runaway schema recursion.

nodes.name: server.ts
nodes.summary: HttpApi server assembly: merges root, event, instance, doc, and UI route layers, wires fourteen handler groups over roughly forty service default layers plus auth, workspace routing, instance context, compression, CORS, fence, and error middleware, and exposes a memoized fetch-standard web handler.
nodes.languageNotes: The route tree deliberately mixes typed HttpApi groups with raw router layers so auth can run as router middleware for public static assets; the /doc OpenAPI response is lazily computed and caches the serialized body.

nodes.name: websocket-tracker.ts
nodes.summary: WebSocketTracker service that keeps a set of registered socket-close effects so the server can broadcast a 1001 server-closing event to all live proxied sockets at shutdown; registration degrades gracefully when the service is absent from the context.

nodes.name: server.ts
nodes.summary: Main server bootstrap: builds the Effect layer graph over the HttpApi routes, starts the HTTP listener with graceful shutdown and WebSocket-tracker socket closing, optionally publishes the server over mDNS, and exposes the default web handler app plus the public OpenAPI document.

nodes.name: fence.ts
nodes.summary: Shared sync-fence utilities: loads event sequence state from the Drizzle EventSequenceTable, diffs state snapshots, parses the x-opencode-sync header, and waits for a workspace to catch up to a requested sequence state.

nodes.name: pty-ticket.ts
nodes.summary: Constants and predicates identifying PTY connect ticket URLs — the path pattern and ticket query param that let terminal-attach requests bypass standard bearer authentication.

nodes.name: public-ui.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the public UI path allowlist and a method+path predicate used by auth middleware to let static web assets bypass authentication.

nodes.name: InstanceContextMiddleware
nodes.summary: HttpApiMiddleware service tag that requires WorkspaceRouteContext and wraps handlers with the per-instance execution context.

nodes.name: provideInstanceContext
nodes.summary: Decodes the routed workspace directory and provides the InstanceStore context plus WorkspaceRef service to the wrapped handler effect.

nodes.name: websocket
nodes.summary: Upgrades the inbound request and bridges it to a remote websocket target, mirroring messages and close events in both directions, with WebSocketTracker registration so proxied sockets close cleanly at server shutdown.

nodes.name: http
nodes.summary: Forwards an HTTP request to the remote workspace target via HttpClient, stripping content-encoding and content-length headers and streaming the response body back with cause-safe fallback to an empty stream.

nodes.name: SchemaErrorMiddleware
nodes.summary: HttpApiMiddleware service tag whose schema-error transform rewrites validation failures into truncated NamedError-shaped 400 responses.

nodes.name: WorkspaceRouteContext
nodes.summary: Context service carrying the resolved routing decision (decoded directory and optional workspaceID) from the routing middleware to downstream handlers.

nodes.name: WorkspaceRoutingMiddleware
nodes.summary: HttpApiMiddleware service tag for the workspace routing layer that plans local vs remote request handling, provides WorkspaceRouteContext, and requires Session.Service.

nodes.name: proxyRemote
nodes.summary: Proxies a request to a remote workspace instance, waiting on the sync fence first, dispatching to the websocket or HTTP proxy based on the upgrade header, and answering 503 while the workspace is still syncing.

nodes.name: planWorkspaceRequest
nodes.summary: Resolves the remote adapter target for a workspace and produces a Remote or Local RequestPlan depending on whether an adapter target exists.

nodes.name: planRequest
nodes.summary: Builds the full routing plan: resolves the configured or query-selected workspace, returns MissingWorkspace for unknown IDs, keeps control-plane-only routes local, and falls back to the default directory for local requests.

nodes.name: routeWorkspace
nodes.summary: Executes a RequestPlan via tagged-union match: passes local effects through with WorkspaceRouteContext, answers missing workspaces directly, and delegates remote plans to proxyRemote.

nodes.name: routeHttpApiWorkspace
nodes.summary: Entry point for HttpApi workspace routing: resolves the session's workspace ID from the URL, tolerating missing or defective session lookups, then plans and routes the request.

nodes.name: matchLegacyOpenApi
nodes.summary: OpenAPI transform applying the full legacy-compatibility pass — component renames, duplicate collapsing, optional-null stripping, error schema injection, and per-operation parameter/response normalization — to keep the generated spec SDK-compatible.

nodes.name: addLegacyErrorSchemas
nodes.summary: Injects the legacy 400/404/500 error component schemas into the spec's components section so error responses keep their historical shapes.

nodes.name: collapseDuplicateComponents
nodes.summary: Deduplicates structurally identical component schemas using canonical JSON comparison and rewrites all $ref pointers to the surviving name.

nodes.name: normalizeComponentNames
nodes.summary: Renames Effect-style dotted component names to legacy PascalCase names and rewrites the corresponding references throughout the spec.

nodes.name: applyLegacySchemaOverrides
nodes.summary: Applies hand-maintained legacy schema tweaks, marking specific components and their fields nullable to preserve the historical SDK contract.

nodes.name: normalizeComponentDescriptions
nodes.summary: Fills in legacy component descriptions from a static map where the generated spec has none.

nodes.name: makePropertiesNullable
nodes.summary: Recursively marks a component's properties nullable (including nested objects and arrays) to match legacy optional-field semantics.

nodes.name: canonicalizeSchema
nodes.summary: Produces a canonical, order-insensitive form of a schema (sorted keys, normalized refs, recursive traversal) used for stable duplicate detection.

nodes.name: rewriteRefs
nodes.summary: Recursively rewrites $ref pointers from one component name to another across a schema tree, warning and bailing on out-of-depth traversals.

nodes.name: normalizeLegacyOperation
nodes.summary: Normalizes a single operation's parameters and error responses to the legacy SDK shape, including legacy error response references.

nodes.name: fixSelfReferencingComponents
nodes.summary: Works around an Effect OpenAPI deduplicator bug where a component's own definition becomes a self-referencing $ref, restoring the correct schema from a raw regeneration without the transform.

nodes.name: stripOptionalNull
nodes.summary: Recursively strips the null-type union arms that Effect's Schema.optional adds to OpenAPI output, merging single-arm allOf constraints and flattening nested option unions with depth caps.

nodes.name: flattenOptions
nodes.summary: Flattens nested anyOf/oneOf option arrays into a flat list with depth guards, used for duplicate and null-arm detection.

nodes.name: normalizeParameter
nodes.summary: Normalizes an operation parameter's schema, applying hand-maintained legacy query-parameter type overrides selected by route and parameter name.

nodes.name: createRoutes
nodes.summary: Composes the complete route layer: merges root, event, instance, doc, and UI route trees and provides roughly forty service default layers plus error, compression, CORS-Vary, fence, and runtime middleware.

nodes.name: webHandler
nodes.summary: Builds the fetch-standard web handler over the route layers with the dispose middleware attached, rebuilding the route layer with a fresh memo map when custom CORS options are supplied.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: WebSocketTracker context service interface exposing add, remove, and closeAll over a set of socket-close effects, rejecting new registrations once closing has begun.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers a close effect with the tracker under a scope finalizer and reports whether the server is still accepting connections; succeeds transparently when the service is absent.

nodes.name: listen
nodes.summary: Starts the HTTP server: builds the Effect layer graph, listens on the configured host and port, optionally publishes the instance over mDNS, and wires graceful shutdown that closes HTTP connections and tracked websockets before disposing the scope.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads sync sequence state for all or selected aggregate IDs from the EventSequenceTable via Drizzle, returning an aggregate-ID-to-sequence map.

nodes.name: diff
nodes.summary: Computes the per-aggregate sequence delta between two sync state snapshots, treating absent entries as -1.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Parses the x-opencode-sync request header into a validated aggregate-ID-to-sequence map, returning undefined on malformed JSON or non-integer sequences.

nodes.name: waitEffect
nodes.summary: Effect that blocks until the workspace fully syncs to the requested aggregate sequence state, logging before and after the wait.

nodes.name: tui-control.ts
nodes.summary: Module-level async queues that shuttle control requests between the HTTP server and the TUI process — the server pushes requests via submitTuiRequest and awaits responses through nextTuiResponse.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses module-scoped AsyncQueue singletons, making the request/response channel a process-wide singleton shared by all importers.

nodes.name: ui.ts
nodes.summary: Serves the web UI either from embedded build assets (opencode-web-ui.gen.ts) or by proxying an upstream dev server, adding ETag caching, SHA-256-based Content-Security-Policies for inline scripts, and proxy header sanitization.

nodes.name: workspace-routing.ts
nodes.summary: Route classification helpers for workspace-scoped proxying — decides which /session and /experimental/workspace routes are handled locally versus forwarded to a workspace server, and rewrites proxy URLs.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Engineering notes for the session subsystem: message schema conventions, two-phase system prompt assembly, subagent permission wiring, and an extensive compaction-system section documenting filterCompacted reordering, overflow headroom, and configurable budgets.

nodes.name: compaction.ts
nodes.summary: Context compaction service — summarizes conversation history into an anchored Markdown summary when the context window overflows, selects a preserved recent-tail budget, prunes old tool outputs, and drives replay and auto-continue behavior after compaction.
nodes.languageNotes: Effect Layer service whose implementation functions are Effect.fn closures inside Layer.effect; the anchored SUMMARY_TEMPLATE enforces a fixed Markdown section order so summaries can be incrementally updated across compactions.

nodes.name: context-budget.ts
nodes.summary: Pure token-budget arithmetic for compaction — resolves compaction config defaults, computes the usable context window (explicit context_limit, reserved tokens, maxOutputTokens headroom), and decides overflow from usage totals.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `tokens.total || fallback` (|| not ??) intentionally so a zero total falls through to the sum of components.

nodes.name: instruction.ts
nodes.summary: Instruction (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) discovery and injection service — resolves global and project instruction files plus remote URLs through an mtime-keyed LRU cache, and attaches nearby instruction files to read operations once per assistant message.
nodes.languageNotes: LRU implemented by Map re-insertion with FILE_CACHE_MAX=100; per-message attachment deduplication via an InstanceState claims map of MessageID to file-path sets.

nodes.name: llm.ts
nodes.summary: LLM streaming service wrapping the AI SDK's streamText — assembles the two-phase system prompt (cacheable prefix + dynamic suffix), merges provider/model/agent/variant options, wires plugin transform hooks, tool-call repair, LiteLLM stub tools, GitLab workflow tool execution, and OpenTelemetry.
nodes.languageNotes: The SystemPrompt = { prefix, suffix } split exists for provider prompt caching: the prefix (core + provider delta or agent override) is stable while the suffix (environment, skills, user system) changes per turn; a guard restores the prefix if a plugin drops it.

nodes.name: command.ts
nodes.summary: Slash-command entry point — resolves a named command, expands inline bash blocks and $ARGUMENTS/positional placeholders, resolves the target model/agent, and delegates to prompt() either directly or assembled as a subtask part.

nodes.name: create-user-message.ts
