nodes.summary: Creates and persists the user message for a prompt — resolves agent/model/variant, expands every prompt part (file reads via the Read tool, MCP resources, agent attachments) into MessageV2 parts, and emits V2 read-model projection events (Prompted/Synthetic).

nodes.name: model.ts
nodes.summary: Three model-resolution helpers shared across the loop: getModel (publishing not-found errors with suggestions), currentModel (session row, then last user message, then provider default), and lastAssistant lookup.

nodes.name: predict.ts
nodes.summary: Ghost-text next-prompt prediction — a side-channel streamText call that deliberately bypasses llm.stream and session-coupled plugin hooks, preferring the small title model with fallbacks to suggest the user's next prompt.
nodes.languageNotes: Shares the run loop's prompt-format transform by wrapping the language model with middleware that only touches args.params.prompt, keeping the call invisible to the session trajectory.

nodes.name: reminders.ts
nodes.summary: Injects synthetic reminder text parts into the latest user message — the plan-mode system-reminder with the full five-phase planning workflow, build-switch notices after plan agents, and plan-file existence references.

nodes.name: embeddedUI
nodes.summary: Lazily imports the generated embedded web UI asset map (opencode-web-ui.gen.ts) and caches it, falling back to an empty map with a warning when the bundle is absent.

nodes.name: cspForHtml
nodes.summary: Computes a Content-Security-Policy for an HTML body by SHA-256 hashing the theme preload script and inline scripts, memoized in a single-entry cache.

nodes.name: embeddedUIResponse
nodes.summary: Builds the HTTP response for an embedded asset — MIME type detection, ETag/304 handling, immutable caching for hashed assets, and CSP injection for HTML.

nodes.name: serveEmbeddedUIEffect
nodes.summary: Effect handler serving a request path from the embedded UI asset map through a bounded file cache, falling back to 404 on misses and logging read failures.

nodes.name: serveUIEffect
nodes.summary: Main UI handler — serves embedded assets when the bundle is present, otherwise proxies the request to the upstream dev server applying CSP to proxied HTML responses.

nodes.name: isLocalWorkspaceRoute
nodes.summary: Classifies a method/path pair against the workspace routing rule table to decide whether the request is handled locally or forwarded.

nodes.name: getWorkspaceRouteSessionID
nodes.summary: Extracts the session ID from a /session/:id route, returning null for the /session/status aggregate route.

nodes.name: workspaceProxyURL
nodes.summary: Rewrites a target URL for proxying: appends the request pathname and search/hash, stripping the workspace query parameter.

nodes.name: completedCompactions
nodes.summary: Finds prior completed compactions — pairs summary assistant messages with their compaction user markers and extracts each summary's text.

nodes.name: buildPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the compaction summary prompt: an anchored-update or create-new instruction plus the fixed-section Markdown SUMMARY_TEMPLATE and an optional token budget hint.

nodes.name: turns
nodes.summary: Splits a message list into user-turn spans (start/end/message id), skipping compaction marker messages so they never begin a preserved turn.

nodes.name: splitTurn
nodes.summary: Finds the earliest split point inside an oversized turn such that the remainder fits the remaining token budget, enabling partial-tail preservation.

nodes.name: select
nodes.summary: Selects the head to compact and the preserved tail: estimates token sizes of the last tailTurns turns, greedily keeps turns within the preserve-recent budget, and falls back to splitTurn for partial fits.

nodes.name: prune
nodes.summary: Walks backwards through completed tool parts — protecting recent tail turns, configured protected tools, and PRUNE_PROTECT tokens — and marks older tool outputs as compacted to free context space.

nodes.name: processCompaction
nodes.summary: Runs one compaction step: resolves the previous anchored summary, selects head/tail, streams the summary via the compaction agent's processor, handles overflow replay of the last real user turn, appends auto-continue messages with pending todos, and publishes the Compacted bus event.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Persists a new compaction marker (a user message plus a compaction part carrying auto/overflow flags) and emits the v2 CompactionStarted sync event.

nodes.name: compactionConfig
nodes.summary: Resolves every compaction knob from config with defaults — auto, prune, tail turns, preserve/protect/minimum tokens, summary budget, protected tools, autocontinue, and explicit context limit.

nodes.name: usableWith
nodes.summary: Computes the usable context window: with an explicit context_limit it subtracts reserved tokens (floored at maxOutputTokens); otherwise it derives headroom from model.limit.context or model.limit.input.
nodes.languageNotes: The maxOutputTokens floor on reserved is a safety invariant: without it a model with a very large output budget could hit the context ceiling mid-response.

nodes.name: isOverflow
nodes.summary: Decides whether token usage has reached the usable budget, honoring the auto-compaction toggle and treating an explicit context_limit as overriding an unknown model limit.

nodes.name: extract
nodes.summary: Collects instruction file paths already loaded from completed (non-compacted) read tool parts by inspecting their metadata.loaded arrays.

nodes.name: readCached
nodes.summary: Reads a file through the mtime-keyed cache (bounded to 100 entries with LRU eviction), refreshing entries when the file's mtime advances and evicting deleted files.

nodes.name: systemPaths
nodes.summary: Resolves the instruction file path set: the first existing global file (user AGENTS.md or ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md), the first project-level match found walking up to the worktree root, and glob-expanded config-specified paths.

nodes.name: system
nodes.summary: Loads all resolved instruction files (concurrency 8, cached) and remote instruction URLs (concurrency 4, 5s timeout), wrapping each payload in an <instructions source=...> block.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Walks directories upward from a file being read, attaching nearby AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files once per assistant message via a claims set so nested reads never duplicate instructions.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Assembles and executes the streamText request: two-phase system prompt with plugin transform, layered option merging (model/agent/variant), plugin params and headers hooks, permission-filtered tools, LiteLLM/copilot stub tools, GitLab workflow toolExecutor and approval wiring, and OpenTelemetry spans.

nodes.name: stream
nodes.summary: Public stream entry — wraps run() in a scoped Effect Stream with an AbortController acquired on start and aborted on scope release.

nodes.name: hasToolCalls
nodes.summary: Returns true when any message's content array contains tool-call or tool-result parts — used to decide whether a dummy tool must be injected for LiteLLM proxy validation.

nodes.name: command
nodes.summary: Resolves and expands a slash command: runs inline bash template blocks, substitutes positional and $ARGUMENTS placeholders, resolves the effective model/agent chain (command → agent → input → current), assembles subtask parts when needed, and delegates to prompt.

nodes.name: createUserMessage
nodes.summary: Creates and persists the user message: resolves agent/model/variant, expands all prompt parts concurrently into MessageV2 parts, validates info and parts with zod before save, and emits AgentSwitched/ModelSwitched/Prompted/Synthetic projection events.

nodes.name: resolvePart
nodes.summary: Resolves a single prompt part into persisted parts: MCP resource reads, data URLs, file reads executed through the Read tool (with LSP document-symbol line ranges and directory listings), base64 encoding for binary files, and agent-attachment task nudges.

nodes.name: getModel
nodes.summary: Resolves a provider model, publishing a session error with did-you-mean suggestions when the model is not found before re-failing with the original cause.

nodes.name: currentModel
nodes.summary: Resolves the session's effective model: the session row's stored model, else the last user message's model, else the provider default.

nodes.name: lastAssistant
nodes.summary: Returns the most recent non-user message via findMessage, falling back to the latest message by descending query.

nodes.name: predict
nodes.summary: Streams a next-prompt suggestion from the small title model (falling back to the assistant's model then the provider's small model) over the three most recent real user queries plus the last completed assistant turn, bypassing session-coupled hooks.

nodes.name: insertReminders
nodes.summary: Injects plan-mode, build-switch, and plan-file synthetic reminder parts into the latest user message, choosing between static templates and persisted parts with the full five-phase plan workflow depending on the plan-mode flag.

nodes.name: run-loop.ts
nodes.summary: The agent loop — per step it filters compacted history, dispatches subtask and compaction task parts, triggers auto-compaction on overflow, resolves tools, assembles the system prompt suffix with skills/environment/instructions, streams the assistant turn, and exits when the assistant finishes without pending tool calls.
nodes.languageNotes: A ~280-line Effect.fn("SessionPrompt.run") generator with an explicit while(true) loop and a RunLoopDeps deps-object; all sibling helpers (title, getModel, handleSubtask, resolveTools, insertReminders) are imported from this directory and called with forwarded deps.

nodes.name: shell.ts
nodes.summary: User-initiated shell command execution — materializes user/assistant messages and a running shell tool part, spawns the child process with streamed output persisted into the part, finalizes abort/error states, and emits v2 sync events.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Effect.uninterruptibleMask with restore() around the spawn so setup is atomic while the wait remains interruptible; a Latch signals readiness to callers.

nodes.name: subtask.ts
nodes.summary: Handles a subtask (task-tool) step in the agent loop — materializes the assistant message and running tool part, invokes the TaskTool with the parent's merged permission ruleset, finalizes success/error/cancelled states, and appends a synthetic summary user message for command subtasks.

nodes.name: title.ts
nodes.summary: Generates a short session title from the first real user turn using the small title model via LLM.stream, stripping think tags and truncating to 100 characters.

nodes.name: tools.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves registry and MCP tools into an AI-SDK tool map for a single model turn — wiring permission asks, plugin before/after triggers, cached schema transforms, MCP content-to-attachment conversion, and output truncation through an EffectBridge-backed runner.

nodes.name: merge-options.ts
nodes.summary: Single deep-merge helper (remeda mergeDeep) with per-layer debug logging, extracted from llm.ts so the provider/model/agent/variant option-merge chain is independently testable.

nodes.name: message-continuation.ts
nodes.summary: Pure function that wraps user-message text parts arriving after the last finished assistant turn in <system-reminder> blocks so the model addresses them and continues its tasks.
nodes.languageNotes: Mutates parts in place on the passed array — callers must operate on a copy (per repo AGENTS.md).

nodes.name: message-v2.ts
nodes.summary: V2 message read/write layer — hydrates MessageTable/PartTable rows into WithParts, converts history to AI SDK model messages (media stripping, tool-output truncation), cursor-paginates history, filters compacted spans, and maps provider/AI-SDK errors to named error objects.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes Drizzle SQL (JSON extraction via `data->>'$.snapshot'` for boundary snapshots) with Effect; re-exports everything from message.schema.ts so consumers see one surface.

nodes.name: message.schema.ts
nodes.summary: Effect Schema definitions for V2 messages and parts — named schema errors (APIError, ContextOverflowError, AuthError, ...), output formats, the full Part union (text, reasoning, tool with state variants, subtask, compaction, snapshot, patch), and User/Assistant/Info schemas with zod mirrors.
nodes.languageNotes: `.zod` bridges are attached only to union schemas (Format, Part, Info), not individual members — a documented convention in the session AGENTS.md; schema types are kept in the consuming module due to Effect Schema cross-file identity issues.

nodes.name: message.ts
nodes.summary: V1 message type definitions — ToolCall/ToolResult/ToolInvocation shapes, the legacy message part union (text, reasoning, tool invocation, source URL, file, step start), and message Info, re-exporting shared named errors.

nodes.name: overflow.ts
nodes.summary: Thin async wrappers exposing ContextBudget.usable/isOverflow through the compaction service's standalone runtime.

nodes.name: plan.ts
nodes.summary: Computes the plan-file path for a session — the instance storage plans directory plus created-time and slug segments.

nodes.name: runLoop
nodes.summary: The core agent loop generator: each iteration filters compacted history, checks finish/tool-call state, forks title generation on step 1, dispatches subtask and compaction task parts, auto-compacts on overflow, resolves tools and system suffix, processes the assistant turn with structured-output handling, and applies message continuation wrapping.

nodes.name: shellImpl
nodes.summary: Executes a user shell command end-to-end: materializes user/assistant messages and a running tool part, applies plugin-provided env, spawns the child process with output streamed into the part, handles interrupt-based abort, and finalizes part and message state.

nodes.name: handleSubtask
nodes.summary: Executes a subtask via the TaskTool: materializes the assistant message and running part, merges parent agent permission with session permission for the ruleset, finalizes completed/error/cancelled states with interruption handling, and appends the synthetic summarize-and-continue user message for command subtasks.

nodes.name: title
nodes.summary: Generates and persists a session title from the first real (non-synthetic) user turn when only one exists — streams from the title agent's model (falling back to the provider's small model), strips think tags, and truncates to 100 characters.

nodes.name: resolveTools
nodes.summary: Builds the AI-SDK tool map from registry and MCP tools with cached schema transforms, a permission-wired ask/updateToolCall context, plugin before/after triggers, MCP content-to-attachment conversion, structuredContent inclusion, and output truncation.

nodes.name: mergeOptions
nodes.summary: Deep-merges a source options object into a target via remeda mergeDeep, logging which layer contributed which keys when a layer name is supplied.

nodes.name: wrapMessageContinuation
nodes.summary: Mutates message parts in place so user text parts after the last finished assistant turn are wrapped in a <system-reminder> asking the model to address them and continue — callers must pass a copy.

nodes.name: hydrate
nodes.summary: Loads parts for the given message rows from PartTable (batched inArray query) and assembles WithParts objects preserving row order.

nodes.name: toModelMessagesEffect
nodes.summary: Converts WithParts history into AI SDK ModelMessages — per-provider media support checks, tool-output truncation for compaction, synthetic attachment prompts for unsupported media, tool-state to tool-result mapping, and reasoning part handling.

nodes.name: page
nodes.summary: Cursor-paginates a session's messages in descending order (limit+1 probe), verifies the session exists, hydrates items, and returns ascending items with the next-page cursor.

nodes.name: boundarySnapshots
nodes.summary: Picks the earliest and latest snapshot/patch JSON payloads for a session by part type using SQL JSON extraction on PartTable.data.

nodes.name: messagesForSummary
nodes.summary: Loads a target message plus its child assistant messages (matched by parentID via JSON extraction) in chronological order, for summary regeneration.

nodes.name: filterCompacted
nodes.summary: Removes compacted history spans from a message list while keeping summary messages and honoring tail_start_id boundaries — the reverse-then-rescan implementation is documented as order-sensitive.

nodes.name: latest
nodes.summary: Extracts the latest user, assistant, and last-finished messages plus pending compaction/subtask task parts from a message list — the anchor state for each agent-loop iteration.

nodes.name: fromError
nodes.summary: Dispatches an unknown error through typed handlers — abort, output length, API key load, ECONNRESET, zlib decompression, invalid response, API call, and generic — producing named error objects for message persistence.

nodes.name: processor.ts
nodes.summary: SessionProcessor service that drives the per-stream LLM event loop: consumes LLM stream events, materializes text/reasoning/tool parts onto messages, tracks file snapshots, enforces doom-loop protection, wires the retry policy, and flags context overflow for compaction. Also dual-writes V2 SessionEvent projections behind the OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_EVENT_SYSTEM flag.
nodes.languageNotes: Effect service built with Effect.fn closures inside Layer.effect; the Service class is a one-line Context.Service tag (@opencode/SessionProcessor) and all behavior lives in the create() factory returning a Handle interface.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Factory that builds the per-assistant-message processing Handle: pre-captures a snapshot, wires tool-call lifecycle helpers (settle/read/update/complete/fail), the stream event reducer, cleanup, halt, and the process() stream runner.

nodes.name: handleEvent
nodes.summary: Reducer over LLM stream events: maps start/step/text/reasoning/tool events onto message parts, computes usage via Session.getUsage, emits patch parts from snapshot diffs, kicks off summary, triggers the doom-loop permission ask after 3 identical tool calls, and sets overflow-driven compaction.

nodes.name: process
nodes.summary: Runs the LLM stream with tap-event handling, takeUntil compaction cutoff, interrupt handling, the SessionRetry policy (publishing retry status and SessionEvent.Retried), catch-to-halt, and guaranteed cleanup; returns compact/stop/continue.

nodes.name: cleanup
nodes.summary: Finalizer that flushes leftover snapshot patches, closes open text/reasoning parts, waits briefly on in-flight tool calls, and marks any still-running tool parts as aborted with an interrupted metadata flag.

nodes.name: projectors-next.ts
nodes.summary: V2 event projectors that fold SessionEvent.* sync events (prompted, step, text, tool, reasoning, compaction, retries) into the SessionMessageTable read model via SessionMessageUpdater and a SQLite adapter; delta events are deliberately no-ops.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports a default array of SyncEvent.project handlers spread into projectors.ts; DateTime values are recursively encoded to epoch millis before JSON persistence.

nodes.name: sqlite
nodes.summary: Builds the SessionMessageUpdater SQLite adapter for a session: queries current assistant/compaction/shell messages from SessionMessageTable and implements append plus typed update operations that re-encode message data.

nodes.name: projectors.ts
nodes.summary: V1 projector registry: SyncEvent.project handlers that materialize Session and MessageV2 events into the SessionTable/MessageTable/PartTable Drizzle tables, tolerating late foreign-key-violating updates, and re-exports the V2 projectors-next array.

nodes.name: grab
nodes.summary: Reads a (possibly nested) field from a partial update object, applying a callback for object values; throws when a present-but-undefined field is passed so callers must use null to clear a column.

nodes.name: toPartialRow
nodes.summary: Maps a DeepPartial Session.Info patch onto a snake_case partial SessionTable row, unwrapping nested share/summary/time objects via grab and dropping undefined keys so Drizzle updates only touched columns.

nodes.name: prompt.ts
nodes.summary: SessionPrompt service exposing prompt/loop/shell/command/predict/cancel entry points; it wires twenty-plus Effect services into the agent run loop, resolves file and agent template parts, merges per-prompt tool permissions, and defines the PromptInput/LoopInput/ShellInput/CommandInput API schemas.
nodes.languageNotes: Composition root for the session loop: runLoop/shellImpl/command/predict implementations are injected from ./loop/* modules as plain function calls, and the layer's defaultLayer chains 20+ provided layers.

nodes.name: resolvePromptParts
nodes.summary: Expands @-mention markdown templates into prompt parts: resolves each ConfigMarkdown file reference against the worktree (or home dir), attaching file parts or agent parts when the name matches an agent instead of a file.

nodes.name: prompt
nodes.summary: Handles a user prompt: cleans up pending reverts, creates the user message (with attachments/skills), merges per-prompt tool toggles into session permissions, then enters the loop unless noReply is set.

nodes.name: loop
nodes.summary: Runs the agent loop for a session through SessionRunState.ensureRunning, injecting the full service bundle (sessions, processor, compaction, registry, MCP, LSP, permission, truncation, runner bridge, cached tool schemas) into runLoop.

nodes.name: command-regex.ts
nodes.summary: Regex constants for the slash-command parser: inline bash extraction (!`cmd`), argument tokenization (including [Image N] and quoted strings), positional placeholders, and quote trimming.

nodes.name: mcp-patterns.ts
nodes.summary: Derives permission-scoping patterns from MCP tool arguments by probing common path/URL fields, so an "always allow" grant covers a specific resource instead of every invocation; falls back to the "*" wildcard.

nodes.name: deriveMcpPatterns
nodes.summary: Returns the first non-empty string among well-known path/URL argument keys (filepath, path, url, directory, file, pattern, repo, repository) as a single-element pattern array, or ["*"] when nothing can be derived.

nodes.name: predict.ts
nodes.summary: Ghost-text next-prompt prediction: system/nudge prompts for the predictor model plus cleanPrediction, which strips think blocks, quotes, and caps output to 120 chars for the TUI's gray inline suggestion.

nodes.name: cleanPrediction
nodes.summary: Cleans raw predict LLM output: removes <think> blocks, takes the first non-empty trimmed line, strips surrounding quotes/backticks, and truncates to 120 characters with an ellipsis.

nodes.name: structured-output.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the AI SDK StructuredOutput tool used when a zod output schema is requested: forces the model to emit its final answer through one validated tool call and captures the parsed result via an onSuccess callback.

nodes.name: createStructuredOutputTool
nodes.summary: Creates the StructuredOutput AI SDK tool from a JSON schema (dropping $schema), invoking onSuccess with SDK-validated args and echoing a text model output so the loop terminates cleanly after capture.

nodes.name: retry.ts
nodes.summary: Retry policy for provider calls: retryable() classifies API errors (5xx, rate limits, OpenCode Go/free-tier limit bodies), delay() honors retry-after headers before falling back to exponential backoff, and policy() wraps both into an Effect Schedule that reports status updates.

nodes.name: delay
nodes.summary: Computes the retry wait: prefers retry-after-ms and retry-after headers (numeric seconds or HTTP date), otherwise exponential backoff (2s base, factor 2) capped at 30s without headers or the 32-bit setTimeout maximum with them.

nodes.name: retryable
nodes.summary: Classifies an error into a Retryable verdict: never retries context overflow, retries 5xx and SDK-marked retryable API errors, maps FreeUsageLimit/GoUsageLimit bodies to upsell actions with reset-time hints, and string-matches plain-text and JSON rate-limit payloads.

nodes.name: policy
nodes.summary: Builds the Effect retry Schedule from retryable/delay: parses each failure, stops the schedule on non-retryable errors, and reports attempt, message, optional upsell action, and next-attempt time through the caller's set callback.

nodes.name: revert.ts
nodes.summary: SessionRevert service implementing checkpoint/restore over message parts and file snapshots: revert() rewinds to a message/part boundary recording the pre-revert snapshot, unrevert() restores it, and cleanup() deletes the post-revert tail before a new prompt runs.

nodes.name: revert
nodes.summary: Walks the session's messages to locate the revert boundary, captures or reuses the pre-revert snapshot, undoes accumulated patches, recomputes the diff summary, and persists the revert metadata plus refreshed session diff on the session row.

nodes.name: cleanup
nodes.summary: Removes messages and trailing parts created after a revert point (emitting MessageV2 Removed/PartRemoved sync events) and clears the revert marker so subsequent prompts start from a consistent history.

nodes.name: run-state.ts
nodes.summary: SessionRunState service tracking one Runner per session in instance state: enforces busy/idle transitions (publishing status events), rejects concurrent prompts with BusyError, cancels in-flight runs, and hosts ensureRunning/startShell execution modes.

nodes.name: runner
nodes.summary: Lazily creates (or returns the existing) per-session Runner wired to idle/busy status publishing, the interrupt handler for the current assistant message, and a BusyError throw on concurrent use.

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: Branded Effect Schema identifiers for the session domain: SessionID (descending ULID-like ids), MessageID and PartID (ascending), each with static make helpers for ordered generation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Schema.String.check(Schema.isStartsWith(...)).pipe(Schema.brand(...)) plus withStatics to attach ascending/descending generators to the schema object.

nodes.name: session.sql.ts
nodes.summary: Drizzle SQLite schema for the session domain: session, message, part, todo, session_message (V2 read model), and permission tables with cascading foreign keys, JSON-typed payload columns, and covering indexes for the common query paths.
nodes.languageNotes: Follows the repo's snake_case column convention so column names never need string overrides; composite payloads (revert, permission, model, diffs) are stored as text JSON via text({ mode: "json" }).$type<T>().

nodes.name: session
nodes.summary: Core session table: SessionID primary key, project FK with cascade delete, workspace/parent self-reference, slug/directory/path/title/version, share URL, aggregate diff summary columns, JSON revert/permission/model payloads, and compacting/archived timestamps; indexed by project, workspace, and parent.

nodes.name: message
nodes.summary: Message table storing one row per MessageV2 message with a JSON data payload minus id/sessionID, cascading from session, and a composite (session_id, time_created, id) index for paged history reads.

nodes.name: part
nodes.summary: Message part table (text, reasoning, tool, step, patch parts) keyed by PartID with a message FK cascade, denormalized session_id, JSON part payload, and (message_id, id) plus session indexes.

nodes.name: todo
nodes.summary: Per-session todo list keyed by (session_id, position) with content, status, and priority columns, cascading from session and indexed for ordered reads.

nodes.name: session_message
nodes.summary: V2 read-model table populated by projectors-next: one row per SessionEvent-derived message with a type discriminator (assistant/compaction/shell/prompted/...) and JSON data, indexed by session, session+type, and creation time.

nodes.name: permission
nodes.summary: Project-scoped persisted permission ruleset stored as a JSON payload keyed by project_id with cascade delete, backing durable "always allow/deny" decisions.

nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.summary: The core Session service: Effect Schema Info/Patch models plus create/fork/get/list/remove and the message/part update surface (updateMessage, updatePart(s), deltas, findMessage), all persisted through SyncEvent projections rather than direct writes; also defines Session bus events, BusyError, and project/global list generators. Re-exports plan and getUsage.
nodes.languageNotes: Writes go exclusively through sync.run(Event.*) so the V1 projectors and bus stay consistent; reads query SessionTable/PartTable directly via a Database.use helper. Row<->Info mapping keeps snake_case storage isolated from the camelCase domain model.

nodes.name: fromRow
nodes.summary: Converts a snake_case SessionTable row into a Session Info domain object, rebuilding optional summary/share/revert/model structures and branded ModelID/ProviderID values.

nodes.name: toRow
nodes.summary: Converts a Session Info object into a snake_case insert row, flattening summary aggregates, share URL, revert metadata, and time fields onto their storage columns.

nodes.name: listByProject
nodes.summary: Generator that assembles Drizzle where-conditions (workspace, path prefix, directory scope, roots, start time, title search) over SessionTable and yields Info rows ordered by update time with a default limit of 100.

nodes.name: listGlobal
nodes.summary: Cross-project session listing generator with cursor paging and archived filtering that batches project lookups via inArray and joins each row with its ProjectInfo for the global session picker.

nodes.name: BusyError
nodes.summary: Error thrown when an operation targets a session that already has a run in flight, carrying the offending sessionID.

nodes.name: status.ts
nodes.summary: SessionStatus service holding an in-memory per-session idle/busy/retry map in instance state; set() publishes session.status (and legacy session.idle) bus events and clears the entry when returning to idle.

nodes.name: set
nodes.summary: Updates a session's status in the instance map, publishing the session.status bus event always and the deprecated session.idle event on idle transitions, deleting the map entry so idle is the implicit default.

nodes.name: summary.ts
nodes.summary: SessionSummary service computing per-session diff summaries from boundary snapshots, persisting them to storage and the session row, attaching per-message diffs for the summarizer, and lazily unquoting git-escaped paths in cached diffs.

nodes.name: unquoteGitPath
nodes.summary: Decodes git's C-style quoted paths ("\"...\""): octal byte escapes, standard C escapes (n, r, t, b, f, v), and escaped backslashes/quotes, rebuilt through a byte buffer to handle non-ASCII filenames.

nodes.name: summarize
nodes.summary: Recomputes a session's aggregate diff summary from boundary snapshots, persists it to the session row and session_diff storage, publishes Session.Event.Diff, and attaches fine-grained per-message diffs to the target user message.

nodes.name: system.ts
nodes.summary: System prompt assembly: provider() joins the shared core.txt with a provider-specific delta chosen by matchDelta's model-ID regex cascade (beast/codex/gpt/gemini/claude/trinity/kimi/qwen/glm/deepseek), while the service builds the dynamic <environment> and <skills> sections including semantic skill auto-match.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the shared-core-plus-delta prompt architecture: universal rules live only in core.txt and provider quirks (TodoWrite for Claude, apply_patch for GPT, autonomous mode for o1/o3) in delta-*.txt files matched in a deliberate order.

nodes.name: provider
nodes.summary: Returns the cacheable system prompt prefix for a model: the shared core prompt joined with the provider-specific delta selected by matchDelta.

nodes.name: matchDelta
nodes.summary: Maps a model ID to its provider delta prompt via an ordered regex cascade: anchored gpt-4/o1/o3 (beast) first, then codex before generic gpt, followed by gemini, claude, trinity, kimi, qwen, glm, deepseek, defaulting to the generic delta.

nodes.name: todo-autoclose.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helpers that auto-complete pending todos when every significant keyword (>3 chars) of the todo content appears in a file diff, preserving the input array reference when nothing changed.

nodes.name: shouldComplete
nodes.summary: Predicate returning true when a todo is still open, has at least one significant word, and all of its words appear (case-insensitively) within a single file change's diff.

nodes.name: applyAutoclose
nodes.summary: Maps autoclose over a todo list, marking matched todos completed; returns the original array reference when no todo changed so callers can skip persistence.

nodes.name: todo.ts
nodes.summary: Todo service persisting per-session todo lists to TodoTable inside a delete-and-reinsert transaction, normalizing legacy status/priority values on read, publishing todo.updated bus events, and applying diff-based autoclose.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Replaces a session's todo set atomically: deletes existing rows and reinserts the new list with positional ordering in one transaction, then publishes the todo.updated bus event.

nodes.name: autoclose
nodes.summary: Applies applyAutoclose to the current todos for a session given recent file changes, persisting via update() only when the reference changed.

nodes.name: usage.ts
nodes.summary: getUsage normalizes AI SDK usage tokens (splitting cache read/write, reasoning, and provider-specific cache metadata from Anthropic/Vertex/Bedrock/Venice) and computes dollar cost with Decimal precision against per-million pricing, including the experimental over-200K rate tier.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses || rather than ?? when falling through cache-write token sources because 0 should also fall through to provider metadata; cost math uses decimal.js to avoid floating-point drift.

nodes.name: getUsage
nodes.summary: Converts a LanguageModelUsage plus provider metadata into normalized token buckets (input net of cache, output net of reasoning, cache read/write) and a Decimal-precise cost using the model's pricing table.

nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.summary: SessionShare facade over ShareNext: share/unshare a session with config gating, plus a create() wrapper that auto-shares newly created root sessions in the background when the auto-share flag or config is enabled.

nodes.name: share-next.ts
nodes.summary: ShareNext service implementing session sharing: creates/removes shares through the legacy opncd.ai API or the authenticated console API depending on the active account, maintains a per-session in-memory share cache over SessionShareTable, and incrementally syncs session/message/part/diff/model data by watching bus events through a debounced flush queue. Disabled entirely via OPENCODE_DISABLE_SHARE.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses InstanceState so queues and subscriptions are scoped per project instance with finalizer cleanup; the queue is keyed by entity key to dedupe rapid updates before the 1-second delayed flush.

nodes.name: sync
nodes.summary: Queues share data updates for a session keyed by entity (session, message/id, part/...), merging into an existing pending queue or creating one and forking a 1-second delayed flush with error logging.

nodes.name: flush
nodes.summary: Drains a session's pending share queue and POSTs it to the sync endpoint with the share secret, logging a warning on HTTP >= 400 without failing the caller.

nodes.name: full
nodes.summary: Performs a full share upload: streams every message and part, resolves distinct user-message models concurrently, fetches the session diff, and queues the complete payload for sync.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Creates a share for a session: POSTs to the create endpoint, upserts the returned id/secret/url into SessionShareTable, caches it in instance state, and forks a full sync with cause-level error logging.

nodes.name: remove
nodes.summary: Removes a session's share: DELETEs it remotely with the secret, clears the SessionShareTable row, and drops cached share and pending queue state.

nodes.name: share.sql.ts
nodes.summary: Drizzle schema for the session_share table storing the remote share id, secret, and public URL keyed by session with cascade delete.

nodes.name: session_share
nodes.summary: One row per shared session: session_id primary key cascading from session, plus the remote share id, sync secret, and public URL with standard timestamps.

nodes.name: shell.ts
nodes.summary: Cross-platform shell utilities: detects and resolves available shells (pwsh/powershell/git-bash/cmd on Windows, /etc/shells on Unix) with per-shell metadata (login/posix/ps/deny), builds per-shell invocation args that source rc files and cd into the working directory, and kills process trees reliably on both platforms.
nodes.languageNotes: Windows bash resolution walks git.exe up to bin/bash.exe; zsh/bash commands run as login shells sourcing rc files with the cwd passed as a positional arg to avoid quoting issues; killTree uses taskkill /t on Windows and process-group signals with a SIGKILL fallback elsewhere.

nodes.name: killTree
nodes.summary: Terminates a child process and its descendants: taskkill /pid /f /t on Windows, otherwise SIGTERM to the process group escalating to SIGKILL after a 200ms grace when the exited check still reports running.

nodes.name: args
nodes.summary: Builds the argument vector to execute a command in a given shell: nu/fish use -c, zsh and bash run as login shells sourcing their rc files then eval the JSON-quoted command with the cwd as a positional parameter, cmd uses /c, and PowerShell uses -NoProfile -Command.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Engineering notes for the skill subsystem: skill selection is LLM-driven from the system prompt catalog (not algorithmic), semantic auto-match uses a zvec HNSW index with incremental embedding manifests, loaded skills are excluded from auto-match, invalid skills register with warnings but stay hidden from the model, and skill.warning events are log-only rather than TUI toasts.

nodes.name: discovery.ts
nodes.summary: Skill discovery service that pulls remote skill registries: fetches an index.json from a configured URL, validates every entry against path-traversal attacks, and downloads each skill's file set into the global cache with bounded concurrency.
nodes.languageNotes: Effect service built with Layer.effect and Context.Service; safePath() rejects resolved targets that escape the cache base via path.relative prefix checks.

nodes.name: download
nodes.summary: Downloads a single skill file over HTTP and writes it to disk, skipping files that already exist and logging-and-swallowing download failures so one bad file does not abort the pull.

nodes.name: pull
nodes.summary: Fetches and validates a remote skill index, filters entries missing SKILL.md, blocks path traversal in skill names and file paths, then concurrently downloads all skill files and returns the cache directories that ended up with a SKILL.md.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Effect Context.Service handle for skill discovery, exposing the pull(url) operation to consumers via the @opencode/SkillDiscovery tag.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: The skill registry: discovers SKILL.md files from config directories, external ~/.claude and ~/.agents dirs, configured extra paths, and remote URLs; validates frontmatter with zod (emitting warnings rather than rejecting), maintains a zvec embedding index for semantic skill matching, and publishes skill.loaded/unloaded/warning bus events.
nodes.languageNotes: Per-instance state via InstanceState.make; the zvec index must open before the manifest is read or a dimension migration can wipe valid entries. Built-in skills register before disk discovery so user skills can override them.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Parses one SKILL.md, validates its frontmatter against the zod schema (name length, description, allowed-tools), collects non-fatal warnings (missing description, name/folder mismatch, duplicates) as skill.warning events, and registers the skill in the registry state.

nodes.name: scan
nodes.summary: Globs a root directory for SKILL.md matches and accumulates them (plus their parent dirs) into the shared scan state, dying on errors for config dirs but degrading to an empty result for scoped external dirs.

nodes.name: discoverSkills
nodes.summary: Enumerates all skill source locations: global and project-external dirs (~/.claude, ~/.agents unless disabled by flags), opencode config directories, extra configured paths (with ~ expansion), and remotely pulled URL directories.

nodes.name: matchBySemantics
nodes.summary: Embeds the user message and searches the zvec index for related skills, filtering by already-loaded set, permission deny rules, and a similarity threshold; embedding failures degrade to zero matches instead of failing the prompt build.

nodes.name: fmt
nodes.summary: Formats the available-skills list for the model: verbose mode emits an XML <available_skills> block with name/description/location, non-verbose emits a markdown bullet list.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Effect Context.Service handle for the Skill registry, exposing get/all/allIncludingInvalid/dirs/available/markLoaded/matchBySemantics to the rest of the app.

nodes.name: customize-opencode.md
nodes.summary: Body of the built-in customize-opencode skill: a 13-section reference for opencode's own configuration surface (opencode.json fields, agents, skills, plugins, MCP servers, permissions, escape hatches) so the model edits config with real schemas instead of guesses. Imported as text in skill/index.ts and registered behind the OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CUSTOMIZE_SKILL flag.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Snapshot service that shadows the working tree in a private bare git directory (keyed by project id and worktree hash) to provide undo/revert: tracks modified and untracked files, produces patches and per-file diffs via git plumbing commands, restores or reverts snapshots, and prunes snapshots older than 7 days.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs git with --git-dir/--work-tree against a snapshot dir under Global.Path.data, never touching the user's repo; a per-gitdir Semaphore map serializes concurrent snapshot operations and large files (over 2MB) are excluded from tracking.

nodes.name: cleanup
nodes.summary: Prunes stale snapshot state, dropping refs older than the 7-day retention window from the shadow gitdir.

nodes.name: track
nodes.summary: Stages the current working-tree state into the snapshot gitdir (modified plus untracked files, honoring ignore rules and size limits) and returns the commit hash of the new snapshot.

nodes.name: patch
nodes.summary: Returns the Patch (hash plus file list) recorded for a given snapshot hash by diffing the snapshot ref against the empty tree.

nodes.name: diffNames
nodes.summary: Produces a Patch whose file list is the set of files changed between two snapshot hashes.

nodes.name: restore
nodes.summary: Checks out a snapshot's tracked files back into the working tree, restoring the recorded state.

nodes.name: revert
nodes.summary: Applies a list of patches in reverse to undo file changes, removing added files and restoring deleted/modified content from the snapshot store.

nodes.name: diff
nodes.summary: Returns a unified text diff between the current working tree and a snapshot hash after first tracking the current state.

nodes.name: diffFull
nodes.summary: Computes per-file FileDiff records (file, patch text, additions, deletions, status) between two snapshots, batch-fetching blob contents via git cat-file --batch with a per-file git show fallback when the batch stream is truncated.
nodes.languageNotes: Parses the cat-file --batch stream manually (header, blob size, newline framing) and bails out to a slower per-file path on any truncation or header anomaly.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Effect Context.Service handle for the Snapshot service, exposing init/cleanup/track/patch/diffNames/restore/revert/diff/diffFull to consumers such as the edit tool and session undo flows.

nodes.name: sql.d.ts
nodes.summary: Ambient module declaration that types imports of *.sql files as string default exports, enabling migration SQL to be embedded at compile time.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Developer notes on database semantics: the lazy Client singleton leaks state across tests, Database.use falls back to the global client outside transactions, and the NotPromise generic constraint requires an as-cast on wrapper functions.

nodes.name: db.bun.ts
nodes.summary: Bun-runtime SQLite initializer: opens a bun:sqlite Database and wraps it with drizzle-orm/bun-sqlite; selected through the #db import alias under the bun/default conditions.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Creates the Bun SQLite database connection (create: true) and returns the drizzle-wrapped client.

nodes.name: db.node.ts
nodes.summary: Node-runtime SQLite initializer: opens a node:sqlite DatabaseSync and wraps it with drizzle-orm/node-sqlite; selected through the #db import alias under the node condition.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Creates the Node SQLite DatabaseSync connection and returns the drizzle-wrapped client.

nodes.name: db.ts
nodes.summary: Database module: lazy singleton SQLite client tuned with WAL/busy_timeout/foreign_keys pragmas, drizzle migrations applied from bundled or dev directories, channel-scoped database paths, and LocalContext-based use/transaction/effect wrappers that give callers ambient transaction semantics with post-commit side effects.
nodes.languageNotes: The #db subpath import switches between bun:sqlite and node:sqlite at package resolution time; transaction() propagates the tx through LocalContext so nested use() calls join the outer transaction, and queued effects run only after commit.

nodes.name: getChannelPath
nodes.summary: Computes the SQLite file path, isolating beta/other installation channels into opencode-<channel>.db so dev channels never share a database with prod.

nodes.name: migrations
nodes.summary: Reads migration directories from disk, parses each timestamped folder name into a UTC epoch, and returns the journal entries sorted chronologically for dev-mode migration.

nodes.name: Client
nodes.summary: Lazy singleton factory that opens the SQLite connection, applies performance pragmas, and runs drizzle migrations from the bundled OPENCODE_MIGRATIONS define or the dev migration directory (skippable via flag).

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Closes the underlying SQLite client and resets the lazy singleton so the next Client() call reopens the database.

nodes.name: use
nodes.summary: Runs a synchronous callback against the ambient transaction if one exists in LocalContext, otherwise opens a fresh context bound to the global client and flushes any queued side effects afterward.

nodes.name: effect
nodes.summary: Registers a side effect to run after the current transaction commits (instance-bound); executes immediately when no transaction context is active.

nodes.name: transaction
nodes.summary: Executes a synchronous callback inside a real SQLite transaction (deferred/immediate/exclusive), joins an already-active transaction transparently, and drains queued effects only after the transaction commits.

nodes.name: json-migration.ts
nodes.summary: One-shot migration from the legacy JSON file storage tree to SQLite: scans storage/project, session, message, part, todo, permission, and share JSON files, decodes them defensively, and bulk-inserts into the drizzle tables with progress reporting and per-file error collection.
nodes.languageNotes: A single ~400-line run() orchestrator; reads are batched with Math.min caps and Promise.allSettled so corrupt JSON files are logged and skipped instead of aborting the migration.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Full migration pipeline: creates tables if needed, globs each legacy entity type in dependency order (project, session, message, part, todo, permission, share), resolves parent references, inserts rows with onConflictDoNothing, and reports progress plus collected errors.

nodes.name: schema.sql.ts
nodes.summary: Shared Drizzle column helper Timestamps (time_created with $default, time_updated with $onUpdate) mixed into table definitions across the schema.

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: Schema barrel re-exporting every drizzle table definition (account, account state, control account, project, session, message, part, todo, permission, session share, workspace) as the single import surface for database code.

nodes.name: storage.ts
nodes.summary: JSON file storage service: keyed .json documents under the storage directory with RcMap-managed file handles, TxReentrantLock read/write serialization, schema-decoded reads, in-place draft updates, and legacy storage-layout migrations that relocate pre-project-scoped data.
nodes.languageNotes: Schemas are decoded with Option-returning decoders so malformed files surface as NotFound-style errors; the MIGRATIONS array at the top runs sequentially during layer init.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Reads and returns a JSON document by key under a reentrant read lock, failing with NotFoundError when the file is missing.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Atomically updates a JSON document by mutating a decoded draft inside a reentrant write lock and persisting the result, creating the file if absent.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Effect Context.Service handle for JSON storage, exposing remove/read/update/write/list to consumers.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Developer notes on the SyncEvent system: the sync envelope wrapping on the global SSE stream, convertEvent payload transformation, BusEvent vs SyncEvent delivery differences, dual GlobalBus publication paths, registry freezing after init, and the Effect-service bypass in run/replay.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Design document for the sync/event-sourcing system: single-writer total ordering via incrementing sequence ids, SyncEvent as a new abstraction layered onto the existing Bus for backwards compatibility, event shape, event flow, and projector-based mutations.

nodes.name: event.sql.ts
nodes.summary: Drizzle table definitions backing the event store: EventSequenceTable (per-aggregate sequence cursor with ownership) and EventTable (append-only event log with cascading aggregate reference and JSON-typed data).
nodes.languageNotes: Follows the project's snake_case Drizzle column convention so column names need no string overrides.

nodes.name: event_sequence
nodes.summary: Per-aggregate sequence cursor (aggregate_id primary key, seq, owner_id) that enforces total ordering and records which device currently owns the write lock for the aggregate.

nodes.name: event
nodes.summary: Append-only event log: one row per persisted sync event with id primary key, cascading aggregate reference, sequence number, versioned type string, and JSON-encoded payload.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: SyncEvent event-sourcing system: typed event definitions with versioned type strings, a frozen global registry, transactional process() that persists events and advances sequence cursors while running projectors, dual publication to ProjectBus and GlobalBus (raw plus sync envelope), replay/replayAll for multi-device sync, and claim() for aggregate ownership transfer.
nodes.languageNotes: After init() the registry is frozen and later define() calls throw; run/replay/replayAll bypass the Effect service layer via runtime.runSync on a dedicated runtime, so projectors must be initialized before tests can use them.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Registers every definition in the registry as a BusEvent under its unversioned type name and freezes the registry so no further SyncEvent types can be defined after projector initialization.

nodes.name: define
nodes.summary: Defines a new SyncEvent type: validates type and aggregate names, tracks the highest version, stores the definition in the global registry, and returns the composed Effect Schema for the event payload.

nodes.name: process
nodes.summary: Core persistence pipeline: inside one database transaction runs the registered projector, upserts the aggregate sequence cursor, and inserts the event row; afterwards fans the event out to the project bus (raw payload) and the global bus wrapped in a versioned sync envelope, and schedules post-commit bus effects via Database.effect.

nodes.name: effectPayloads
nodes.summary: Builds the Effect Schema union of all registered sync envelope payloads (type literal "sync", event name, id, seq, aggregateID, and per-type data schema) for the SDK/event stream contract.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Effect Context.Service handle for SyncEvent, exposing run/replay/replayAll/remove to consumers such as the server projectors.

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: Branded EventID schema: strings prefixed with "evt", carrying an ascending ID factory and zod statics for boundaries that need zod validation.

nodes.name: temporary.ts
nodes.summary: Standalone yargs CLI entry point wiring only the TuiThreadCommand, with global help/version/print-logs/log-level/pure options; a minimal bootstrap separate from the main CLI.

nodes.name: apply_patch.ts
nodes.summary: apply_patch agent tool: parses multi-file patch text into add/update/delete/move hunks, validates containment and external-directory permissions, computes per-file diffs with BOM preservation, applies changes, publishes file and watcher events, then reports LSP diagnostics and autocloses matching todos. Failed hunks are collected and skipped rather than aborting the patch.
nodes.languageNotes: Move destinations that already exist are refused unless the patch uses Force Move, guarding against an LLM hallucinating a target path over user data.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: The 370-line execute body of ApplyPatchTool: hunk parsing, path containment and permission checks, per-type file change computation (add/update/delete/move with diff and line counting), the edit permission ask, applying writes/removals, event publication, LSP diagnostics, and the todo autoclose plus summary output.

nodes.name: codesearch.ts
nodes.summary: codesearch agent tool: forwards a documentation/code-context query to the Exa MCP endpoint (get_code_context_exa) with a 1000-50000 token budget, gated by the codesearch permission.

nodes.name: edit.replacer.ts
nodes.summary: Fuzzy replacement engine behind the edit tool: a chain of replacer strategies (exact, line-trimmed, block-anchor, whitespace-normalized, indentation-flexible, escape-normalized, multi-occurrence, trimmed-boundary, context-aware with Levenshtein scoring) tried in order, plus trimDiff for trimming unified diff output.
nodes.languageNotes: Each replacer is an object conforming to a shared shape returning a match or undefined; the replace() entry point iterates the chain so LLM-imperfect old_string values still land.

nodes.name: levenshtein
nodes.summary: Classic dynamic-programming edit distance between two strings, used by the context-aware replacer to pick the best candidate match.

nodes.name: blockSubstring
nodes.summary: Extracts a line-range substring from file content, clamped to the available lines, for block-anchor replacement.

nodes.name: trimDiff
nodes.summary: Trims unified diff output by collapsing unchanged context runs and stripping leading/trailing noise so stored diffs stay compact.

nodes.name: replace
nodes.summary: Entry point that tries each replacer strategy in order for old-to-new substitution, handling replaceAll mode and falling back to exact indexOf/lastIndexOf semantics when no fuzzy strategy matches.

nodes.name: edit.ts
nodes.summary: edit agent tool: exact-or-fuzzy string replacement in a single file with per-file locking, line-ending detection and preservation, BOM handling, an edit permission ask carrying the diff, optional formatting, file/watcher event publication, LSP diagnostics, and todo autoclose.
nodes.languageNotes: Empty oldString means whole-file rewrite; a per-instance LockRegistry serializes concurrent edits to the same path since cross-instance edits are not serialized.

nodes.name: external-directory.ts
nodes.summary: Permission gate for paths outside the current project instance: normalizes the target, checks containment, and when the path escapes the instance asks the external_directory permission using a parent-directory glob.

nodes.name: assertExternalDirectoryEffect
nodes.summary: Effect function that no-ops for contained or bypassed targets and otherwise prompts the user for external_directory approval with a normalized parent-dir glob (Windows path normalization aware).

nodes.name: file-path.ts
nodes.summary: Tool path helpers: resolvePath resolves tool-supplied paths with symlink awareness, and projectContainmentError produces the error message used by tools when a resolved path escapes the instance directory.

nodes.name: resolvePath
nodes.summary: Resolves a file path and follows symlinks, recovering the real target when only the file itself (not its directory) is a link.

nodes.name: projectContainmentError
nodes.summary: Returns a containment error string when a resolved path does not start with the instance directory, else undefined; used by edit and apply_patch to block writes outside the project.

nodes.name: file-read.ts
nodes.summary: Streaming file-reading helpers shared by the read and shell tools: reads files line-by-line with per-line truncation and byte budgets, and extracts changed line ranges from unified diffs for hunk-based reads.
nodes.languageNotes: Streams via Node readline createInterface over createReadStream and destroys the stream early once byte or line budgets are exceeded.

nodes.name: lines
nodes.summary: Streams a file through readline, truncating over-long lines and stopping early once the line or byte budget is exceeded.

nodes.name: getChangedRanges
nodes.summary: Parses a unified diff into changed line ranges by extracting start/end pairs from @@ hunk headers.

nodes.name: linesWithHunks
nodes.summary: Reads only the lines inside changed ranges (plus surrounding context), merging overlapping hunks and applying the same line/byte truncation as the plain reader.

nodes.name: glob.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the `glob` tool that lets the agent find files by glob pattern, powered by ripgrep file listing with permission prompts and external-directory checks.

nodes.name: GlobTool
nodes.summary: The `glob` tool definition: matches workspace files against a glob pattern via ripgrep, gated by permission ask and external-directory assertions.

nodes.name: grep.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the `grep` tool for regex content search across the workspace via ripgrep, with include filters, a 100-match limit, and external-directory permission checks.

nodes.name: GrepTool
nodes.summary: The `grep` tool definition: runs a regex pattern search through ripgrep with optional path scoping and include filters, returning capped matches.

nodes.name: index-workspace.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the `index_workspace` tool that builds or rebuilds the semantic search index over workspace files, optionally resetting it, and reports indexed file and chunk counts from the manifest.

nodes.name: IndexWorkspaceTool
nodes.summary: The `index_workspace` tool definition: permission-gated indexing run that resets the index on force and summarizes results from the zvec manifest.

nodes.name: invalid.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the `invalid` placeholder tool that reports argument-validation failures back to the model when a tool call's parameters fail schema validation.

nodes.name: InvalidTool
nodes.summary: The `invalid` tool definition: echoes the validation error text back to the model as tool output instead of executing anything.

nodes.name: lock.ts
nodes.summary: Provides LockRegistry, a named-lock registry built on Effect Semaphores that serializes concurrent access to shared resources such as file writes from parallel tool calls.

nodes.name: LockRegistry
nodes.summary: Named lock registry keyed by string that lazily creates an Effect Semaphore per key via acquireUseRelease and deletes entries when the last holder releases.

nodes.name: lsp.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the `lsp` tool exposing nine language-server operations (goToDefinition, findReferences, hover, document/workspaceSymbol, call hierarchy) with per-operation permission metadata.

nodes.name: LspTool
nodes.summary: The `lsp` tool definition: resolves relative paths against the instance directory, enforces external-directory access, and dispatches the requested LSP operation.

nodes.name: matcher.ts
nodes.summary: Unicode-normalizing line-matching primitives used by the edit tools to locate edit anchors in file content, with exact, ambiguity-detecting, and backward-search variants.
nodes.languageNotes: Normalizes typographic Unicode (smart quotes, dashes, ellipsis) to ASCII before comparing so model-emitted edit anchors still match file bytes.

nodes.name: normalizeUnicode
nodes.summary: Normalizes typographic quotes, dashes, and ellipsis characters to their ASCII equivalents before comparison.

nodes.name: findPattern
nodes.summary: Finds the first line index at or after a start index where a pattern matches under the supplied comparator.

nodes.name: findPatternAmbiguity
nodes.summary: Finds pattern matches and reports ambiguity when the pattern matches multiple distinct locations in the lines.

nodes.name: findExactPattern
nodes.summary: Locates an exact multi-line pattern match using whole-content index slicing with EOF anchoring, falling back to a backward scan.

nodes.name: findPatternBackward
nodes.summary: Scans lines in reverse to find the last index where the pattern matches under the comparator.

nodes.name: mcp-websearch.ts
nodes.summary: HTTP MCP client for web-search backends (Exa and search.parallel.ai): builds JSON-RPC tool-call requests, parses direct JSON or SSE stream payloads, and enforces request timeouts.

nodes.name: parseResponse
nodes.summary: Extracts the first text content from an MCP result payload, handling both a direct JSON body and server-sent-event `data:` lines.

nodes.name: call
nodes.summary: Posts a JSON-RPC MCP tool-call request to a web-search endpoint with custom headers and a timeout, then decodes the response payload.

nodes.name: plan.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the `plan_exit` tool that ends plan mode: asks the user to approve switching to the build agent, then injects a synthetic user message instructing execution of the approved plan.

nodes.name: PlanExitTool
nodes.summary: The `plan_exit` tool: prompts approval via Question.Service, reassigns the session to the build agent with the last-used model, and appends a synthetic text part to kick off implementation.

nodes.name: question.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the `question` tool that pauses the agent loop to ask the user structured multiple-choice questions and feeds the answers back into the conversation as tool output.

nodes.name: QuestionTool
nodes.summary: The `question` tool definition: submits prompts through Question.Service and formats the collected answers as the tool's output text.

nodes.name: read.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the `read` tool, the agent's primary file reader: offset/limit windowed reads, git-hunk-only reads, image and PDF attachment handling, LSP diagnostics on read, and fuzzy filename fallback on a miss.

nodes.name: ReadTool
nodes.summary: The `read` tool implementation: resolves files with a fuzzy-miss fallback, streams text with hunk filtering, embeds supported media as attachments, and attaches LSP diagnostics.

nodes.name: registry.ts
nodes.summary: The tool registry: an Effect service that assembles all built-in tools plus plugin-provided ones, deduplicates custom tools, generates dynamic task/skill descriptions, and filters tools per model (e.g. apply_patch vs edit/write for GPT models).
nodes.languageNotes: Plugin tool parameters cross the Zod to Effect Schema boundary via Schema.declare with a safeParse guard; descriptions are sanitized to strip HTML and wiki-style markup.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Context.Service tag for the ToolRegistry, exposing ids(), all(), named() (task/read handles), and tools(model) for per-model tool filtering.

nodes.name: webSearchEnabled
nodes.summary: Returns whether web-search tools are enabled for a provider: true for the opencode provider or when the exa/parallel feature flags are set.

nodes.name: repo_clone.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the `repo_clone` tool that clones or refreshes a remote repository into the managed reference cache, gated by a permission ask on the repository name.

nodes.name: RepoCloneTool
nodes.summary: The `repo_clone` tool definition: parses a git URL / host-path / owner-repo shorthand reference, validates the branch, and delegates to RepositoryCache.ensure with clone status metadata.

nodes.name: repo_overview.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the `repo_overview` tool that produces an LLM-oriented structural summary of a cached repository or local directory: depth-limited tree, detected package manager, ecosystems, dependency files, and common entrypoints.

nodes.name: ecosystems
nodes.summary: Detects language ecosystems (node, python, go, rust, ruby, java, php, etc.) from the presence of their canonical dependency files.

nodes.name: commonEntrypoints
nodes.summary: Filters the conventional entrypoint list (index/main variants at root and src/) down to files that actually exist in the repository.

nodes.name: RepoOverviewTool
nodes.summary: The `repo_overview` tool implementation: walks the directory tree within depth/structure limits, detects package manager, ecosystems, and entrypoints, and renders a metadata-rich overview.

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the branded ToolID schema (string identifiers starting with "tool") with ascending ID generation and a Zod bridge for SDK boundaries.

nodes.name: semantic-search.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the `semantic_search` tool that embeds a query via the embedding service and returns the most relevant indexed code passages with similarity scores.

nodes.name: SemanticSearchTool
nodes.summary: The `semantic_search` tool definition: permission-gated query embedding and top-K vector search returning scored passages.

nodes.name: shell.ts
nodes.summary: Thin entry that defines the shell tool by composing config, filesystem, truncation, plugin, and process-spawner services and delegating to createShellTool; re-exports the shell Parameters schema.

nodes.name: ShellTool
nodes.summary: The shell tool entry definition: yields five services from the Effect context and hands them to createShellTool to build the executable tool.

nodes.name: execute.ts
nodes.summary: The shell tool implementation: parses commands with tree-sitter (bash and PowerShell grammars) to derive permission patterns and affected paths, resolves Windows/POSIX path forms via cygpath, and spawns the process with streaming output truncation, timeout, and abort handling.
nodes.languageNotes: web-tree-sitter wasm modules are lazy-loaded with paths resolved via resolveWasm; process lifecycle arbitration uses Effect.raceAll over exit/abort/timeout with a force-kill after 3 seconds, and output overflow demotes to a truncation file mid-stream.

nodes.name: cmd
nodes.summary: Builds the ChildProcess spec for a command, choosing between PowerShell invocation and login-shell (-lc) invocation with cwd and env.

nodes.name: createShellTool
nodes.summary: Full shell tool factory: cygpath-aware path resolution, tree-sitter AST scans that classify commands into permission patterns and directories, streaming spawn with mid-flight truncation to a file, and abort/timeout racing against process exit.

nodes.name: helpers.ts
nodes.summary: Shared shell-tool helpers: command classification sets (cwd-changing and file-mutating commands per shell), tree-sitter AST part extraction, env-var and home-directory path expansion, path-argument detection, and output preview/tail truncation.
nodes.languageNotes: Re-exports getChangedRanges from file-read.ts so the read and shell pipelines share diff-range parsing.

nodes.name: parts
nodes.summary: Extracts typed token parts from a tree-sitter command node, descending through nested command and argument nodes to produce flat text parts.

nodes.name: provider
nodes.summary: Extracts a lowercase provider ID from cloud-provider URL patterns found in command text.

nodes.name: pathArgs
nodes.summary: Classifies command arguments into candidate paths, filtering out flags, known switches, and shell-specific non-path tokens before applying tilde/env expansion.

nodes.name: tail
nodes.summary: Truncates output to the last N lines/bytes using byte-level slicing that avoids splitting multi-byte UTF-8 characters.

nodes.name: id.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the shell tool's branded ShellID schema and a kind guard that maps tool IDs to shell kinds.

nodes.name: prompt.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the shell tool's LLM-facing surface: the Effect parameter schema with per-shell description annotations, and the rendered tool description with per-shell command sections (bash, PowerShell, cmd) and output limits.

nodes.name: parameterSchema
nodes.summary: Builds the shell tool's Effect parameter schema (command, timeout, description) with per-shell command-description examples.

nodes.name: powershellNotes
nodes.summary: Produces PowerShell-specific usage notes (quoting, cmdlet conventions) for the rendered shell tool description.

nodes.name: chainGuidance
nodes.summary: Returns per-shell command-chaining syntax guidance (&&, ;, etc.) for bash, PowerShell, and cmd.

nodes.name: bashCommandSection
nodes.summary: Renders the bash/zsh command section of the tool description, including path handling rules and output line/byte limits.

nodes.name: powershellCommandSection
nodes.summary: Renders the PowerShell command section with quoting rules, path-separator guidance, and per-shell output limits.

nodes.name: cmdCommandSection
nodes.summary: Renders the cmd.exe command section covering its restricted syntax, chaining quirks, and output limits.

nodes.name: profile
nodes.summary: Assembles the per-shell profile: display name, chaining guidance, and the appropriate command section for bash, PowerShell, or cmd.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders the final shell tool description from the shell.txt template plus the OS, shell name, command section, and output limits; also returns the parameter schema.

nodes.name: shell.txt
nodes.summary: The shell tool's description template with placeholders (${os}, ${shell}, ${commandSection}, ${tmp}, ...) covering terminal usage rules, a detailed git commit safety protocol, and pull-request creation steps via the gh CLI.
nodes.languageNotes: Template with ${...} placeholders rendered by ShellPrompt.render in shell/prompt.ts; includes hard rules like never force-pushing main and never skipping hooks.

nodes.name: skill.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the `skill` tool that loads a named skill's SKILL.md instructions into the conversation, with permission gating, validation-warning banners, and streamed content output.

nodes.name: SkillTool
nodes.summary: The `skill` tool definition: resolves the skill by name (listing available ones on miss), surfaces frontmatter warnings, and streams the skill content in a <skill_content> block.

nodes.name: task.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the `task` tool that spawns subagent sessions: enforces permission rules and nesting limits, applies subagent tool restrictions, supports resuming prior task sessions, and bridges Effect cancellation to abort the child prompt.

nodes.name: TaskTool
nodes.summary: The `task` tool implementation: evaluates permission rulesets (deny even when bypassing the ask dialog), derives subagent session permissions and tool restrictions, creates or resumes the child session, and runs the subagent prompt with abort bridging.

nodes.name: todo.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the `todowrite` built-in tool that replaces the session's todo list, validating per-item content/status/priority through Effect Schema, asking permission, and persisting the update via Todo.Service.

nodes.name: wrap
nodes.summary: Wraps a tool's execute: decodes arguments against the tool schema (with friendly rewrite-the-input error messages), runs the original execute, then applies output truncation via Truncate.Service and stamps truncated/outputPath metadata, all under a Tool.execute OpenTelemetry span.

nodes.name: define
nodes.summary: Registers a tool by id, resolving Truncate.Service and Agent.Service from the Effect context and returning an Info whose init produces the wrapped definition; attaches the id as a property for ergonomic registry handling.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Materializes a tool Info into a full Def by invoking its deferred init and merging in the tool id.

nodes.name: tool.ts
nodes.summary: Core tool framework: `Tool.define` wraps every tool's execute with schema decoding, friendly validation-error messages, automatic output truncation, and OpenTelemetry spans; also declares the shared Context/Def/Info types and inference helpers used by all tool implementations.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses generic conditional types (InferParameters/InferMetadata/InferDef) to derive parameter and metadata types from Info, and hoists the Schema.decodeUnknownEffect parser closure once per tool init to avoid re-allocating it on every LLM invocation.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Effect Context.Service tag for the Truncate interface exposing cleanup, write, output, and limits operations; provided by the layer defined in the same module.

nodes.name: truncate.ts
nodes.summary: Truncation service for oversized tool output: enforces max-lines/max-bytes limits (configurable via `tool_output` in opencode config), writes the full output to the global truncation directory, returns a head or tail preview with a Task-tool delegation hint, and prunes old files hourly with 7-day retention.
nodes.languageNotes: Effect Layer-based service (Context.Service) that forks a scoped hourly-repeated cleanup fiber and resolves limits from an optional Config.Service so it also works when config is absent.

nodes.name: truncation-dir.ts
nodes.summary: Single-constant module locating the global truncation directory (<global data path>/tool-output) where full untruncated tool output is stored.

nodes.name: isPrivateIPv4
nodes.summary: Returns true for any non-global-public IPv4 address (private, loopback, link-local including cloud IMDS, CGNAT, TEST-NET, multicast, and reserved ranges) and fails closed on malformed input.

nodes.name: isPrivateIPv6
nodes.summary: Blocks non-global IPv6 ranges: unspecified/loopback, link-local, unique local, multicast, IPv4-mapped with leading zeros, discard-only, documentation, NAT64 well-known, Teredo, 6to4, and ORCHID prefixes.

nodes.name: isPrivateIP
nodes.summary: Dispatches private-IP detection across IPv4, IPv6, and IPv4-in-IPv6 embedded forms (IPv4-mapped, NAT64, and 6to4 dotted-quad suffixes).

nodes.name: extractTextFromHTML
nodes.summary: Streams HTML through Bun's HTMLRewriter collecting visible text while skipping script, style, noscript, iframe, object, and embed content.

nodes.name: convertHTMLToMarkdown
nodes.summary: Converts HTML to markdown via Turndown configured with ATX headings, fenced code blocks, and horizontal rules, with script/style/meta/link elements removed.

nodes.name: decodeBody
nodes.summary: Decodes a response body using the charset declared in the Content-Type header, falling back to UTF-8 for unknown or unsupported labels.

nodes.name: webfetch.ts
nodes.summary: The `webfetch` tool: fetches a URL behind an SSRF guard (private/reserved IPv4 and IPv6 range blocking plus DNS-rebinding defeat by pinning the resolved IP into the request URL), then converts responses to markdown (Turndown) or plain text (HTMLRewriter), or returns images as base64 attachments.
nodes.languageNotes: SSRF defense pins the DNS-resolved IP in the request URL while preserving the original Host header, brackets IPv6 literals (the WHATWG URL hostname setter silently ignores unbracketed IPv6), and retries with an honest User-Agent when Cloudflare bot detection (cf-mitigated challenge, 403) blocks the browser-like UA.

nodes.name: selectWebSearchProvider
nodes.summary: Chooses the web search backend: OPENCODE_WEBSEARCH_PROVIDER env override wins, then feature flags, otherwise a checksum-of-session-ID coin flip for stable per-session bucketing between Exa and Parallel.

nodes.name: webSearchModelName
nodes.summary: Extracts a truncated (100 char) model identifier from the tool context's forwarded model info, preferring the API-specific id over the model id.

nodes.name: callProvider
nodes.summary: Dispatches a search to the selected backend through McpWebSearch.call: Parallel (objective plus search queries plus session/model telemetry, optional bearer auth) or Exa (query, type, numResults, livecrawl, context size), each with a 25-second timeout.

nodes.name: websearch.ts
nodes.summary: The `websearch` tool: selects between the Parallel and Exa search backends (env override, feature flags, or checksum-based per-session bucketing) and dispatches the query through the MCP-style web search bridge with a permission ask and metadata reporting.

nodes.name: write.ts
nodes.summary: The `write` tool: overwrites a file after enforcing project containment and external-directory checks, preserves UTF-8 BOMs, shows a diff in the permission ask, runs the formatter, publishes file-edited bus events, auto-closes todos, and feeds LSP diagnostics for the written file plus up to 5 other project files back to the model.

nodes.name: write.txt
nodes.summary: LLM-facing description for the write tool: prefer editing existing files, never proactively create documentation or README files, read a file before overwriting it, and avoid emojis unless requested.

nodes.name: combineSignals
nodes.summary: Merges multiple AbortSignals into one controller-backed signal, propagating the first abort reason, and returns a cleanup function that detaches all listeners to prevent accumulation; short-circuits for empty, single-signal, and already-aborted inputs.

nodes.name: abort.ts
nodes.summary: Provides combineSignals, which merges multiple AbortSignals into one and returns an explicit cleanup function that removes listeners to prevent leaks across repeated calls, unlike AbortSignal.any.

nodes.name: extractZip
nodes.summary: Extracts a zip archive cross-platform: PowerShell Expand-Archive with progress suppressed on Windows, unzip -o -q elsewhere, both invoked through the Process runner.

nodes.name: archive.ts
nodes.summary: Cross-platform zip extraction helper: uses PowerShell Expand-Archive on Windows (with the progress popup suppressed) and unzip on Unix-like platforms, invoked through the Process runner.
nodes.languageNotes: Branches on process.platform and shells out to the platform's native archiver instead of bundling a JavaScript unzip library.

nodes.name: split
nodes.summary: Splits a UTF-8 string into a { bom, text } pair, detecting a leading U+FEFF byte-order mark.

nodes.name: join
nodes.summary: Prepends or strips a UTF-8 BOM from text according to the requested flag, normalizing any existing BOM first.

nodes.name: syncFile
