nodes.summary: Rewrites a file through the app filesystem so its on-disk BOM matches the desired flag (for example restoring a BOM stripped by an external formatter), returning the BOM-less text.

nodes.name: bom.ts
nodes.summary: UTF-8 byte-order-mark helpers that split and join BOMs on text and read/sync files through the app filesystem service so tool edits preserve a file's original BOM.

nodes.name: hexToRgb
nodes.summary: Parses a #rrggbb hex string into its red, green, and blue components.

nodes.name: hexToAnsiBold
nodes.summary: Converts a validated #rrggbb hex color to an ANSI 24-bit truecolor foreground plus bold escape sequence, returning undefined for invalid input.

nodes.name: color.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny color utilities converting #rrggbb hex values to RGB components and to bold ANSI truecolor escape sequences for terminal rendering.

nodes.name: decodeDataUrl
nodes.summary: Decodes a data: URL into its payload string, handling base64-encoded bodies via Buffer and percent-encoded text bodies via decodeURIComponent.

nodes.name: data-url.ts
nodes.summary: Single helper that decodes data: URL payloads into strings, transparently handling base64 and URL-encoded bodies.

nodes.name: defer
nodes.summary: Wraps a cleanup callback into an object implementing both Symbol.dispose and Symbol.asyncDispose so it can be used with `using` and `await using` declarations.

nodes.name: defer.ts
nodes.summary: Turns a void-returning callback into a dual sync/async disposable, enabling explicit-resource-management syntax for arbitrary cleanup logic.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements both Symbol.dispose and Symbol.asyncDispose on one object, so the same disposable works in sync `using` and async `await using` blocks.

nodes.name: withTransientReadRetry
nodes.summary: Pipes an Effect HttpClient through retryTransient: up to 2 retries on both transport errors and retryable responses, with a jittered exponential schedule starting at 200ms.

nodes.name: effect-http-client.ts
nodes.summary: Adds transient-failure retry semantics (2 jittered exponential attempts on errors and responses) to any Effect HttpClient via a single composable pipe helper.

nodes.name: errorFormat
nodes.summary: Renders an unknown error as a printable string: Error stacks first, then pretty JSON for objects, with fallbacks (custom toString, constructor name plus own property names) for opaque objects that serialize to {}.

nodes.name: errorMessage
nodes.summary: Extracts the best single-line message from an unknown error, unwrapping Error.message, { message }, and { data.message } shapes before falling back to String conversion and errorFormat.

nodes.name: errorData
nodes.summary: Flattens an unknown error into a serializable record with type, message, stack, formatted, and cause fields, preserving primitive own-properties and stringifying complex ones.

nodes.name: safeCatch
nodes.summary: Logs a caught error with a context prefix to stderr and optionally invokes a fallback; the project's standard wrapper for promise catch handlers instead of manual try/catch.

nodes.name: error.ts
nodes.summary: Error normalization helpers used across the codebase: errorFormat renders any thrown value readably, errorMessage extracts the best single-line message, errorData flattens errors into serializable records, and safeCatch logs caught promise errors with context.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Writes string, Buffer, or Uint8Array content to a file, creating parent directories on ENOENT and retrying, with an optional file mode.

nodes.name: writeStream
nodes.summary: Pipes a web ReadableStream or Node Readable into a file, creating the destination directory first and applying an optional chmod mode after the pipeline completes.

nodes.name: normalizePath
nodes.summary: On Windows, canonicalizes a path's casing through realpathSync.native because LSP servers may return differently-cased paths than were sent; a no-op on other platforms.

nodes.name: normalizePathPattern
nodes.summary: Normalizes Windows directory-glob patterns (dir/*), preserving the trailing wildcard while canonicalizing the directory portion for case-insensitive matching.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves a path to its canonical absolute form, applying Windows drive translation and realpathSync (falling back to the unresolved path on ENOENT) so results serve as stable cache keys.

nodes.name: windowsPath
nodes.summary: Translates Unix-style Windows drive paths from Git Bash (/drive/...), Cygwin (/cygdrive/drive/...), and WSL (/mnt/drive/...) into native Windows drive-letter form.

nodes.name: findUp
nodes.summary: Walks ancestor directories from a start path collecting all existing matches of one or more target filenames, honoring an optional stop directory and a root-first search order.

nodes.name: up
nodes.summary: Async generator that lazily yields ancestor-directory matches for a set of targets as each directory is scanned.

nodes.name: globUp
nodes.summary: Scans a glob pattern in the start directory and each ancestor, accumulating absolute file matches while silently skipping invalid patterns.

nodes.name: filesystem.ts
nodes.summary: Filesystem helper layer used across config and tooling: promise-based read/write helpers that auto-create directories, stream piping, MIME lookup, Windows-aware path canonicalization (Git Bash/Cygwin/WSL drive translation and case normalization), and upward file and glob discovery.
nodes.languageNotes: windowsPath translates Git Bash (/drive/...), Cygwin (/cygdrive/drive/...), and WSL (/mnt/drive/...) prefixes to Windows drive letters because git.exe may originate from any of those environments; resolve() also realpathSyncs so callers get stable cache keys for a physical directory.

nodes.name: fn
nodes.summary: Wraps a callback with zod schema validation: each invocation is parsed against the schema (console.trace plus pretty-printed issues on failure), and the wrapper exposes .force for schema bypass and .schema for introspection.

nodes.name: fn.ts
nodes.summary: Small factory that binds a zod schema to a callback, producing a validated callable with debug-friendly parse-failure reporting plus force and schema escape hatches.

nodes.name: formatDuration
nodes.summary: Formats a number of seconds into a compact human duration string (fractional seconds under a minute, minutes-plus-seconds, or hours-plus-minutes).

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: Single helper that formats a seconds count into a compact human-readable duration string.

nodes.name: iife.ts
nodes.summary: Three-line immediately-invoked-function-expression helper enabling inline computations inside expressions.

nodes.name: lazy
nodes.summary: Creates a memoizing thunk that computes its value once (caching only non-undefined results), with .reset to clear the cache and .loaded to inspect it.

nodes.name: lazy.ts
nodes.summary: Memoizing thunk factory for deferred one-time initialization with explicit reset support.

nodes.name: NotFound
nodes.summary: Error thrown when a local context's use() is called outside its provide() scope.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Builds a typed AsyncLocalStorage context returning a use/provide pair: use() throws NotFound outside a scope, provide() runs a callback with the value active.

nodes.name: local-context.ts
nodes.summary: Creates typed AsyncLocalStorage-backed contexts with provide/use pairs, throwing NotFound when use() runs outside a provider — a lightweight alternative to Effect Context for call-scoped state.

nodes.name: todayTimeOrDateTime
nodes.summary: Formats a timestamp as time-only when it falls on today's date, otherwise as a locale date plus time — used for compact TUI list rendering.

nodes.name: duration
nodes.summary: Formats milliseconds into a human duration: fractional seconds under 10 seconds, then second, minute, hour, and day decompositions.

nodes.name: truncateMiddle
nodes.summary: Shortens a string to a maximum length by replacing its middle with an ellipsis, preserving both the head and tail.

nodes.name: locale.ts
nodes.summary: Locale-aware display formatting helpers for the TUI: time, date, and today-aware timestamps, compact numbers, human durations, left/right/middle truncation with ellipsis, titlecasing, and pluralization.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns (creating if needed) the per-key lock state: active reader count, writer flag, and FIFO waiter queues.

nodes.name: process
nodes.summary: Advances a key's lock queue once free: grants the next waiting writer first (preventing writer starvation), otherwise wakes all waiting readers, and deletes empty lock entries.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Acquires a shared read lock for a key, immediately unless a writer holds or is waiting, returning a Disposable that decrements the reader count and re-runs the queue on release.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Acquires an exclusive write lock for a key, immediately when no readers or writer are active, returning a Disposable that clears the writer flag and re-runs the queue on release.

nodes.name: lock.ts
nodes.summary: In-process async reader-writer lock keyed by string: allows multiple concurrent readers or a single writer, with writer-priority handoff to prevent starvation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the explicit-resource-management pattern: read() and write() return a Promise of a Disposable released via Symbol.dispose inside `using` blocks.

nodes.name: sniffAttachmentMime
nodes.summary: Detects an attachment's MIME type from magic bytes (gzip, PNG, JPEG, GIF, PDF, and RIFF-container types such as WEBP), falling back to the declared MIME when no signature matches.

nodes.name: media.ts
nodes.summary: MIME classification and magic-byte sniffing for message attachments: detects images, PDFs, and other media so the session layer knows what to inline versus attach.

nodes.name: named-schema-error.ts
nodes.summary: Factory for Schema-backed NamedError-shaped Error classes that keep the { name, data } wire format byte-identical to the legacy NamedError, so generated OpenAPI/SDK output stays stable while internals move to Effect Schema.
nodes.languageNotes: Bridges Effect Schema and zod through the @opencode-ai/core/effect-zod adapter so one field definition feeds both the zod wire schema and the Effect Schema used for HttpApi OpenAPI generation.

nodes.name: network.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny connectivity helpers: reports browser online status and detects whether an HTTP proxy is configured through HTTP(S)_PROXY environment variables.

nodes.name: opentui-lib.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves the native OpenTUI render library (libopentui.so/dylib/dll) for Bun --compile binaries, pointing the renderer at the real library shipped next to the executable instead of Bun's virtual bunfs path, and explicitly registers the spinner custom element.
nodes.languageNotes: Bun compiled binaries embed native libraries on a virtual filesystem the OS dynamic linker cannot dlopen; setRenderLibPath must be called before the renderer is created.

nodes.name: process.ts
nodes.summary: Cross-platform child process toolkit wrapping cross-spawn with abort-signal wiring, SIGTERM-to-SIGKILL escalation timeouts, output buffering, and Windows-aware taskkill stop semantics.
nodes.languageNotes: stop() shells out to taskkill /T /F on Windows because proc.kill() cannot terminate entire process trees there.

nodes.name: queue.ts
nodes.summary: Async queue primitive plus a bounded-concurrency worker pool for draining item lists in parallel.

nodes.name: record.ts
nodes.summary: Single type guard checking whether a value is a plain object record, excluding arrays and null.

nodes.name: repository.ts
nodes.summary: Parses and normalizes git repository references from URLs, SCP-style shortcuts, github: shorthand, bare host/path strings, and file:// paths into a validated Reference struct, deriving clone remotes and cache paths.
nodes.languageNotes: Every host and path segment passes safeHost/safeSegment checks (no whitespace, no ':' in segments, no leading dash, no dot-dot traversal) to prevent option injection into downstream git clone commands.

nodes.name: rpc.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal JSON postMessage RPC protocol for Web Workers: server-side listen()/emit() handlers and a client() factory returning typed call()/on() handles with promise correlation by request id.

nodes.name: scrap.ts
nodes.summary: Scratch module exporting dummy constants and stub functions; appears to be leftover scaffolding with no production consumers.

nodes.name: signal.ts
nodes.summary: One-shot latch built from an externally-resolvable Promise, exposing trigger() and wait() for lightweight synchronization.

nodes.name: timeout.ts
nodes.summary: Promise.race wrapper that rejects with a labeled error when a promise exceeds a time budget, clearing the timer once the promise settles.

nodes.name: token.ts
nodes.summary: Rough LLM token estimator using the 4-characters-per-token heuristic.

nodes.name: update-schema.ts
nodes.summary: Zod helper that clones a ZodObject making every field optional-and-nullable, used for PATCH-style partial update payloads.

nodes.name: which.ts
nodes.summary: Executable PATH lookup that prepends opencode's global bin directory to the search path, with Windows PATHEXT extension handling.

nodes.name: wildcard.ts
nodes.summary: Glob-style wildcard matcher underpinning the permission system, with a MAX_WILDCARDS=10 cap against ReDoS, backslash/slash normalization, optional trailing-argument patterns, and structured head/tail sequence matching for commands.
nodes.languageNotes: Patterns with more than 10 wildcards return false instead of throwing because permission-critical callers do not catch exceptions; trailing ' *' becomes an optional group so 'ls *' also matches bare 'ls'.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Architecture guide for the V2 session layer documenting the intended two-layer design — V2 reads project Drizzle tables directly while all writes delegate to V1 services — plus subagent permission fallbacks, model-ID brand casts, synthetic result posting, and event projection rules.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: V2 authentication service managing OAuth and API-key accounts in an auth-v2.json store, with automatic migration from the v1 flat credential map, per-service active-account tracking, and SynchronizedRef-guarded persistence written with 0o600 permissions.
nodes.languageNotes: State lives in an Effect SynchronizedRef so read-modify-write cycles are fiber-safe; every mutation persists the entire store via writeJson with 0o600 file mode, and OPENCODE_AUTH_CONTENT can inject state for tests.

nodes.name: event.ts
nodes.summary: Event definition factory pairing a wire Schema.Struct payload with a SyncEvent definition, stamping every V2 event with a branded ID, optional metadata, and an aggregate key.

nodes.name: model.ts
nodes.summary: V2 model catalog: branded ID types, provider/endpoint/capability/cost schemas, the Modelv2.Info class, and an in-memory HashMap-backed service offering get/add/remove/all with release-date ordering plus default and small-model lookups.
nodes.languageNotes: ProviderID uses withStatics to pre-brand well-known providers (anthropic, openai, google, bedrock, ...) as named constants on the schema itself.

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: Shared V2 schema transform converting epoch milliseconds to Effect DateTimeUtc on decode and back on encode, used as the timestamp convention across all V2 schemas.

nodes.name: session-event.ts
nodes.summary: Complete V2 session event taxonomy: 25 tagged event schemas (agent/model switched, prompted, synthetic, shell, step lifecycle, text/reasoning/tool streaming deltas, retried, compaction) defined via EventV2.define and unioned into the SessionEvent.All discriminated union.
nodes.languageNotes: Each event is both a wire payload schema and a SyncEvent definition; the oneOf union is piped through Schema.toTaggedUnion("type") so exhaustive matching works on the literal event type.

nodes.name: session-message-updater.ts
nodes.summary: Event-sourcing reducer folding SessionEvent streams into SessionMessage lists through an Adapter interface: memory() adapts in-memory state with hand-rolled backward scans, while update() dispatches all event types through immer produce drafts.
nodes.languageNotes: Hot paths use manual backward for-loops instead of findLastIndex to avoid GC pressure (Bolt optimization), and immer produce for structural sharing while mutating draft messages in place.

nodes.name: session-message.ts
nodes.summary: SessionMessage data model: the persisted message tagged union (user, assistant, synthetic, shell, compaction, agent/model-switched) plus tool lifecycle states and assistant content parts, reusing field schemas directly from SessionEvent definitions to stay in lockstep.
nodes.languageNotes: Field schemas are referenced cross-module (e.g. SessionEvent.Shell.Started.fields.data.fields.callID) so events and their projected messages can never drift apart.

nodes.name: session-prompt.ts
nodes.summary: Prompt input schemas for V2: text plus optional file attachments (uri, mime, optional source span) and agent attachments.

nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.summary: The V2 session service — a stable two-layer facade where reads (get/list/messages/context) query SessionTable and SessionMessageTable directly via Drizzle, while writes (create/prompt/shell/skill/subagent/compact) delegate to V1 services that own the agent loop; adds deferred prompt delivery and subagent orchestration with permission fallbacks and nesting limits.
nodes.languageNotes: V1 dependencies are captured with Effect.serviceOption so read-only consumers work without any V1 layer; the V1/V2 branded model-ID mismatch is centralized in the v2ModelToV1Session/v2ModelToV1Prompt cast helpers, and subagent results are posted back to the parent as Synthetic events rather than returned.

nodes.name: namedSchemaError
nodes.summary: Builds a NamedSchemaError class exposing both a zod wire schema and an Effect Schema for OpenAPI generation, with static isInstance() and instance toObject() preserving the legacy NamedError surface.

nodes.name: setupOpenTUILib
nodes.summary: Points @opentui/core at a bundled native library shipped next to the executable and registers the spinner renderable on the @opentui/solid instance, skipping both when no library is present and not running under Bun.

nodes.name: spawn
nodes.summary: Launches a child process via cross-spawn with abort-signal wiring and SIGTERM escalation to SIGKILL after a grace timeout, returning the process augmented with an exited promise.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Awaitable command execution that buffers stdout and stderr, with a nothrow fallback capturing the error message and RunFailedError raised on non-zero exit codes.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Terminates a child process, using taskkill /T /F on Windows so the entire process tree dies; duplicated in the SDK package to avoid an import cycle.

nodes.name: RunFailedError
nodes.summary: Error thrown when a command exits non-zero, carrying the command argv, exit code, and the captured stdout/stderr buffers for diagnostics.

nodes.name: work
nodes.summary: Runs an async function over a list with bounded concurrency by having N workers pop items from a shared pending list until it is exhausted.

nodes.name: AsyncQueue
nodes.summary: Unbounded async queue implementing AsyncIterable; parks consumers in pending resolver callbacks when the queue is empty and wakes them on push.

nodes.name: parseRepositoryReference
nodes.summary: Normalizes any repository string (github: shorthand, SCP-style user@host:path, bare host/path, full URL, or file:// URL) into a validated Reference or null, selecting the correct clone remote per host.

nodes.name: client
nodes.summary: Creates the calling side of the postMessage RPC protocol, correlating request ids to pending promises and dispatching rpc.event messages to subscribed handlers.

nodes.name: signal
nodes.summary: Creates a one-shot latch pairing a trigger() callback with the wait() promise it resolves.

nodes.name: withTimeout
nodes.summary: Races a promise against a timer, rejecting with a labeled timeout error and clearing the timer when the promise settles first.

nodes.name: updateSchema
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of a ZodObject with every field wrapped in nullable-optional, producing the schema shape for partial updates.

nodes.name: which
nodes.summary: Resolves a command name to its executable path by searching the caller's PATH plus opencode's global bin directory, honoring Windows PATHEXT extensions.

nodes.name: match
nodes.summary: Glob matcher compiling a wildcard pattern to an anchored regex, with slash normalization, case-insensitive matching on Windows, optional trailing ' *' argument groups, and a 10-wildcard cap that returns false to block ReDoS.

nodes.name: all
nodes.summary: Returns the value of the last matching pattern from a record, evaluating patterns sorted shortest-first so longer patterns win.

nodes.name: allStructured
nodes.summary: Matches a head/tail command structure against multi-token patterns, delegating tail matching to recursive sequence matching.

nodes.name: migrate
nodes.summary: Converts the v1 flat serviceID-to-credential map into the v2 accounts/active structure, assigning ascending account IDs to each decoded credential and marking it active for its service.

nodes.name: Account
nodes.summary: AuthV2 account schema class pairing a branded AccountID and ServiceID with a description and an OAuth or API-key credential.

nodes.name: define
nodes.summary: Event factory that combines a wire payload Schema.Struct (id, metadata, literal type, data fields) with a SyncEvent definition under one aggregate key and version.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Splits a provider-prefixed model string on its first slash into branded ProviderID and model ID parts.

nodes.name: Info
nodes.summary: Modelv2.Info schema class describing a catalog model: branded IDs, endpoint type, capabilities, options and variants, release time, cost tiers, status, and context/output limits.

nodes.name: memory
nodes.summary: Builds an in-memory Adapter over a mutable messages array, locating the active assistant, compaction, or shell message with backward scans and exposing append/update/finish operations.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Folds a single SessionEvent into the adapter's message state, exhaustively matching all 25 event types to append user/synthetic/shell/compaction messages and evolve assistant content parts (text, reasoning, tool state machine) via immer drafts.

nodes.name: User
nodes.summary: User message schema reusing the Prompt fields (text, files, agents) with creation time.

nodes.name: Shell
nodes.summary: Shell command message carrying callID, command, accumulated output, and completion time.

nodes.name: AssistantTool
nodes.summary: Tool-call content part with a lifecycle ToolState (pending to running to completed or error), provider metadata, and per-stage timestamps.

nodes.name: Assistant
nodes.summary: Assistant message aggregating streamed content parts (text, reasoning, tool calls), cost and token usage, snapshot markers, finish reason, and error detail.

nodes.name: Compaction
nodes.summary: Compaction marker message with reason, summary text, and an optional include span.

nodes.name: FileAttachment
nodes.summary: File attachment schema with uri, mime, optional name/description and source span, plus a static create() factory.

nodes.name: toV2Info
nodes.summary: Maps a V1 Session.Info to the V2 Info projection, converting epoch-millis timestamps to DateTime and rebuilding the branded Modelv2.Ref.

nodes.name: promptToParts
nodes.summary: Translates a V2 Prompt into V1 PromptInput parts (text, file, agent), a pure data transform since the V1 loop owns event emission.

nodes.name: v2ModelToV1Session
nodes.summary: Bridges a V2 Modelv2.Ref to the { id, providerID, variant } shape V1 Session.create expects, centralizing the unavoidable branded-type cast in one place.

nodes.name: v2ModelToV1Prompt
nodes.summary: Bridges a V2 Modelv2.Ref to the { modelID, providerID } shape V1 PromptInput.model and SessionCompaction.create expect, dropping the variant field.

nodes.name: Info
nodes.summary: V2 session projection of V1 Session.Info: session/parent/project/workspace IDs, agent, model ref, DateTime timestamps, title, and permission ruleset.

nodes.name: tool-output.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the Effect Schema content types for V2 tool output: TextContent and FileContent classes combined into a type-tagged Content union, plus a free-form Structured record schema.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Schema.Class generics pattern (`class X extends Schema.Class<X>(...)`) and Schema.toTaggedUnion to build a discriminated union keyed on the `type` literal.

nodes.name: TextContent
nodes.summary: Effect Schema class for plain-text tool output carrying a single `text` field tagged as type "text".

nodes.name: FileContent
nodes.summary: Effect Schema class for file-based tool output with uri, mime type, and optional display name, tagged as type "file".

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Effect service managing git worktrees for opencode projects: generates unique branch/directory names, creates and bootstraps worktrees (including project start-command execution), lists, removes (with fsmonitor shutdown and directory cleanup), and resets worktrees to the default branch including submodule sweeps. Also declares a NamedError taxonomy, worktree.ready/failed bus events, and app/default layer wiring.
nodes.languageNotes: Effect-gen layer pattern: the service implementation is a closure of `Effect.fn` generators returned via `Service.of(...)`, with `Context.Service` tag declaration and `Layer.provide` composition for dependency injection.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Effect Context.Service tag for the Worktree service, typed against the Interface contract (makeWorktreeInfo, createFromInfo, create, list, remove, reset).

nodes.name: failedRemoves
nodes.summary: Extracts directory paths from git `clean -ffdx` "warning: failed to remove ..." stderr lines so the sweep logic can prune locked entries and retry.

nodes.name: parseWorktreeList
nodes.summary: Parses `git worktree list --porcelain` output into entries of path and branch by folding lines starting with "worktree " and "branch ".

nodes.name: makeWorktreeInfo
nodes.summary: Validates the project is a git repo, creates the per-project worktree root under the global data directory, and delegates to the candidate generator to reserve a unique name/branch/directory triple.

nodes.name: boot
nodes.summary: Populates a freshly created worktree via `git reset --hard`, bootstraps an opencode instance in it through the instance store, emits worktree.ready/failed bus events, and runs project plus extra start scripts.

nodes.name: createFromInfo
nodes.summary: Sets up a worktree from prepared Info (branch creation and sandbox registration) then forks the boot sequence into the service scope so creation returns immediately.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Public create entry point: reserves a unique worktree name (or slugifies the requested one) and runs createFromInfo with the optional start command.

nodes.name: list
nodes.summary: Lists all non-primary git worktrees with canonicalized (case-normalized on Windows) directories and branch names, returning an empty list for non-git projects.

nodes.name: remove
nodes.summary: Removes a worktree: stops the fsmonitor daemon, runs `git worktree remove --force` with stale-entry verification, force-deletes the directory with retries, and deletes the associated branch.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Resets a worktree to the project's default branch: fetches the remote ref, hard-resets, sweeps untracked files (with a prune-and-retry pass for locked paths), recursively resets and cleans submodules, verifies a clean status, and re-runs start scripts.

nodes.name: sweep
nodes.summary: Runs `git clean -ffdx` and, when git reports paths it failed to remove, prunes those directories and retries the clean once.

nodes.name: sst-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated SST ambient type stub that pulls in the `sst` module types; required for the SST environment integration to typecheck.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Manifest for @opencode-ai/plugin exposing three source-TS entry points (root, ./tool, ./tui), with the SDK as a workspace dependency and the @opentui packages as optional peer dependencies so server-only plugins need no TUI toolchain.

nodes.name: publish.ts
nodes.summary: Publish script for @opencode-ai/plugin: typechecks with tsc, skips if the version already exists on npm, otherwise rewrites the exports map from ./src to ./dist paths, packs, publishes under the release channel tag, and restores package.json afterwards.
nodes.languageNotes: Mutates package.json in place before `bun pm pack` and restores the original text in a `finally` block, so the working tree is never left pointing at dist outputs.

nodes.name: example-workspace.ts
nodes.summary: Reference example of the experimental workspace adapter API: registers a "folder" workspace type that provisions blank directories under /tmp, with configure/create/remove/target lifecycle methods.

nodes.name: FolderWorkspacePlugin
nodes.summary: Plugin entry function that registers a folder-backed WorkspaceAdapter computing a random directory in configure, mkdir-ing it in create, rm-ing it in remove, and exposing it as a local workspace target.

nodes.name: example.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal plugin example demonstrating custom tool registration: returns a Hooks object with one zod-arg tool that echoes its input.

nodes.name: ExamplePlugin
nodes.summary: Plugin implementation that contributes a single custom tool ("mytool") defined via the tool() helper with a zod string argument and a greeting execute function.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: The public server plugin API for @opencode-ai/plugin: defines PluginInput (SDK client, project, Bun shell handle, workspace registry), the Plugin/Hooks contracts (event, config, tool, auth with OAuth/API prompt flows, provider models, chat.message/params/headers, permission.ask, tool.execute.before/after, shell.env, and experimental message/system/compaction transform hooks), and the WorkspaceAdapter interface. Also re-exports the tool helper.
nodes.languageNotes: Entirely a type-surface module: hooks use a mutable-`output` interception pattern where plugins mutate the output object in place rather than returning a new value.

nodes.name: shell.ts
nodes.summary: Hand-written type declarations mirroring Bun's shell API — the `$` template tag, BunShell, BunShellPromise, BunShellOutput, and BunShellError — so plugins get typed shell access (passed as `input.$`) without a hard dependency on bun-types.

nodes.name: tool.ts
nodes.summary: Custom-tool definition helper for plugins: the identity function tool() captures zod-arg inference for execute(), and the module exports ToolContext (session/agent/abort/metadata/ask) and ToolResult types.
nodes.languageNotes: The `tool()` function returns its input unchanged purely for type inference, and exposes `tool.schema = z` so examples can define args without a separate zod import.

nodes.name: tool
nodes.summary: Identity helper that types a plugin tool definition (description, zod args shape, async execute receiving inferred args and a ToolContext) and returns it unchanged.

nodes.name: tui.ts
nodes.summary: The public TUI plugin API for @opencode-ai/plugin: re-exports OpenTUI renderer/keymap primitives and declares the full TuiPluginApi surface — dialogs (alert/confirm/prompt/select), slot registration, theme and KV stores, session state views, keymap and route registration, toasts, plugin lifecycle management, and the deprecated v1 command API. Consumed by TUI extension authors via the package's ./tui export.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines a curated re-export barrel over @opentui/core, @opentui/keymap, and @opentui/keymap/extras with a large hand-maintained type surface; the `Frozen<T>` recursive mapped type makes the whole TUI config view deeply readonly.

nodes.name: createBindingLookup
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper that instantiates the @opentui/keymap binding lookup for the TUI's Renderable/KeyEvent types, defaulting to an empty config.

nodes.name: sst-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated SST ambient type stub that pulls in the `sst` module types for the plugin package.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for @opencode-ai/plugin extending @tsconfig/node22: compiles src/ to dist/ with declarations, nodenext module resolution, and DOM libs (for the OpenTUI-facing types).

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Manifest for @opencode-ai/script, the shared release-tooling helper package: depends only on semver and exports its source entry directly.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Shared release-scripting helpers: validates the running Bun version against the root packageManager field, derives the release channel (latest vs preview branch), computes the next npm version via registry lookup or major/minor/patch bump, loads the team members allowlist from .github/TEAM_MEMBERS, and exports everything as the Script singleton used by all package publish scripts.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses top-level await with IIFE async functions to compute channel/version at import time, exposed through getter properties on the exported Script object.

nodes.name: sst-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated SST ambient type stub that pulls in the `sst` module types for the script package.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for @opencode-ai/script extending @tsconfig/bun with ESNext and DOM libs, relaxing noUncheckedIndexedAccess for the script's index arithmetic.

nodes.name: example.ts
nodes.summary: SDK usage example that boots a local opencode server via createOpencode(), then creates one session per file matched by a glob and prompts the agent to write tests for every public function in each file.

nodes.name: build.ts
nodes.summary: SDK generator script: runs `bun dev generate` in the opencode package to emit openapi.json, generates the v2 TypeScript types and fetch client via @hey-api/openapi-ts into src/v2/gen, patches the generated client's data-style error return and TData|undefined types, then compiles with tsc into dist/.
nodes.languageNotes: Post-generation patching via exact string replace on the generated client.gen.ts/types.gen.ts is load-bearing: regenerating without it reintroduces the `undefined`-return bug in the data response style.

nodes.name: publish.ts
nodes.summary: Publish script for @opencode-ai/sdk: skips already-published versions, recursively rewrites the exports map from ./src to ./dist import/types pairs, packs and publishes under the release channel tag, and restores package.json in a finally block.

nodes.name: transformExports
nodes.summary: Recursively maps a package.json exports object, converting string ./src/*.ts paths to { import: .js, types: .d.ts } dist entries while preserving nested condition objects.

nodes.name: error-interceptor.ts
nodes.summary: Error normalization for the SDK client: wraps decoded non-2xx POJO bodies into real Error instances with useful messages (NamedError-shaped data.message first) when callers opt into throwOnError, preserving the parsed body and status under .cause, while leaving the result-tuple error path untouched.

nodes.name: wrapClientError
nodes.summary: Interceptor that converts object/string error bodies into Error instances with the best available message (data.message, message, name, or a request/response description), falling back to an explicit empty-body/network-error message.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Root entry of @opencode-ai/sdk: re-exports the entire v2 surface plus the data namespace, and provides createOpencode() which boots a local server and returns a connected client pair.

nodes.name: createOpencode
nodes.summary: Convenience factory that starts a local opencode server (createOpencodeServer) and returns it bundled with a client pointed at the server's URL.

nodes.name: process.ts
nodes.summary: Child-process lifecycle helpers for the SDK: stop() kills process trees cross-platform (taskkill /T /F on Windows) and bindAbort() ties an AbortSignal to process termination with listener cleanup on exit/error. Duplicated from the opencode package to avoid a workspace dependency cycle.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Terminates a child process if still running, using Windows taskkill with tree-kill semantics before falling back to proc.kill().

nodes.name: bindAbort
nodes.summary: Registers an abort handler that stops the process and invokes a callback, with symmetric listener removal on either abort or process exit/error, and immediate firing if the signal is already aborted.

nodes.name: client.ts
nodes.summary: V2 SDK client factory: wraps the generated hey-api client with a no-timeout fetch, directory/workspace header injection, a request interceptor that moves those headers into query params for GET/HEAD requests, an HTML-response guard against version-mismatched servers, and error wrapping via wrapClientError.
nodes.languageNotes: Header-to-query-param rewriting lets GET requests stay cacheable/bookmarkable while POSTs keep routing context in headers; the pick() helper tolerates both raw and encodeURIComponent forms of the fallback.

nodes.name: rewrite
nodes.summary: Request interceptor that, for GET/HEAD only, copies the x-opencode-directory and x-opencode-workspace headers into directory/workspace query params (when absent) and strips the headers from the rewritten request.

nodes.name: createOpencodeClient
nodes.summary: Constructs the OpencodeClient from the generated SDK: installs a timeout-free default fetch, encodes directory and workspace targeting headers, then registers the rewrite, HTML-detection, and wrapClientError interceptors.

nodes.name: data.ts
nodes.summary: SDK data helpers for fabricating user messages locally: message.user() assembles a UserMessage info plus fully-linked parts, filling in placeholder IDs, timestamps, and session/message back-references.

nodes.name: message.user
nodes.summary: Builds a user message pair from stripped input: assigns a placeholder id and created time to the UserMessage and stamps each part with id, messageID, and sessionID back-references.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Entry point of the SDK v2 surface that re-exports the generated client and server modules, and provides the createOpencode factory that boots a local opencode server and returns a client wired to its URL.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `export *` barrel re-exports plus a composed factory function, so the v2 namespace (client, server, data) is consumable from a single import.

nodes.name: server.ts
nodes.summary: Process-management helpers for the SDK that spawn the `opencode` CLI: createOpencodeServer launches `opencode serve`, parses the listening URL from stdout with timeout/abort handling, and createOpencodeTui launches the interactive TUI with project/model/session/agent flags.
nodes.languageNotes: Config is injected via the OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT environment variable (JSON-serialized) instead of CLI flags, and server readiness is detected by scanning stdout for the `opencode server listening` banner.

nodes.name: sst-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated SST ambient type declaration that pulls in the `sst` module's environment typing for the SDK package.

nodes.name: main.ts
nodes.summary: Storybook server configuration for the component workshop: selects the storybook-solidjs-vite framework and addons, globs stories from packages/ui, and in viteFinal wires Tailwind plus a resolve-alias table that swaps every packages/app context import (`@/context/*`, `@/hooks/use-providers`, `@/components/dialog-select-model*`, `@solidjs/router`) for the lightweight mocks under .storybook/mocks.
nodes.languageNotes: Regex-anchored alias entries (`/^@\/context\/local$/`) shadow the catch-all `{ find: "@", replacement: app }` alias, so mock substitutions win over real app modules while unrelated `@/...` imports still resolve to packages/app/src.

nodes.name: manager.ts
nodes.summary: Storybook manager-side script that registers the opencode theme-toggle toolbar tool (rendered by ThemeTool) for story and docs view modes.

nodes.name: dialog-select-model-unpaid.tsx
nodes.summary: Stub replacing the app's unpaid-model dialog with a static placeholder div so stories can render without the real billing UI.

nodes.name: dialog-select-model.tsx
nodes.summary: Mock of the app's ModelSelectorPopover that renders any passed trigger component with its props and children, decoupling stories from the real model-picker dialog.

nodes.name: command.ts

nodes.name: comments.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app comments context backed by module-level Solid signals, providing in-memory list/replace/remove/clear plus focus and active setters for comment-driven stories.

nodes.name: file.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app file context exposing tab-path helpers and a case-insensitive fuzzy search over a static pool of five source paths, standing in for real filesystem access in stories.

nodes.name: global-sync.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app global-sync context wrapping a Solid store with a static anthropic provider listing and per-session todo setters, simulating cross-window state sync for stories.

nodes.name: language.ts
nodes.summary: Mock i18n context for the app language module: hardcodes the `en` locale, serves a ~55-entry English dictionary covering prompt/command/dialog strings, and renders `{{param}}` template substitutions.

nodes.name: layout.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app layout context providing signal-backed tab open/activate tracking, a review panel visibility flag, and no-op fileTree/handoff setters for layout-dependent stories.

nodes.name: local.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app local context offering signal-backed agent selection over a build/review/plan list and a Claude 3.7 Sonnet model with fast/thinking variants.

nodes.name: permission.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app permission context tracking auto-accept toggles in a module-level Set keyed by directory+sessionID, with autoResponds always disabled.

nodes.name: platform.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app platform context typed against the real `Platform` interface from packages/app/src/context/platform, returning a web platform with no-op navigation/notifications and a passthrough markdown parser.

nodes.name: prompt.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app prompt context: defines the ContentPart/Prompt types (text, file, agent, image), and manages a signal-backed prompt buffer with cursor position plus a context-item list supporting add/remove and comment update/replace operations.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level `createSignal` state means every story shares one prompt store; `withKey` assigns monotonic `ctx:N` keys to context items so comment updates can be keyed.

nodes.name: sdk.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app SDK context returning a stub client whose session/prompt/shell/command/abort and worktree methods resolve immediately, pointed at a fake localhost:4096 server URL.

nodes.name: sync.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app sync context exposing a Solid store pre-shaped for sessions, permissions, questions, session diffs, messages, session status, agents, and commands, with no-op optimistic session helpers.

nodes.name: use-providers.ts
nodes.summary: Mock of the app useProviders hook returning a single static anthropic provider with Claude 3.7 Sonnet across all/default/connected/paid/popular listings.

nodes.name: solid-router.tsx
nodes.summary: Module mock for @solidjs/router that replaces routing hooks with fixed story values (dir slug, story-session id) and turns MemoryRouter/Route into children passthroughs so app components render outside a real router.

nodes.name: playground-css-plugin.ts
nodes.summary: Vite dev-server plugin exposing POST /__playground/apply-css, which lets the timeline playground write CSS property edits back into packages/ui/src/components source files by anchoring on a marker string and replacing the next `prop: value;` occurrence.
nodes.languageNotes: Guards against path traversal by resolving each edit target and requiring it to stay under the components root; writes only proceed when at least one edit in a file succeeded.

nodes.name: preview.tsx
nodes.summary: Storybook preview runtime for the workshop: registers docs/a11y addons and a JSX decorator that wraps every story in MetaProvider, Font, ThemeProvider, DialogProvider, and MarkedProvider, with a Scheme component syncing the toolbar theme global to light/dark root classes.
nodes.languageNotes: Theme changes propagate through the Storybook addon channel's GLOBALS_UPDATED event, bridging the manager-side toolbar toggle to SolidJS effects that set `document.documentElement` classes.

nodes.name: theme-tool.ts
nodes.summary: React toolbar component for the Storybook manager that toggles the global `theme` value between light and dark via a ToggleButton.
nodes.languageNotes: The manager UI is React-based while stories are SolidJS, so this tool uses React's createElement rather than Solid JSX.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Workspace manifest for the @opencode-ai/storybook package defining the storybook dev/build scripts and devDependencies, including the @opencode-ai/ui workspace dependency, Storybook 10 addons, and the storybook-solidjs-vite framework.

nodes.name: createOpencode
nodes.summary: Convenience factory that starts a local opencode server and returns a client bound to the server's resolved URL, giving one-call access to a fully wired SDK instance.

nodes.name: createOpencodeServer
nodes.summary: Spawns `opencode serve` with hostname/port/log-level options, awaits the `opencode server listening` stdout banner to resolve the server URL, and enforces startup timeout, abort-signal, and exit-error rejection with captured process output.

nodes.name: createOpencodeTui
nodes.summary: Launches the interactive opencode TUI as an inherited-stdio child process with optional project/model/session/agent flags and returns a close handle honoring an abort signal.

nodes.name: viteFinal
nodes.summary: Storybook's Vite config hook: merges in the Tailwind and playground-css plugins, dedupes solid-js packages, installs the alias table redirecting app contexts and router imports to the .storybook/mocks stubs, and opens the dev-server FS allowlist to the ui/app/mocks directories.

nodes.name: applyEdits
nodes.summary: Applies a sequence of anchored CSS edits to file content: for each edit it locates the anchor string, regex-matches the next `prop: value;` occurrence after it, and splices in the replacement, collecting per-edit ok/error results.

nodes.name: playgroundCss
nodes.summary: Vite plugin factory that installs a middleware handling POST /__playground/apply-css: validates the JSON edit payload, groups edits by file under the components root (rejecting path escapes), applies them via applyEdits, and writes changed files back to disk.

nodes.name: Scheme
nodes.summary: Headless Solid component that applies the selected color scheme to the shared theme, keeps the document root's light/dark class in sync via effects, and listens for Storybook GLOBALS_UPDATED events so toolbar theme changes take effect live.

nodes.name: ThemeTool
nodes.summary: React toolbar control that reads the `theme` global and flips it between light and dark through updateGlobals, rendering its active state in a ToggleButton.

nodes.name: usePrompt
nodes.summary: Mock prompt hook exposing the shared prompt/cursor/item signals with set/reset/dirty operations and a context sub-API for adding, removing, and updating file context items and their comments.

nodes.name: isPromptEqual
nodes.summary: Structural equality check for two prompts that compares lengths and JSON-serializes each part pairwise, used to compute the dirty flag against DEFAULT_PROMPT.

nodes.name: selectionFromLines
nodes.summary: Converts a simple line range into a full FileSelection with zeroed character offsets, mirroring the app's line-to-selection coercion for file context items.

nodes.name: useFile
nodes.summary: Mock file hook providing tab/path conversion helpers, a load stub, and case-insensitive substring search over the static file pool.

nodes.name: useComments
nodes.summary: Mock comments hook exposing the shared signal store with replace/remove/clear list mutations and direct focus/active signal access.

nodes.name: useLocal
nodes.summary: Mock local hook exposing agent list/current/set selection over build/review/plan and a model API with fast/thinking variant switching backed by shared signals.

nodes.name: usePermission
nodes.summary: Mock permission hook implementing auto-accept toggling per session+directory key in a module-level Set, with autoResponds permanently false.

nodes.name: sst-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated SST environment type declaration for the Storybook package, chaining to the monorepo root sst-env.d.ts via a triple-slash reference and importing the `sst` module for its ambient types.

nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the Storybook package, extending @tsconfig/node22 with SolidJS JSX preserve mode, bundler module resolution, and strict mode, scoped to the .storybook/*.ts(x) files only.

nodes.name: junit.xml

nodes.summary: Animates a single digit column rolling from its previous value to the next using store-driven spin state with settled-state cleanup.

nodes.languageNotes: Statically imports ~16 SVG/PNG assets so the bundler inlines only the referenced icons; dark variants are chosen via a MutationObserver-style scheme sync on mount.

nodes.name: AppIcon
nodes.summary: Renders the named app icon asset, tracking light/dark color-scheme changes through a media-query observer to swap variant assets at runtime.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Generated constant listing the available app icon names (vscode, cursor, zed, ghostty, warp, ...) that backs the IconName union type consumed by AppIcon.
nodes.languageNotes: Auto-generated by the icon spritesheet generator; the IconName union is derived from the const array via typeof indexing.

nodes.name: apply-patch-file.ts

nodes.languageNotes: Defensive unknown-shape parsing: every field is narrowed by typeof checks before constructing the strongly typed result.

nodes.name: patchFile
nodes.summary: Validates a raw apply_patch record and normalizes it into an ApplyPatchFile whose ViewDiff is produced by session-diff's normalize().

nodes.name: patchFiles
nodes.summary: Maps an array of raw records through patchFile in parallel via Promise.all, dropping entries that fail validation.

nodes.summary: Individual tab button with active styling, an optional close button, middle-click close, and arrow-key focus movement between sibling tabs.

nodes.name: TabsContent
nodes.summary: Panel whose children render only while its tab value is the active one.

nodes.name: tag.tsx
nodes.summary: Small styled tag/label span accepting size and tone variants for inline metadata chips.

nodes.name: Tag
nodes.summary: Renders a compact label span with tone and size data attributes driven by props.

nodes.name: text-field.tsx
nodes.summary: Text input wrapping Kobalte TextField with optional copy-to-clipboard and password-reveal actions, validation states, and localized labels.

nodes.name: TextField
nodes.summary: Renders a labeled text field supporting copy and password-reveal icon actions with copied-state feedback, disabled/read-only modes, and error/description slots.

nodes.name: text-reveal.tsx
nodes.summary: Animated text-swap component that measures incoming and outgoing text widths and cross-fades/slides between them using clip-path and animated container width.

nodes.name: TextReveal
nodes.summary: Cross-fades between old and new text values: measures both strings with canvas metrics, animates the container width between them, and re-measures once web fonts finish loading.

nodes.name: text-shimmer.tsx
nodes.summary: Shimmering text effect that sweeps a gradient highlight across the string once per activation using a CSS background-clip animation.

nodes.name: TextShimmer
nodes.summary: Renders text with a one-shot gradient shimmer that re-triggers on content change, gated by an active flag and cleaned up on dispose.

nodes.name: text-strikethrough.tsx
nodes.summary: Animated strikethrough that draws a line across text left-to-right driven by a spring, using dual stacked spans with complementary clip-paths.
nodes.languageNotes: Renders the text twice in a CSS grid stack and animates complementary clip-path insets driven by a spring progress value, so the plain and struck-through copies reveal in opposite directions.

nodes.name: TextStrikethrough
nodes.summary: Animates a strikethrough by measuring text and container widths with a resize observer and clipping two stacked copies of the text against spring-driven revealed pixels.

nodes.name: toast.tsx
nodes.summary: Toast notification system built on Kobalte Toast: compound UI pieces (region, root, icon, title, actions, progress) plus showToast/showPromiseToast helpers with action buttons and progress bars.

nodes.name: ToastRoot
nodes.summary: Styled toast surface applying data-variant tone attributes on top of Kobalte's Toast.Root.

nodes.name: ToastCloseButton
nodes.summary: Icon-only toast dismiss button with a localized aria-label.

nodes.name: showToast
nodes.summary: Shows a toast through the shared Kobalte toaster, mapping variant to icon, wiring action buttons to auto-dismiss after click, and configuring duration with a progress bar.

nodes.name: showPromiseToast
nodes.summary: Wraps toaster.promise to show loading, success, and error toasts around a promise, deriving icons and durations per state with an optional fallback loading message.

nodes.name: tool-count-label.tsx
nodes.summary: Animated singular/plural count label that splits ICU-style {{count}} templates, computes the common stem between the one/other forms, and animates only the differing suffix.
nodes.languageNotes: Splits ICU-style plural templates (one/other) around the {{count}} placeholder and animates only the suffix that differs between forms, keeping the numeric part in an AnimatedNumber.

nodes.name: common
nodes.summary: Computes the longest common character prefix between two plural-form strings, returning the shared stem plus both remainders.

nodes.name: AnimatedCountLabel
nodes.summary: Renders before-text, an AnimatedNumber, and a word stem with an animated singular/plural suffix swap derived from the one/other i18n templates and the current count.

nodes.name: tool-count-summary.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a comma-joined list of animated count labels with enter/exit transitions and per-item width animation.

nodes.name: AnimatedCountList
nodes.summary: Maps visible count items to AnimatedCountLabel rows with an empty-state fallback and animated join transitions between items.

nodes.name: tool-error-card.tsx
nodes.summary: Collapsible error card for tool failures: decodes known error keys, maps provider error strings to a title/subtitle pair, and offers copy-to-clipboard.

nodes.name: ToolErrorCard
nodes.summary: Renders a tool error as an expandable card with localized name/subtitle derived from the error key and message, plus copy and expand/collapse actions.

nodes.name: tool-status-title.tsx
nodes.summary: Animates the transition between a tool call's active and done status titles, splitting the shared text prefix so only the differing tail swaps, with measured width transitions and shimmer styling.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a first-render/last-render width measurement around a requestAnimationFrame flip to animate the swap via an inline width style rather than CSS keyframes.

nodes.name: common
nodes.summary: Computes the longest shared prefix between the active and done status texts, returning the prefix plus the diverging active and done tails so only the differing tail animates.

nodes.name: ToolStatusTitle
nodes.summary: Renders the tool status label that cross-fades between active and done states, choosing between suffix-split mode and full swap mode, and animating width changes with requestAnimationFrame so the shimmer text doesn't jump.

nodes.name: tooltip.tsx
nodes.summary: Tooltip components wrapping Kobalte's tooltip with interaction suppression - tooltips stay closed while clicking, keyboard-activating, or when the trigger hosts an expanded popover tracked via MutationObserver.

nodes.name: TooltipKeybind
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that renders a Tooltip whose content pairs a title with a highlighted keyboard shortcut chip.

nodes.name: Tooltip
nodes.summary: Wraps Kobalte's tooltip with trigger-interaction state: arms a block on pointer-down or Enter/Space activation, suppresses re-open after trigger clicks, and stays closed while the trigger contains an expanded element observed for aria-expanded/data-expanded changes.

nodes.name: typewriter.tsx
nodes.summary: Typewriter effect component that reveals text with randomized per-character delays (with occasional long pauses) and a blinking cursor, rendered through a configurable dynamic element tag.

nodes.name: Typewriter
nodes.summary: Reveals text character by character with randomized keystroke delays, showing a blinking cursor that disappears two seconds after typing completes; all pending timeouts are cleared on cleanup.

nodes.name: data.tsx
nodes.summary: Defines the shared Data context exposing the SDK-backed store of sessions, messages, and parts (plus directory and session-navigation callbacks) consumed across UI components.

nodes.name: dialog.tsx
nodes.summary: Implements the modal dialog context: a single active Kobalte dialog rendered in a stack, with capture-phase Escape handling, a re-entrancy lock, a 100ms closing delay before root disposal, and owner-aware dialog creation.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Builds the dialog context value: a single active-dialog signal with Escape-to-close capture listener, re-entrancy locking, and immediate disposal of any prior dialog when a new one is shown.

nodes.name: DialogProvider
nodes.summary: Provides the dialog context and renders the active dialog node inside a `dialog-stack` container beneath the children.

nodes.name: useDialog
nodes.summary: Consumes the dialog context, capturing the caller's SolidJS owner so dialogs render under the invoking component's reactive root and chain ownership when a dialog is already active.

nodes.name: file.tsx
nodes.summary: Tiny context allowing hosts to override which ValidComponent is used to render files in the UI.

nodes.name: helper.tsx
nodes.summary: Provides createSimpleContext, the factory every UI context uses to build typed provider/use pairs with optional readiness gating before children render.

nodes.name: createSimpleContext
nodes.summary: Factory that builds a typed provider/use context pair from an init function; gates children rendering on the context value's reactive `ready` flag and throws a named error when `use` runs outside a provider.

nodes.name: i18n.tsx
nodes.summary: Defines the UI i18n context with an English-dictionary fallback and `{{param}}` template interpolation, exposed through I18nProvider and useI18n; UiI18nKey is derived from the English dictionary's shape.

nodes.name: I18nProvider
nodes.summary: Provides the UiI18n value (locale accessor plus `t` translation function) to the component tree.

nodes.name: useI18n
nodes.summary: Returns the nearest UiI18n context, falling back to English-dictionary translation when no provider is mounted.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the context modules (helper, data, file, dialog, i18n).

nodes.name: marked.tsx
nodes.summary: Markdown rendering context: registers the custom OpenCode Shiki theme (CSS-variable syntax colors), wires marked with KaTeX math and Shiki highlighting extensions, and when a native parser is supplied post-processes its HTML with math rendering and code-block highlighting.
nodes.languageNotes: The OpenCode theme maps TextMate scopes to CSS custom properties (var(--syntax-*)) so highlighting follows runtime theme changes without re-instantiating Shiki; ~370 of the 519 lines are the theme registration.

nodes.name: renderMathInText
nodes.summary: Renders `$$...$$` display and `$...$` inline LaTeX in a text string to KaTeX HTML, falling back to the raw delimiter-wrapped text on render errors.

nodes.name: renderMathExpressions
nodes.summary: Applies math rendering to rendered HTML while leaving pre/code/kbd contents untouched by splitting on code-block boundaries and only processing the non-code parts.

nodes.name: highlightCodeBlocks
nodes.summary: Post-processes rendered markdown HTML by unescaping and re-highlighting each fenced code block through the shared Shiki highlighter with the OpenCode theme, lazily loading languages and defaulting unknown ones to plain text.

nodes.name: worker-pool.tsx
nodes.summary: Context providing the shared diff-rendering worker pools (unified and split) and a hook that selects the pool matching the requested diff style.

nodes.name: useWorkerPool
nodes.summary: Returns the diff WorkerPoolManager matching the requested diff style, choosing the split pool only for "split" and the unified pool otherwise.

nodes.name: custom-elements.d.ts
nodes.summary: Ambient JSX declaration registering the @pierre/diffs `<diffs-container>` custom element on SolidJS's IntrinsicElements so the web component typechecks in .tsx files.

nodes.name: create-auto-scroll.tsx
nodes.summary: Auto-scroll hook implementing bottom-follow behavior for streaming UIs: distinguishes programmatic scrolls from user scrolls via a timestamped mark, pauses on upward wheel or text selection, stays aware of nested scrollable regions, and manages overflow-anchor dynamically.
nodes.languageNotes: A `markAuto` timestamp+scrollTop snapshot lets the scroll handler recognize async-dispatched scroll events caused by its own scrollTo calls, preventing false user-scroll detection while content streams in.

nodes.name: createAutoScroll
nodes.summary: Keeps a scroll container pinned to the bottom while `working()` is true or content is settling: tracks user scrolls, ignores self-initiated scrolls, resumes following when the user returns near the bottom, and exposes ref setters plus scroll/pause/resume controls.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the hooks modules (use-filtered-list, create-auto-scroll).

nodes.name: use-filtered-list.tsx
nodes.summary: Fuzzy-filterable list hook combining fuzzysort search, Remeda grouping/sorting pipelines, and solid-list keyboard navigation for select-style dialogs; supports both static arrays and async filter functions.
nodes.languageNotes: Filtering runs inside a createResource so function-valued (async) item sources stay reactive with grouped output - replacing it with createMemo previously broke List-based dialogs; the flat/keys memos use manual pre-allocated loops to reduce GC pressure.

nodes.name: useFilteredList
nodes.summary: Builds a resource-backed list controller: filters items with fuzzysort (string arrays or keyed objects), groups and sorts the results, wires solid-list active-item tracking, and handles Enter-to-select plus ctrl+n/ctrl+p navigation while skipping macOS text-editing shortcuts.
